011230.text: Samwha Electronics develops and makes ferrite cores, supplying magnetic materials for eco-friendly vehicle electronics, AI data-center power equipment, semiconductor process equipment and EMI/EMC products for home appliances. It belongs to the Samwha capacitor group and has subsidiaries including one in China. Founded in 1976, it listed on the KOSPI in 1987.

011280.text: Tailim Packaging makes corrugated board and boxes at plants across Korea. Its subsidiaries make containerboard and provide freight transport, giving it a vertically integrated chain from base paper to finished boxes and delivery. Founded in 1976, it listed on the KOSPI in 1988.

011300.text: Woosung Materials makes and exports polyester-based fabrics for sportswear, functional clothing and fashion apparel. It sells under its own STARTEX, SOFSIL and SOFTAMIS brands and also produces on an OEM basis for global customers. Founded in 1976, it listed on the KOSPI in 1995.

011320.text: Unick supplies electronic, drivetrain, control and electrification parts to carmakers in Korea and abroad. It runs two research centers working on combustion-engine, eco-friendly and self-driving vehicle technology, and operates sites in Korea, China and India, including a newly established Indian unit. It listed on the KOSDAQ in 1993.

011330.text: Unichem makes automotive interior materials and supplies domestic carmakers. It has developed domestically made flame-retardant seat materials for the KTX EMU-320 train, and is expanding into eco-friendly leather and smart leather solutions for future mobility and robots. It also has an entertainment division. Founded in 1976, it listed in 1989.

011370.text: Seohan is a general construction company working in housing, civil engineering, building and property leasing, with a focus on public-sector projects. Housing it builds for sale makes up 49.1% of sales, and it won the first turnkey project in its region. Founded in 1971, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 1994.

011390.text: Busan Industrial runs 6 business segments, including ready-mixed concrete, concrete railway sleepers, tunnel segments, precast building components and cement bags. Its tunnel segment business, which supplies subways and tunnels, is the market leader with an 85% share. It also supplies precast parts to large logistics centers and housing sites. Founded in 1976, it listed in 1990 and has two subsidiaries.

011420.text: Galaxia SM provides advertising services specialised in apartment sales campaigns and distributes premium fitness equipment as the exclusive Korean distributor for an Italian brand. It recently acquired a 51% stake in another company to find new growth. Founded in 1975, it listed on the KOSPI in 1989 and joined a large business group in 2011.

011500.text: Hannong Chemicals makes fine chemicals such as glycol ethers (GE), surfactants (EOA) and specialty industrial emulsifiers (EM), supplying semiconductor cleaning agents and the electronics, cosmetics and automotive industries. It started with agricultural chemical raw materials and is raising the share of advanced products such as FM and glymes. Founded in 1976, it listed on the KOSPI in 2003.

011560.text: Sebo Manufacturing Engineering is a specialty contractor focused on mechanical systems, with facilities, plant, overseas and manufacturing divisions, and works with large domestic builders. It introduced the PFP method for the first time in Korea and automated CAD/CAM facilities. Founded in 1978 to build semiconductor production facilities, it was the first in its industry to list on the KOSDAQ, in 1996.

0115H0.text: Samsung Special Purpose Acquisition 13 is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

011690.text: Y2 Solution develops and makes power supply units (PSUs), including high-output PSUs for OLED and QNED TVs, and also runs bio-energy and robotics businesses. It is developing power modules for EV fast chargers, ESL solutions and a cell therapy for macular degeneration as new growth areas. Founded in 1976, it listed on the KOSPI in 1995.

011700.text: Hanshin Machinery makes piston and screw air compressors and is the only listed company in the air compressor industry. It developed an oil-free air compressor in 1985 and obtained ISO 8573 CLASS 0 certification for a model line in 2018. Founded in 1969, it incorporated in 1976, listed on the Korea Exchange in 1987 and set up a Chinese unit in 2001.

011760.text: Hyundai is a general trading company dealing in steel, cars, ships, construction equipment and chemicals. Its operations include import and export, trade between third countries, overseas resource development, logistics and investment, and it is investing in manufacturers and eco-friendly businesses. Founded in 1976, it took its current name in 2021 and has 36 unlisted subsidiaries.

011780.text: Kumho Petro Chemical makes synthetic rubber, synthetic resins, fine chemicals, CNTs and building materials, and runs an energy business. Synthetic rubber accounts for 62.8% of sales and synthetic resins for 24.7%. It is reviewing overseas production sites and pursuing greenhouse gas reduction. Founded in 1976, it listed in 1988 and has 20 subsidiaries.

011790.text: SKC is an SK Group materials company. It makes battery copper foil for rechargeable batteries, chemicals such as PO and PG, and semiconductor materials including test sockets and glass substrates. In 2025 it sold its CMP and thin-film businesses and absorbed an affiliate to simplify its structure. Founded in 1973, it listed on the KOSPI in 1997.

0117P0.text: Piece Peace Studio runs contemporary lifestyle fashion brands, including the designer brand Mardi Mercredi, and has expanded from womenswear into athleisure, kids and shoes. It sells mainly through its own online store and flagship stores and is expanding overseas, with subsidiaries including a unit in Shanghai. It was founded in 2020 to make and sell clothing.

011810.text: STX is a trading company focused on energy, raw materials, and machinery and engines, including steel and non-ferrous metal imports and exports. Through subsidiaries it makes industrial valves, provides aircraft maintenance and runs a resort, and it operates a digital platform called TrollyGo. It was founded in 1976 and has 14 consolidated subsidiaries.

011930.text: Shinsung E&G makes and installs cleanroom equipment for the semiconductor, display and bio industries, and also supplies dehumidifying systems for battery dry rooms, solar modules and solar power EPC. It has overseas units in 11 countries, including the US, China, Indonesia and Poland. Founded in 1977, it listed on the KOSPI in 1996 and has 20 unlisted subsidiaries.

012030.text: DB is a DB Group IT services company providing systems integration and IT outsourcing for the financial, manufacturing, service and public sectors. It also trades chemicals and steel products, supplies and maintains information security solutions, and manages the DB trademark, collecting royalties. Founded in 1977, it listed on the KOSPI in 1993.

0120G0.text: Samyang Biopharm makes medical devices such as biodegradable surgical sutures and absorbable haemostats, and drugs including treatments for solid and blood cancers. Its drug development unit uses its own SENS delivery platform for gene therapies, with more than 10 delivery systems. It was created by a spin-off in 2025 and relisted on the KOSPI.

012160.text: Youngwire makes and sells steel wire rod products. With its subsidiaries, including a KOSDAQ-listed maker of cold-heading wire, it works in steel, cold-heading quality wire and steel bars, automotive coil and leaf springs, logistics, packaging materials and AI services. Founded in 1977, it listed on the KOSPI in 2010.

012170.text: Ascendio is an entertainment company that invests in, produces and distributes films, develops and produces dramas, and runs performances and exhibitions. It filed for court receivership in 2019 because of capital impairment and a cash shortage, exited in 2020 and diversified into new businesses. Founded in 1977, it listed on the KOSPI in 1989 and took its current name in 2021.

012200.text: Keyang Electric Machinery has industrial products and automotive electronics segments. The first makes power tools, small engines and industrial tools, while the second makes vehicle motors such as power seat and electronic parking brake motors, a business it entered in 1987. Founded in 1977 to make power tools, it listed on the KOSPI in 1988.

012210.text: Sammi Metal Products makes closed-die forgings and has the largest hammer in Korea, including the country's only 50-ton hammer. It supplies forgings for commercial vehicles, heavy equipment and ship engines, and has supplied front axles and steering knuckles for a domestic carmaker's commercial vehicles for 40 years. Founded in 1977, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

012280.text: Yeonghwa Metal makes and sells cast materials for auto parts and runs 4 plants. It absorbed a wholly owned subsidiary in 2014 to focus on its automotive business. Founded in 1977, it listed on the KOSPI in 1990 and moved to an industrial complex in 1991.

012320.text: Kyungdong Invest is a holding company that owns and supports its subsidiaries, which run plant and logistics services, power generation, mining and resource development, and construction. It earns dividends, brand fees and rent from them. Founded in 1977, it listed on the KOSPI in 1997 and took its current name after spinning off two companies in 2017.

012330.text: Hyundai Mobis is a Hyundai Motor Group auto parts maker. It assembles core modules, including chassis modules, cockpit modules and front-end modules (FEM), for group carmakers and supplies a range of parts to global automakers. It focuses R&D on autonomous driving and electrification and is building a robotics business. It was founded in 1977.

012340.text: Nuin Tek makes capacitors and metallised film for home appliances and renewable energy, supplying markets in Korea and abroad. It makes its own film, and holds a 70% domestic share in DC-link capacitors for eco-friendly vehicles. It has overseas affiliates in China, Romania, Thailand and Mexico. Founded in 1977, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997.

012450.text: Hanwha Aerospace is a defense and aerospace company making aircraft gas turbine engines, self-propelled howitzers, armored vehicles, precision-guided weapons, space launch vehicles and satellite systems, and it also builds ships and provides IT services. Founded in 1977, it joined Hanwha Group in 2015 and absorbed two defense affiliates in 2022.

012610.text: Kyung-in Synthetic makes reactive dyes for textile and leather dyeing, and chemicals such as food additives and semiconductor intermediates. It has moved into electronic materials, including display dyes, OLED intermediates and semiconductor photoresists. Founded in 1977, it listed in 1995 and has 5 subsidiaries, including units in China and India.

012620.text: Wonil Special Steel buys special steel from domestic and foreign producers, then cuts and processes it for the automotive, machinery, shipbuilding, construction and home appliance industries. It has sites across Korea, two wholly owned domestic subsidiaries and 1 Vietnamese unit. Founded in 1977, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 1994.

012630.text: HDC Holdings is the holding company of the HDC group, formed in 2018 through a spin-off. Its main subsidiaries work in construction and real estate, power generation, functional synthetic resins and retail, and it runs the IPARK housing brand and AI and robot living services. The company was formed in 1986 through the merger of two firms founded in 1976 and 1977.

012690.text: Monalisa makes and sells toilet paper, paper products, hygiene products, cosmetics and household goods, and also runs trading and e-commerce businesses. It is an affiliate of a holding company and has 8 related companies. Founded in 1977 to make tissue, it listed on the KOSPI in 1988.

0126Z0.text: Samsung Epis Holdings is a bio investment holding company with 3 subsidiaries. Its main subsidiary develops and commercialises biopharmaceuticals and has launched 11 biosimilars globally in areas such as autoimmune disease, oncology, ophthalmology, haematology and bone disease. It was created by a spin-off from a Samsung biopharmaceutical affiliate in 2025 and relisted on the KOSPI.

012700.text: The Leadcorp has three businesses: petroleum product distribution, small personal loans, and a highway rest area. It expanded into specialised credit finance by buying a 63.08% stake in a capital company in 2025, launched an app-based loan that year and is entering microfinance in Kazakhstan. It was founded in 1977 and has 10 consolidated subsidiaries.

012750.text: S-1 is a security solutions company. Its physical security business links security devices, monitoring centers and response staff to prevent crime and accidents, and its digital security business protects clients' information assets. Its infrastructure business provides property services such as FM and PM, and security systems integration. Founded in 1977, it listed on the Korea Stock Exchange in 1996.

012790.text: Shinil Pharmaceutical makes and sells tablets, capsules and other drugs through a sales network in major cities, and runs a CDMO business producing products for about 80 other drugmakers. It also sells functional cosmetics and health supplements under its own brand and does new drug research. Founded in 1971 through an acquisition, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 1999.

012800.text: Daechang is a non-ferrous metals maker whose main products, brass rods and copper alloys, are used as basic materials in semiconductors, electrical and electronic goods and cars. It is the largest brass rod exporter in Asia, exporting to about 20 countries, and is developing lead-free brass, tough-pitch copper for EV parts and copper-alloy fish farming nets. It was founded in 1974.

012860.text: Mobase Electronics makes automotive electronic parts, including smart key systems, car lock sets, power window switches and wireless chargers. It has 33 affiliates in Korea and abroad, including a die-casting unit and a subsidiary in China. Its origins date to 1957, and it incorporated in 1978 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1994.

0129K0.text: Shinhan 18th Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

013000.text: Sewoo Global distributes plastic raw materials and was founded in 1978, listing on the KOSPI in 1989. As the Korean agent for SABIC Innovative Plastics, it also trades with suppliers such as Polyplastics and BASF, selling a range of plastic resins at wholesale and retail. It runs a nationwide sales network from its head office and has entered ABS compounding.

013030.text: Hy-lok makes and sells instrumentation tube fittings and valves. Founded in 1977 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1989, it supplies industries including petrochemicals, shipbuilding, offshore plants and power generation. It has localised its products through in-house development, holds supplier approvals from global customers and runs overseas subsidiaries.

0130D0.text: Shinhan 17th Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

0130H0.text: NH Special Purpose Acquisition 33 is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

013120.text: Dongwon Development is a housing-focused general construction company, founded in 1978 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1994. It carries out civil engineering and building work and supplies apartments under its own brands. It is currently building a number of housing projects and holds an order backlog from them.

0131D0.text: Kiwoom Hero No.2 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

0132G0.text: Kyobo 20 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

013310.text: A-jin Industry was founded in 1978 to make car body parts and has its head office and plant in Korea. It produces reinforcing body panels, such as dash panel and front roof rail assemblies, that provide waterproofing, soundproofing and impact protection. Its affiliates include JOON INC, and one of its affiliates is listed on the exchange.

013360.text: Ilsung Construction is a general contractor founded in 1978, licensed for civil engineering and building, industrial and environmental facilities, and landscaping work. It builds roads, railways, tunnels and bridges as well as public buildings, apartments and mixed-use complexes, with public agencies such as LH and a display maker among its main clients. It is expanding into business facility projects and overseas ODA work.

0134X0.text: Daishin Balance No.20 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

013520.text: Hwaseung, founded in 1978 and listed on the KOSPI in 1991, has 24 consolidated subsidiaries. It makes automotive sealing and fluid products, materials such as CMB and TPE compound, and rubber products for industrial and defence use, and also runs a trading business. It uses production bases in the Americas, India and Asia to compete for global orders.

013570.text: DY is a holding company founded in 1978 and listed on the KOSPI in 1989; it filed its conversion to a holding company with the Fair Trade Commission in 2014. In July 2026 it absorbed one of its subsidiaries, and it now has 15 subsidiaries, 1 listed and 14 unlisted. The group operates in 4 segments: holding activities, industrial machinery, auto parts and hydraulic equipment.

013580.text: Kye-ryong Construction Industrial is a mid-sized builder founded in 1978 and listed in 1996, with 16 subsidiaries. It works in building and housing, including redevelopment and apartments, and in civil engineering such as land development, ports, railways and roads, selling homes under its own brands. It also runs fashion outlets, highway rest areas and gas stations, as well as golf courses.

013700.text: Camus Engineering & Construction, founded in 1978, makes and sells PC (precast concrete) products and carries out civil and building construction. Using PC methods, it has expanded into apartment complexes, public buildings, logistics centres and civil works, applying an industrialised construction approach. It is also developing smart construction technology and using more eco-friendly materials.

013720.text: Cheongbo was founded in 1978 to make auto parts and castings and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1996. Drawing on casting and precision machining, it produces engine parts such as valve tappets and chambers for commercial vehicle and powertrain markets. It has long-standing customer relationships, including 50 years with an HD group construction equipment maker, 40 years with a Korean carmaker, 30 years with GM and more than 25 years with BorgWarner.

013810.text: Speco was founded in 1979 to make special-purpose construction machinery and steel structures, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997. Starting with asphalt plants, it now also makes concrete batcher plants and other construction machinery, marine machinery, and towers for wind turbines. It has 19 affiliated companies.

013870.text: GMB Korea was founded in 1979 to make auto parts and machine tools and became a foreign-invested company in 1982 through a joint venture with GMB Corporation. Its main products are V/spools, electric water pumps and CV joints, supplied to carmakers in Korea and abroad. It has 11 consolidated subsidiaries and has newly set up GMB USA Alabama Inc in the US.

013890.text: Zinus, founded in 1979 and listed on the KOSPI in 2019, has 21 production and sales entities around the world. In 2005 it became the first company in the world to commercialise small boxed mattresses, cutting shipping costs and opening online sales channels. Building on its US model, it has expanded into Canada, Korea, China, Australia, Japan and Europe and is adding sofas and other living-room products.

013990.text: Agabang, founded in 1979, was Korea's first company specialising in baby clothing and products and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002. Its domestic business includes its own operations and several subsidiaries, while overseas it has entities in the US and China. Alongside its flagship brand it runs other labels, including a licensed baby brand, and has expanded into baby skincare.

014100.text: Medience was founded in 1979, listed on the KOSDAQ in 1995 and adopted its current name in 2020. It sells childcare products including skincare, feeding goods and fashion, with brands such as Dr.ato and B&B. It set up a subsidiary in China in 2020.

014130.text: Han Express is a logistics company founded in 1979 and listed on the KOSPI in 1989. Using tractors, tank lorries and bulk trailers, it provides domestic transport, international logistics, third-party logistics (3PL) and warehousing, with a focus on special cargo such as chemicals, toxic substances and oil. It serves major chemical complexes and runs a nationwide cold-chain system for chilled 3PL.

014160.text: Daeyoung Packaging is a corrugated board company founded in 1979 and listed on the KOSPI in 1990, operating together with 8 affiliates. It produces corrugated board and boxes in an integrated process and ranks near the top of the triple-wall corrugated board market. It holds ISO and FSC certifications covering quality, environmental and safety management.

014190.text: Wonik Cube, founded in 1979 and listed on the KOSDAQ, makes and distributes chemical products and building materials. It supplies basic raw materials to the petrochemical and paint industries, sells engineering plastics for household goods and auto parts, and distributes materials for wooden houses. It also develops and makes silicone products at its own R&D centre, distributes and services digital printers, and runs an electronic materials business through a subsidiary.

014280.text: Kumkang Kind, founded in 1979 and listed on the KOSPI in 1988, makes steel pipes and temporary construction materials. Its main businesses are piping and structural steel pipes and the manufacture and rental of formwork systems, while its subsidiaries make compound feed, marine engine valves and forged products. It has production bases in Korea and Vietnam and runs an aluminium formwork rental business.

014440.text: Youngbo Chemical, founded in 1979 and listed on the KOSPI in 1997, makes cross-linked polyolefin foam from PE and PP. Its products are used as headliners, door cushioning and sealing materials in vehicles made by Korean carmakers. Its consolidated subsidiary, SEKISUI YOUNGBO HPP (Wuxi) in China, also makes and sells automotive interior materials.

014470.text: Bubang was founded in 1979 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1994, became a holding company through a spin-off in 2015 and merged with a textile company in 2016. It has 1 listed and 20 unlisted affiliates. Its businesses are managing its subsidiaries, leasing real estate and investing in new ventures.

014530.text: Kukdong Oil & Chemicals, founded in 1979 and listed on the KOSPI in 1991, specialises in lubricants and petrochemicals. Its lubricant division makes industrial and machinery lubricants and liquid paraffin for pharmaceutical, cosmetic and food use, and other divisions sell LPG, petroleum products and asphalt. Its subsidiaries sell lubricants in China, store oil, make biodiesel, and supply gas meters and pressure regulators.

014570.text: Korean Drug, founded in 1980 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000, makes and sells medicines. Its range includes over-the-counter products such as a cold remedy, prescription drugs for central nervous system (CNS) disorders, blood tonics, digestive remedies and antibiotics. It sells through pharmacy, hospital and clinic divisions, and 7 research teams work on new drugs, generics and health supplements.

014580.text: Taekyung BK was founded in 1980 for non-metallic mineral mining, lime manufacturing and industrial waste recycling, and listed on the KOSPI in 1991. In 2024 it acquired a 55.58% stake in a subsidiary, adding artificial marble and wax businesses. It operates 5 business segments, including lime, carbon dioxide gas, artificial marble and wax.

014620.text: Sung Kwang Bend was founded in 1980 to make metal pipe fittings and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001. It makes welded pipe fittings such as elbows, tees and reducers for petrochemical, shipbuilding, offshore and power plants, and also runs solar power and property leasing businesses. Since 2003 it has owned a fitting maker in the same industry, in which it now holds 100%.

014680.text: Hansol Chemical is a fine chemicals company founded in 1980 that supplies materials for semiconductor, display and rechargeable battery production. It makes hydrogen peroxide and BPO, along with thin-film materials for chips, display resins, anode binders and silicon anode materials. It is widening its range of high-purity materials and developing solid electrolytes.

014710.text: Sajo Sea Food was founded in 1980 as a seafood wholesaler and retailer and now processes and distributes seafood. Its main business is processing and selling sashimi-grade tuna at home and abroad, with Japan as its main export market and expansion into Europe and North America. It also exports laver and operates deep-sea fishing.

014790.text: HL D&I Halla was founded in 1980 for construction and listed on the KOSPI in 1994. Its construction division handles housing and buildings as well as civil works such as ports, roads and railways. Other businesses include running logistics complexes, port and marine shipping, and designing, building and operating waste and water treatment facilities, and it has 8 consolidated subsidiaries.

014820.text: Dongwon Systems is an advanced materials company founded in 1980. It makes packaging such as flexible packaging, aluminium foil and moulded containers, as well as aluminium cathode foil and cylindrical cans for rechargeable batteries, and exports worldwide. A merger in 2021 took it into battery components, and it has 4 subsidiaries, including Tan Tien Packaging in Vietnam.

014830.text: Unid was founded in 1980, listed on the KOSPI in 2004 and belongs to a larger business group. Its chemical division makes potassium- and chlorine-based chemicals such as caustic potash, potassium carbonate and hydrochloric acid. Its overseas division makes chemicals and supplies steam and electricity through subsidiaries in China, and it completed the liquidation of USC in May 2026.

014910.text: Sungmoon Electronics, founded in 1980 and listed in 1990, makes metallised films used in film capacitors and has subsidiaries in China and India. It supplies zinc- and aluminium-metallised film to capacitor makers and also runs a direct mail business offering mail dispatch and parcel delivery. It is developing special films for eco-friendly inverters and electric vehicle chargers.

014940.text: Oriental Precision & Engineering, founded in 1980 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001, makes shipbuilding equipment. It produces ship cranes, deck machinery, engine-room cranes, and lifeboats with launching systems, while its subsidiary makes ship superstructures such as accommodation blocks and funnels. Its main customers are Korea's big three shipyards, and it is developing eco-friendly cranes and parts for wind-assisted ship propulsion.

014950.text: Samik Pharm, founded in 1980, makes and sells medicines and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025 through a SPAC merger. It focuses on prescription drugs, with strengths in cardiovascular treatments for hypertension and hyperlipidaemia and in diabetes drugs. It set up a drug distribution subsidiary in 2020 and also provides contract manufacturing (CMO).

014970.text: Samryoong was founded in 1980 to make sanitary packaging containers and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1992. It supplies dairy and beverage makers with liquid cartons made from natural pulp board with an aseptic polyethylene coating, in a carton market shared by 3 companies. Its main subsidiaries make food containers and research synthetic paint products.

014990.text: In the F was founded in 1980 to make and sell clothing and listed on the KOSPI in 1989. Its fashion business runs several women's wear and menswear brands, along with the BIND multi-brand store and a jewellery label. It is replacing underperforming stores, diversifying sales channels and broadening its suppliers to cut costs.

015020.text: e-STARCO is a small real estate company founded in 1980 and listed on the KOSPI in 1988. It has four segments: building and selling homes and shops, running a foreign-language academy, leasing its own property, and operating a hotel. It aims to secure sites for new residential developments in the Seoul metropolitan area and to lease any unsold units to tenants.

015230.text: Daechang Forging traces its roots to 1955 and makes undercarriage parts for heavy equipment and core engine parts for cars, supplying equipment and vehicle OEMs, including an HD group construction equipment maker. It runs an after-sales distribution business for the Americas through Trek Inc in the US and local processing and assembly in India, and is taking its DCF brand global.

015260.text: Automobile & PCB, founded in 1981 and listed on the KOSPI in 1988, has made printed circuit boards (PCBs) since its founding. It produces PCBs for automotive electronics, telecommunications, networking and other industrial uses, and is extending into aerospace and precision engineering. In 2022 it entered car seat cover manufacturing by acquiring another company's seat business, and it has 2 unlisted subsidiaries.

015360.text: Inveni was founded in 1981 as a city gas company and in 2018 split into a city gas business and an investment and holding business. In 2025 it became an investment company and changed its name to INVENI Co., Ltd. It aims to invest its own capital directly under a principal investment model, balancing core and satellite assets.

015590.text: DKME, founded in 1981 and listed on the KOSPI in 1989, makes chemical process equipment and has 3 unlisted subsidiaries. Its main products are heat exchangers and pressure vessels for the petrochemical industry, so its business is closely tied to petrochemical plant investment in Korea and abroad. It is expanding sales through EPC contractors and direct orders.

0155E0.text: Haechitech is a fabless chip company founded in 2017 that designs magnetic sensor ICs based on high-precision monolithic 3D magnetic sensor SoC technology. Its sensor chips are used in mobile devices, home appliances, industrial equipment and automotive electronics, and it has supplied major customers in volume. It plans to broaden its range of next-generation sensor ICs and SoC products.

0156T0.text: HL Genomics, founded in 2000, develops and manufactures synthetic active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and listed on the KOSDAQ in July 2026. It has long-term partnerships with Korean drugmakers, including its parent company, and with raw-material wholesalers. Using organic synthesis, commercial-scale production and high-purity crystallisation technology, it mass-produces APIs for cardiovascular, respiratory, digestive and neurological treatments.

015710.text: Kocom, founded in 1980 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997, specialises in smart-home IoT and holds a 30-35% share of Korea's apartment home-network market. It makes smart home systems, video door phones and other communication devices, and in 1988 developed Korea's first CCD video door phone. It exports under its KOCOM brand to about 100 countries and won a CES 2026 Innovation Award for a conversational AI wall pad.

015750.text: Sungwoo Hitech is an auto parts maker founded in 1977 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1995, with 18 unlisted subsidiaries. Its main customers are Korean carmakers, and through overseas subsidiaries it also supplies global carmakers such as VW, BMW and GM. It holds an exclusive position in bumper rails and more than 20% of the car body parts market, including dash panels and side members.

015760.text: Korea Electric Power was established in 1982 under the Korea Electric Power Corporation Act and is Korea's only public electricity supplier, with 169 consolidated subsidiaries including 6 power generation companies. It generates, transmits, distributes and sells electricity, with electricity sales making up 94.8% of revenue from external customers. After building nuclear plants in the UAE, it won a new nuclear project in the Czech Republic and is expanding renewables such as offshore wind.

015860.text: Iljin Holdings was founded in 1982, became a holding company in 2008 and lost its holding company status in 2025. Its main subsidiaries make power cables and heavy electrical equipment, industrial diamonds, and hydrogen storage tanks. The heavy electrical equipment subsidiary operates in about 80 countries, and the diamond subsidiary is one of the world's 3 largest industrial diamond producers.

015890.text: Taekyung Industrial, founded in 1982 and listed on the KOSPI in 1996, has 16 affiliates, including Korea's largest lime company and a gas company. In 2025 it acquired two companies, expanding into cosmetic ingredients, artificial marble and synthetic wax. It operates 7 business segments, including lime, carbon dioxide gas, non-ferrous metals, highway rest areas and gas stations, and fuel.

016090.text: Daehyun makes and sells women's clothing and was founded in 1982, listing on the KOSPI in 1990. It runs several women's wear brands through 361 stores across Korea and its own online mall. In 2025 it opened a multi-brand store, and it is focusing on expanding its online sales channels.

016100.text: Leaders Cosmetics was founded in 1986 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003; in 2011 it absorbed a cosmetics company and spun off its corrugated board business. In 2022 it merged with another company to improve efficiency and financial stability, and it has 2 overseas subsidiaries, in China and the US, and 4 affiliates. Its main businesses are cosmetics sold under its own brand and corrugated board and boxes.

0161M0.text: Neosapience, founded in 2017, provides voice generation services based on generative AI. Using TTS technology and foundation models, it runs an AI voice generation service with users in 226 countries. It is expanding into AI tutors for education, AI agents for businesses and AICC automation solutions to meet demand for conversational and agentic AI.

016250.text: SGC E&C is a plant and construction company that grew out of a builder founded in 1982, took over OCI's engineering department in 1997 and adopted its current name in 2024. It belongs to the OCI business group and has 12 subsidiaries, including overseas units such as SGC Arabia. It provides plant EPC services for petrochemicals, fine chemicals, power, semiconductors and LCD, as well as civil works, buildings and logistics centres.

016360.text: Samsung Securities joined the Samsung Group in 1992, when it took its current name, and has been listed on the KOSPI since 1988. It has 1 domestic subsidiary, a futures company, 3 overseas subsidiaries and 2 overseas offices. It offers a full range of financial investment services, including dealing, brokerage, investment advice, discretionary management and trusts.

016380.text: KG Dongbu Steel was founded in 1982 to make steel and non-ferrous metal products and listed on the Korea Exchange in 1986. Its steel business makes and sells cold-rolled sheets, X-TONE, tinplate, steel pipes, sections and PEB, while other businesses include port operations, leasing services and metal oxides. In the second quarter of 2026 it invested in KG STEEL EUROPE B.V. and merged two group units to streamline operations.

016450.text: Hansae Yes24 Holdings was founded in 1982 and in 2009 split off its apparel OEM business to become a holding company. Through its subsidiaries it makes clothing on an OEM/ODM basis, sells books and content online, publishes educational materials, sells casual and children's clothing, and makes auto parts.

0164H0.text: Korea No.16 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

016580.text: Whanin Pharm was founded in 1978 to make and trade medicines and listed on the KOSPI in 1996. It makes drugs sold mainly to hospitals, and neuropsychiatric drugs account for more than 80% of its sales. Its subsidiaries work on drug research and development and on general distribution.

016590.text: Shindaeyang Paper was founded in 1982 to make corrugating paper and listed on the KOSPI in 1995. It operates in two segments: base paper, including kraft liner, test liner and corrugating medium, and corrugated board and boxes. It has 7 consolidated subsidiaries.

0165X0.text: Meritz No.2 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

016600.text: Q Capital Partners is a specialised credit finance company founded in 1982 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1993. Its main businesses are new technology business financing and managing private equity funds (PEFs). It currently manages 10 institutional PEFs and 3 venture investment funds.

016610.text: DB Securities was founded in 1982 as a short-term finance company, became a securities firm in 1991 and adopted its current name in 2025. It belongs to the DB Group, which has 23 domestic and 76 overseas affiliates, including listed companies such as DB Inc. It provides a full range of financial investment services, including dealing, brokerage, advisory, discretionary management and trusts.

016670.text: DMOA was founded in 1982, listed on the KOSDAQ in 1993 and specialises in software distribution. As a distributor for global vendors such as Microsoft, Adobe, Ahnlab, PTC, Unity and Zoom, it supplies software products and services to Korean companies, public agencies and educational institutions. It absorbed a software sales subsidiary in 2022 and has recently set up a new subsidiary.

016710.text: Daesung Holdings was founded in 1983 to produce and supply city gas and, after a spin-off in 2009, became the holding company for its group affiliates, with 6 main domestic subsidiaries. It provides management guidance and support to subsidiaries, builds and maintains IT systems and offers IT consulting. Its income comes from subsidiary dividends and brand royalties.

016740.text: DUAL, founded in 1983 and listed on the KOSPI in 2016, makes car interior materials and has 22 subsidiaries across China, Europe, the Americas and elsewhere. Its main products are automotive fabrics, seat coverings and airbag cushions, supplied to major Korean carmakers. It focuses on eco-friendly materials, including recyclable single-material seat cover fabrics and natural-fibre fabrics.

016790.text: Hyundai Feed makes and sells compound animal feed and was founded in 1983, listing on the KOSDAQ in 2018. Its main products are poultry feeds, particularly for laying hens, designed to balance nutrients by growth stage and to be highly digestible. It uses special processing methods such as expanders and extruders and provides farm-specific feed through technical service contracts.

016800.text: Fursys, founded in 1983 and listed on the KOSPI in 1996, makes office furniture and has 2 unlisted subsidiaries. It holds about 6.5% of Korea's office furniture market, sells through about 250 specialist dealers and exports under the FURSYS brand to 38 countries. It relies on its own manufacturing and automation for quality and is working to build its brand overseas.

016880.text: Woongjin, founded in 1983, is the operating holding company of the Woongjin Group. In 2007 it split off its education and culture business as a new company, and in 2025 it acquired a stake in another company, renamed it and added a life-care business to the group. It holds and manages stakes in affiliates, earning income from dividends, brand royalties and management advisory fees.

016920.text: Cas, founded in 1983 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1989, makes and sells electronic scales and load cells. It has a manufacturing site in Korea and 5 overseas subsidiaries, including CAS SHANGHAI, CAS ZHEJIANG, CAS S.A, CAS USA Inc. and CAS DEUTSCHLAND AG. The Chinese units make and sell scales, the Turkish and German units handle sales, and the US unit leases real estate.

017000.text: Shinwon Construction is a general contractor founded in 1983 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1994. Its work covers private apartments, high-end villas under its own brands, plants, and civil engineering such as roads, tunnels and bridges. It has also built quartzware factories for semiconductors, logistics warehouses, and leisure facilities such as golf courses and guesthouses.

017040.text: Kwang Myung Electric is a small company founded in 1955 to make and sell switchboards, listed on the KOSPI in 1990. It operates 4 business segments: switchgear, including eco-friendly gas-insulated switchgear (EGIS); electrical, mechanical and fire-protection installation work; solar power systems; and leasing of real estate and temporary power equipment.

017180.text: Myungmoon Pharm is a drugmaker founded in 1983 with two consolidated subsidiaries. Its pharmaceutical and bio division makes and sells finished drugs and active ingredients and distributes medicines, while its service division runs academies and develops real estate. It became widely known for Korea's first transdermal patch and is researching treatments for hypertension, diabetes, hyperlipidaemia, dementia and cancer.

017250.text: Interm was founded in 1983 to make industrial audio equipment and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1996. Its professional audio and video equipment covers public address systems, pro audio and HD video, and it works with partners such as JVC and ASHLY on OEM/ODM projects. It is developing fully digital networked PA systems and IP speakers that integrate with IP CCTV.

017370.text: Wooshin Systems, founded in 1984 and listed on the KOSPI in 2002, makes car body automation equipment and auto parts. Its automation division builds body assembly lines and electric vehicle battery equipment, while its parts division makes doors, seat belts and interior parts. A main subsidiary makes automotive safety parts, and it has local subsidiaries in the US, India and China.

017390.text: Seoul City Gas, founded in 1983 and listed on the KOSPI in 1995, supplies city gas and is one of 53 affiliates in its business group. It supplies LNG-based city gas to households across 1,337.2 km² covering 11 districts of Seoul and several nearby cities. In 2026 it acquired a stake in another company, bringing its subsidiaries to 23.

017480.text: Samhyun Steel was founded in 1978, incorporated in 1984 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001. As a processing centre for a steelmaker it buys, processes and sells hot-rolled products and heavy plates, and as a designated dealer for another steelmaker it buys and sells steel sections. Its work includes coil slitting and cutting and plate and section processing, run as a single steel segment.

017510.text: Semyung Electric Machinery is a small company founded in 1962 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1991. It supplies fittings for transmission, distribution and substation lines to Korea's state power utility and overseas power authorities, and railway fittings to the national rail operator, and also makes sectional beams for textile looms and auto parts. It is developing fittings for HVDC 500kV transmission lines to expand exports to Taiwan, Southeast Asia and Latin America.

017550.text: Soosan Cebotics was founded in 1984 to localise construction heavy equipment and special vehicles and listed on the KOSPI in 1991. It makes hydraulic breakers, truck cranes, hydraulic drills and bulk trailers, organised into attachment and special equipment divisions. Its subsidiaries are SOOSAN USA in the US and SOOSAN VINA MOTOR, a trailer maker in Vietnam.

017650.text: DaelimPaper is a small company founded in 1984 that makes and sells paper for corrugated board, such as liner, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1994. It produces corrugating paper and corrugated boxes from waste paper, using industrial water to remove impurities before separating fibres, grinding, adjusting consistency and drying. It has 1 unlisted consolidated subsidiary and runs a corrugated board operation as a branch.

017670.text: SK Telecom is a mobile carrier in the SK Group, founded in 1984, and remains Korea's No. 1 operator after launching the world's first commercial 5G service in 2019. It has 18 consolidated subsidiaries, and its business splits into wireless (74%), fixed-line (24%) and other (2%) services. It is launching AI-linked services on its 5G network and growing IoT-based B2B business.

017800.text: Hyundai Elevator, founded in 1984 and listed in 1996, specialises in transport machinery and has several main subsidiaries. It makes, sells, installs and maintains elevators, escalators and moving walkways. Its 2026 management goals focus on strengthening customer value through AI and digital tools and expanding overseas.

017810.text: Pulmuone Corporate was established in 1984 through the incorporation of a food company and became a holding company through a spin-off in 2008. As a pure holding company with 6 subsidiaries and 33 consolidated subsidiaries, it covers food manufacturing and distribution in Korea and abroad, food service, and health care products. Its domestic food unit makes and distributes fresh foods such as tofu, seasoned vegetables, fresh noodles and dumplings, and another unit makes fermented milk.

017860.text: DS Dansuk was founded in 1984 and listed on the KOSPI in 2023, running eco-friendly businesses built around the circular economy. It has 3 divisions: bioenergy, battery recycling and plastic recycling. Its bioenergy division makes biodiesel, bio heavy oil and bio marine fuel, and has completed an HVO PTU facility to begin producing feedstock for sustainable aviation fuel (SAF).

017890.text: Korea Alcohol Industrial was founded in 1984 to make chemicals and ethanol and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1992. It makes and sells ethanol products, petrochemicals and fine chemical materials, and is Korea's largest producer of ethyl acetate and industrial ethanol. It has subsidiaries in real estate leasing and chemical manufacturing, and is developing eco-friendly products, next-generation petrochemical materials and electronic materials.

017900.text: Auk was founded in 1984 to make and sell semiconductors and electronic components and listed on the KOSPI in 1996. It is an electronic components maker with a network in Korea, China and Japan, and its main products are core parts for mobile, automotive and digital home appliance products. It is developing next-generation semiconductors for robotics and AI.

017940.text: E1 is an LPG distributor founded in 1984 and part of the LS business group. Its main business is importing, exporting, storing and selling LPG through 3 terminals in Korea and overseas bases in Singapore, the Middle East, Vietnam and elsewhere. Through subsidiaries it also runs a sports brand, imported car dealerships, real estate leasing, securities and power generation.

017960.text: Hankuk Carbon was founded in 1984 to make carbon fibre and synthetic resins and listed in 1995. It makes advanced composite materials, including insulation for LNG carriers, sports and leisure goods, and parts for aircraft, railways, cars and defence. In the latest half-year, through its US subsidiary, it added United Composite Materials and bought out Engineered Textile Solutions, making it wholly owned.

018000.text: Unison, founded in 1984 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1996, specialises in wind power and has unlisted subsidiaries. It builds and sells wind turbine systems from 750kW to 4.5MW, along with towers. It also develops, operates and maintains large wind farms.

018120.text: Jinro Distillers was set up in 1985 as an independent company from a liquor maker's plant to make alcohol, liquor and food, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1993. Its main business is producing fermented and refined ethanol, and it also makes alcohol-based sanitisers, sells certain liquors and runs renewable power generation. Its affiliates include a leasing company created by a spin-off in 2005 and a spirits maker using farm produce, acquired in 2006.

018250.text: Aekyung Industrial, founded in 1985 and listed on the KOSPI in 2018, makes and sells cosmetics and household goods. Its cosmetics brands include AGE20'S, and its household goods brands include 2080. Cosmetics are sold through home shopping, health and beauty stores, online and exports, while household goods go through retail, online, agencies, special sales and exports.

018260.text: Samsung SDS, founded in 1985 and listed on the Korea Exchange in 2014, is a Samsung Group company providing IT services and logistics. It offers cloud, systems integration (SI) and IT outsourcing (ITO) services, including SCP-based cloud (CSP), end-to-end MSP and SaaS solutions. It uses its full-stack AI capabilities to support companies' AI transformation (AX) through its AX centre.

018290.text: VT, founded in 1986 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1994, focuses on making and selling cosmetics and has 7 subsidiaries in laminating, housing development and biotech. Its products are sold in Korean health and beauty and variety store chains and in about 20,000 stores in Japan. It is expanding into North America, Europe and other overseas markets.

018310.text: Sammok S-form, founded in 1985 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1996, specialises in construction formwork and absorbed another company in 2021 to build a circular business structure. It makes and rents aluminium forms, gang forms, system forms and special forms, and runs its overseas business through 7 foreign subsidiaries. It continues to develop its aluminium form systems for safer, more precise construction.

018470.text: Choil Aluminum, founded in 1975 and listed on the KOSPI in 1988, specialises in aluminium rolling. It makes wide rolled products, supplying foil stock, cathode foil stock for rechargeable batteries, building interior and exterior materials, and automotive materials. It runs continuous casting and hot rolling lines and holds patents for products such as high-strength alloys for car heat exchangers.

018500.text: Dongwon Mobility is an auto parts maker founded in 1971 and listed on the KOSPI in 1995. It makes door frames, seat frames, bumper beams and battery frames mainly for Korean carmakers. It runs overseas operations in the US, Europe, Asia, Brazil and Mexico and has 6 unlisted subsidiaries.

018620.text: WooGeneB & G was founded in 1985 to make and sell veterinary medicines and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2008. It makes animal drugs, active ingredients for human medicines, microbial products and vaccines. Its two subsidiaries make premium dry pet food, on an ODM basis and under their own brand, and produce pet treats.

018670.text: SK Gas was founded in 1985 to import, store and sell LPG and is Korea's largest LPG operator. It owns two storage terminals and supplies LPG stations through a nationwide distribution network. In 2024 it began commercial operation of the world's first dual LNG/LPG power plant.

018680.text: Seoul Pharma, founded in 1985 and listed on the KOSDAQ, makes and sells medicines and operates a new plant. Its main products include treatments for hypertension, stroke and obesity, and it specialises in orally disintegrating films. It focuses on improved new drugs and drug delivery technology, and is expanding exports and launching new diabetes drugs.

018700.text: Jolse was founded in 1985, listed on the KOSDAQ in 1994 and adopted its current name in 2026. Its beauty business runs an online store selling about 250 K-beauty brands in about 180 countries, and it also has film production and investment, VFX and restaurant businesses. Its film division produces series for global OTT platforms.

018880.text: Hanon Systems was founded in 1986 to make automotive parts and systems and listed on the KOSPI in 1996. It became the 2nd-largest company in the global automotive climate control market through acquisitions, including Visteon's climate business in 2013, a thermal management and exhaust business in 2014 and an FPC business in 2019. In 2025 a Korean tyre company became its largest shareholder.

019010.text: VenueG was founded in 1979 to run wedding halls and wedding consulting and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1993. It operates in two segments, wedding halls and golf courses, with a subsidiary that runs its golf course. In the latest half-year its tourist hotel business was removed from consolidation after its stake fell below 50%.

019170.text: Shinpoong Pharmaceutical is a mid-sized drugmaker founded in 1962 and listed on the Korea Stock Exchange in 1990. It makes and sells finished drugs and active ingredients, and reaches overseas markets through 6 foreign subsidiaries in countries including Vietnam, the Philippines, Myanmar and the US. It is working on new drug development, with nearer-term plans to launch improved new drugs and first generics.

019180.text: THN is an auto parts maker founded in 1986 and listed on the KOSPI in 1996. It makes wire harnesses for vehicles, mainly for affiliates of a Korean automotive group, and runs local subsidiaries in China, Brazil, Vietnam, Mexico and elsewhere. It is developing new businesses related to autonomous and future vehicles.

019210.text: YG-1 was founded in 1981 to make and sell cutting tools and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997. Its tools, used to make moulds and machine parts, cover milling, drilling, threading and turning, in solid and indexable types. It has 32 consolidated subsidiaries and added two new subsidiaries during the current year.

019490.text: Exicure Hitron, founded in 1986 and listed on the KOSPI in 1998, develops, makes and exports security systems. It supplies video recorders and AI-based CCTV cameras and solutions, selling specialised products under the HASS brand. It has 2 subsidiaries, including one listed on the US Nasdaq, and works with global security companies on a long-term basis.

019540.text: Ilji Technology is an auto parts maker listed on the KOSDAQ in 1992, with a Korean carmaker among its main customers. Its core business is car body parts. It has 2 unlisted subsidiaries, and in 2023 it received an export award and a government commendation for contributions to the machinery, robotics and aerospace industries.

019550.text: SBI Investment Korea is a venture capital firm founded in 1986 under Korea's venture investment law, and in 1989 it became the first venture capital firm to list on the KOSDAQ. It invests in small start-ups and high-tech industries, forms and runs venture funds and handles M&A. Since its founding it has run 87 funds, invested in more than 1,000 companies and helped more than 220 go public, and it currently manages 26 funds.

019570.text: GMI Venture, founded in 1986 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1989, specialises in new technology finance and took its current name in 2026. It invests in new technology businesses through bonds, shares and fund contributions. It has 6 unlisted subsidiaries and earns fund management fees and gains from valuing and selling its investments.

019660.text: Globon, founded in 1986 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1992, runs cosmetics and fertiliser-related raw materials businesses. In cosmetics it launched the RUE KWAVE brand in China, targeting women in China, Southeast Asia and the Middle East who like Korean pop culture. Its fertiliser business covers trading and investment, using regional supply and demand gaps and price differences to expand globally.

019680.text: Daekyo was founded in 1976 and listed on the KOSPI in 2004, and in 2026 absorbed a subsidiary to bring premium education content in-house. In Korea it offers home-visit tutoring, learning centres and online education under several brands, and it also runs a senior business and Eye Level learning centres overseas. It is expanding into study rooms for young children, a senior HR platform and pet care.

019770.text: Seoyon Topmetal was founded in 1987 to make automotive moulds and construction equipment parts and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2011. Its mould business makes press moulds for carmakers in Korea and abroad and injection moulds mainly for one customer. Its machinery division supplies excavator cabins to construction equipment makers.

0197V0.text: NH Special Purpose Acquisition 34 is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

019990.text: Enertork was founded in 1987 to develop and sell electric actuators and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006. It makes actuators and gearboxes that drive valves controlling fluid flow in power plants, water and sewage systems, water treatment plants, gas companies, shipyards and steelworks. Overseas plant exports and national infrastructure make up more than 80% of its business, and it sells through dealers in Korea and abroad.

020000.text: Handsome was founded in 1987 to make and sell women's clothing and listed on the Korea Stock Exchange in 1996. It runs its own brands, including TIME, MINE and SYSTEM, and foreign brands such as TOMMY HILFIGER and DKNY, selling through department stores, outlets, its own stores and online malls such as EQL. Its subsidiaries include Handsome Paris in France and another overseas unit.

0200G0.text: Korea No.17 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

020120.text: KidariStudio was founded in 1987 and listed on the KOSPI in 1996. In 2021 it acquired a webtoon company and made DELITOON SAS, a European webtoon platform, a subsidiary, and in 2023 it bought a stake in a Thai unit to strengthen its position in Southeast Asia. It runs several webtoon and web novel platforms and produces and distributes video content.

020150.text: Lotte Energy Materials, founded in 1987, makes and sells Elecfoil, a core material for rechargeable batteries, AI accelerators and IT products. Its materials division produces battery foil and circuit foil, while its construction division builds building exteriors using the curtain wall method in Korea and abroad. It is developing battery materials such as sulfide solid electrolytes and LFP cathode materials and expanding capacity at its Malaysian and European subsidiaries.

020180.text: Daishin Information is a systems integration company founded in 1987, focused on IT consulting, development, operation and maintenance. It builds and maintains information systems for the public, financial and logistics sectors and offers network security consulting and mobile solutions. It also develops industrial PDAs, leases real estate and is building its cloud and AI capabilities.

020400.text: DaedongMetal was founded in 1987 as a joint venture and, after the venture ended in 1993, took its current name and listed on the KOSDAQ. It produces cylinder heads and blocks for farm machinery and car engines, MCVs for construction machinery, marine cylinder heads and vacuum pump parts for semiconductors. Its farm machinery engine products go to its former partner and to Japan, and its car engine products to Korean carmakers.

020560.text: Asiana Airlines is an air transport company founded in 1988 and listed on the KOSPI in 2008. In June 2026 it had 67 passenger aircraft and flew regular passenger and cargo services to 6 domestic cities and 54 cities in 20 countries. It has several main subsidiaries.

020710.text: Sigong Tech, founded in 1988 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1999, specialises in exhibitions and has 6 affiliates. It plans, designs, builds and installs exhibits for museums, science centres, exhibition halls and theme parks. It also leases investment property, runs self-storage and invests in new technology businesses, and its subsidiaries include a cultural heritage conservation company.

020760.text: Iljin Display, founded in 1994 and listed in 2002, specialises in touchscreen panels and has a subsidiary, ILJIN DISPLAY VINA CO., LTD. Its DS division supplies touchscreen panels for notebook PCs, car electronics, tablets and smartphones. It is developing new capacitive structures and product lines and improving manufacturing productivity.

0209J0.text: KB No.34 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

021040.text: dhSteel was founded in 1988 to make cold heading quality wire (CHQ wire) and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1996. It added a cold-drawn bar (CD-bar) business through a merger in 2012 and expanded into AI services with an acquisition in 2024. Its CHQ wire and CD-bar are materials for auto parts, industrial machinery parts and electronic components.

021050.text: Seowon is a non-ferrous metal maker founded in 1988 and listed on the KOSPI in 1996. Its main products are brass billets, ingots and copper alloy products, used as materials for electrical and electronic parts and in other industries. Its subsidiaries make brass bars, copper pipe materials, brass components and extruded products.

021080.text: Atinum Investment is a venture capital firm founded in 1988 under Korea's start-up support law and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1991. It invests in small and mid-sized companies in Korea and abroad, focusing on their fundamental value. It manages 4 funds, with major pension funds among its investors, and has repeatedly received the top rating in government evaluations.

021240.text: Coway was founded in 1989 to make and sell water purifiers and home appliances and listed on the KOSPI in 2001. It specialises in environmental appliances such as water purifiers, air purifiers and bidets, and in 1998 became the first in its industry to introduce a rental business, backed by home-visit service staff. Through overseas subsidiaries in Malaysia, the US, China and elsewhere, it also runs water treatment, furniture and cosmetics businesses.

021320.text: KCC Engineering & Construction was founded in 1989 when a company spun off its construction arm, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001. It builds infrastructure such as dams, railways, subways and highways, as well as hotels, officetels, apartments and industrial plants, and sells property. It is diversifying from public infrastructure and private contracts into urban redevelopment and its own development projects.

021650.text: Cubic Korea was founded in 1989 to apply curved-surface finishing using the Curl-fit method and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003. Its interior business uses CURL-FIT technology to provide wood-substitute surface finishes, and a subsidiary acquired in 2009 makes exterior parts such as radiator grilles, emblems and garnishes. It supplies carmakers and tier-1 suppliers.

021820.text: Sewon Precision Industry is an auto parts maker founded in 1989 and listed on the KOSPI in 1996. It makes body parts such as front side members, cowl cross members and dash panels, which reduce vibration and noise and absorb crash impact. It has 12 domestic affiliates and a consolidated subsidiary in China.

021880.text: Mason Capital was founded in 1989 for equipment leasing and new technology finance and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1996. Its main businesses are lending, securities investment, new technology finance and debt collection. Its subsidiaries include MASON Microfinance, which makes microloans in Myanmar, and a debt collection and credit research company acquired in 2023.

0218L0.text: Neovue makes displays for vehicles, a market growing as in-car convenience and entertainment gain importance. In 2020 it invested in an automotive display production line in China, completed set-up in 2021 and began mass-producing automotive displays for a display panel maker that year. Since 2024 it has been investing in additional production lines as it wins new customers and orders.

0220W0.text: Hanwha Machinery & Service Holdings was created through a spin-off and relisted to manage several Hanwha affiliates and make new investments. Its machinery business aims to become an AI and process-equipment technology platform linking process equipment with AI and robotics. Its service business builds on capabilities across daily consumer life, including the full food and beverage value chain.

022100.text: POSCO DX was founded in 1989 for software development and information processing and became a KOSPI-listed company in 2024. Combining IT and operational technology (OT), it runs automation and IT service businesses that drive digital transformation (DX) in steel and battery materials. It is expanding intelligent factory projects across battery materials and developing P-GPT, a generative AI tool, as it aims to become an AI-native company.

022220.text: TKG Aikang, founded in 1990, makes piping materials and fire-protection equipment and relisted on the KOSDAQ in 2006. It makes PB pipes for water supply and heating and CPVC pipes for fire protection, supplying apartment complexes and construction sites. It also makes sprinkler heads and flow control valves for apartments, officetels and factories.

023000.text: Samwon Steel was founded in 1992 to make flat steel and leaf springs for vehicles and listed on the KOSPI in 2011. It went through a workout during the 1998 financial crisis and exited early in 2003, then built a materials processing plant in 2006 and a pipe mill in 2009. It makes vehicle leaf springs and spring materials, rolled products, coil springs, stabiliser bars and pipes.

023150.text: Mhethanol was founded in 1978 to make and sell ethanol and listed on the KOSPI in 1996. Its ethanol division is one of 9 ethanol makers in Korea, supplying liquor, food and pharmaceutical companies, and its golf division runs membership and public golf courses. It has 4 subsidiaries, covering machinery manufacturing, golf course operation, and property development and management.

023160.text: T. K, founded in 1982 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1994, makes and sells industrial piping materials and pipe fittings used in LNG, petrochemical, power and shipbuilding. Through ongoing R&D it has localised pipe fittings, and it is working to enter the market for ultra-precision fittings for rocket launch pads. Its subsidiaries handle real estate leasing and exhibitions, and parts for battery production equipment.

023350.text: Korea Engineering Consultants was founded in 1963 as a large engineering company linked to Korea's economic development plans. It provides design, supervision and consulting across water supply and sewerage, water resources, urban planning, transport and railways. It owns two fuel cell power companies and is investing in renewable energy technology while moving into environmental and plant EPC projects.

023410.text: Eugene was founded in 1984, took its current name in 1989 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1994. Its main business is making and selling ready-mixed concrete, with plants in and around the Seoul metropolitan area. Its subsidiaries run golf courses, logistics, robotics and logistics automation, and broadcasting and media.

023440.text: J Steel Company Holdings was founded in 1964 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1994. It makes steel products such as mild steel wire rod, BIC and deformed rebar from slabs and other materials, and in 2026 mild steel wire rod made up all of its sales. It is Korea's only producer of ultra-low-carbon mild steel wire rod and invests in a nickel mining project in the Philippines through a subsidiary.

023450.text: Dongnam Chemical, founded in 1965 and listed on the KOSPI in 1996, makes surfactants based on interfacial chemistry. Surfactants act at the boundary between substances that do not mix, such as water and oil, to clean, emulsify and disperse, and are used in detergents, cosmetics, textiles, pesticides and other industries. It is developing high-performance products and broadening its portfolio.

023530.text: Lotte Shopping was founded in 1970 to run department stores and had 33 subsidiaries at the end of the first half of 2026. It is a diversified retailer with 8 segments, including department stores, discount stores, electronics stores, supermarkets, home shopping, cinemas and e-commerce, and a wide store network in Korea and abroad. It runs an integrated online platform, has adopted the Ocado system and is expanding its shopping mall business.

023590.text: Daou Technology is an IT services company founded in 1986 and listed on the KOSPI in 1997. Its non-financial business provides SMS, mobile coupons, data centres (IDC) and authentication security. Its financial business, centred on a securities subsidiary, offers stock and derivatives trading, IPOs, real estate project finance and asset management, and its subsidiaries also include a savings bank, an asset manager and a capital company.

023600.text: Sambo Corrugated Board was founded in 1973 to make corrugated board and boxes and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1996. It produces corrugated board and boxes at 5 plants and makes liner and other base paper to secure its own supply. It has several affiliated board and paper companies.

023760.text: Han Kook Capital is a specialised credit finance company founded in 1989 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1994; it absorbed a leasing company in 2002. Registered with the Financial Services Commission, it provides leasing and rental, factoring, working capital, credit and secured loans, guarantees, new technology finance and instalment finance. Loans make up 67.72% of its funds deployed, followed by leases at 8.08% and instalment receivables at 7.46%.

023770.text: Playwith Korea was founded in 1984 to make leather goods and casual shoes, and since a merger in 2001 its main business has been developing and supplying game software. It runs online and mobile games based on its own titles, with about 81% of sales coming from mobile games. It is launching new games, mainly mobile, built on its existing online game IP.

023790.text: Dongil Steelux was founded in 1967 to make and sell steel products and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1994. It makes and sells steel bars from its head office plant, having sold its section steel business in 2020 when its site was included in an industrial regeneration zone. In 2026 it stopped its rolling operations and now focuses on drawing, using semi-finished products bought from outside.

023800.text: Inzi Controls is an auto parts maker listed in 1997 and part of a group of 39 affiliates. Its main products are TMS, EMS, EP and eco-friendly parts, and it holds more than 85% of Korea's TMS parts market and 40% of the engineering plastic parts market. It is increasing sales of parts for eco-friendly cars, such as EV battery modules and integrated thermal management modules.

023810.text: Infac was founded in 1969, adopted its current name in 2004 and has 11 affiliates in Korea and abroad. It makes automotive cables, solenoid valves and other parts for Korean carmakers, GM and Volkswagen. It is expanding into power electronics and next-generation motor actuators and has started an EV battery business.

023900.text: Pungguk Ethanol was founded in 1954 to produce ethanol as a raw material for soju and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1994. Its ethanol division makes ethanol in energy-saving plants, and its industrial gas division makes and supplies a range of gases. It has three affiliates, holding 50% of one and 56.4% of another.

023910.text: Daehan Pharmaceutical, listed on the KOSDAQ in 1994, makes and sells IV fluids, ampoules and nutritional infusions. It sells mainly to general hospitals and pharmacies in Korea and is expanding its over-the-counter (OTC) business. In 2026 it started operating an automated warehouse and is investing in new products to enter new areas.

023960.text: SC Engineering was founded in 1971, listed on the KOSPI in 1997 and adopted its current name in 2006. Based on industrial facility construction, it designs fine chemical, pharmaceutical and environmental plants, while another unit makes bio-collagen treatment materials and health supplements. It applies modular plant, smart factory, AI, big data and IoT technology.

024060.text: HeunguOil was founded in 1966 to sell petroleum products and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1994. It buys gasoline, kerosene and diesel from a refiner and supplies them to independent businesses and consumers in its regional market, where it holds about 10.7% of the dealer market. It also owns a number of gas stations and investment properties and runs a real estate leasing business.

024070.text: Wiscom was founded in 1978 and listed on the KOSPI in 1996, specialising in synthetic resins. It makes custom compounds by blending PVC, PE, PP and other base materials with high-performance additives, and also makes and processes plastic products. Its compounds are used in cables for power and telecoms, AI data centres, renewable energy transmission and automotive electronics.

024090.text: DCM was founded in 1972, incorporated in 1987 and in 1999 took its current name and listed on the KOSPI. Its main business is making laminated colour steel sheets and industrial films; the laminated sheets are used for appliance exteriors, ship interior panels and building materials. It holds stakes of 48.21% and 45.00% in two associates.

024110.text: Industrial Bank Of Korea was founded in 1961 under a dedicated law to build a credit system for small and medium-sized businesses, and listed on the KOSPI in 2003. It takes deposits, lends, handles domestic and foreign exchange, and issues SME financing bonds. It has 9 non-bank subsidiaries, including capital and securities firms, 4 overseas subsidiaries, 9 overseas branches and 2 offices.

024120.text: KB Autosys makes and sells brake pads and linings for automobiles, parts that turn a vehicle's kinetic energy into heat when braking. It supplies carmakers in Korea and abroad on an OEM and OES basis, holds ISO14001, IATF16949 and TISAX certifications, and is developing green friction materials. Founded in 1985, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 1994.

024720.text: Kolmar Holdings was founded in 1990 and became a holding company through a spin-off in 2012. It earns trademark royalties, management fees and dividends from its subsidiaries, which operate in health supplements, cosmetics and prescription drugs. The company concentrates on raising the value of those subsidiaries, which are working on stronger R&D and new growth drivers.

024740.text: Hanil Forging Industrial is a forging specialist for auto parts, founded in 1966 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1996. It supplies precision parts such as axle shafts and spindles and also produces components for the defense and aerospace industries. It is controlled by a parent company and has a subsidiary in Thailand that serves as its export base.

024800.text: Yoosung T&S was founded in 1977 as a freight trucking company and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1999. After signing a road haulage contract with a major steelmaker in 1986, it grew into a logistics company specializing in steel products and keeps contracts with domestic steelmakers. It handles road and rail transport, cargo handling and forwarding with a fleet of about 300 vehicles.

024830.text: Sewon is an auto parts maker founded in 1985 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1994, with 12 affiliates in Korea and abroad, including units in China and the United States. It mainly produces body reinforcement panels for a domestic carmaker and its affiliates, in mass production for models such as the AVANTE, GV80, SANTAFE and TUCSON.

024840.text: Kbi Metal was founded in 1987 to make magnetic cores for motors and transformers, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1994. Its metal division supplies copper rod to small cable makers, while its electrical components division makes magnetic cores and automotive electrical parts. It runs wire and logistics divisions in Vietnam and in 2026 acquired 100% of an electric subsidiary through a rights issue.

024850.text: HLB innoVation was founded in 1978 to make and sell semiconductor parts and molds, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001. Its chip parts business stamps lead frames for ICs, transistors and power modules, pre-molded lead frames and contact pins for test sockets, and it also supplies automotive and industrial parts. It has recently moved into gene therapy research, adding Verismo Therapeutics, Inc. as a subsidiary.

024880.text: KPF was founded in 1963 and took its current name in 2006 as it expanded into auto parts. It makes industrial fasteners, forged automotive parts and marine cables, with sales split roughly 28% fasteners, 23% auto parts and 49% marine cables and other businesses. It has overseas units in Vietnam, the United States and China, and acquired a marine cable maker in 2021.

024890.text: Daewon Chemical, founded in 1974, specializes in artificial leather and has 4 overseas subsidiaries, including units in Vietnam and China. Its main product is polyurethane synthetic leather for shoes, balls and car interiors, and it also makes functional composite materials through its DMF refining and LPMC businesses. It is expanding production through its overseas units and growing in high-value specialty materials.

024900.text: DY Deokyang is an auto parts maker founded in 1977 and listed in 1997, now run by professional managers. It produces interior parts such as cockpit modules, door trims and anti-vibration pads for a domestic carmaker. It started business in China in 2015 and has supplied BMA parts since 2021 as it expands globally.

024910.text: Kyungchang Industrial was founded in 1961, incorporated in 1977 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1994. It makes auto parts including automatic transmission parts, actuators, pedals, levers, cables and wipers, supplied on an OEM basis to carmakers in Korea and abroad. It has 4 affiliates in Korea and 4 overseas, and operates globally through subsidiaries such as KCW and KC USA.

024940.text: PN Poongnyun was founded in 1954, incorporated in 1973 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1995, taking its current name in 2009. It makes and sells pressure cookers and also handles OEM pots, frying pans and electrical appliances. It is renewing its online store, stepping up social media and influencer marketing, and attending trade fairs in Germany and China to expand overseas.
