024950.text: Samchuly Bicycle was founded in 1979 to make and sell bicycles and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1995. It is Korea's largest bicycle company, supplying electric and regular bicycles through 8 branches and more than 900 dealers and selling to large retailers. A subsidiary runs a travel business that sells package tours and airline tickets directly to cut distribution costs.

025000.text: KPX Chemical makes PPG, a raw material for urethane, and in 1975 became the first company in Korea to produce it. Founded in 1974 and listed on the KOSPI in 1994, it supplies about 500 products used in car seats, furniture and appliance insulation. Since 2005 it has set up 7 overseas units, starting in China and including the United States, India and Vietnam.

025320.text: Synopex, founded in 1985, is a technology-based total solution company combining electronics, membranes and medical devices. It makes filters for semiconductor processes and semiconductor package modules, and holds the top share of Korea's CMP filter market for chips. It has 4 overseas units under its SE division, 2 under its AMFS division and 4 domestic subsidiaries, and in 2026 absorbed its membrane affiliate in a small-scale merger.

025440.text: Dhautoware, founded in 1979, specializes in in-vehicle infotainment systems and completed new plants in Korea and Mexico in 2024. Its electronics division develops car audio, display audio, AMP, AVN and monitors, while its automation division designs automation systems and assembly jigs for car factories. Its customers include carmakers and major parts suppliers in Korea and abroad.

025530.text: SJM Holdings was founded in 1975 and listed on the KOSPI in 1997, becoming a holding company in 2010 after moving its manufacturing business into a subsidiary. It has 20 subsidiaries, including one listed company. The group makes flexible couplings for automotive exhaust systems, expansion joints for buildings and plants, and MMIC semiconductors for communications.

025540.text: Korea Electric Terminal was founded in 1973 as a Korea-US joint venture and listed on the KOSPI in 1996. It makes connectors for automobiles, electronics and electrical modules, including high-voltage connectors for eco-friendly vehicles, and mainly supplies domestic carmakers. It is preparing electrification parts for green vehicles, supporting mass production of dedicated EV platforms and building global R&D capabilities.

025550.text: Hankuk Steel Wire was founded in 1974, incorporated in 1990 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1995. It makes and processes galvanized steel wire and stainless steel wire. Its subsidiaries include an instrumentation fitting and valve maker, a plant valve maker and an asset manager, and they supply fittings and valves to petrochemical, shipbuilding and offshore, semiconductor, hydrogen fuel cell and ESS industries.

025560.text: Mirae, founded in 1983 and listed on the KOSPI in 1996, makes semiconductor equipment and factory automation equipment. Its ATE division produces test handlers for chip testing, and its MAI division makes odd-form component insertion machines. It is strengthening custom design and developing high-speed, high-precision test equipment as the industry shifts toward AI, power semiconductors and advanced packaging.

025620.text: CHA AI Healthkare was founded in 1972 and listed on the KOSPI in 1995, adding cosmetics manufacturing and sales in 2016; cosmetics are now its main business. It develops, makes and sells skincare, makeup and personal care products, mainly sheet masks and basic skincare. It is expanding overseas through offline sales in North America and a high-end product line for China.

025750.text: Hansol HomeDeco was founded in 1991 and listed on the KOSPI in 2003, making MDF and wood flooring for interiors. It has wood, cogeneration and forestation divisions, and its products include MDF, furniture door boards, flooring and wall panels. It owns Hansol NewZealand Ltd. and has decided to withdraw from Vietnam, consolidating that production at a domestic plant.

025770.text: Korea Information & Communication, founded in 1986, specializes in financial VAN services, offering integrated payment services based on credit card value-added networks and electronic payment processing. It links merchants with card companies and banks, was the first VAN company to obtain ISMS certification and maintains PCI DSS certification. Its subsidiaries include a venture capital firm and an online tax filing and bookkeeping service.

025820.text: Leeku Industrial, founded in 1971 and listed on the KOSPI in 1995, makes non-ferrous metals. With annual capacity of 60,000 tons, it supplies more than 20% of domestic demand for copper, brass and phosphor bronze used in auto parts, semiconductors and electronics, and it sells to EV battery makers. It is investing in rolling equipment and more plating lines to serve EV and AI infrastructure markets.

025860.text: Namhae Chemical, founded in 1974, is Korea's largest fertilizer company. Its fertilizer and chemical division produces urea, compound and slow-release fertilizers as well as ammonia and sulfuric acid, and its fuel division supplies gasoline, kerosene and diesel to agricultural cooperative and other filling stations. A subsidiary makes high-purity sulfuric acid for semiconductors and began commercial supply in 2024 after passing customer tests.

025870.text: Silla SG was founded in 1977 for seafood processing and food wholesale and retail, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1995. It makes fish sausages and processed seafood, supplies sausages to a food company on an OEM basis, and distributes meat wholesale and online in cooperation with overseas packers. It is developing meat and functional sausages and expanding chilled meat distribution and online sales.

025880.text: KC Feed was founded in 1970 to make and sell compound feed and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1995. Its feed division makes compound feed, its food division produces eggs and liquid egg, and its fertilizer division makes fertilizer from livestock manure. In 2026 it acquired a raw material and feed transport company to strengthen sourcing and logistics.

025890.text: Hankook Steel, founded in 1987 and listed on the KOSPI in 1997, makes steel castings and has 4 domestic affiliates. It can produce up to 12,000 tons of castings a year for shipbuilding, industrial machinery and power generation equipment, and ranks among Korea's top foundries. It holds 9 global classification society certifications, is pursuing special steel certifications such as NORSOK, and is expanding into power, offshore plants, defense and offshore wind.

025900.text: Dongwha Enterprise, founded in 1948, makes wood boards and chemical materials and was reorganized in 2013 as the surviving company of the wood business. In Korea it runs MDF, PB, MFB, chemical and building materials businesses, and in Vietnam it makes and sells MDF and flooring. It acquired Dongwha Finland in 2017 to expand chemicals and Dongwha Malaysia in 2025 to grow its board business.

025950.text: Dongshin Engineering & Construction was founded in 1958 and changed its name in 1969 and again in 1973. It carries out civil engineering, building, housing and cultural heritage work, from public facilities, commercial buildings, apartments and BTL projects to roads, bridges, subways and water and sewage systems. It is also expanding into landscaping, electrical, firefighting and water pollution prevention work.

025980.text: Ananti was founded in 1987 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1996, shifting to golf course leisure and tourist lodging after a change of largest shareholder in 2004. It operates golf courses, hotels and resorts, and both develops and sells properties and runs them. It has 6 subsidiaries.

026040.text: J.estina, founded in 1988 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1999, is a fashion brand company. It sells jewelry and handbags under the J.ESTINA brand and wristwatches under the ROMANSON brand. It concentrates on design, R&D and marketing while outsourcing production, and aims to build a global fashion brand business.

026150.text: Tuksu Construction, founded in 1971 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997, works in specialized construction. The group builds rail and road underpasses using trenchless excavation, power cable tunnels and other tunnels with shield methods, and large-diameter bridge foundations. During the latest fiscal year it acquired a stake in an engineering firm and set up TS HALLA INVESTMENT PTE. LTD.

026890.text: STIC Investments, founded in 1982 and listed on the KOSPI in 1997, manages private equity funds and venture investment partnerships. It runs growth capital, special opportunity and credit funds, with total funds under management of about 10.5 trillion won. It set up an alternative asset manager in 2018 to invest in real estate and infrastructure and made it a wholly owned subsidiary in 2023.

026910.text: KwangjinInd was founded in 1976 to make and sell steel products and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1996. Its steel division produces stainless and carbon steel bars for automobiles, shipbuilding and machinery, focusing on special-shaped bars. Its motors division is an official regional dealer for two foreign motorcycle brands and is growing through its dealerships.

026940.text: Bookook Steel was founded in 1976 to make and sell steel products and became a designated POSCO distributor in 1977. It runs plants in three cities, with hot- and cold-rolled steel cutting lines and equipment for pipes and formed products. It buys raw material from POSCO, processes it and supplies steel users in Korea's southwestern region.

026960.text: Dong Suh Companies was founded in 1975 and listed in 2016, with two unlisted subsidiaries. It runs food, manufacturing, purchasing-for-export and other businesses, and its main customers include a food manufacturer, large discount stores and online retailers. It is responding to market changes by introducing new brands and conducting food research.

027040.text: Seoul Electronics & Telecom, founded in 1983 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1999, makes electronic components and has subsidiaries in Vietnam, Malaysia and Hong Kong. Its power division produces power supplies for home appliances and vehicles, and its ODM division develops kiosks, touch pads and electronic smart labels. It serves domestic electronics makers and is strengthening global safety certifications and custom design.

027050.text: Coreana Cosmetics, founded in 1988 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1999, makes and sells cosmetics, with its head office and plant in the same location in Korea. It owns several brands and sells through both direct and retail channels as well as online and overseas. A subsidiary in China makes and sells cosmetics there.

027360.text: Aju IB Investment was founded in 1974 to commercialize technology developed at a Korean science and technology research institute, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018. It is a new technology finance company and PEF manager engaged in venture capital and private equity investment, managing funds of 2.5 trillion won in total. It has 4 subsidiaries, including US units Solasta Ventures, Inc. and Solasta Nexus, Inc.

027410.text: BGF was founded in 1994 to run a convenience store chain and split into investment and operating companies through a spin-off in 2017. In 2018 Korea's antitrust regulator confirmed that it met the requirements of a holding company. Its main subsidiaries make polymer materials, electronic components and car interior materials, and specialty gases for semiconductors, while its retail subsidiary runs convenience stores under the CU brand.

027580.text: Sangbo was founded in 1977, incorporated in 1989 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007, specializing in coating films. It makes window and protective films, and heat-blocking films for cars and buildings plus paint protection film (PPF) for car exteriors account for 82% of consolidated sales. Its window films block infrared and ultraviolet light to improve energy efficiency, while PPF shields vehicles from impact and dirt.

027710.text: FarmStory was founded in 1991 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1996, taking its current name after a merger in 2012. It has 65 affiliates, with main subsidiaries in hog farming and chicken processing. It runs feed, meat processing and poultry divisions, making compound feed for livestock, operating an integrated hog business and producing processed chicken foods.

027740.text: Maniker, founded in 1985 to produce and sell chicken products, is an integrated broiler company listed on the KOSPI in 2002. Its integrated system covers breeder stock, hatching, raising, slaughtering and meat processing, and distribution. Live chickens, its main raw material, come from contract farms, and a farming subsidiary also produces live birds.

027830.text: Daesung Private Equity was founded in 1987, registered on the KOSDAQ in 1999 and joined its current business group in 2009 after a change of largest shareholder. It invests in startups and venture companies under Korea's small business startup support law and forms and manages venture investment partnerships. Specializing in parts and materials, energy and ICT, it aims to cover everything from venture investment to private equity with larger funds.

027970.text: Hankuk Paper MFG was founded in 1984 and listed in 1996, taking its current name after absorbing another paper company in 2023. Its business consists of printing paper and packaging, and it is extending its copy paper brand miilk into specialty and processed paper. It keeps a global network centered on a US subsidiary to raise brand awareness and find new demand in North America.

028050.text: Samsung E&A was founded in 1970 for plant construction, industrial machinery, technical services and pollution control facilities, and listed on the KOSPI in 1996. It is a global EPC company covering plants from feasibility studies and financing to design, procurement, construction, commissioning and O&M. Its businesses are chemicals (oil and gas, refining, petrochemicals), advanced industries (industrial facilities, bio plants) and New Energy (LNG, clean energy, ECO).

028080.text: Humax Holdings was founded in 1989 to develop and make electronic equipment systems and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997. It became a holding company in 2009 by spinning off its investment business and has 14 domestic affiliates in its group. Its main subsidiaries develop and sell audio-visual equipment, home appliances, auto parts and EV chargers, and provide ESG compliance platforms and solutions.

028100.text: Dong-Ah Geological Engineering is a civil engineering contractor founded in 1971 and listed in 2009, with a subsidiary in India for overseas work. Its work includes boring and grouting, underwater construction, water and sewage facilities, earthworks and reinforced concrete, covering mechanized tunnels, ground improvement and diaphragm walls. It offers a total service from ground investigation to construction, drawing on accumulated data for its designs.

028260.text: Samsung C&T traces its roots to a business founded in 1938 and took its current structure through a merger with a group affiliate in 2015. As the parent company of its business group, it has 136 subsidiaries. It runs 6 divisions: construction, trading, fashion, resorts, food service and ingredient distribution, and biotech, and its trading division operates 64 overseas bases in 42 countries.

028300.text: HLB, founded in 1985 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1996, is a biopharmaceutical company with drug development and clinical trial capabilities through overseas subsidiaries. It runs 4 divisions, healthcare, bio, ships and media commerce, and spun off its ship business into a new subsidiary in 2023. The healthcare division makes in vitro diagnostic devices and quasi-drugs, and the bio division develops new cancer drugs.

028670.text: Pan Ocean was founded in 1966 to carry ocean freight and listed on the KOSPI in 2007. Its main business is shipping iron ore, coal, grain, crude oil and LNG worldwide with bulk carriers, tankers, container ships and LNG carriers, and it also runs grain and ship management businesses. It belongs to a business group and has 10 subsidiaries in Korea and abroad.

029460.text: KC was founded in 1987 for semiconductor and display equipment and materials, and listed on the KOSPI in 1997. It makes gas supply systems and chemical supply systems (CCSS) used in chip and display production and manages its affiliates. It has several subsidiaries.

029480.text: Kwangmu was founded in 1972, incorporated in 1991 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1996. Its NI/SI division provides network consulting and system design, building and maintenance, and its ITO division works with KT to offer corporate data services and lease network and security equipment. In 2022 it absorbed a secondary battery materials company, and it owns a semiconductor packaging and processing firm.

029530.text: Sindoh was founded in 1960 and listed on the KOSPI in 1996, and was the first to introduce copiers and fax machines in Korea. It mainly makes and sells office equipment such as multifunction printers, printers and supplies, offering digital and networked office solutions. It has 15 unlisted affiliates in Korea and abroad.

029780.text: Samsung Card, founded in 1983, is a specialized credit finance company whose ultimate parent is a life insurer, and it owns several securitization vehicles. It runs card, installment and lease financing, and insurance agency businesses built on a large base of cardholders and merchants. It has introduced 24-hour card screening and issuance, digital member recruitment and data-driven personalized marketing.

030000.text: Cheil Worldwide was founded in 1973 as an advertising company and listed in 1998. It runs a global network of 55 offices in 46 countries and owns agencies including Iris in the UK, TBG and McKinney in the US, and PengTai in China. It provides advertising planning and production, media selection and promotion services aimed at improving clients' marketing results.

030190.text: NICE Information Service was founded in 1985 under Korea's credit information law for credit rating, credit inquiry and debt collection, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000 and moved to the KOSPI in 2023. It has 10 subsidiaries. Built on credit information, its services include identity verification, MyData, corporate ratings, technology credit ratings, debt collection, big data analysis, advertising and bond valuation.

030200.text: KT was founded in 1981 to run information and communications businesses and listed on the KOSPI in 1998. It provides wireless, high-speed internet and IPTV services and has diversified into finance, satellite broadcasting, real estate, music platforms, commerce and cloud. It has 78 consolidated subsidiaries and reorganized its group in 2026, creating a new media broadcasting unit and merging another subsidiary.

030210.text: Daol Investment & Securities was founded in 1981 and received its financial investment license in 2009. Its main subsidiaries include an asset manager, a savings bank and Daol (Thailand) PCL, a Thai brokerage it acquired. Its IB unit advises on alternative investments, its equity unit brokers products to corporations, its fixed income unit handles bonds and derivative-linked securities, and its retail unit offers online accounts and wrap accounts.

030350.text: Dragonfly GF was founded in 1990, listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997 and absorbed another company in 2009. It develops and distributes VR, AR, online and mobile content software, including online and mobile games. A subsidiary makes functional films and sound-absorbing materials for cars.

030520.text: Hancom was founded in 1990 to develop and supply software and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1996. Its main business is developing and selling office software and solutions centered on its own office suite, and a subsidiary makes personal protective equipment. It has 47 affiliates and entered financial investment in 2024 by acquiring an investment firm.

030530.text: Wonik Holdings was founded in 1991 to make and sell semiconductor equipment and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1996. It is an operating holding company with 16 subsidiaries, and its group was first designated as a disclosure-subject business group in 2024. It makes source gas supply systems for chip and display production and does piping work, with divisions covering semiconductor equipment, gas, new businesses and investment.

030610.text: Kyobo Securities, founded in 1949 and listed on the KOSPI in 2002, is a securities firm affiliated with a life insurer. It is licensed for dealing, brokerage, collective investment, advisory, discretionary management and trust businesses, earning its main revenue from brokerage, proprietary trading, derivatives and investment banking. It aims to reach 3 trillion won in equity capital by 2029 and become a comprehensive financial investment business operator.

030720.text: Dongwon Fisheries was founded in 1970 for seafood processing and cold storage, and listed on the KOSPI in 1996. It owns 17 deep-sea fishing vessels, 14 tuna longliners in the Pacific and Indian oceans and 3 trawlers off New Zealand, with overseas units in New Zealand and China. A subsidiary processes and exports sashimi-grade tuna, and another, set up in 2022, sells it in the domestic market.

030960.text: Yangjisa was founded in 1976 as a sole proprietorship, incorporated in 1979 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1996. It is the largest maker in its field of planners, diaries and notebooks, and also runs real estate leasing, a gift mall and digital device sales. It splits production between made-to-order and planned output at a 7:3 ratio, with exports making up more than 43.5% of made-to-order output.

031210.text: Seoul Guarantee Insurance, founded in 1969, is Korea's only dedicated surety insurer; it took its current name after a merger in 1998 and listed on the KOSPI in March 2025. It sells 74 surety products, including fidelity, performance, advance payment and credit guarantees, and invests in capital markets as an institutional investor. Its subsidiaries are a credit information company and SGIM, a Middle East insurance management unit.

031310.text: Eyesvision was founded in 1992 for paging, PC communications and mobile telecom research, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997. It provides budget mobile phone services as an MVNO, and its telecom equipment unit develops and makes AP and optical cable products for carriers in Korea and abroad. Its subsidiaries handle telecom equipment manufacturing and distribution, environmental safety and HMR food.

031330.text: Samt, founded in 1990 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000, specializes in IT marketing. It has 14 affiliates and distributes electronic components under supply contracts with major domestic electronics makers. It is sourcing new items such as CIS, automotive memory and AI chips and expanding into overseas markets.

031430.text: Shinsegae International, founded in 1980, is an affiliate of a retail group, set up to specialize in fashion. It began importing and distributing foreign fashion brands in 1996 and also runs its own brands sold in major department stores. It entered cosmetics in 2012 and has built a brand portfolio that includes niche fragrances such as Diptyque and Hermes Perfume.

031510.text: Austem, founded in 1990 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997, makes auto parts such as steel wheels, chassis parts and seat mechanisms. Its main customer is GM, both its Korean unit and globally. It has 4 subsidiaries and is expanding into other areas such as solar structures and DPF filters.

031820.text: Itcencts was founded in 1983, listed on the KOSPI in 1997 and took its current name in 2025. It has 10 consolidated subsidiaries, 2 listed and 8 unlisted. Serving captive clients in the public, financial and enterprise sectors, it provides AI infrastructure consulting, building and operation, AI solutions, and AI and cloud infrastructure services.

031860.text: DHX was founded in 1979 for mail-order and internet businesses, later moved into bicycles and distribution, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997. Through subsidiaries it runs bicycle manufacturing and sales, ICT, bio, property sales agency, food processing and advertising. Trading in its shares has been suspended since April 2026 after its auditor issued a disclaimer of opinion on its 2025 audit report.

031980.text: PSK Holdings was founded in 1990 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997, splitting off a new operating company in a 2019 spin-off. It merged with an unlisted affiliate in 2020 and runs SEMIgear Inc., a subsidiary in the United States. Its main business is making and selling semiconductor packaging equipment for descum and reflow, along with parts sales and technical services.

032080.text: Aztech WB, founded in 1969 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000, is one of Korea's first-generation wool fabric makers. Its textile division supplies fabrics for fashion and uniforms, and its apparel division plans and produces clothing. It uses animal-welfare-certified wool in eco-friendly processes and develops special materials for defense and industry, including GRS-certified blends.

032190.text: Daou Data was founded in 1992 for software media, computer programs and electronics, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1999. Its group was designated in 2026 as a business group subject to cross-shareholding limits, and it has 251 consolidated subsidiaries, including a securities firm and a savings bank. It distributes software and hardware and runs VAN and payment gateway businesses, while its securities subsidiary handles dealing and brokerage.

032280.text: SamIl, founded in 1965, is a mid-sized transport company. It provides special cargo trucking, special bonded transport, freight forwarding, warehousing and cargo handling, with a nationwide network of offices anchored by its head office. It has numerous affiliates.

032300.text: Korea Pharma was formed by acquiring a drug maker in 1974, incorporated in 1985 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020. Drawing on its own R&D, it makes and sells prescription drugs for areas including the nervous system, circulation, digestion, infections, endocrine and respiratory conditions, inflammation and diabetes. It opened a new drug research center in 2018, working on biologics and DDS-based improved drugs.

032350.text: Lotte Tour Development, founded in 1971 and listed on the KOSPI in 2006, is a travel company with 4 subsidiaries. It sells package tours, corporate travel and cruises, and runs fashion and beauty stores. Its integrated resort, opened in 2020, extended the business into hotels and retail, with a global hotel group operating 1,600 rooms and 14 restaurants.

032500.text: KMW, founded in 1991 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000, makes wireless base station equipment and components. Its RF business produces systems, antennas and filters for mobile base stations and made up about 72% of sales in the first half of 2026, while its LED business makes sports and outdoor lighting. Its main customers include global telecom equipment makers such as Samsung and ZTE.

032540.text: TJ Media, founded in 1991 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997, makes karaoke machines and ranks first in its domestic market. It runs 6 businesses, including karaoke machines, music content and online platforms. Its subsidiaries include an online karaoke service, Dream S.A.S, which makes music chips, an entertainment company and TJ PHILIPPINES in the Philippines.

032560.text: Hwang Kum Steel & Technology was founded in 1986, went public in 1997 and moved to the KOSPI in 2009. It specializes in stainless and steel materials, producing and selling hot- and cold-rolled stainless sheet, special steel and carbon steel plate. Its main subsidiaries make and sell stainless pipe and steel products, and design and build bridges using IPC girder technology.

032580.text: Fidelix was founded in 1990 to design and sell memory chips and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997. Its main products are DRAM, flash memory and MCP, and it is extending from low-power memory and serial NOR flash into NAND flash. Using foundries, it develops its own products while also taking outsourcing work from large companies, and it is entering consumer electronics and IoT markets.

032620.text: GC MediAI, founded in 1994 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997, is a medical IT company. It processes treatment and prescription data from a network of about 24,300 hospitals, clinics and pharmacies, and runs an AI EMR solution and the healthcare big data platform UBIST. From 2026 it is shifting its EMR business to an AI and cloud-based Medical OS.

032640.text: LG Uplus was founded in 1996 for wireless communications and listed on the KOSPI in 2008. It runs mobile, smart home and enterprise infrastructure businesses, building on 5G technology. Its main subsidiaries provide cable TV and high-speed internet, media and MVNO services, and EV charging infrastructure.

032680.text: Softcen, founded in 1988 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997, is a small company with 6 unlisted subsidiaries. Its IT infrastructure division covers ICT, new materials systems and industrial X-ray inspection equipment, and its IT solutions division provides B2B and B2C value-added services in partnership with China's 3 major mobile carriers. It is pursuing a UTG cover glass business with a partner and acquired control of a cloud company.

032750.text: Samjin was founded in 1976 to make electrical and electronic equipment and parts and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997. It makes remote controls for digital TVs and IoT communication modules, with businesses in remote controls, speakers and IoT and smart home products, and has been named a strong small supplier by a major electronics maker. It has overseas units in China, Indonesia and Thailand and one domestic subsidiary.

032790.text: Mgen Solutions was founded in 1973 to make high-frequency coils and transformers and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997. It grew through mergers in 2004, 2009, 2012 and 2021, and in 2023 took control of an infrastructure company and set up a subsidiary in Vietnam. It runs ICT, electrical and electronics, and bio businesses, installing private networks for local governments nationwide and supplying AI video analysis solutions.

032800.text: Fantagio was founded in 1991 as the first company under ETRI's researcher startup program and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997. It runs an entertainment business covering actor and singer management, music production and drama planning. It markets its supporting actors as a group, runs a system to find and train new talent, and works with OTT platforms in Korea and abroad on content.

032820.text: Woori Technology, founded in 1993 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000, specializes in control and instrumentation and has 11 subsidiaries. It has developed and supplied monitoring and control systems for nuclear power plants with its own technology for more than 30 years, including localized MMIS instrumentation and control equipment. Its other businesses include SOC, leasing, offshore wind, smart farms, defense, low-temperature pyrolysis and incineration ash recycling.

032830.text: Samsung Life Insurance, founded in 1957, is Korea's largest life insurer. It mainly sells protection and savings insurance, and through financial subsidiaries it offers credit cards, asset management and real estate fund management. It is expanding equity stakes in global asset managers, developing senior living, healthcare and trust businesses tied to insurance, and pursuing synergies among its group's financial affiliates.

032850.text: BITComputer, founded in 1983 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997, specializes in medical information systems and has 3 unlisted subsidiaries. It develops and supplies integrated systems such as EMR, OCS and HIS and has held the top market share since its founding. Its digital healthcare unit offers telemedicine platforms and remote consultation services, and its IT education unit runs AI-focused training.

032860.text: The Lamy was founded in 1985 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997, originally distributing steel scrap. It added a resort business in 2021 and, after merging with a cosmetics company in 2023, now mainly sells cosmetics. It is developing high-performance products with eco-friendly ingredients and sustainable packaging, while continuing its steel scrap distribution.

032940.text: WonIk was founded in 1983 to make quartz ware for semiconductors and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997. It added medical devices, industrial materials and lighting by absorbing a trading affiliate in 1998, and spun off its quartz ware business into a new company in 2003. After merging with a subsidiary in 2019, it operates in electronic components, semiconductor industrial materials and medical devices.

032960.text: Dongil Technology was founded in 1986 to make and trade electronics and parts, lease real estate and make medical devices, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997. Its electronic components division makes EMI filters and negative ion clusters, and its industrial division produces static eliminators, smart cameras, industrial dust collectors and dental devices. It is using ceramic materials technology to diversify beyond a single core product.

033050.text: Jeongmoon Information was founded in 1993 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997, growing by reproducing MS operating system media under an AR agreement. Since 2020 it has shifted from media replication to other chemicals, and its domestic business mainly makes household goods on an OEM and ODM basis. It has subsidiaries in the US, which makes labels, printing and auto parts, in Vietnam, which makes electronic components, and in Mexico.

033100.text: Cheryong Electric was founded in 1986 and became the surviving company for heavy electrical equipment after a spin-off in 2011. Heavy electrical equipment makes up 100% of its business, mainly transformers for voltage conversion, switchgear and GIS. It is expanding capacity and delivery stability through facility investment and skilled staff, and moving into medium and large transformers.

033130.text: Digital Chosun, founded in 1995 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997, is a digital media and IT services company with 4 unlisted subsidiaries. It runs the internet outlet dizzo.com, a TV channel, outdoor electronic billboards, CTS for newspaper publishing and SI services. Its education unit runs language and training centers, and its portfolio spans media, IT, education and real estate.

033160.text: MKElectron, founded in 1982 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997, makes materials for semiconductor back-end packaging, with production bases in Korea and China. Its main products, bonding wire and solder balls, connect chips to substrates and carry signals, and it ranked first in the global bonding wire market in 2022. It is building capacity for next-generation products to meet demand for HBM and automotive chip packages.

033170.text: Signetics, founded in 1966 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2010, specializes in semiconductor packaging. Its back-end work, including testing, connects chips electrically and seals them so they can withstand external shocks. Its main customers include domestic electronics makers and Infineon, and it is diversifying with fingerprint sensor customers in Greater China.

033200.text: Moatech, founded in 1989 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997, specializes in small precision motors, with 134 affiliates and 3 associates. Its main business is making and selling stepping motors used in home appliances, office equipment, cars and telecommunications, with automotive making up more than 80% of sales. A subsidiary runs a real estate leasing business.

033230.text: Insung Information was founded in 1992 for system integration and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1999. Its main business is IT infrastructure and managed IT services, offering networking, storage, servers, cloud and security products and solutions as a one-stop service for companies. Through affiliates it also wholesales software and network equipment.

033240.text: Jahwa Electronics was incorporated in 1987 and listed on the KOSPI in 1999, building on core technology in magnets and electronic components. It has invested in a graphite company in China and set up a production unit with a second plant in Vietnam and a unit in India. It opened a new domestic plant for new customers and began mass production there in 2023.

033250.text: Chasys was founded in 1989 to make and sell auto parts and listed in 1999. It specializes in suspension systems and chassis parts, supplying domestic and global carmakers including VW. After setting up a research center, it became the first in its industry to export suspension design technology, to India's Mahindra, and it is entering North America with orders for EV battery module cross members.

033270.text: Korea United Pharm, founded in 1987, makes prescription drugs and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1999 before moving to the KOSPI in 2007. It sells 21 improved new drugs, including treatments for thrombosis and dyslipidemia, to hospitals, clinics and pharmacies nationwide and exports to about 40 countries. It has 8 affiliates.

033290.text: Logen was founded in 1974 as the Korean unit of a foreign company, became a domestic company in 1994 and took its current name after a merger in 2025. It runs 3 businesses: film capacitor manufacturing, parcel pickup and delivery, and fashion goods such as bags, wallets and clothing. It has two subsidiaries.

033310.text: M2N was founded in 1965, merged with another company in 2007 and took its current name in 2020. It runs 3 businesses: steel drum manufacturing, automotive electronics and new drug development. Its subsidiaries include M2N BIO US, and it is the largest shareholder of an oil storage and lending company and of a medical and pharmaceutical research company.

033320.text: JCH Systems, founded in 1991 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997, specializes in IT distribution. Partnering with suppliers such as AMD, it markets and supplies computer products and sells monitors under its own brand Udea. It also supplies structured cabling solutions, drones from Parrot and its own drone solutions, and runs an AI research and development unit.

033340.text: Good People was founded in 1993 to make and sell knitted underwear and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997. It created a fashion underwear category in a market once dominated by plain white underwear, helped bring branding to functional underwear and runs several underwear brands. Its subsidiaries include GOOD PEOPLE(CAMBODIA) CO., LTD. and a production plant.

033500.text: Dongsung Finetec was founded in 1985 to import and sell chemicals and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997, and now specializes in cryogenic insulation. Its businesses are PU insulation and gas. PU insulation covers cryogenic insulation for the cargo holds and fuel tanks of LNG and LPG carriers, based on its Low BOR technology, as well as PU systems for appliances, industry and construction.

033530.text: SJG Sejong was founded in 1976 as an automotive exhaust system maker, listed on the KOSPI in 2002 and has 22 consolidated subsidiaries. Its main products are converters that clean harmful exhaust gases and mufflers that cut noise and vibration, and it also makes body parts. It added hydrogen fuel cell vehicle parts in 2020 and EV parts in 2024.

033540.text: Paratech was founded in 1973 for manufacturing and specialty construction and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1997. It makes firefighting products such as sprinkler heads, automatic kitchen fire suppression devices, synthetic resin fire pipes and valves, and installs fire protection in clean rooms. It has 13 affiliates, including FESCO JAPAN, which sells fire protection equipment, and businesses in LED lighting, mineral resources and construction.

033560.text: Bluecom was founded in 1990, incorporated in 1991 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2011, and has 1 subsidiary. It made and sold Bluetooth earphones and smartphone accessories, but after volumes and profitability fell it agreed with its customer in 2025 to end that business and announced a suspension of operations. Its main business is now real estate investment and leasing, with investment property making up more than 70% of total assets.

033640.text: Nepes was founded in 1990 to make semiconductor and electronic parts, electronic materials and chemicals, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1999. It runs an advanced back-end foundry business, electronic materials for chips and displays, and secondary battery parts and materials. Its semiconductor business works in WLP and FOWLP, and its materials unit supplies developers, etchants, PR, cleaning agents and HBM process materials.

033780.text: KT&G was founded in 1987 as a state monopoly corporation and listed on the KOSPI in 1999, and it has 33 consolidated subsidiaries. It mainly makes and sells cigarettes and next-generation heated tobacco (HNB) products, and also runs health supplements, real estate, pharmaceuticals and cosmetics. It is diversifying exports to the Middle East, CIS and Asia-Pacific and expanding globally through a strategic alliance with PMI.

033790.text: Fino was founded in 1990 to make and sell repeaters and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001. Its core business is researching, producing and selling cathode materials and precursors for lithium-ion batteries, including nickel, cobalt, phosphorus and sodium-based materials, and it also runs a telecom equipment business. In 2024 an affiliate of CNGR, which holds about 25% of the global precursor market, became its largest shareholder through a rights issue.

033830.text: TBC, founded in 1994, is a private terrestrial broadcaster that went on air in 1995 after being selected as its region's private broadcaster. Its coverage area was widened in 2000 to a metropolitan city and the surrounding province, and it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2010. It earns mainly from TV and radio advertising and sponsorship, and under a network agreement with SBS it airs 70% SBS programs and 30% its own.

033920.text: Muhak was founded in 1929, incorporated in 1973 and listed on the KOSPI in 2010. Its liquor business makes and sells soju, liqueurs and fruit wines, including a plum wine, while its other businesses cover steel products and financial investment. It has 5 subsidiaries.

034020.text: Doosan Enerbility was founded in 1962, acquired by its current business group in 2001 and took its current name in 2022. It makes and builds power generation equipment, from cast and forged base materials to the design, manufacture and servicing of power equipment and EPC for power plants. Large gas turbine orders are picking up after successful commercial operation, and it is expanding into offshore wind turbines, hydrogen and other clean energy.

034120.text: Seoul Broadcasting System was founded in 1990 under Korea's broadcasting law as a private broadcaster, went through a spin-off in 2008 and has 10 subsidiaries. It earns advertising from terrestrial TV and radio, produces dramas and entertainment shows, sells content to OTT services and cable channels, and runs cultural events. It is adding value through OSMU and a wider content value chain.

034220.text: LG Display was founded in 1985, took over an LCD business in 1998 and mainly makes and sells TFT-LCD and OLED products. It has 19 consolidated subsidiaries, with production and sales units in North America, Europe and China. Its sales split into IT 36%, mobile and other 36%, TV 18% and auto 10%, and its top 10 customers account for about 92% of sales.

034230.text: Paradise, founded in 1972, operates casinos for foreigners only and integrated resorts, and moved to the KOSPI in 2024. It runs 4 foreigner-only casinos in Korea and owns a hotel in Korea and an Embassy Suites hotel in the United States. At its integrated resort it runs a casino, five-star and boutique hotels and entertainment facilities.

034310.text: NICE Holdings was founded in 1986 and became a holding company in 2010 by splitting off its investment and credit inquiry businesses; it now has 43 subsidiaries. Through them it provides credit information, payment processing, unmanned operations, credit ratings and asset management, and makes secondary batteries and e-cigarettes. It is working to improve governance transparency and efficiency as a data and financial infrastructure group.

034590.text: Inchon City Gas, founded in 1983 and listed on the KOSPI in 2006, supplies city gas. It holds exclusive rights to supply households in several districts of its home city and parts of a neighboring city. It buys natural gas from Korea's state gas company, lowers its pressure at regulator stations and delivers it through pipelines for residential, commercial, industrial and transport use.

034730.text: SK, founded in 1991, is the holding company of the SK group, with 524 subsidiaries and 12 major listed subsidiaries as of the first half of 2026. It invests in energy and chemicals, ICT and materials, bio, AI and digital, and green businesses, and provides IT services, global IT consulting and system building. It is stepping up investment in semiconductors, next-generation batteries, new drugs, clean energy and AI and digital technology.

034810.text: Haesung Industrial, founded in 1954, is a holding company with 13 subsidiaries. Besides its holding company role, it leases and manages 4 office buildings and warehouses totaling 98,452 square meters. Through its subsidiaries it operates in paper, industrial goods, electrical components and semiconductor parts.

034830.text: Korea Real Estate Investment & Trust was founded in 1996 under the former trust business law to run real estate trusts, and listed on the KOSPI in 2016. It runs land trusts and non-land trusts covering collateral, management, disposal and sales management, and is expanding into urban redevelopment, REITs and investments. Its largest shareholder is an investment company, and it has 13 unlisted affiliates, including an asset manager.

034940.text: ChoA Pharmaceutical was established in 1988 by acquiring a drug maker and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1999. Focused on over-the-counter drugs, it produces about 200 medicines and health supplements, with about 100 sales reps at 15 offices nationwide. It runs a pharmacy franchise and exports about 150 products to 23 countries, including Vietnam, Myanmar, China and the United States.

034950.text: Korea Ratings, founded in 1983, is a credit rating agency under Korea's capital markets law and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002. It rates commercial paper, corporate bonds and ABS, provides investment assessments such as feasibility studies, valuations and ESG financial product ratings, and runs an information business. Fitch Ratings Ltd. is a major shareholder, and it has 1 listed and 1 unlisted consolidated subsidiary.

035000.text: HS Ad, founded in 1984, is an advertising agency affiliated with the LG group and took its current name after a merger in 2023. Its main business is ad production and media buying, with a global network of 10 overseas units, including in the US, India and the UK, and 27 branches. It is expanding its digital business and strengthening its marketing orchestration capabilities through DASH X and DASH.AI.

035080.text: Gradiant, founded in 1997 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1999, is a mid-sized company that supports and manages its subsidiaries and develops, makes and sells health supplements. Its segments are holding company operations, B2B e-commerce and bio-healthcare. It launched health supplement brands in 2023 and 2025 and entered a major health and beauty retail chain to grow its bio-healthcare business.

035150.text: Baiksan was founded in 1986, took its current name in 1998 and listed on the KOSPI in 1999. It makes and sells synthetic leather using polyurethane resin and nonwoven fabrics, focusing on sports shoes, car interiors and electronics cases. It has set up production units in Indonesia, China and Vietnam and has 15 subsidiaries.

035200.text: Plumb Fast, founded in 1992 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002, makes plastic piping materials and has a subsidiary in China. Its main products are PB pipes for heating and water supply, made from polybutylene supplied exclusively in Korea by Japan's Mitsui Chemical. With good corrosion and chemical resistance and easy installation, the pipes replace steel and copper pipe and are supplied to major domestic builders.

035250.text: Kangwon Land, founded in 1998, runs a casino and resorts. It operates Korea's only casino open to both Koreans and foreigners, and runs hotels, condominiums, skiing and golf as a year-round resort under its own brand. Its largest shareholder is a state mining corporation, it has 20 affiliates, and it is developing content such as slot machine manufacturing and a wellness center.

035290.text: Gold & S, founded in 1994, listed on the KOSDAQ in 1999 and took its current name in 2021. It is an education platform company running online and offline language education, academy franchises and educational publishing, with a language platform offering 45 languages and subjects under its main brand. Its English unit has ranked first for 10 consecutive years in a premium brand index for online English conversation.

035420.text: Naver was founded in 1999 and spun off its game business into a separate company in 2013. Built on Korea's No. 1 internet search portal, it earns revenue from search, advertising, commerce and local place services, and from payment and financial platforms. It has 95 consolidated subsidiaries as of 2026 and is expanding its global C2C portfolio, including the acquisition of Wallapop.

035460.text: Kisan Telecom, founded in 1994 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1999, makes telecom equipment. Its main telecom division produces optical repeaters for LTE and 5G, Wi-Fi access points and VoIP equipment, and a subsidiary makes navigation safety radio equipment for defense and aviation. Having localized equipment with its RF design and embedded software capabilities, it is preparing to enter global 5G markets, including Japan.

035510.text: Shinsegae Information & Communication, founded in 1997 and listed on the KOSPI in 2006, is an IT services company affiliated with a retail group. Its 3 business divisions provide system management and system development and integration specialized for retail, cloud POS and membership, MSP, private cloud and data center services. A subsidiary builds and operates online commerce systems.

035600.text: Kginicis was founded in 1998 for internet and e-commerce services and in 2002 became the first in its industry to list on the KOSDAQ. Its main business is electronic payment processing (PG), linking card companies with merchants to provide payment services and remit settlement funds. It has 13 consolidated subsidiaries.

035610.text: Solborn, founded in 1994, is a holding company that manages and advises other companies through shareholdings and also leases real estate. It has 14 affiliates, including Solborn Investment. It uses its holding structure to improve its affiliates' efficiency and transparency and to find new business areas.

035620.text: Barunson Entertainment & Arts, founded in 1996 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1999, is a content company. It plans and produces films, dramas and video content and has diversified into investment and distribution, exhibitions and leasing of its office building. It develops projects with established writers and directors and seeks out new creators and stories for ongoing production and distribution.

035720.text: Kakao was founded in 1995, merged with another company in 2014, took its current name in 2015 and listed on the KOSPI in 2017. It earns revenue from commerce, mobility, payments and other areas built around Korea's No. 1 messenger. It is strengthening its content business through entertainment and other subsidiaries.

035760.text: CJ ENM was founded in 1994 and took its current name in 2018 after a merger between group affiliates. Its media platform business runs broadcast channels such as tvN and Mnet and a streaming service, alongside film and drama, music and commerce businesses. In 2022 it built a multi-studio system by acquiring FIFTH SEASON and setting up CJ ENM STUDIOS.

035810.text: Easy Holdings was founded in 1988 to develop, make and sell raw materials for drugs, animal medicines and functional foods, and has served as the investment arm since a 2020 spin-off to become a holding company. It has 64 consolidated subsidiaries in businesses including feed and meat processing. It has built an integrated system from breeder chicken farming to distribution and is expanding into overseas markets.

035890.text: Seohee Construction was founded in 1982 as a transport company, switched to construction in 1994 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1999. Starting with civil and building maintenance work at POSCO sites, it carries out public and private projects and builds apartments for local housing associations nationwide. It has 15 consolidated subsidiaries in areas such as dormitory operation, waste treatment, building management, golf course and park development, housing, drug wholesale and overseas leasing.

035900.text: JYP Entertainment, founded in 1996 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001, is an entertainment company. It finds and trains artists, plans and produces albums, digital music, merchandise and content, and manages its artists' performances and appearances. It has 11 subsidiaries, including JYP Entertainment Japan Inc.

036000.text: YeaRimDang Publishing, founded in 1989 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1999, is a book publisher. It publishes books for children and teens, produces e-books and animation, and manages copyrights. Its flagship Why? series has grown to 324 titles covering subjects from science to Korean and world history.

036010.text: Abco Electronics was founded in 1973 to make and sell electronic components and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002. Its main products are passive components such as inductors and resistors, which are essential parts of electronic products. It has two consolidated subsidiaries: one that makes flexible printed circuit boards and one in Vietnam that makes inductors.

036030.text: kt alpha was founded in 1991 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1999, running shopping data broadcasting and mobile gift certificates. It operates Korea's first T-commerce data broadcast shopping channel and offers mobile gift certificates that can be exchanged for physical and digital goods. Its T-commerce business is licensed and serves pay-TV subscriber households.

036090.text: Wizit, founded in 1997 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1999, makes parts for semiconductor and display equipment. After localizing consumable display parts, it built precision machining and anodizing lines and produces parts for deposition, exposure and etching equipment. Its main subsidiary develops SMPS for displays, AV and home appliances and is expanding into IoT service equipment.

036120.text: Seoul Information Service is a credit information company founded in 1992 for credit investigation work. It became the first private firm licensed for debt collection in 1998 and listed on the KOSDAQ after gaining a credit inquiry license in 1999. It mainly provides personal and corporate credit ratings, company information, technology credit ratings and identity verification, alongside debt collection and securitized asset management; its credit rating unit became a subsidiary in 2016.

036170.text: Hmnex was founded in 1993 to make automatic control equipment, listed on the KOSDAQ in 1999 and switched its main business to LED packages in 2002. Its LED division makes automotive LED packages and landscape lighting LEDs, supplying first- and second-tier auto parts makers. In May 2025 it acquired a semiconductor equipment maker as a subsidiary.

036190.text: Geumhwa PSC is a plant construction specialist founded in 1981 to build plants and maintain power generation equipment, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. In 1995 it became the first private company to enter power plant maintenance. Its businesses are power plant maintenance, plant construction, water and wastewater treatment, and auto parts manufacturing, and it has 8 affiliates.

036200.text: Union Semiconductor Equipment makes semiconductor and display equipment. Its main products are scrubbers that purify hazardous gases from chipmaking and chillers that keep temperatures stable in core semiconductor processes. Founded in 1988, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 1999 and has 4 unlisted subsidiaries.

036220.text: Osang Healthcare, founded in 1996, develops, makes and sells in-vitro diagnostic products in clinical chemistry, immunodiagnostics and molecular diagnostics. Its products include self-monitoring blood glucose meters, immunodiagnostic devices such as SelexOn and PCR-based Genefinder tests. It listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024, and its subsidiaries OSANG LLC and OSANG DO BRASIL LIMITADA handle distribution in the United States and Brazil.

036420.text: ContentreeJoongAng is a holding company with 36 unlisted subsidiaries and four business divisions. These cover group management, media content production and distribution and film production, investment and distribution, cinemas and indoor kids' playgrounds, and new businesses in digital marketing, commerce and sports investment. Founded in 1987 as a trading company, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000 and moved to the KOSPI in 2019.

036460.text: Korea Gas is a market-type public enterprise founded in 1983 that imports and sells natural gas. As Korea's only natural gas wholesaler, it holds 100% of that market, bringing in LNG and supplying it to power generators and city gas companies. In response to carbon neutrality, it is pursuing new businesses such as LNG bunkering and overseas gas-to-power projects and building hydrogen infrastructure.

036480.text: Daesung Microbiological Labs is an animal health company founded in 1968 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. It has a portfolio of about 150 products, including vaccines, antibiotics and nutritional supplements, with sales spread evenly across items. At home it sells directly through about 200 dealers and supplies public procurement, and it exports to 9 countries including Pakistan, Vietnam and Russia.

036530.text: SNT Holdings is a pure holding company, founded in 1979 as a machinery maker and converted in 2008. Its consolidated subsidiaries make vehicle parts and industrial equipment for automotive and truck customers. The company provides management consulting to its subsidiaries to raise their equity value and manages the SNT brand.

036540.text: SFA Semicon was founded in 1998 to make and sell semiconductors and LCDs, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001. It focuses on back-end semiconductor assembly and testing, supplying packaging solutions to chipmakers including Micron and IDT. It has one unlisted subsidiary.

036560.text: KZ Precision was founded in 1983 to make and sell pumps and valves, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1999. Its fluid machinery division produces industrial pumps, valves and castings used in petrochemical plants and other facilities. It supplies centrifugal pumps to refining, petrochemical and secondary battery industries, and through a technology partnership with FLOWSERVE it has sales networks in 10 countries.

036570.text: NCSoft is a game company founded in 1997 and listed on the KOSPI in 2003, with affiliates including ArenaNet. It develops and runs PC and mobile games, including several long-running PC titles and their mobile versions. In 2025 it expanded by acquiring domestic and overseas mobile casual platforms and developers, including JustPlay and Lihuhu.

036580.text: Farmsco is an integrated livestock and food company created in 1999 through a spin-off. Its core business is compound feed from 5 feed mills, alongside fresh food and meat processing, integrated pig farming and solar power. It has 7 subsidiaries, 4 in Korea and 3 in Indonesia, runs a livestock science institute developing eco-friendly feed, and is expanding its Indonesian feed business.

036620.text: Gamsung started in 1991, incorporated in 1994 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. Its apparel division makes and sells outdoor clothing and gear under an outdoor apparel brand, and its mobile division makes smartphone accessories under a separate brand. In 2026 it focused on expanding in China, opening its sixth store in Guangzhou, and it is growing online platform and direct-to-consumer sales.

036630.text: Sejong Telecom was founded in 1992 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. Its main business is electrical construction for power, railway and semiconductor infrastructure, and it offers ICT services through subsidiaries after splitting off its wired telecom business into two companies in 2024. It is laying groundwork for AI agent, STO and senior welfare businesses.

036640.text: HRS was founded in 1981 to make silicone rubber products and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. It develops, makes and sells specialty silicone materials based on silicon and polymer compounds, supplying electrical and electronics, automotive and power plant customers. It runs research at its two plants and has one subsidiary.

036670.text: Samyang KCI was founded in 1991 to make polymers and surfactants used as additives in shampoos and conditioners. Its products include Polyquaternium-10 polymers, BTAC and BTMS surfactants and MPC derivatives, with POLYQUTA KC and BTAC named World-Class Products. Backed by in-house research, it is expanding business with multinationals such as P&G and developing natural raw materials.

036690.text: Commax is a smart home company founded in 1968 to make and sell electronics, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. It works in smart home IoT systems, home networks, security and industrial networks, with about 33% of Korea's smart home market. It runs a production subsidiary in Tianjin, China, and a customer service subsidiary with nationwide coverage.

036710.text: Simmtech Holdings was founded in 1987 and became a holding company through a 2015 spin-off, handling equity investment, brand management, management advisory and leasing. Its main subsidiary makes printed circuit boards for semiconductors and telecom devices, including memory module PCBs and package substrates. Customers include global memory chipmakers and packaging specialists.

036800.text: Nice Information & Telecommunication is a NICE Group payments company founded in 1988 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. It runs VAN, PG and TRS businesses as a total payment service provider, with VAN at 34.8%, PG at 60.4% and POS at 4.8% of its business. It spun off its PG unit in 2016 and merged it back in 2025.

036810.text: Fine Semitech, founded in 1987, makes pellicles that protect photomasks in semiconductor and display processes, and chillers that control the temperature of chipmaking equipment. Its divisions are Pellicle, TCU, INTENSE and CMS, the last of which took in a company it absorbed in 2026. It has local subsidiaries in China and the United States.

036830.text: Soulbrain Holdings was founded in 1986 to make and sell semiconductor and electronic chemicals, and split its investment and manufacturing businesses in 2020. It is now a holding company with 25 subsidiaries, whose businesses include secondary battery electrolytes and semiconductor probe cards. It is developing HBM and packaging materials for AI chip demand and expanding global production sites.

036890.text: Jinsung T.e.c was founded in 1975 to make construction equipment parts, incorporated in 1982 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. It specializes in undercarriage parts for tracked construction machinery, including rollers and track link assemblies. It has production subsidiaries in China, Georgia in the United States and Thailand, and sales units in Texas, Tokyo and India.

036930.text: Jusung Engineering makes manufacturing equipment for semiconductors, solar cells and displays. Founded in 1993 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1999, it says it has developed 27 world-first technologies and holds about 3,420 patents. It is using its ALG technology to target compound semiconductors, next-generation tandem solar cells and next-generation displays.

037030.text: Powernet Technologies was founded in 1994 to make power conversion devices and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018. Its main product is SMPS power supplies for electronics, and it is diversifying into EMS, battery packs and B2C products. It has manufacturing subsidiaries in Shenyang, China, and Hanoi, Vietnam, and consolidates one listed and 4 unlisted subsidiaries.

037070.text: Paseco is a home appliance maker founded in 1986 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1999. It makes seasonal appliances such as kerosene stoves, heaters and window air conditioners, kitchen appliances such as gas cooktops, hoods and induction cooktops, and household products like humidifiers and water purifiers. Its seasonal appliances are exported to about 30 countries.

037230.text: Hankuk Package is a carton pack maker spun off from a paper company in 1993, and it absorbed a packaging company in 2021. It has a carton division and a packaging division, and is expanding carton packs into Japan and Southeast Asia. With demand rising for eco-friendly packaging, it is promoting its containers as substitutes for plastic and vinyl.

037270.text: YG Plus was founded in 1996, listed on the KOSPI in 2003 and has 15 subsidiaries. Its businesses include music investment and distribution, running an internet portal's music platform on its behalf, artist and character merchandise, IP licensing and fund management. In 2026 it set up 4 new technology investment partnerships to expand its financial investment business.

037330.text: Inzi Display listed on the KOSDAQ in 1999 and has run subsidiaries in China, the Americas and Vietnam since starting global operations in 2003. Its display division makes chassis for TV panel modules, and its automotive division makes aluminum die-cast engine and transmission parts. It is developing products for next-generation displays and expanding into die-cast parts for electric vehicle batteries.

037350.text: Sungdo Engineering & Construction was founded in 1987 for semiconductor equipment installation work and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. It builds cleanrooms for high-tech industries, industrial and specialty gas plants, refinery, petrochemical and power plants, and logistics and industrial facilities, and also develops real estate. It has overseas subsidiaries in the United States, China, Vietnam, Poland and Hungary.

037370.text: EG was founded in 1987 to make ferrite magnetic materials and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. It produces high-purity iron oxide used as a raw material for TVs, mobile devices and cars, and also runs energy and environment, ferroalloy trading and solar power businesses. It is expanding a resource recycling facility, pursuing lithium wastewater reuse and researching epsilon iron oxide for 6G.

037400.text: Wooree Enterprise is a lighting source company founded in 1966, listed on the KOSDAQ and with 14 subsidiaries. It operates in 6 areas: LED lighting, health supplements and bio, FPCB manufacturing, LED package modules and SMT, LED backlight units and TV assembly, and property leasing. It launched a health supplement brand in 2025.

037440.text: Heerim Architects & Planners began as an architecture office in 1970, incorporated in 1989 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. Its main businesses are building design and construction management and supervision, across housing, hotels, hospitals, airports, offices and commercial facilities. It has 6 subsidiaries, including HEERIM VIETNAM COMPANY LIMITED.

037460.text: Samji Electronics was founded in 1981 to make electrical and electronic products and parts, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 1999. It makes wireless communication repeaters and operating information display units, distributes electronic components, installs and maintains semiconductor facilities, and leases property. It consolidates one listed and 11 unlisted subsidiaries.

037560.text: LG HelloVision is a cable TV operator founded in 1995, listed in 2012 and an LG affiliate since its acquisition in 2019. It provides cable TV, high-speed internet, internet telephony, MVNO mobile service and advertising nationwide, along with rentals, installment sales and business solutions. It is upgrading service with cloud-based digital broadcasting, UHD transmission and wider gigabit internet coverage.

037710.text: Gwangju Shinsegae was founded in 1995 as a department store company. Its main business is a department store in Gwangju selling food, clothing and other goods to the surrounding region, and it also runs real estate and passenger terminal businesses. In July 2024 it acquired a bus terminal business in Gwangju, whose site is central to its department store redevelopment project.

037760.text: Cenit was founded in 1995 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. It makes and sells rolled steel and stainless steel products, runs cinemas, produces concrete and aggregates, and tests pharmaceuticals. Its steel unit focuses on precision thin rolled products, and it recently took a 70% stake in a company through a rights offering, bringing its unlisted subsidiaries to 8.

037950.text: Elcomtec was founded in 1991 to make electronic components and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. Its EMS business assembles products such as light sticks and navigation devices, and its injection molding business makes plastic parts and molds for car electronics, camera modules and sensors. Its LED lighting business produces outdoor LED modules, indoor panel lights and floor-mounted traffic signals.

038010.text: Jeil Technos makes shipbuilding equipment and building materials, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. Its shipbuilding unit does steel cutting, forming and sub-assembly, using 9% nickel steel and high-manganese steel processing for LNG carriers. Its construction unit makes deck plates such as NT-DECK and MULTI-DECK, and it has 2 subsidiaries including one in Vietnam.

038060.text: Lumens Bios is an LED company founded in 1996 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006. It supplies LEDs for lighting, LCD backlights and mobile devices, light guide plates for TVs, lighting and cars, and automotive LED modules. It developed a flip-chip solution, is developing Micro LED and stacked RGB chips, and is working toward VR and AR commercialization.

038070.text: Seou Lin Bioscience is a life science company founded in 1984 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005. Its core business is supplying raw materials for biopharmaceutical development and reagents and equipment for basic life science research. It also offers bio industry total solutions, AI-based custom bio-analysis services and hygiene and sterilization solutions, and it widened its product lineup through a sales agreement in 2026.

038110.text: Ecoplastic is an auto parts maker founded in 1984 with 19 subsidiaries. It produces bumpers, consoles and trim parts for domestic and global automakers, and was selected as a first-tier supplier for an automaker's electric vehicle plant in North America, moving there alongside it. It is developing ultra-light plastic body parts to make cars lighter.

038290.text: Macrogen is a biotech company founded in 1997 that provides genome analysis for precision medicine, and it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. Its services include genome analysis, oligo synthesis and microarray analysis, split between first-generation CES and next-generation NGS sequencing. It consolidates 6 subsidiaries, including Macrogen Japan, Macrogen Europe B.V. and Psomagen.

038390.text: RedcapTour was founded in 1992 as a travel company, merged with another company in 2007 and then carried out a spin-off. It runs two businesses: car rental, which includes vehicle leasing and used car sales, and travel, which covers general travel arrangements, airline ticket agency, hotel booking and event planning. It has one subsidiary.

038460.text: BioSmart, founded in 1985 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000, has one listed and 4 unlisted subsidiaries. Its businesses span smart cards, pharmaceuticals, liquor payment services, book publishing and heavy electrical equipment. In smart cards it is a total solutions supplier certified by international card brands such as VISA and MasterCard.

038500.text: Sampyo Cement was founded in 1990, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001, absorbed another cement company in 2010 and took its current name in 2017. Part of Sampyo Group since 2015 and described as Korea's first cement company, it produces cement at its own plant and sells cement and related products through shipping terminals nationwide. A ready-mixed concrete unit set up in 2021 now operates in 6 regions after a plant acquisition in 2026.

038530.text: Kbio Labs was founded in 1997, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000 and took its current name in 2026. It runs bio distribution and ICT businesses, supplying research reagents to universities, hospitals and research institutes after buying a distribution business in 2021. It has one listed subsidiary that develops and makes video security equipment and solutions such as DVRs.

038540.text: Sangsangin was founded in 1989 to make relays and electronic components, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000 and adopted its current name in 2018. It has 20 subsidiaries, including a savings bank, a securities firm and a ship machinery maker. Its businesses cover network services, savings banking and financial investment, ship equipment manufacturing and software development.

038620.text: Wiz was founded in 1995 to develop information system software and provide related services, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. After its IT business became less profitable, it shifted its main business to operating highway rest areas and gas stations at several locations. It has three subsidiaries.

038680.text: S Net Systems was founded in 1999 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. Its main businesses are system integration, network integration and hardware and software maintenance. Working with partners such as NVIDIA, CISCO and DELL, it builds and runs ICT infrastructure, data centers and cloud systems, and it opened an AI center in 2024 to expand hybrid cloud, MSP and AI work.

038870.text: EcoSimplex was founded in 1997 as an ESG company and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001, changing its name in 2016 and again in 2026 to expand into AI and hydrogen. It runs biogas-based renewable energy and bio-sulfur businesses. A new AI division is pursuing virtual images and video, an AI photo curation platform, safety AI and virtual creators.

038880.text: iA was founded in 1993 to develop and sell semiconductors and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. The parent makes automotive semiconductors and modules, while its subsidiaries handle power semiconductors, cloud and AI platforms and cooling hardware. It is building an AI infrastructure business around small modular data centers (MDC), running trials with Korean-made NPUs and seeking to enter Europe.

038950.text: Finedigital was founded in 1992 to develop and sell wired and wireless telecom equipment, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. It sells dashcams, car navigation systems and golf rangefinders under its own brands. Its subsidiaries include a digital map software developer (90.3%), a customer service company (99.9%) and a public bicycle rental system operator (66.7%).

039010.text: Hyundai HT was set up in 1998 when a chipmaker spun off its home automation unit during restructuring, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. Drawing on home automation know-how built since 1988, it provides smart home systems, intelligent home and smart security solutions and maintenance. It is developing on-device and on-premise AI and working with appliance makers and telecom carriers.

039020.text: Eagon Holdings was founded in 1988 to make and sell windows and doors, and became a holding company in 2017 after spinning off that business. Through its subsidiaries it operates in wood products, windows and doors, energy, pallets and forestry. It exports plywood through a subsidiary in Chile and is building a sustainable production system based on its overseas forestry experience.

039030.text: EO Technics is a laser equipment company founded in 1989 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000, with 10 affiliates. Its main products are semiconductor laser markers and other laser equipment for the semiconductor, display, PCB and mobile phone industries. It holds 95% of the domestic market and 60% of the overseas market for semiconductor laser markers.

039130.text: Hanatour Service is a travel wholesaler founded in 1993, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000 and moved to the KOSPI in 2011. It sells travel products worldwide through about 8,000 partner travel agencies, online portals and other channels. Through subsidiaries it also targets business travel and independent travel and offers services to travelers at overseas locations.

039200.text: Oscotecinc is a drug development biotech founded in 1998 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007. It has focused on synthetic drugs for arthritis and cancer, and its businesses cover new drug development, functional materials and dental bone graft materials. Its main subsidiary, Genosco Inc., discovers and researches drug candidates in Boston in the United States.

039240.text: Kyeong Nam Steel was founded in 1990 and processes and sells steel coils and plates, and leases property. As a processing center for a steelmaker, it receives cold-rolled and hot-rolled steel and shears and cuts it to customer specifications. Its main raw materials are cold-rolled sheet, pickled coil and galvanized steel sheet.

039290.text: Info Bank was founded in 1995 to develop software and services for wired, wireless and broadcast networks, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006. Its main business is information services combining mobile telecom and the internet, including enterprise messaging, interactive media, smart car services and mobile solutions. It has one subsidiary in enterprise messaging.

039310.text: Sejoong was founded in 1995, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000 and took its current name in 2011. It provides document and workplace BPO services, and its travel division, with 45 years of experience, arranges business trips for corporate clients. Its PLM division distributes Siemens PLM Software and offers IT improvement and infrastructure consulting.

039340.text: The Korea Economic Broadcasting is a program provider founded in 1999 under the Broadcasting Act and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004. Its core businesses are an economic news channel carried on cable TV, IPTV, satellite and mobile platforms, and securities information service platforms. It has 8 affiliates.

039420.text: KL-Net was founded in 1994 with investment from several institutions and companies to cut national logistics costs, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002. Focused on shipping, port and logistics, it provides EDI electronic logistics services, system integration, solution sales and IT outsourcing. It is the designated operator of the national logistics information network, with 29 years of experience in logistics EDI.

039440.text: Systems Technology was founded in 1997 to make semiconductor equipment and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002. Its main products, C.C.S.S. and wet systems for semiconductors and displays, make up 80~90% of sales, and major chipmakers are its main customers. Since 2013 it has entered main-process chip equipment, developed lead-free vacuum reflow equipment and expanded into OLED and touch panel front-end equipment.
