039490.text: KIWOOM Securities was founded in 2000 for investment trading and brokerage, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004 and moved to the KOSPI in 2009. As Korea's first online full-service brokerage, it has held the largest market share in stock brokerage since 2005, supported by a low-cost structure and its online customer base. It also offers discretionary investment and trust services and has 218 subsidiaries.

039560.text: Dasan Networks is a network equipment company founded in 1993 with 13 subsidiaries. Its core network business provides automotive electronics communication solutions and 5G cloud network solutions, and exports infrastructure equipment. Its group companies include makers of automotive rubber parts and industrial heat exchangers and a network business covering the APAC region.

039570.text: HDC Labs, founded in 1999 and listed in 2015, operates home, construction and facility management businesses. The home business supplies home network systems under the BESTIN brand, and the construction business handles specialty work such as smart buildings, fire protection, SOC and renewable energy. Its facility management unit provides facility and asset management, and in 2025 it pursued proptech data solutions and an AI smart living platform.

039610.text: HS Valve is a piping valve maker founded in 1987 that acquired two companies in 2022 to build vertical integration. It mainly makes valves for gas and chemicals, such as LPG cylinder valves and flanged ball valves, and holds several international certifications. It ranks at the top of the domestic market for insulating and buried valves, and is developing new products and overseas markets as the hydrogen economy grows.

039740.text: Korea Information Engineering Services was founded in 1990 as a software developer, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000 and shifted to IT hardware distribution after signing an HP distribution deal in 2005. It now distributes computers, servers and storage from HPE, HPI, Lenovo, H3C and Everpure. Its subsidiaries work in venture capital, e-commerce solutions and IT education.

039830.text: Aurora World is a character design company that grew out of a trading firm founded in 1981, incorporated in 1985 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. It develops characters and turns them into toys, earning about 70% of sales overseas. It has production subsidiaries in Indonesia and China, sales units in the United States, the United Kingdom, Hong Kong and Germany, and added APAC AURORAWORLD PTE.LTD in Singapore in 2025.

039840.text: DIO was founded in 1988 to make automatic packaging machinery and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. Its main business is now making and selling dental implants, with 20 overseas subsidiaries in the United States, China, Japan, Europe and elsewhere and a network in about 70 countries. It is also expanding into bone grafts, membranes and intraoral scanners.

039860.text: Nanoen Tek was founded in 1987 as an information security company and took its current name in 2006 after a share swap. It develops, makes and sells in-vitro diagnostic and life science laboratory instruments based on a lab-on-a-chip platform. Its main subsidiaries are the US sales unit NanoEntek America Inc. and a domestic B2B healthcare services provider.

039980.text: Polaris AI was founded in 1991 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002, and has 11 affiliates, 6 listed and 5 unlisted. Its F&C division distributes and licenses fashion brands in Korea. Its AI convergence division, renamed from its IT division, handles system integration, AI convergence solutions and wireless communications.

040160.text: NuriFlex is an IoT solution and platform company founded in 1992 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000, with 7 affiliates. It develops, makes and sells smart metering, energy management systems, virtual power plants and renewable energy solutions. It has bases in Japan, Vietnam and Singapore and is diversifying into energy data platforms using IoT, cloud and AI.

040300.text: YTN was founded in 1993 under the Broadcasting Act to produce and supply general news programs, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001. It centers on a 24-hour news channel, producing and distributing news content and earning revenue from broadcast advertising, content sales and digital distribution. Affiliates provide radio and DMB news and content services.

040350.text: CreoSG was founded in 1997 for software development and biotechnology, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002. Its solutions business provides the BANCS-K core banking system to major banks, while its bio business develops AIDS and COVID-19 vaccines. Its subsidiaries include a vaccine developer in Canada, Inferrex for superbug antibiotic research, and a real estate operator.

040420.text: JLS was founded in 1986 to run language and online education academies, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007 through a merger with a listed company. It teaches practical English to elementary and middle school students through 58 directly run branches and 96 franchise academies nationwide. Its US subsidiary JLS ACADEMY in San Francisco runs early study-abroad and language camp programs.

040610.text: SG&G was founded in 1993, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000 and adopted its current name in 2008. Its main businesses are auto parts manufacturing and logistics, including 3PL and international logistics. It started auto parts production in 2009, began mold and nuclear power parts work in 2013 and added a branch in 2020 to expand auto parts.

040910.text: ICD was founded in 2000 to make LCD, semiconductor and flat panel display equipment, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2011. Its main products are HDP dry etchers for making TFT and touch sensors in LCD and OLED panels, and vacuum transfer equipment for OLED deposition. An affiliate spun off in 2018 produces electrostatic chucks (ESC).

041020.text: Polaris Office is a software platform company founded in 1997 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005, with two subsidiaries. Built around its global office suite, Polaris Office, it also offers enterprise collaboration platforms, mobile security, blockchain and groupware. It has launched a version of its office software with generative AI and aims to become an AI work platform company.

041190.text: Woori Technology Investment is a new technology business finance company founded in 1996 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. It invests in new technology companies by buying their shares, convertible bonds and bonds with warrants, and forms and manages investment partnerships. It pursues returns through both direct investment and indirect investment via partnerships and PEFs, and has 3 unlisted subsidiaries.

041440.text: Hyundai Everdigm was founded in 1994 to sell used heavy equipment and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003. It makes hydraulic machinery such as attachments, tower cranes, rock drills and generators, vehicles such as concrete pump trucks and fire trucks, and trades used construction machinery. It has sales subsidiaries in China, the United States, Mongolia and Panama.

041460.text: Korea Electronic Certification Authority is an electronic certification company founded in 1999 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2010. Its three businesses are joint certificate services for individuals and businesses, global certification services such as SSL, code signing and IoT device certificates, and certification solutions including PKI digital signatures and FIDO biometric authentication. It also offers simple authentication and AI-based security services.

041510.text: SM Entertainment is an entertainment group founded in 1995 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000, and it now belongs to a larger business group. It manages artists worldwide and builds entertainment content using its Culture Technology concept and the SM Culture Universe.

041520.text: ELC is a control and measuring instrument and semiconductor equipment company founded in 1984 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003. It makes parts for wafer cleaning equipment such as flow meters, LFCs and spinner motors, and builds strip grinders for chipmakers. It acquired 100% of one company in 2020 and another in 2023, and supplies equipment to global semiconductor manufacturers.

041590.text: Flask was founded in 1998 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002, and has 2 unlisted subsidiaries. Its construction division handles interior design and fit-out, furniture design, manufacturing and installation, and architectural design and construction. Its IT division runs a game channeling business, which it acquired in May 2025 to widen its game service lineup.

041650.text: Sangsin Brake is an auto parts maker founded in 1975 and listed on the KOSPI in 2004. It produces brake pads, linings and shoe assemblies for both the original equipment and replacement markets, and owns the Hi-Q and HARDRON brands. It invests about 3.5% of sales in research and development, focusing on eco-friendly and high-performance products.

041830.text: InBody is a medical device maker founded in 1996 to make electronic medical devices and biosignal measuring equipment, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. Its products include body composition analyzers for professional and home use, automatic blood pressure monitors, stadiometers and software, sold through overseas subsidiaries in the United States, China, Japan and elsewhere. It is combining its database with AI to grow its software business.

041910.text: Polaris AI Pharma was founded in 1999, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004 and joined the Polaris Group, which has AI and software capabilities, in 2024. Using organic synthesis, chiral technology and nano-filter technology, it produces about 60 active pharmaceutical ingredients and runs API and CDMO businesses. It serves about 100 customers at home and abroad, with a large share of sales from Japan, a market with strict approval rules.

041920.text: Mediana is a medical device company founded in 1995 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2014, with one unlisted subsidiary. Its businesses are integrated patient monitoring, emergency care centered on automated external defibrillators, and vascular catheters, sold under its own brand and through ODM. It is working with its parent company and affiliates to combine AI and software with medical device development.

041930.text: SY Dong-a was founded in 1974 to make specialty rubber parts for cars, home appliances and industry, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001. Its automotive products include air intake hoses and EV battery pack gaskets, and it supplies door gaskets and other parts to appliance makers. It has local subsidiaries in India, China, Russia, Mexico, Poland, Japan, Vietnam and the United States.

041960.text: Komipharm International was founded in 1972 to make and sell veterinary medicines, and runs plants in two Korean provinces. It makes animal vaccines and treatments and provides contract research, and is registered as a venture company for its vaccine technology. It is running clinical trials of a new drug to expand into human medicines, and has an overseas subsidiary, Komipharm International Australia Pty. Ltd.

042000.text: Cafe24 was founded in 1999 to develop and supply internet business solutions and software. It offers a free solution for building D2C online stores and links it with paid add-ons such as payments and e-commerce marketing tools, providing one-stop e-commerce services. It is strengthening partnerships with global platforms and using AI and big data to upgrade its platform.

042040.text: KPM Tech is a surface treatment materials company founded in 1971 to produce plating chemicals domestically, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003. It makes and sells surface treatment chemicals for PCBs, electronics, telecom, semiconductors and auto parts, along with fully automatic plating equipment. Subsidiaries sell health supplements and household goods, and it invests in pharmaceutical and bio businesses through affiliates.

042110.text: SCD was founded in 1987 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. It makes parts for refrigerators and air conditioners, holding domestic market shares of 63% in ice makers, 89% in step valves and 40% in BLDC motors. It is expanding into auto parts as a new business and holds several vehicle-related patents, including valve actuators for EV thermal management modules.

042370.text: Vitzro Tech is a holding company founded in 1968 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. Its subsidiaries make power equipment and lithium primary batteries, and run special businesses such as plasma applications and ultra-precision vacuum bonding. It aims to become the global number one in lithium primary batteries and is strengthening technology for aerospace, fusion energy and particle accelerators.

042420.text: Neowiz Holdings was founded in 1997, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000 and became a holding company in 2007 after spinning off its game business. Its main subsidiaries cover game development and publishing, investment, game services in Japan and a mobile advertising platform. The holding structure lets each business run independently.

042500.text: RingNet was founded in 2000 to provide computer network communication solutions and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002. Its network integration business covers network design, telecom equipment supply, installation and maintenance, and it also works in cloud virtualization, AI infrastructure and data centers. It has a network maintenance subsidiary and local units in Poland, China and Vietnam.

042510.text: RaonSecure is an AI security and authentication platform company founded in 1998 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000, with 4 affiliates. It offers biometric multi-factor authentication, integrated account and privilege management, blockchain-based decentralized identity and security consulting. It has set up an AI division to develop an agentic AI security automation platform and digital trust infrastructure.

042520.text: Hans Biomed is a biotech company founded in 1999 that makes human skin and bone grafts and medical devices. It was the first in Asia to commercialize human skin, bone and silicone implant products and received Korea's first human tissue bank license. Tissue grafts make up about 72% of sales and medical devices about 25%, and it is expanding abroad through subsidiaries in the United States and Thailand.

042600.text: Seronics was founded in 1968 to make door locks and began making electronic components in 1981 after moving its headquarters. It listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002 and runs electronic components and solar parts businesses, producing input devices for LCD TVs and kitchen TVs. It has an affiliate and subsidiaries including Kwangsung Electronics Inc.

042660.text: Hanwha Ocean is a shipbuilding and offshore company spun off from a heavy industries company in 2000 and listed on the KOSPI in 2001. It builds LNG, crude oil, container and LPG carriers, FPSOs, offshore platforms and energy plants, as well as special vessels such as submarines and destroyers. In 2024 it bought a stake in Philly Shipyard Inc. to enter the US market, and it has set up a new subsidiary in Singapore.

042700.text: Hanmi Semiconductor was founded in 1980 to make semiconductor automation equipment and listed on the KOSPI in 2005. It has built a vertically integrated manufacturing system covering casting, design, fabrication, assembly, inspection and testing, and supplies chipmaking equipment to major global AI chip companies. It has 3 unlisted subsidiaries.

042940.text: Sangji Construction was founded in 1979 to make video, audio and telecom equipment, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. With its three consolidated subsidiaries, it now works in real estate development, construction and property services. Its projects include luxury villas, officetels and housing, along with civil and building works, electrical works and telecom construction.

043100.text: Alpha AI was founded in 1995 to make and sell medical supplies and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. Its medical division makes and sells biomedical metals, surgical instruments and medical equipment used in hospitals. Its affiliates include Hyzen Corp, and in 2026 it sold Solco Biomedical Corporation to exit non-core business.

043150.text: Value Added Technology was founded in 1992, moved into dental digital X-ray and CT in 2002 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006. It develops digital X-ray, CT and generator products, with main lines such as Green X and the PaX-i series, and focuses on premium 3D products. It operates 27 entities and reaches domestic and overseas markets through a sales affiliate.

043200.text: Paru makes structures and tracking systems for solar power plants, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. Its main products are fixed structures and single-axis and dual-axis trackers, and it supplied about 400MW to a large project in the United States. It develops structural analysis and design technology, standardizes products to cut costs and works with global EPC firms, and has 2 unlisted subsidiaries.

043220.text: TS Nexgen was founded in 1995 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001, with 3 subsidiaries. It makes power plant dampers and ship desulfurization systems, manufactures busways and sells medical devices. Through a subsidiary it develops focused ultrasound medical devices, holding a low-intensity focused ultrasound stimulation system and patents, and is running clinical trials for Alzheimer's disease, depression and Parkinson's disease.

043260.text: Sungho Electronics is an electronic components maker founded in 1973 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001. It has 5 segments: capacitors and power, semiconductors, construction, leasing and other, with film capacitors, metallized film and power supplies as its main products. Its semiconductor unit makes optical communication process equipment, temperature control equipment and memory test equipment, and its construction unit supplies LED lighting and windows.

043340.text: Essen Tech is a copper and copper alloy processing company founded in 1985 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. It makes brass forgings, ball valves, distributors and fittings used in housing, electronics, cars, shipbuilding and plants. It produces everything from materials to assembly in-house and is investing in eco-friendly products, aiming to reach the global TOP10.

043360.text: Digital Graphics was founded in 1985, took its current corporate name in 2000 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001. It developed its own cutting plotters and inkjet printers, which had previously been fully imported, and exports products under its own brand to about 50 countries. In 2023 it acquired a company to add eco-friendly textile printing products.

043370.text: PHA was founded in 1985 to make auto parts and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001. It has 16 domestic and 16 overseas affiliates, supplies auto parts to automakers and runs production sites worldwide. It set up PHA Georgia to serve the growing North American EV market and has filed 400 patent applications.

043590.text: Welkeeps Hitech was founded in 1974 as an IT electronic components company, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001 and added a subsidiary in 2024. It works in driver IC design and driver IC packaging, a back-end semiconductor process. Its display driver ICs run TFT and AMOLED panels, and its touch ICs pass touch coordinates from mobile devices to the application processor.

043610.text: KT Genie Music was founded in 1991 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. Its core is the digital music streaming platform genie, and it also runs an e-book subscription platform, sells concert tickets and artist merchandise. It is expanding AI-based personalized recommendations using its customer data, strengthening music distribution and investing in concert IP.

043650.text: Kook Soon Dang was founded in 1983 to make and sell alcoholic beverages, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. It makes traditional Korean rice wines, both clear and unfiltered, imports premium wines and runs franchise businesses. It has 6 subsidiaries, including an agricultural company, a venture capital firm and a unit in China.

043710.text: CosLeaguer Global was founded in 1991 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002. It set up a dermocosmetic ODM manufacturer and in 2025 acquired the operator of a skincare brand, giving it a full cosmetics value chain. It works in cosmetics, healthcare, green technology and new media marketing, and its factory produces cosmetics under ISO 22716 certification.

043910.text: Nature and Environment is an environmental company founded in 1999 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005, with three subsidiaries. It runs soil and water (SW), climate and environment (CE) and off-site construction (OSC) segments, covering environmental infrastructure and eco-friendly precast concrete and modular building. A subsidiary has entered the modular housing market under the MODU brand, and it is commercializing CCU technology.

044180.text: KD is a construction company founded in 1974 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. Its main business is housing, building and selling officetels and apartments under its own brands. Through subsidiaries it also develops and leases real estate and makes mold bases.

044340.text: Winix is a home appliance company founded in 1986 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. It makes air purifiers, dehumidifiers, clothes dryers and heat exchangers for refrigerators, and since acquiring 100% of an airline in 2024 it also runs passenger and cargo air transport. Its airline uses a hybrid model combining LCC and FSC features, and its appliance business focuses on premium, energy-saving products.

044380.text: Jooyontech was founded in 1988 to make and sell PCs and listed on the KOSPI in 2006. Over 39 years in the domestic PC market, it has built PCs for businesses and public agencies, gaming PCs, laptops, monitors and TVs, and it also runs a pet-tech business. It is expanding PCs with AI software and strengthening B2B sales.

044450.text: KSS Line was founded in 1969 and carries liquefied gas and petrochemical products by sea in Northeast Asia. It relaunched in 1984 under a shipping industry rationalization policy. It operates gas, product and chemical carriers, transporting LPG and other gas cargo and petrochemical products.

044480.text: Billions was founded in 1973 to make latex rubber products and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001. It became an entertainment company by merging with entertainment firms in 2023, 2024 and 2026. Its main businesses are condoms and medical rubber products, and entertainment, including planning and producing content for its artists.

044490.text: Taewoong was founded in 1981 as a forging company, took its current name in 1989 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001. It set up a steelmaking division in 2016 to produce the ingots and round blooms used in its forgings, creating an integrated production system. It makes custom forged parts for wind power, shipbuilding, power generation including nuclear, SMR and CASK, petrochemical and offshore plants, and industrial machinery.

044780.text: HK is a laser cutting machine maker founded in 1990 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. It makes and sells laser machines that use the heat of a laser beam to process metal and non-metal materials, specializing in cutters. It also sells parts and provides maintenance, and has expanded into production automation systems built around its laser machines.

044820.text: Cosmax Bti was founded in 1992 as a cosmetics maker, listed in 2006 and became a holding company in 2014 after spinning off Cosmax. It has 13 subsidiaries, sets group strategy and handles global raw material purchasing, export agency work and cosmetics manufacturing. Through two subsidiaries it also runs a health supplement ODM business.

044960.text: Eagle Veterinary Technology is an animal health company founded in 1970 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. It makes and imports medicines for cattle, pigs and poultry, including feed additives, injectables and water-soluble powders, covering nutrients, antibiotics, dewormers and vaccines. It was the first in Korea to obtain EU GMP certification and is developing medicines for companion animals.

044990.text: H&S High Tech is a semiconductor component company founded in 1995 and listed on the KOSDAQ, with one unlisted subsidiary. Its materials division makes ACF for display makers, and its electronics division develops quartz crystal resonators and oscillators for home appliances and telecom devices. It holds several patents from technology projects with KAIST and is developing high-frequency products for telecom.

045060.text: Okong was founded in 1962 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000, with 2 subsidiaries. It makes and sells adhesives and tapes, including vinyl acetate emulsion adhesives, hot melt adhesives, pressure-sensitive tapes and instant adhesives. Its emulsion adhesives carry eco-friendly certification, and automotive quality certification has helped it take hot melt adhesives into electronics and automotive uses.

045100.text: Hanyang ENG was founded in 1988 to make semiconductor and display equipment and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. It provides ultra-high-purity facilities and engineering services essential for chip and display equipment, operating through 4 divisions. It has subsidiaries in the United States, Vietnam, China and Singapore, and in 2026 plans to raise its stake in one company and set up HMGM LLC in the United States.

045300.text: Sungwoo Techron is a semiconductor parts and inspection equipment company listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001, with one subsidiary. It has a parts division doing contract processing of chip components, a PCB division and an equipment division. It makes LOC, PCB, automotive and battery inspection equipment, and produces key parts for memory chips, PCs, TVs, aircraft and cars.

045340.text: Total Soft Bank was founded in 1988 to develop software for shipping, port and logistics, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002. It provides terminal operating systems, stowage planning systems and other IT solutions for ports and logistics. Its CATOS system is installed at about 110 terminals worldwide, and it is developing AI, machine learning and big data technology.

045390.text: Daea Ti was founded in 1995 to develop and supply railway signaling control systems, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001. It has localized core railway signaling products such as centralized traffic control (CTC) and carries out turnkey projects. Its consolidated subsidiaries include DAEA TI TRANSPORTATION PHILIPPINES INC and PT. DAEATI RAILWAY INDONESIA.

045510.text: Zungwon En-sys is an IT infrastructure sales company founded in 1969 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. It is the Korean distributor for Fujitsu and a partner of HPE, Broadcom and other foreign vendors, selling and maintaining servers, storage and network equipment. Drawing on more than 40 years of experience, it is expanding into physical AI, including AI solutions, robot distribution and robot system integration.

045520.text: Clean & Science is a filter media and filter maker founded in 1979 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000. Its products are filters for home appliances and industry, and filter paper for HVAC and cars, and it supplies HEPA filters to major domestic air purifier makers. It set up a US unit in 2009, a China unit in 2011 and a production subsidiary in Thailand in 2022.

045660.text: ATEC started in 1993 making LCD display products, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001 and has 5 unlisted subsidiaries. Its main business is financial automation, including ATM manufacturing and services that combine IT with financial services. Building on large project experience and its own technology, it has entered the retail sector and is developing into an automation platform company.

045970.text: CoAsia is a semiconductor and technology company founded in 1993 with 17 subsidiaries. It works in system semiconductor design, electronic component manufacturing and new technology business finance. One subsidiary is a design solution partner (DSP) in a foundry ecosystem and holds Arm's top-tier AADP status, while another designs automotive application processors under ISO26262.

046120.text: Orbitech was founded in 1991 for non-destructive testing and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2010, with 3 consolidated subsidiaries. It runs 4 segments, including nuclear services such as radiation management and clearance, and pre-service and in-service inspection of power plants. Its aviation unit makes B737 bulkhead assemblies and precision parts, and in 2025 it won a contract from KAI to supply machined parts for the KF-21.

046210.text: HLB Panagene is a bio venture company founded in 2001 that listed on the KOSDAQ after a merger in 2008. Its main businesses are immunodiagnostics and molecular diagnostics based on its own PNA technology, and it has commercialized a somatic mutation detection platform for companion diagnostics, expanding into liquid biopsy. It has added an AI diagnostic platform and drug development, including AOC development.

046310.text: BG T&A is a communications device maker founded in 1996 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002. Its main products are vehicle radar detectors, two-way radios, dashcams and RDVR combo units. It has a production subsidiary in the Philippines and a development subsidiary, and is working on AI, IoT and ADAS to export connected IoT and AI dashcams.

046390.text: Samhwa Networks was founded in 1991 and built its business base through a merger with a production company in 2007. It was Korea's first independent drama production company and has produced more than 130 dramas over more than 30 years. It works in video content production and entertainment, securing drama IP through contracts with writers and producers, and has two subsidiaries.

046440.text: KG Financial was founded in 2000 to provide online information and develop solutions, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004. Its main business is electronic payment processing, connecting credit card companies and telecom carriers with about 27,500 merchants. It also runs prepaid mobile card, MVNO and early settlement services for online sellers, and offers education content through a subsidiary.

046890.text: Seoul Semiconductor was founded in 1987, grew into an LED manufacturer from 1992 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002. It sources LED chips from an affiliate, packages them and sells them, and researches and makes products for a wide range of uses. It operates through 4 subsidiaries and production sites, supported by a global R&D lab, manufacturing bases and sales network.

046940.text: Woowon Development is a civil engineering contractor founded in 1998 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002. Its main business is earthworks for highways, bridges, tunnels, ports and land development, and it also offers urban development and property leasing. It has completed about 70 national road and highway projects totaling more than 320km, and has an urban development subsidiary.

046970.text: Wooriro was founded in 1998 to make optical splitters and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2012. Its optical communications division makes PLC optical splitters and PD photodiodes, and its SI division sells IT storage devices under a contract with Western Digital. Its subsidiaries sell audio equipment, invest through a partnership and make optical communication parts.

047040.text: Daewoo Engineering & Construction was set up in 2000 as a new company spun off from its predecessor's construction division, and has 30 consolidated subsidiaries. It builds infrastructure such as roads and railways, buildings such as apartments, officetels and offices, and plants including oil and gas facilities, power plants and industrial facilities. Through subsidiaries it also runs hotels, steel bridge and structure work and overseas development.

047050.text: POSCO International is a global business company spun off from its predecessor's trading division in 2000, with 44 subsidiaries at home and abroad. Through 127 overseas locations it runs materials businesses in steel, EV parts, battery materials and palm oil, and energy businesses such as LNG terminals and renewables. In 2025 it completed an overseas plant for drive motor cores and acquired an Indonesian palm oil company.

047080.text: Hanbit Soft was founded in 1999 to develop and sell game software and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002. Through a subsidiary it offers online and mobile games, and another subsidiary distributes drones as an official DJI partner. It launched a mobile version of one of its online games in Korea in 2024, planned services in Taiwan and Japan for 2025, and is preparing businesses such as AI voice avatars.

047310.text: Power Logics was founded in 1997 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003, with 10 unlisted subsidiaries. Its ES division makes protection circuits for secondary batteries, which improve Li-ion battery safety, as well as mid- and large-sized battery packs. Its CM division makes camera modules for mobile IT devices and vehicles, and it is a first-tier supplier for smartphones.

047400.text: Union Materials was founded in 2000 to make ferrite magnets and fine ceramics, and listed on the KOSPI in 2009. It makes components that use the properties of ceramics, including ferrite magnets, cutting tools, magnetron stems for microwave ovens and discs for faucet valves. It has subsidiaries in China and Vietnam.

047560.text: ESTsoftCorp is an AI and software company founded in 1993 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2008. Its businesses include AI software, utility and security software, an AI portal, AI eyewear commerce and asset management. It uses generative AI for dubbing and avatar video creation, and is pursuing AI search and agentic AI with its own AI model.

047770.text: Codes Combine makes and distributes women's casual clothing under its main brand, codes-combine. Since a 2016 domestic license deal with the US innerwear brand JOCKEY, it also makes and supplies underwear, thermal wear and socks. Founded in 1995, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001, went through court-led rehabilitation in 2015, returned to normal operations in 2016 and has 1 subsidiary.

047810.text: Korea Aerospace Industries designs, makes, sells and maintains military aircraft, civil aircraft, helicopters, spacecraft, satellites, launch vehicles and their parts. Its products include the KT-1, T-50, FA-50, KUH and LAH, as well as an unmanned aerial vehicle. Founded in 1999 to make aircraft parts, it listed on the KOSPI in 2011, has 7 subsidiaries and added another in 2025.

047820.text: Chorokbaem Media produces and supplies broadcast programs, centred on TV dramas, and also runs broadcast channel, celebrity management, real estate and restaurant businesses, expanding through two subsidiaries. It was founded in 1998 to make textiles and industrial filters, spun off its nonwoven fabric business in 2008 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

047920.text: HLB Pharmaceutical makes and sells prescription drugs, runs contract manufacturing (CMO) and sells health supplements. It sells more than 160 prescription drugs through contract sales, and since acquiring a drug distributor outright in May 2025 it also runs a pharmaceutical distribution business. Founded in 1998, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2015 and took its current name after joining the HLB group in 2020.

048410.text: Hyundai Bioscience is a biopharmaceutical and cosmeceutical company developing new drugs, including the antiviral candidate CP-COV03 and cancer drug candidates, alongside functional cosmetics brands. It has a production plant in Korea and joint ventures and subsidiaries in Japan, the US and elsewhere. It was spun off from an electronics company in 2000 and took its current name in 2018 after largely exiting its IT business.

048430.text: Yura Tech is an auto parts maker that manufactures and sells ignition coils and spark plugs, selling mainly to domestic carmakers and a major auto parts supplier. It has two wholly owned subsidiaries, a trading company in China set up in 2012 and a company in Vietnam set up in 2019. Founded in 1987, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001.

048470.text: Dae Dong Steel distributes steel and runs coil service centers, operating 5 coil service lines at plants in Pohang and Incheon. It began distributing steel after its founding in 1973, became a designated dealer of POSCO hot-rolled products in 1975, converted to a coil service center in 1989 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

048530.text: iNtRON Biotechnology is a biotech company with two divisions. Its new drug division develops first-in-class drugs based on a bacteriophage platform, while its DR division provides PCR-based molecular diagnostics; it also works on antibiotic alternatives for animals. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2011.

048550.text: SM Culture & Contents runs advertising, entertainment management, video content production, corporate travel services and domestic and overseas travel agency businesses. Founded in 1980, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001 and took its current name after SM Entertainment acquired it in 2012. In 2017 it acquired an advertising business spun off from another company and added it through a small merger.

048770.text: TPC Robotics makes automation systems, with a pneumatics division that accounts for about 78% of sales and a robotics division for about 22%, along with bio/3D printing and collaborative robot units. It has 2 plants in Korea, 3 affiliates in China and 1 in the US. Founded in 1979, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001 and adopted its current name in 2026.

048830.text: NPK makes synthetic resin compounds and masterbatches, blending additives into base resins such as ABS, PP, PC and PE to give customers the material properties they need. Its products are used in cars, electrical goods, electronics and other industries. Founded in 1987, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2000 and has an overseas subsidiary in China.

048870.text: Synergy Innovation makes microbial culture media and runs biotechnology, medical and health supplement businesses, while also investing in drug research for degenerative brain diseases. It holds ISO13485 and KGMP certification, and since 2024 has been expanding facilities to enter global markets. Founded in 1998, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004 and has 7 subsidiaries.

048910.text: Daewon Media plans and creates animation and licenses characters, and also runs animation channels, comic publishing and webtoon and web novel businesses. Its subsidiaries include a broadcaster and a publisher, and in 2025 it added a motion capture and virtual technology company to expand its IP business. Founded in 1977, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001.

049070.text: Intops makes IT devices, home appliances, auto parts and molds and provides distribution services. For mobile phone assemblies it handles everything from mold design to inspection and supplies a major domestic electronics maker, with production in Vietnam and China. Founded in 1981, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002 and has 9 subsidiaries, including an Indian unit set up in 2024.

049080.text: Gigalane makes semiconductor equipment and RF communication parts. Its RF business develops mobile base station products, RF antenna modules and RF cables for defense and aviation, while its nano pattern solutions unit supplies ICP/DRIE etching equipment and nanoimprinters. Founded in 2000, it merged with an older company of the same name in 2012 and set up a unit in China in 2024.

049120.text: Fine DNC makes parts for rechargeable batteries and displays. Its battery parts include cell cases, cap assemblies and current collector assemblies, and its display parts include TV and monitor chassis and parts for QD-OLED panels. It is moving into ESS and UPS parts and expanding supply for North America and Europe. Founded in 1992, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001.

049180.text: Cellumed runs medical device and biologics businesses. It handles tissue-engineered products such as demineralized bone and knee cartilage, artificial knee joints and allografts, and makes and distributes bone morphogenetic protein and synovial fluid substitutes. Founded in 1985, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002, entered its current businesses through a 2010 merger and has 5 consolidated subsidiaries.

049430.text: Komelon makes precision measuring tools, mainly steel and long measuring tapes, with its tape measure business making up 90.93% of sales and its rolling business 3.14%. It runs production and sales through subsidiaries in the US and Vietnam. It began making tape measures after its founding in 1963, became a corporation in 1983 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001.

049470.text: Bitplanet was founded in 1997 to make industrial computers and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001. It expanded into integrated security through a 2008 merger and later reached its current structure through acquisitions and group separations. After a change in its largest shareholder in September 2025 through a rights offering and share transfer, it is pursuing new businesses independently.

049480.text: Openbase provides hybrid and multi-cloud solutions, network security solutions, application delivery controllers (ADC), network infrastructure and IT outsourcing services, along with assessment, consulting, implementation and technical support. It has three main subsidiaries. Founded in 1992 to make computers and telecom equipment and develop software, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001.

049520.text: UIL develops and makes mobile phone parts, e-cigarette parts and automotive electronics parts. Its products include smartphone key buttons, metal interior and exterior parts, waterproof and heat-dissipation materials, wireless chargers, e-cigarette devices and injection-molded car parts. Founded in 1982, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001 and has subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Vietnam, India and China.

049550.text: Inktec specializes in inkjet technology and printed electronics. Built on nanotechnology, its businesses cover office and industrial inks, electronic materials such as paste ink, insulating and EMI shielding films and inductors, and printing systems under the JETRIX name. It is expanding in Southeast Asia and Europe with a new domestic plant. Founded in 1992, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

049630.text: Jaeyoung Solutec makes camera actuators for smartphones, covering AF actuators, OIS, encoders and VCMs, and describes itself as the only Korean specialist able to produce the full range. It handles development through mass production, holds 100 industrial property rights and produces through a subsidiary in Vietnam. Founded in 1984, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003.

049720.text: Korea Credit Information runs debt collection, credit investigation and civil petition agency businesses and has ranked first in Korea's debt collection industry for 17 consecutive years, according to the credit information industry association. Founded in 1991, it obtained a debt collection license in 1998 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002. A subsidiary set up in 2019 offers real estate-backed loans.

049800.text: Woojin Plaimm makes plastic injection molding machines, including energy-saving hydraulic and electric models, and provides precision molding solutions to various industries. It has 4 affiliates, in China, the US, Mexico and an R&D unit in Austria. Founded in 1985 to make industrial machinery and automation equipment, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001 and moved to the KOSPI in 2006.

049830.text: Seung IL makes metal cans. It supplies aerosol cans on an OEM basis for cosmetics, insecticides and household goods, and general cans for food, industrial use and sesame oil to large domestic companies, including CJ. Founded in 1961, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001 and expanded its general can business by merging with an affiliate in 2008.

049950.text: meerecompany makes semiconductor and display manufacturing equipment, including edge grinders, and makes touch panels through a subsidiary. It is applying its precision grinding technology to industries such as rechargeable batteries and diversifying into ToF 3D cameras and laparoscopic surgical robots. Founded in 1984, it added a subsidiary in 2026 to enter the financial business.

049960.text: Cell Biotech researches and produces probiotic lactic acid bacteria, selling raw powders and finished products at home and abroad. It ranks second by market share in Denmark and first among Korean exporters, and uses dual coating technology to develop microbiome supplements and a colorectal cancer treatment in clinical trials. Founded in 1995, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

050090.text: BK Holdings is a full-service advertising agency that produces ads for TV, radio, newspapers and magazines and buys media on behalf of clients. It operates from its head office in Gumi and a branch in Seoul, and has focused on advertising since suspending its semiconductor materials business in 2023. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004.

050110.text: CammSys makes small camera modules for mobile IT devices and biometric and healthcare sensor modules for IoT and wearable devices. It is diversifying into AI system cameras and early-stage electric vehicle battery technology. Founded in 1993, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001 and has its head office in Incheon and production subsidiaries in Vietnam and Indonesia.

050120.text: ES Cube makes leisure and functional tents at wholly owned subsidiaries in China and Vietnam and exports them to large buyers in Japan, North America and Europe. Its sales come from ODM and OEM production, and it keeps R&D teams at its Chinese and Vietnamese units. Founded in 1977 to make tents and outdoor gear, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

050760.text: S Polytech makes and sells PC and PMMA sheets and films. Its specialty products are used in security ID cards and passports, windows and furniture, and its general products in noise barriers, building materials, roofing and interiors. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002, absorbed another company in 2006 and has two consolidated subsidiaries, one in China.

050860.text: Asia Technology makes a full line of farm machinery, including power tillers, speed sprayers, tractors and combines, and says its multipurpose tiller is recognized as the world's top product in its class. It was the first farm machinery maker to earn a KS mark and applies ICT and IoT to automate machines. Founded in 1978, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2010.

050890.text: Solid develops, makes and supplies wireless communication equipment, including mobile repeaters, optical transmission equipment and base station equipment based on Open RAN technology. It has 10 subsidiaries, including units in defense communications and aviation and defense parts. Founded in 1998 to make mobile and fixed-line network equipment, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005.

050960.text: Soosan INT develops internet traffic filtering technology used in partnerships with internet service providers, including KT, and sells security solutions that improve business productivity and internet security. It is increasing R&D in mobile security and virtualization-based data security. Founded in 1998 to develop and sell internet software, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2016.

051160.text: Gaeasoft runs IT services, advertising, and distribution and e-commerce businesses, covering system development and operation, integrated marketing, organic food stores and an early-morning delivery platform. It has 8 subsidiaries, which run the delivery platform and a fulfillment business. Founded in 1998 for mobile and wireless internet services, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

051360.text: Tovis makes industrial monitors for casino gaming machines and public information displays, as well as automotive displays and TFT-LCD modules. Its customers include global casino companies such as ARISTOCRAT and IGT and automotive electronics suppliers. Founded in 1998, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004.

051370.text: Interflex makes flexible printed circuit boards (FPCB), including foldable and rigid FPCBs, supplying key parts for smartphones, LCDs, OLEDs and other electronics. Its main customers are large domestic electronics and display makers, and it has two subsidiaries in Vietnam. Founded in 1994 to make and sell FPCBs, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003.

051380.text: PC Direct distributes IT hardware, holding distribution rights for global brands such as Seagate, Intel and NVIDIA and supplying processors, storage, motherboards and graphics cards. It added distribution rights for Sennheiser in 2024 and Dreame in 2025, extending its range from industrial components to home appliances. Founded in 1998, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

051390.text: YW runs wholesale, rental and corporate finance businesses. It rents office equipment, home appliances, medical devices and industrial equipment to business customers, typically on contracts of about 3 years, and has been widening its rental range since 2015. Its corporate finance arm invests spare cash in corporate bonds and loans. Founded in 1995, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001.

051490.text: Nara Mold And Die makes molds for the mass production of cars, displays and home appliances and uses its mold technology to mass-produce parts. It was founded in 1999 as a spin-off of an electronics maker's in-house mold plant and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001. It has 7 subsidiaries, including units in Indonesia, China, Poland and Mexico.

051500.text: CJ Freshway distributes food ingredients and runs contract catering for offices, industrial sites and hospitals, and also makes sauces, dressings and extracts and pre-processes farm produce. It is an intermediate holding company within the CJ group with 7 subsidiaries, 4 in Korea and 3 abroad. Founded in 1988, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001.

051600.text: Kepco Plant Service & Engineering maintains power generation equipment, covering thermal, nuclear and transmission and substation facilities at home and abroad. It applies its technology for improving plant performance and uptime in countries such as the UAE and South Africa, and is pursuing nuclear decommissioning and renewable energy. It was founded in 1984 with full funding from KEPCO.

051630.text: Chinyang Chemical makes plastic products, mainly artificial leather for cars and interiors and tarpaulin fabric. Its PVC artificial leather, made mainly from fabric and PVC resin, gives the feel of natural leather at a lower cost. The company was formed in 2001 when a synthetic resin division was split off from its parent, and listed on the KOSPI the same year.

051780.text: Curo Holdings mainly imports and distributes coffee and coffee machines. Its coffee business imports beans and related products from Italy's illy Caffe and supplies them to luxury hotels, golf courses, upscale restaurants and department stores. It also has subsidiaries in entertainment and resource development. Founded in 1987, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001.

051900.text: LG H&H has three divisions, Beauty, HDB and Refreshment, covering cosmetics, household goods and beverages under its own brands. Positioning itself as a 'Science-driven Beauty & Wellness Company' based on its R&D, it has also been expanding into beauty devices. The company was split off from LG Chem and listed in 2001.

051910.text: LG Chem runs petrochemicals, advanced materials and life sciences businesses, along with its battery and crop protection subsidiaries, through 76 consolidated subsidiaries. Its petrochemical unit produces PE, PVC and ABS, its advanced materials unit makes battery materials such as cathode materials and separators plus electronic materials, and its life sciences unit makes drugs including a diabetes treatment. It was split off in 2001 and spun off its battery business in 2020.

051980.text: Joongang Advanced Materials makes PVC products and building materials such as PVC windows and ducts, produces communication equipment for electric trains and the public sector, and runs a property sales agency business. Since 2023 it has also distributed materials for rechargeable batteries. Founded in 1999, the company listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001.

052020.text: Stcube runs a biotech business with its main subsidiary, STCube Pharmaceuticals, developing cancer immunotherapies including an immune checkpoint inhibitor targeting BTN1A1 that is in global clinical trials. It also makes and distributes cosmetics under its own brand and sells industrial lens modules. Founded in 1989, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001.

052220.text: iMBC provides paid and free digital content through the MBC group's www.imbc.com and runs online advertising and promotions tied to the group's drama, entertainment, current affairs and radio programs. It was set up in 2000 as an MBC group subsidiary for internet broadcasting, digital content and web agency work, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005. A subsidiary runs an international parcel forwarding business.

052260.text: Hyundai Bioland uses extraction, fermentation, purification and concentration technologies to draw active compounds from natural materials. Its businesses include cosmetic ingredients, brand distribution, health supplements, medical devices and pharmaceutical ingredients. Founded in 1995 to make natural raw materials for cosmetics, drugs and functional foods, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001.

052300.text: Ocean In W distributes glass as a dealer for KCC and another glassmaker, serving about 300 customers nationwide, and earns rental income from real estate in Seoul. It has 13 consolidated subsidiaries. Founded in 1995, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001 and adopted its current name in 2024.

052330.text: Kortek makes industrial monitors in two areas: gaming monitors and public information displays (PID). Its gaming monitors are a core part of slot machines, used for game display, touch control and visual effects. Founded in 1987, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001, belongs to a domestic business group and has overseas subsidiaries in Vietnam and the US.

052400.text: Kona I makes smart cards, supplying COB and finished cards to about 90 countries, and ranks fourth by global market share. Subsidiaries make metal cards and run a taxi-hailing platform and OTA services, and its MVNO business broke even in 2025. It is also working on stablecoins, STOs and automotive electronics. Founded in 1998, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001.

052420.text: Osung Advanced Materials makes display films, producing PET protective films, process protective films and functional films at one site and antistatic interleaf sheets and trays at another. Founded in 1994, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001 and took its current name after a 2018 spin-off. It acquired a shipping company in 2024 and absorbed an affiliate in March 2026.

052460.text: i Craft provides AI services, network solutions and cloud services, including design and construction of AI data centers built on GPU computing platforms, core and access network construction, system integration, and cloud and integrated security services. It has 3 affiliates. Founded in 2000 to build internet networks and systems, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005.

052600.text: Hannet runs a CD-VAN business installing and operating cash machines, mainly in public places, and an automation business that sells self-checkout machines and settlement services to retailers. It was the first private company in Korea to install off-site cash machines. It began in 1990 as a VAN division of another company, became independent in 1997 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001.

052690.text: Kepco Engineering & Construction designs nuclear power plants and handles nuclear plant design in Korea. It completed the design of the UAE's Barakah plant using the APR1400 reactor and signed a design contract for a plant in the Czech Republic in 2025. It also works on combined-cycle, offshore wind and hydrogen power, SMRs and the floating small reactor BANDI. Founded in 1975, it joined the KEPCO group in 1982.

052710.text: Amotech makes parts based on new materials, including ceramic chip components, antenna components for wireless communications and BLDC motors for cars and home appliances. Founded in 1994 to make electronic components, it absorbed motor and varistor companies in 1999, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003 and has 3 subsidiaries, including one in China.

052770.text: Itoxi focuses on publishing and republishing mobile games, working with outside developers and partners across planning, publishing and marketing. Founded in 1997 for software consulting and development, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002, merged with a computer game developer in 2005 and adopted its current name in 2020.

052790.text: Actoz Soft develops and services online and mobile games and runs a game publishing and IP licensing business built on several flagship titles. The company says one of them has drawn cumulative members in China equal to 40% of the country's population and was the first Korean game to enter Europe. Founded in 1996, it has 9 consolidated subsidiaries.

052860.text: I&C Technology designs system semiconductors across smart energy, wireless, multimedia and AE businesses. It takes part in the state power utility's AMI project and develops its own Wi-Fi chipsets for IoT. Covering everything from arc detection SoCs to finished breakers, it has developed a third-generation compact arc breaker. Founded in 1996, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2009.

052900.text: KX Hitech makes parts and materials for front-end and back-end chip manufacturing, such as IC trays, module trays and carrier tape, as well as SSD cases and broadcast receivers. It has 6 subsidiaries and overseas units in China, the Philippines and Vietnam. Founded in 1997, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005 and took its current name in 2022.

053030.text: Binex makes chemical drugs and provides CDMO services for biopharmaceuticals, offering one-stop work from cell line and process development to finished products. It runs CDMO operations at two plants and makes chemical drugs in various dosage forms at a plant in Busan, and has passed global GMP inspections. Founded in 1957, it acquired production facilities from a chemical company in 2015.

053050.text: GSE supplies LNG city gas in several cities and runs CNG vehicle charging stations, and is working to develop industrial and cooling demand to narrow gaps in demand. Founded in 1989 to supply network systems, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001 and entered the city gas business through a merger in 2010.

053060.text: Sae Dong makes exterior auto parts such as metal extrusions, variable extrusions and gas-injection moldings, supplying domestic carmakers. For the shift to electrified vehicles it is developing ETF coating, PVD deposition and aluminum lightweighting technologies. Founded in 1986, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001 and has subsidiaries in Brazil and the US.

053080.text: K-ensol builds industrial clean rooms, dry rooms and bio clean rooms, offering design through construction, commissioning and operating guidance, and also works on IDC immersion cooling and bridge construction. Its clean room customers are chip, battery and bio companies, while its bridge work is for public agencies. Founded in 1989, it entered bridge construction through a 2019 acquisition and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020.

053160.text: FreeMs makes electrical parts for construction machinery and industrial vehicles, such as wire harnesses and battery cables. It has its head office and plant in Korea and 2 subsidiaries in China. Founded in 1989 to make electrical parts for construction equipment and automatic control devices, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001.

053210.text: KT Skylife is Korea's only satellite broadcaster, providing the same service nationwide, and sells TPS bundles combining satellite TV, cable, internet and budget mobile services. It added a cable TV operator as a key subsidiary in 2021 and runs the ENA, ENA PLAY and ENA DRAMA channels through another subsidiary. Founded in 2001, it listed on the KOSPI in 2011.

053260.text: Keum Kang Steel's main business is cutting and slitting cold-rolled steel coil to customer specifications as a designated processing center for a major steelmaker. Its other units provide management and M&A advisory and collect livestock manure to make and spread liquid fertilizer. Founded in 1977, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

053270.text: Guyoung Technology makes seat, body, drivetrain and electric vehicle parts, mainly for domestic carmakers. It has units in the US and China, and in 2025 acquired CAR TECH, which supplies BMW and other global makers, to strengthen its North American business. Founded in 1989, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002 and completed an integrated plant in Daegu in 2017.

053280.text: YES24Co runs an online bookstore selling books, eBooks, music and DVDs, along with a performance ticketing business and a digital business in web novels and webtoons. Its subsidiaries include a concert hall, web novel producers and a fractional art investment platform. It launched Korea's first online bookstore in 1998, incorporated in 1999 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2008.

053290.text: NE Neungyule publishes educational materials and provides education services for preschoolers and school students, with several best-selling English textbook brands including Grammar Zone. Founded in 1994 for English education and publishing, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002 and joined a domestic business group in 2009.

053300.text: Korea Information Certificate Authority provides integrated security and authentication services, including joint certificates, PKI solutions, SSL web security servers, OTP, e-signatures and electronic document issuance. Founded in 1999 as Korea's first certification authority, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2014 and added an e-document business through a 2024 merger. Its subsidiaries include advertising businesses.

053350.text: Initech supplies security software such as PKI, database encryption and integrated access management, having launched Korea's first integrated internet banking security service in 1999. Its financial IT business provides IT staff outsourcing, data center operations and internet banking systems to financial firms. Founded in 1997 to develop software, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001.

053450.text: Sekonix makes camera lenses and modules for phones and cars, car lamps, optical parts, visibility-enhancing films and heart rate sensor films for watches. It has 7 production bases in Korea, China, Vietnam and Poland, and runs 4 domestic research labs. Founded in 1988 to make optical parts, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001.

053580.text: WebCash provides B2B financial services and launched Korea's first corporate internet banking service before expanding into cash management (CMS). Its network links all domestic financial institutions and 482 banks in 44 countries with companies' internal systems in real time. Founded in 1999, it began shifting toward financial AI in 2025 and is pursuing 5 AI businesses.

053610.text: Protec makes semiconductor packaging equipment based on high-speed automation, including dispensers, die bonders and AGVs. Founded in 1997 to make chip equipment, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001, acquired Japan's MINAMI CO.,LTD in 2012, set up an investment company in 2022 and acquired 100% of a venture capital firm in 2024.

053620.text: Taeyang makes portable butane gas and aerosol products. Its portable butane brand holds more than 70% of the domestic market and more than 60% of the global market, and a US subsidiary, SUN America, imports and sells portable butane in North America. Founded in 1989 to make cans and fill gas, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001.

053690.text: HanmiGlobal provides construction management, overseeing projects from planning and design through construction, supervision and post-completion management. Founded in 1996 as Korea's first construction management firm, it listed on the KOSPI in 2009 and has 20 unlisted subsidiaries. It has acquired US firms Otak, DAYCPM, TWG and Loris and Associates, as well as two domestic firms.

053700.text: Sambo Motors makes automatic transmission parts and pipes for cars, and makes plastic products and molds through subsidiaries. It acquired an electric vehicle parts maker in 2023 and set up SAMBO MOTORS INDIA in 2024 to expand its global network. Founded in 1987, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001.

053800.text: Ahnlab is an integrated security company with 5 affiliates, including units in Japan and China. In 2024 it acquired a cloud-native company to launch a combined MSP business and set up Rakeen, a cybersecurity joint venture in Saudi Arabia. Founded in 1995, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001.

053950.text: Kyung Nam Pharm makes and sells drugs and pharmaceutical ingredients and runs a health supplement business. Founded in 1998, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001, merged with an older company of the same name in 2010, and in 2026 gained several subsidiaries by investing in an investment partnership.

053980.text: Osangjaiel runs IT and agricultural packaging businesses. In IT it provides PLM solutions as a Korean partner of Dassault Systems and system integration as an IBM partner, while its BT unit makes premium fruit packaging and is developing cosmetics using boehmite-based materials. Founded in 1993, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

054040.text: Korea Computer provides electronics manufacturing services, producing OLED and QD-OLED PBAs and industrial inverters for a display maker and an electrical equipment maker. It belongs to a domestic business group and has a subsidiary in Vietnam. Founded in 1994, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

054050.text: NH Nongwoobio researches, produces and sells vegetable seeds and farm supplies, developing seeds through breeding and biotechnology research and making growing media, organic fertilizer and biochar. It runs 3 research centers and 10 sales branches in Korea and 7 overseas units. Founded in 1990 and part of the NH group, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

054090.text: Samjin LND makes parts such as ESS, UPS and busbar components, along with products including OA finishers and diffuser plates. It runs 6 overseas subsidiaries in the US, Mexico and Vietnam, which produce parts, OA units, ESL and adapter parts. Founded in 1987, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004.

054180.text: Medicox has two businesses: shipbuilding equipment, where it makes specially fabricated ship blocks, and motors and generators, which it produces on an OEM basis for a heavy industry company. It was founded in 1998 for software and electronics services, incorporated in 1999 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001, and has 3 consolidated subsidiaries.

054210.text: Elentec makes battery packs, plastic and metal cases and chargers for global mobile phone makers, and supplies battery packs for power tools, laptops, vacuum cleaners and ESS. It has 7 subsidiaries with production in Malaysia, Vietnam, India and China. Founded in 1982 to make electronic components, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

054220.text: VitzroSys makes automatic control systems for power monitoring, railway operations control, nuclear power plant control and water treatment monitoring. It is expanding into control systems for small modular reactors, smart remote meter reading and corrosion prevention. Founded in 1989 with technical cooperation from France's CLEMESSY, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001 and has 4 subsidiaries.

054300.text: Panstar Enterprise makes car maintenance equipment such as lifts and wheel alignment systems, holding more than 60% of the domestic market. Since 2016 it has run ship leasing and cruise businesses, and it has more than 300 ship conversion designs in its ship engineering work. Founded in 1991, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

054410.text: Korea Plasma Technology U provides metal surface treatment through Plasma PVD Coating and Metal Ceramic Coating, adding wear and corrosion resistance to metal materials. It also treats auto parts, processes mold parts and sells aluminum materials, and is developing environmentally friendly processes. Founded in 1995, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

054450.text: Telechips is a fabless chip designer focused on automotive semiconductors, offering solutions centred on application processors and supplying chips for IVI systems. It is expanding into ADAS and vehicle gateway chips and has developed the N-Dolphin vision processor and the AXON network processor for software-defined vehicles. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004.

054540.text: Samyoung M-tek C0 makes industrial steel materials for plant equipment and ship engine structures, as well as bridge bearings, supplying ship engine makers and power and steel plant makers at home and abroad. Its subsidiaries make rubber parts for cars and appliances, invest in companies, produce steel materials in China and farm. Founded in 1997, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001.

054620.text: APS is a holding company that also runs a new materials unit, with software, skin care device and semiconductor equipment businesses under its subsidiaries. It has 8 subsidiaries and 16 second-tier subsidiaries. Founded in 1994 to make chip and LCD equipment, it became a holding company through a 2017 spin-off and in 2026 absorbed a company to run a semiconductor parts business directly.

054670.text: Daehan Nupharm makes and sells human and animal medicines. Its prescription drugs focus on metabolic diseases such as hypertension and diabetes and on peptic ulcer treatments, and it is expanding into obesity, dementia and Parkinson's disease. It is also building up vitamin, mineral and immune-boosting injections and developing veterinary treatments, vaccines and pet products. Founded in 1984, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

054780.text: Keyeast is an entertainment company that plans and produces dramas, films and other video content with creators and supplies them to broadcasters and OTT platforms. It also scouts and manages artists and runs a rights business using its content IP. Founded in 1996, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003.

054800.text: IDIS Holdings is a holding company that controls and advises its subsidiaries, develops new technology and leases real estate, earning mainly rental, service and other income. It has 21 affiliates, including 4 listed companies. Founded in 1997 to develop, make and sell video equipment, it became a holding company for its investment business through a spin-off in 2011.

054920.text: Hancom WITH is a security company offering PKI authentication, integrated simple authentication, biometric authentication, data and mobile security and SSO solutions. Through a subsidiary it also wholesales and distributes physical gold. Founded in 1999 under a different name, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001, took its current name in 2019 and sold a former unit during the year.

054930.text: Yooshin Engineering provides feasibility studies, design and construction management across infrastructure, including roads, railways, airports, bridges and ports, as well as water resources, urban planning, plants and the environment. Founded in 1966, it was the first civil engineering firm to list on the KOSDAQ, in 2002, and expanded into EPC through a small merger completed in 2025.

054940.text: Exa E&C builds uninterruptible clean rooms for chip and OLED plants, makes partitions for data centers and other advanced facilities, and runs a space design and interior business. It works with major domestic chip and display makers and construction firms. Founded in 1991 to make electronic parts and run water treatment, it absorbed clean room and telecom parts makers between 2004 and 2007.

054950.text: Jvm develops hospital and pharmacy automation systems and software in-house, automating the dispensing, packaging, inspection and management of medicines with products such as ATDPS and MENITH. Founded in 1977 to make pharmacy dispensing equipment, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006, became part of a pharmaceutical group in 2016 and has subsidiaries in Europe and China.

055490.text: Tapex makes tapes for rechargeable batteries, displays and semiconductors, along with food packaging wrap and other industrial and kitchen products. It is adding sites and capacity, targeting Europe and North America and growing sales of high-performance UV tape for MLCCs. Founded in 1994 as a tape maker, it entered food wrap through a 2003 acquisition and electronic materials tape in 2005.

055550.text: Shinhan Financial Group is a financial holding company offering banking, credit cards, financial investment, life and non-life insurance, specialized credit, asset management, savings banking and real estate trust services. It was formed in 2001 through a share swap by the shareholders of four Shinhan companies, listed in Korea in 2001 and on the New York Stock Exchange as ADSs in 2003. It has 412 consolidated subsidiaries.

056080.text: Yujin Robot develops and makes robots, including autonomous logistics robots, 3D LiDAR sensors, robot automation packages and smart automation systems. Offering end-to-end solutions covering LiDAR sensors, SLAM and navigation, it is pursuing global smart logistics automation. Founded in 1993, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001 and exited its toy business in 2021 to focus on robots.

056090.text: CG MedTech develops, makes and supplies medical devices such as fracture fixation devices, spinal implants and minimally invasive instruments, and its electric energy unit supplies smart grid, AMI and EV-related products. Founded in 1997 to make orthopedic devices, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2015 as a technology growth company and has 6 subsidiaries, including one in which it bought a 90% stake in 2026.

056190.text: SFA Engineering and its consolidated subsidiaries focus on AI robotics and semiconductor packaging. It has 12 consolidated subsidiaries, and in 2026 it sold its stake in SFA Sweden AB and completed the liquidation of CIS USA Inc. Founded in 1998 as a spin-off of an aerospace company's automation division, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001.

056360.text: Coweaver develops and makes optical transmission equipment such as MSPP, PTN (POTN), CWDM and ROADM, supplying telecom carriers including KT, LG U+ and SKT, and also works in quantum cryptography. A wholly owned subsidiary develops and makes wireless mobile terminal equipment. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001.

056700.text: Shinwha Intertek makes and sells optical films for TFT-LCDs, which account for about 90% of its sales. Founded in 1988 to make specialty tapes, it joined a domestic business group in 2013 and has sold its entire stake in a Chinese unit to reshape its business portfolio.

056730.text: CNT85 builds environmental facilities and plants, including incineration and power facilities, sludge recycling, air pollution control and wastewater treatment systems, and rechargeable battery production equipment. It also makes filter presses for industrial wastewater and develops housing under its own brand. Founded in 1996, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

057030.text: YBM Net provides B2C and B2B online education, online registration for language tests, junior education and device sales. It uses AI tutors and AI-based assessment systems and exports IT solutions and content overseas. Founded in 2000 for online education, database and education services, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004.

057540.text: Omnisystem makes meters and remote meter reading systems, manufactures credit cards and runs a lighting business. It developed Korea's first digital watt-hour meter capable of remote reading and produces at domestic plants and a factory in Vietnam. It is expanding through energy management systems and monitoring software and diversifying into EV chargers. It was founded in 1997.

057680.text: T Scientific runs information security, SI/ITO services and mobile coupon businesses, providing infrastructure management and security log analysis solutions to about 200 financial firms, public institutions and companies. Founded in 1998 for mobile platforms and content, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002 and entered security through mergers in 2023 and 2024.

058110.text: Mekics makes respiratory care devices across the field, including high-flow respiratory therapy devices, non-invasive ventilators and home CPAP machines. It is reshaping its business around a wider product range, dedicated consumables and AI-assisted respiratory care services. Founded in 1998, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2015 and has 5 unlisted subsidiaries, including a ventilator and patient monitor maker in China.

058400.text: Korea New Network is a private regional broadcaster for Busan and the surrounding region, the only one serving that area as a single broadcast zone. It runs TV and radio broadcasting and earns revenue from advertising, sponsorship, services and rentals, and forms a national network through an agreement with SBS. Founded in 1994, it went on air in 1995, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2010 and has 3 unlisted subsidiaries.

058430.text: POSCO Steeleon makes galvanized and other coated steel sheets, supplying products such as ALCOSTA, MACOSTA and ALZASTA to the automotive, home appliance and construction materials markets. Founded in 1988, it merged with another company in 1999, completed its #2CGL line in 2004 and #4CCL line in 2018, and acquired a coating plant in 2019 to enter Southeast Asia.

058450.text: Hanjoo ART runs a film props business covering broadcast equipment rental, broadcast content and prop making, after its industry classification changed from plastic products to film and broadcast production in May 2025. It has 3 consolidated subsidiaries. Founded in 1978, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002 and has been entering new businesses since a change in its largest shareholder in January 2026.

058470.text: Leeno Industrial makes test probes and semiconductor test sockets and was the first in Korea to develop them under its own brand, replacing products that had been fully imported. It also makes parts for medical devices and handles all production steps in-house. Founded as a business in 1978, it incorporated in 1996 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001.

058610.text: SPG makes about 900 models of geared motors for FA, OA and HA uses, small motors for home appliances and blowers. It is expanding into planetary and precision reducers and actuators for robots. Founded in 1991, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002 and gained more than 50 years of small motor know-how through a 2016 merger.

058630.text: Mgame develops and publishes PC and mobile games and runs a game portal that services about 50 games. Founded in 1999 as a first-generation game developer, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2008 and has 6 consolidated subsidiaries. In 2025 it set up two new companies, including a rehabilitation and nursing care operator, to diversify.

058650.text: Seah Holdings is a pure holding company and the representative company of the Seah group, which has 24 domestic affiliates, 8 of them its direct domestic subsidiaries. Its group businesses span steelmaking and ferroalloys, rolled, extruded and drawn steel products, and non-residential building leasing. It was formed in 2001 when an affiliate's investment and leasing division was split off.

058730.text: Development Advance Solution runs solar-focused energy, building materials, SOC and steel businesses, with its SOC work covering road safety products such as vehicle crash barriers, guardrails and noise barriers. It has 19 consolidated subsidiaries, including 4 in which it newly acquired stakes. Founded in 1996, it listed on the KOSPI in 2004.

058820.text: CMG Pharmaceutical researches, makes and sells drugs and health supplements as a core affiliate of a domestic business group.
