Its STARFILM Technology is an orally dissolving film (ODF) platform, which it is also applying to improved new drugs. It is expanding into cancer, anti-aging, eye care and health supplement products. The company listed on the KOSDAQ in 2001.

058850.text: ktcs runs contact services such as KT customer centers and 114 directory assistance, and sells KT fixed and mobile telecom products through its own stores and KT's face-to-face channels. It has commercialized its own AICC solution, HiQri, as it moves toward becoming an AI contact company. It was spun off from KT's 114 directory service in 2001 and listed on the KOSPI in 2010.

058860.text: ktis runs KT customer centers, general contact centers, distribution and directory assistance. In 2025, KT customer centers made up 45% of sales, general contact centers 32%, distribution 19%, directory assistance 3% and other 1%. It was spun off from KT's 114 directory service in 2001, listed on the KOSPI in 2010 and in late 2025 acquired and absorbed a contact center operator specializing in finance.

058970.text: EMRO makes AI-based supply chain management software, including digital procurement systems and analytics and optimization solutions, and has completed about 1,600 projects with large companies. Since 2024 it has been entering overseas markets with a domestic IT services partner through Caidentia, a global SRM SaaS. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

059090.text: MiCo operates in four areas: making, cleaning and coating parts for semiconductor equipment; SOFC, industrial boilers and BHS; AI-based IT solutions; and microbial and molecular diagnostic equipment. Drawing on ceramic materials technology, it aims to localize high-performance chip equipment parts and commercialize SOFC and CCUS technology. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002 and has 41 affiliates.

059100.text: i-Components makes optical films such as barrier coating films, functional coatings, light guide plates, PC film and PMMA film, and sells them to IT companies. Its barrier films are being applied to QD TVs, ESLs, monitors and organic solar cells, and it is keeping pace with technologies such as substrates for flexible OLED displays. Founded in 2000 to make flat panel display parts, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2008.

059120.text: Ajinextek builds motor control technology into ASIC and SoC chips using non-memory chip design skills, and develops and sells motion control modules and robot controllers. It is working on joint development with large companies, new businesses and core software and hardware technology. Founded in 1997 to develop precision motion controllers based on custom chip design, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2014.

059210.text: Metabiomed runs dental, suture, medical and cosmetic divisions, developing dental materials and equipment, biodegradable suture threads, threads for cosmetic procedures and bone repair materials, which it exports to about 100 countries. It has sales bases in the US, Germany, China and Japan and a production unit in Vietnam. Founded in 1990 to make dental materials, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2008.

059270.text: Haisung Aero-Robotics designs and makes reducers and gears, and holds the largest domestic market share in elevator traction machines, which it produces with its own worm gear technology. It says it is the only company mass-producing high-precision cycloid reducers for industrial robots, and it is expanding into yaw and pitch drives for wind turbines and turning gears for ships. It was founded in 1997.

060150.text: Insun Environmental New Technology collects, transports and processes construction waste, and is the only domestic company in the field with technology and patents covering the whole chain from scaffolding dismantling to recycled aggregate production, incineration and steam sales, and landfill disposal. Founded in 1997, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002 and has 5 subsidiaries.

060230.text: JK Synapse develops and produces etching agents for semiconductor showerheads and electronic materials for display processes, and makes UHF and HF RFID inlays and finished tags in a one-stop production system. It is focusing on higher-value products such as OLED materials, eco-friendly chemicals and foldable OCA. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

060250.text: NHN KCP provides payment services through online payment, offline payment and project divisions. Its online unit offers PG and VAN services, its offline unit provides VAN services and payment terminals, and its project unit offers kiosks, order data relay and cloud POS solutions. Founded in 1994, it merged with another payment company in 2006 and has 4 unlisted subsidiaries.

060260.text: Nuvotec makes water and sewage infrastructure products such as PVC double-wall sewer pipes, impact-resistant water pipes and manholes, and also makes eco-friendly de-icing agents and runs a recycling business that treats designated waste. Demand for its water products is tied to government and local SOC investment. Founded in 1990 to make environmental piping materials, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

060280.text: Curexo develops and sells medical robots, including a joint replacement surgery robot, a spine surgery robot and a rehabilitation robot. It outsources manufacturing on an OEM basis to limit fixed costs and serves mainly domestic hospitals while growing overseas sales. Founded in 1992, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002 and set up an Indian subsidiary in 2024.

060310.text: 3S Korea mainly makes semiconductor wafer carriers, such as FOSB, FOUP and O/C boxes for moving silicon wafers, and environmental test equipment, including calorimeters and environmental control systems it designs and produces for customers. Founded in 1991, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002 and has 3 subsidiaries, including one in China.

060370.text: LS Marine Solution builds and maintains subsea power and telecom cables, installs and maintains specialty cables and carries out surveys. In 2024 it added an LS underground cable installation company as a consolidated subsidiary, allowing it to offer turnkey subsea and underground work. Founded in 1995, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002 and adopted its current name in 2023.

060380.text: Dongyang S·TEC processes hot-rolled coil, sheet and plate as a processing center for a major steelmaker, making small construction members, BH-BEAMs and standard materials. Its 4 subsidiaries handle construction waste, metal-cutting machinery, steel structure work and designated waste collection. Founded in 1981 to make and sell steel products, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

060480.text: Kukil Metal makes copper alloy products, mainly brass rods, along with iron-copper alloy coil, copper slabs, tin-plated products and copper balls. Its rolled and extruded copper products serve as basic materials for electrical and electronics, semiconductor, telecom, automotive, construction, gas appliance, medical device and defense industries. Founded in 1993, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2014.

060540.text: System and Application Technologies runs ITS, mobile parts supply and real estate leasing businesses, while its subsidiaries handle calibration, construction waste processing and shrink film manufacturing. It has 14 domestic and overseas subsidiaries, including units in Vietnam. Founded in 1998 to design and make electronic control equipment, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006.

060560.text: HC HomeCenter is a holding company that wholesales and retails building materials and runs leisure sports and neighborhood commercial facilities. Its affiliates include 13 ready-mixed concrete makers and companies in asphalt concrete, fuel wholesale, logistics and apartment construction, and it acquired a housing builder in 2024. Founded in 1988 for fire protection work, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002 and became a holding company in 2017.

060570.text: Dreamus runs a platform business built on FLO, a music platform launched in 2018, along with artist-linked IP businesses in music and album distribution, merchandise and concerts. Using distribution rights from major music producers, it invests in music IP and fandom businesses. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003 and took a majority stake in another company in 2024.

060590.text: CTC Bio researches, makes and distributes animal medicines such as feed additives, injectables and vaccines, along with improved new drugs and generics for humans. It runs its animal vaccine business through a subsidiary and has core technologies in microbial fermentation, drug coating and DDS, and it is developing CTCZYME. Founded in 1993, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

060720.text: KH Vatec makes parts for smartphones, laptops, tablets and other IT devices, as well as telecom equipment and robot parts, using die-casting, CNC and IDC processes. Founded in 1992 to do small precision die-casting with non-ferrous metals, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002 and has 8 subsidiaries, with units in China, Vietnam and India.

060850.text: YoungLimWon SoftLab develops and supplies ERP software. It developed the Korean-style ERP K-System in 1997 for small and midsize companies and now offers products including K-System Ace I&I and SystemEver, combining ERP with AI, cloud and data technology. Founded in 1993, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020.

060900.text: Agent AI develops and maintains wind and other renewable energy projects, its main business, and through subsidiaries runs AI payment, game and self-driving taxi businesses. It has 9 affiliates, including an offshore wind company, and is pursuing green hydrogen as a new business. Founded in 1997, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

060980.text: HL Holdings earns royalties from the HL, Halla and Mando brands and sells and distributes auto parts and accessories, among other businesses. It has 55 affiliates, including 14 in Korea and 40 overseas. Founded in 1999, it became a holding company through a spin-off in 2014 and turned into an operating holding company after a merger in 2015.

061040.text: Rftech supplies chargers, data link cables and wireless charging combo antennas on an ODM basis to a major domestic electronics maker, and also makes 5G base station antenna modules. It has units in China, Vietnam, the Americas and India, and in 2026 restructured by selling a stake in one affiliate and setting up another. Founded in 1995 for wireless communications devices, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

061090.text: Sena Technologies develops, makes and sells wearable smart devices, with 95% of its sales coming from overseas. Its more than 170 products include mesh communication devices for motorcycles and bicycles and smart helmets, and it works with about 60 companies such as BMW Motorrad and Shoei. It is extending its mesh technology to robot communications. It was founded in 1998.

061250.text: Hwail Pharm makes and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients and finished drugs, handling ingredients across a wide range of therapeutic classes such as cardiovascular and gastrointestinal treatments. It runs a plant dedicated to cephalosporin antibiotics, used both for its own products and for contract manufacturing (CMO). Founded in 1980, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002 and in 2024 bought an industrial-park plant that it plans to use for ingredient production once permits are granted.

061970.text: LB Semicon provides back-end (OSAT) services for non-memory chips such as DDI, PMIC and CIS used in flat-panel displays. It also runs a battery recycling business that recovers cobalt, nickel, manganese and lithium from electric vehicle batteries and ESS. Founded in 2000 to offer chip and package design services and passive components, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2011 and absorbed a subsidiary through a merger in 2025.

062040.text: Sanil Electric makes power equipment and also runs a renewable energy business. Transformers, its main product, account for 96% of cumulative sales for the current period. Founded in 1994, it listed on the KOSPI in July 2024, has one subsidiary and is treated as a small or medium-sized enterprise under a grace period running from 2024 to 2028.

062970.text: Korea Advanced Materials builds optical communication components on its own planar lightwave circuit (PLC) technology, supplying PLC optical power splitters and wavelength division devices to global markets and to the three domestic telecom carriers. Founded in 1999 to develop wired optical communication equipment, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019 and added 4 new subsidiaries during the current fiscal year.

063080.text: Com2uS Holdings is an operating holding company whose businesses span holding and investment activities, mobile and PC game services, blockchain development and game platforms. Its wholly owned subsidiary provides Hive, an all-in-one game back-end platform, as part of a multi-platform strategy. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2009 and took its current name in 2021.

063160.text: CKD Bio was spun off in 2001 from another company in its group, of which it is a core affiliate. Using fermentation and biotechnology, it produces active pharmaceutical ingredients, probiotics, microbiome products and botulinum toxin, supplying about 40 countries. In 2025 it won domestic approval for its botulinum toxin and began phase 3 trials in China, and it is expanding into microbiome CDMO work and new drug pipelines.

063170.text: Seoul Auction runs art auctions and also sells and brokers artworks, along with related businesses. It holds regular offline and online auctions, drawing on an appraisal system and specialist staff in each field to secure works for sale. Founded in 1998 to run an art auction business, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2008.

063440.text: SM Life Design Group handles logistics and distribution of albums and merchandise for artists, including those of the SM group, and in 2024 opened a studio that serves as a video production hub. It is also developing new media and responding to global demand for K-content. Founded in 1998 as a printing and media business, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002 and owns one subsidiary.

063570.text: NICE Infra runs ATM VAN and bulk management services and builds infrastructure businesses in digital finance, mobility and unmanned solutions on a nationwide operating network. Its main subsidiaries handle cash transport and real estate leasing. It was set up in 2000 when a credit information company spun off its financial business division, and it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006.

063760.text: ELP makes and sells inspection equipment for OLED and micro displays, covering display processes from cell to module, as well as inspection equipment for semiconductor packaging. It is developing Micro OLED and LED inspection tools and inspection systems for chip packaging substrates. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017 and set up a unit in China in 2016.

064090.text: InkredibleBuzz is a distribution and marketing platform company for fashion clothing and other goods. It also runs a healthcare business selling amino acid-based beauty, therapeutic and pet food products in cooperation with Italy's Professional Dietetics, and operates a subscription service for skin care and cosmetic procedures. Founded in 1991, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

064240.text: homecast mainly distributes electronic components, including semiconductors. Its medical aesthetics division sells cross-linked HA fillers and skin boosters for export, and a subsidiary researches, makes and sells digital set-top boxes (STB). Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003.

064260.text: Danal operates in commerce, digital content, franchising and investment. Its commerce division offers a range of payment services, including a mobile phone payment service that ranks first in Korea by market share. Founded in 1997 to develop and sell software, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004, has 16 consolidated subsidiaries and expanded its e-commerce business in 2026 by acquiring overseas stakes.

064290.text: Intekplus develops 3D and 2D automated visual inspection equipment based on machine vision technology. It supplies inspection systems for semiconductor packages, memory modules, SSDs, flip-chip substrates, OLEDs and rechargeable batteries. Founded in 1995 to make control and measurement instruments, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2011 and sells globally through branches in Taiwan, China, the US and Japan.

064350.text: Hyundai Rotem is a machinery company with three divisions: AD&RH, covering land, sea and air weapon systems, space launch vehicles, hydrogen infrastructure and industrial robotics; RS, which makes railway vehicles and related solutions; and EP, which supplies press and eco-friendly steelmaking equipment. It is pursuing new businesses such as manned-unmanned weapon systems and hydrogen rail vehicles. Founded in 1977, it listed on the KOSPI in 2013 and has 14 unlisted subsidiaries.

064400.text: LG CNS is the IT services affiliate of the LG group, working in cloud and AI, smart engineering and digital business services. In smart engineering fields such as manufacturing, logistics and cities, it drives digital transformation (DX) projects and is expanding its robotics business. Founded in 1987, it has 19 unlisted subsidiaries.

064480.text: Bridgetec is a software company that develops contact center solutions, including AICC, voice bots, speaker recognition, IPCC and cloud contact centers, for financial firms, telecom operators and public institutions. It is expanding its AI contact center business, which combines speech recognition, speech synthesis, natural language understanding and LLM-based AI, and offers cloud-based subscription services. Founded in 1995, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2008.

064520.text: TechL provides back-end packaging and test services for memory and non-memory chips through its Storage SIP business, supplying memory cards, eMMC, SSD and eMCP products in Korea and abroad. It also offers leadframe-based package assembly for data storage chips used in PCs, telecom equipment, office automation and home appliances. Founded in 1998, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

064550.text: Bioneer is a genetic engineering company founded in 1992 as the first startup from a Korean biotechnology research institute, and it was the first in Korea to localise DNA synthesis and PCR technology. It makes life science research products, molecular diagnostics and probiotics, develops RNA interference-based drugs, and exports hundreds of products, including PCR equipment, to 50 countries. It has two subsidiaries.

064760.text: Tokai Carbon Korea makes parts for semiconductors, solar cells and LEDs, and was the first in Korea to set up integrated production covering machining, high-purification and CVD SiC coating processes. It is focused on strengthening its Solid-SiC manufacturing technology as chip processes shrink. It was founded in 1996 as a joint venture that included Japan's TOKAI CARBON CO.,LTD., and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003.

064800.text: PonyLink operates in overseas fashion, mainly parallel imports of luxury goods; IT, including wireless internet, messaging, AI and LLM services; and mobility, including autonomous driving. Founded in 2000 as a wireless internet service provider, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002 and diversified in 2018 by acquiring an overseas fashion and luxury goods distributor. It has 6 subsidiaries.

064820.text: Cape Industries makes cylinder liners, a core part of large marine engines, and supplies them to engine makers and engine technology licensors in Korea and abroad for both new ships and replacement. It also runs a financial investment business through its main subsidiary, a securities firm. Founded in 1983 as an engine parts dealer, it later moved into marine engine parts manufacturing and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007.

064850.text: FnGuide provides financial information services, indexes and fund evaluation to securities firms, asset managers, banks, universities and research institutes. It builds on its own industry classification system and index development capabilities, and is applying AI technology to meet new market demand. Founded in 2000 to provide online financial information, it listed on the KONEX in 2013 and moved to the KOSDAQ in 2020.

064960.text: SNT Motiv is an SNT group affiliate set up in 2002 through a spin-off from a telecommunications company. Its roots go back to 1981, when it began making small arms for the defence industry, and it later moved into auto parts. Its businesses are vehicle parts and others such as defence and chip equipment parts, and it supplies drive motor parts and drive units for electric vehicles of domestic automakers and GM.

065060.text: Great New wave Coming is a mid-sized fashion company that makes and sells clothing and accessories. Its brands cover women's casual wear, unisex wear, men's contemporary casual wear under PLADS7, a premium niche perfume line and casual wear under TOINQ. Its subsidiaries include investment firms, an ISUZU commercial vehicle dealer and a trading company in China. Founded in 1997, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

065130.text: Top Engineering develops, makes and sells process equipment for semiconductors, LCD, OLED, rechargeable batteries and camera modules. Its dispensers and GCS hold high global market shares, and it has used its LCD equipment know-how to develop OLED process equipment for display panel makers in Korea and abroad. Founded in 1993, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003, has 12 subsidiaries and runs offices in China and Germany.

065150.text: Daesan F&B runs restaurants and domestic and overseas franchises, and also works in food manufacturing and processing, food ingredient imports and exports, and meat processing and wholesale. Its meat business serves customers in the Daejeon area and sources raw meat through direct contracts with farms. Founded in 1990 for franchise, restaurant and food distribution businesses, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2009.

065170.text: BL Pharmtech is a healthcare company with three divisions: household health products, in vitro diagnostic devices and cancer drug development. It offers cervical cancer and sexually transmitted disease testing through a self-sampling product, and is developing anticancer drug candidates through a subsidiary. Founded in 1995, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

065350.text: Shinsung Delta Tech has four segments: HA, which makes home appliance parts and premium vacuum cleaners on an OEM basis; BA, which produces parts for electric vehicles and ESS; SVC, covering logistics services; and others, including finance. It is focusing R&D on robotics and won a CES Innovation Award in 2025. Founded in 1987, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004 and has 18 consolidated subsidiaries.

065370.text: WISE iTech is a software company built on AI and big data that has reorganised its business into Tailored AX and Digital Asset Management, offering solutions that range from data to source code. It serves about 500 customers in finance, the public sector and manufacturing, and offers iDocu, an LLM-based product. Founded in 1990, it strengthened its digital asset management capabilities in 2023.

065420.text: Si Resources develops and distributes natural resources. Its resource sales business covers biofuel production, peat mining and bituminous coal mining. It processes palm oil and other animal and vegetable fats into biofuel for major domestic energy companies, and distributes peat in Korea under exclusive overseas rights from Russia's Biotex-Torf. Founded in 1987, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

065440.text: Eluon provides telecom solutions and services, developing equipment such as HSS and MRF for KT and LG U+ and supplying solutions to financial firms and broadcasters. Its other businesses include smart card issuing and delivery and digital archive systems. Founded in 1998 for mobile communication solutions, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003 and has 3 subsidiaries.

065450.text: Victek runs defence and civilian businesses. Its defence products include electronic warfare direction finders, military power supplies, electro-optical equipment, identification friend or foe equipment and TICN devices, while its civilian business operates an unmanned public bicycle rental system. Founded in 1990 and incorporated in 1996, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003 and has 1 subsidiary.

065500.text: Orient Precision Industries makes and sells auto parts, mainly machined aluminium and assembled parts for transmissions and engines, which it produces in cooperation with automakers. Founded in 1987, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002. It has 3 subsidiaries, including ORIENT VINA JOINT STOCK COMPANY, and 15 affiliates.

065510.text: Huvitz makes ophthalmic optical medical devices and was the first in Korea to produce and sell optical coherence tomography (OCT) retinal scanners and auto refractors. It invests 18% of sales in R&D, researchers make up 33% of its staff, and it is expanding across the ophthalmic optics field. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003 and has 5 subsidiaries.

065530.text: Wiable builds and maintains shared wireless relay networks that mobile carriers use jointly in areas with poor signal, such as national parks, stadiums, subways and tunnels. It also provides system support for the defence procurement agency and runs solar power generation, while looking at new areas such as IoT and C-ITS. Founded in 1996, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

065570.text: Samyung ENC makes marine electronic equipment, producing a wide variety of ship and navigation devices such as GMDSS and AIS in small batches at its headquarters and plant in Busan, and sells them with after-sales service through agents in Korea and abroad. It is expanding into leisure boats, e-Navigation services and the IMO-led maritime digitalisation market. Founded in 1978, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003.

065650.text: Hyper runs a commerce business that distributes a range of products, including home appliance brands. Its drug business develops central nervous system treatments, including an Alzheimer's dementia drug, an early dementia diagnostic kit, a non-narcotic painkiller and an NLRP3 inhibitor-based anti-inflammatory drug. Founded in 1997, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003 and expanded into payments in 2026 by absorbing another company through a merger.

065660.text: Anterogen researches, develops, makes and sells stem cell-based treatments. In 2012 it commercialised a treatment for Crohn's fistula, the world's first adipose-derived stem cell therapy, and it sells a pulmonary arterial hypertension drug in Korea. It is expanding its pipeline for rare and intractable diseases such as diabetic foot ulcers and received approval in Japan for one of its products in 2026. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2016.

065680.text: Uju Electronics makes and sells electrical, electronic and auto parts. Its IT division produces ultra-precision connectors for mobile devices such as smartphones and tablets and for TVs, while its AD division makes vehicle connectors. Founded in 1993 and incorporated in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004, runs sites in Korea, Vietnam and China, and has 8 unlisted subsidiaries.

065690.text: Pakers makes printer parts and LED lighting. It supplies key rubber rollers, blades and cartridges for printers to Foxconn, and develops LED packages, lamps and healthcare products for sale in Korea and abroad. Founded in 1970, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002 and runs 2 research centres in Korea, a production subsidiary in China and a site in Hong Kong.

065710.text: Seoho Electric makes electrical control systems for cranes at ports and shipyards, along with AC inverters and DC converters. It built unmanned automation systems for the HPNT and PNIT terminals in Busan, supplied 130 ARMG units to Singapore's PSA PPT terminal and is supplying 202 ARMG units and 4 double-trolley QC automation systems for phase 1 of PSA TUAS. Founded in 1981, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

065770.text: CS makes mobile communication repeaters as its single business segment, with SKT in Korea and NTT DoCoMo and Toshiba in Japan among its main customers. Its subsidiaries CS JAPAN and CS GLOCAL handle telecom equipment trading and brokerage. Founded in 1999 to make RF and optical repeaters and other telecom equipment, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004.

065950.text: Welcron makes microfiber cleaning products, functional bedding and defence products, and also runs construction, plant, renewable energy and warehouse leasing businesses. It operates a premium functional bedding brand, exports microfiber cleaning goods to about 50 countries and is expanding in protective products such as bulletproof vests. Founded in 1992, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003 and has three subsidiaries.

066130.text: Haatz makes and sells range hoods, built-in kitchen appliances and heat recovery ventilators for homes, supplying construction companies and distribution agents across the country. With air quality management (AQM) as its motto, it also offers household ventilation systems and ventilation air purifiers, and ranks first in its industry in range hoods. Founded in 1988 to make kitchen appliances, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003.

066310.text: Q.S.I makes and sells semiconductor lasers and optical semiconductor products. It holds core semiconductor laser technology and has built a total solution for making products to customer specifications, and its ability to tailor products to individual customers sets it apart from large Japanese makers. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006 and has 1 consolidated subsidiary.

066360.text: Cherrybro is a vertically integrated broiler chicken company covering production and distribution from breeding stock through slaughterhouses to processing plants. Its segments are broilers, processed meat distribution, and breeding and hatching, and it runs its own broiler feed plant while adding home meal replacement (HMR) products. Founded in 1991, it has 5 subsidiaries.

066410.text: Bucket Studio distributes content for smart devices and runs a text messaging business based on UMS technology, while its subsidiaries handle kiosk distribution and food and beverage. It acquires secondary rights to major domestic and foreign films and invests in a range of existing and new platforms. Founded in 1999 to produce, duplicate and service video content, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003.

066430.text: I-robotics makes polyethylene-based industrial protective films and distributes raw materials. Its main products, LDPE, HDPE and anti-rust films, are used in packaging for home appliances, auto parts and other applications, and it works with automotive and electronics companies to grow its market share. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002 and is pursuing lower costs and higher-value films.

066570.text: LG Electronics was set up in 2002 through a spin-off of the electronics and telecommunications businesses, and it has 182 subsidiaries. Its five main segments are home appliances, air conditioning and cooling solutions, TVs and monitors, vehicle components, and an LG group subsidiary. It researches core technologies such as AI, quantum computing and semiconductor equipment, and is pursuing mass production of humanoid robots and cooperation with NVIDIA.

066590.text: Smotronic makes auto parts ranging from powertrain parts for combustion engines to key systems for electrified vehicles, focusing on transmission parts, engine parts and dedicated parts for electric and hydrogen vehicles. Its main customers are automakers in Korea and abroad. Founded in 1983, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003 and has three subsidiaries, including units in India and the Czech Republic.

066620.text: Kukbo Design provides total interior design services, including interiors and remodelling for homes, commercial and office buildings, hotels and leisure facilities, national infrastructure and special facilities. It operates without borrowings, has posted consecutive profits and has ranked first in contract rankings for 15 straight years since 2012. Founded in 1983, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002 and has 14 unlisted subsidiaries.

066670.text: DTC provides display solutions, including LCD modules for mobile phones and displays for mini notebooks and tablet PCs. It set up IATB GLOBAL PRIVATE LIMITED in 2019 to enter India, and in 2025 bought a 21.97% stake in an LED company and made it a subsidiary. Founded in 1998 to develop and make LCD modules, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2002.

066700.text: Theragen Etex makes and sells prescription and over-the-counter drugs and conducts new drug R&D, while its healthcare and genome analysis division offers DNA and RNA analysis and distributes health supplements. Founded in 1990, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004 and took its current name after a 2010 merger. It has 6 consolidated subsidiaries and is expanding in China, including through Theragen HK.

066790.text: Korea Cable T.V Chung-buk System is a licensed cable TV operator serving 7 cities and counties in its home province. Alongside cable TV, it offers high-speed internet, internet phone and broadcast advertising, with speeds of up to 1Gbps over optical LAN and FTTH, and is adding IoT products, digital broadcasting, VOD content and home network services. It was founded in 1997.

066900.text: DAP makes and sells printed circuit boards (PCBs), mainly for smartphones and automotive electronics, as well as for tablets, wearables and other devices. Its main customers are domestic electronics and auto parts companies. Founded in 1987, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004 and dropped its airline business during the current half after losing control of that subsidiary.

066910.text: Sonokong is an IP-based content and retail company that distributes character and animation merchandise and game consoles. Its mobility business sells used cars and imports electric vehicles, and it owns a car dealership, an investment firm and a K-IP platform. It is diversifying through unmanned retail and online platforms and adding services such as AI-based wellness. Founded in 1996, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005.

066970.text: L&F makes cathode active materials for rechargeable batteries used in EVs and ESS. It was the first in the world to develop and mass-produce a high-nickel NCMA product with about 95% nickel content, and it set up LLBS, a precursor joint venture with the LS group. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003 and moved to the KOSPI in 2024.

066980.text: Hansung Cleantech focuses on EPC projects for water treatment facilities, including ultrapure water systems for electronics, semiconductor and display production, industrial wastewater treatment and seawater desalination. Its subsidiaries cover operations and maintenance, liquid waste, air quality management and activated carbon supply. It was founded in 1998 under a different name and relaunched under its current name in 2023.

067000.text: JoyCity develops and publishes PC online and mobile games. Its services include an in-house game series, several strategy simulation games and a console game. Founded in 1994 to develop and supply online games, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2008 and has 5 subsidiaries in Korea, China and elsewhere.

067010.text: Ecstelecom provides enterprise communication solutions and services through its customer success and digital workplace businesses. It offers contact center products such as IPCC, AICC and CCaaS, as well as cloud telephony and unified communications, manages client systems through ETaaS, and develops AI chatbots and agent support systems. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007.

067080.text: Dae Hwa Pharm is a drugmaker whose businesses cover drug manufacturing and wholesale, medical information systems, pharmaceutical ingredients, and cosmetics and medical devices. Its GMP-certified third plant produces solid dosage forms, transdermal products and anticancer drugs, and its products include pain relief patches and a filler. Founded in 1984, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003 and has 4 subsidiaries in Korea and abroad.

067160.text: SOOP runs SOOP, a live-streaming platform for individual creators. Platform revenue comes from viewer donation-based services and functional items, while advertising and content revenue comes from digital ads and ad agency work. Its main subsidiaries include an ad agency, a sports channel, an esports company and a video editing firm. Founded in 1996, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003.

067170.text: Autech makes special-purpose vehicles, including negative-pressure ambulances, welfare vehicles and special logistics vehicles. Its subsidiaries work in heating, ventilation and air conditioning, refrigeration and cold-storage solutions, and mechanical parking systems, and the group aims to become an intelligent energy solutions group combining manufacturing with AI and IoT. Founded in 1991, it listed on the KOSPI in 2003.

067280.text: Multicampus provides education services. Its education business offers online and offline training and HRD services to build job skills in IT, management and leadership, while its foreign language business runs language tests such as OPIc and customised corporate training. LTI, under an exclusive contract with ACTFL, administers and scores language tests globally. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006.

067290.text: JW Shinyak makes and sells drugs, supplying prescription medicines such as antifungals and urology drugs to hospitals, clinics and pharmacies. Founded in 1975, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003 and went through several name changes, an acquisition in 2005 and a merger in 2009 before adopting its current name in 2016.

067310.text: Hana Micron provides back-end semiconductor services, including packaging, testing and modules, with domestic chipmakers as its main customers. It is expanding into higher-value memory products and non-memory businesses to improve profitability. Founded in 2001 as a back-end chip specialist, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005, and its main subsidiaries include HT MICRON.

067370.text: SunBio is a biotech company specialising in PEGylation technology. It synthesises, produces and sells PEG derivative materials and uses PEGylation to develop biosimilars and new drugs, with work including a Pegfilgrastim biosimilar, MucoPEG and SBX research. It has a facility certified by the EU's EMA. Founded in 1997, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

067390.text: AeroSpace Technology of Korea mainly manufactures and converts commercial aircraft fuselages, producing Section 48, fuselage, bulkhead and stringer parts, along with doors and structures for freighters. Founded in 2001 to make and assemble aircraft parts and tooling, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2014 and merged with a subsidiary in 2024 to add assembly parts and tooling capacity.

067570.text: NVH Korea makes auto parts, supplying interior parts and engine-room sound-absorbing and insulation materials to domestic automakers and VW. Through acquisitions in 2018 and 2019, it moved into cleanrooms for semiconductors, displays and bio, battery dry rooms, and bridge girder fabrication and installation, and it provides total cleanroom solutions to domestic chipmakers. Founded in 1984, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2013.

067630.text: HLB Life Science is an HLB group biohealthcare company with four segments: medicare, medical devices, bio development and energy. It expanded its syringe business through a 2023 merger and in 2026 obtained a human tissue bank licence to grow in regenerative medicine. It is also pursuing global markets with FDA 510(k) clearance and MDSAP certification. Founded in 1998, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2008.

067730.text: Logisys maintains and sells computer equipment for financial institutions and public agencies, and also provides VAN services, cash transport and EV charger maintenance. Its VAN management work is expanding into ATM management and automated machine services. It was spun off from a holding company's technology department in 1996, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2015 and has run an integrated computer system and call center since 2006.

067770.text: Sejin T.S processes and produces optical films for LEDs and LCDs, including reflector, protective, diffuser, prism and composite sheets, and supplies them to domestic electronics and display makers. It has a subsidiary in Vietnam to support global set makers' local production. Founded in 1996 to make optical sheets for TFT LCDs, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004.

067830.text: Savezone I&C runs 6 department-store-style discount outlets in Korea, selling apparel brands' off-season and specially planned goods at everyday discounts. Its mall-type outlets also carry food and household goods and offer facilities such as culture and sports centres for one-stop shopping. It was set up in 2002 through a spin-off of a construction company's retail division and relisted on the KOSPI in July that year.

067900.text: Y-entec runs four businesses: environmental services, marine transport, a golf course and ready-mixed concrete. Its environmental services cover waste collection and transport through to incineration and landfill, and its fleet of 10 tankers carries chemicals within Asia. Founded in 1990, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005 and has 1 domestic subsidiary.

067920.text: Igloo's main businesses are security information and event management (SIEM) solutions and managed security services (MSS). It pioneered Korea's SIEM market and has held the largest share of it for more than 20 years. Its main subsidiary makes hardware such as application delivery controllers (ADC), L2 switches and web firewalls. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2010.

067990.text: Deutsch Motors sells new and certified used BMW and MINI cars and runs after-sales service. It has 13 consolidated companies covering real estate development, auto financing and leasing, and sales of another car brand, and during the current half one subsidiary absorbed another to streamline operations. Founded in 2000 for car sales, parts, repair and used car trading, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2009.

068050.text: Pan Entertainment plans and produces TV dramas and supplies them to broadcasters and OTT platforms. It also produces albums and soundtracks, makes and distributes films and runs a restaurant business. It is focused on securing production talent and on IP-based content to supply more to global OTT platforms. Founded in 1998, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006 and has 3 subsidiaries.

068100.text: Kweather is Korea's largest private weather service provider, founded in 1997 when a private forecasting system was introduced under the weather service law. Its big data platform combines weather and air quality data, distributing weather data and customised data to about 4,000 member companies to help them reduce weather-related risks. It listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024 as a technology growth company.

068240.text: Dawonsys designs, makes and sells power electronics equipment that controls power semiconductors to convert commercial power into special forms, including fusion power supplies, plasma power supplies, railway vehicles and induction heating equipment. Its subsidiaries cover railway vehicle parts, investment advisory and trade, distribution and subway operation. Founded in 1996 to make special power supplies, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2010.

068270.text: Celltrion is a biotech company that develops biopharmaceuticals for autoimmune diseases, cancer and other conditions, and it holds 11 product approvals, including the world's first antibody biosimilar. It completed a merger with its sister healthcare company in 2023 to form a single integrated entity, and in 2025 finished buying a US plant that serves as a supply base for the US market and a contract manufacturing (CMO) site. It was founded in 1991.

068290.text: Samsung Publishing makes and sells children's and educational books, and also runs an English learning materials business and real estate leasing. Its main products include children's book series and English textbooks, and it offers cognitive development programs organised by subject and age for preschool children. It was set up in 2002 through a corporate split and listed on the KOSPI the same year.

068330.text: ilShinbiobase makes, sells and exports freeze dryers, ultra-low temperature freezers and other research equipment, as well as large industrial freeze dryers for mass production of drugs, vaccines and functional foods. Its lineup builds on vacuum, refrigeration and control technology, and it is developing automated systems and models that meet global GMP standards. Founded in 1988, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007, and a subsidiary handles its overseas sales.

068760.text: Celltrion Pharm makes prescription drugs and holds exclusive domestic sales rights to biopharmaceuticals developed by its parent, Celltrion. Its production facilities hold KGMP, US cGMP and EU-GMP certification, and a PFS line at one of its plants gives it biopharmaceutical production capacity. Founded in 2000 to make and sell drugs, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006.

068790.text: DMS makes display equipment, covering the wet process equipment at the core of display panel production, and holds the largest global market share in high-density cleaning equipment. It designs and builds its own equipment for the four key OLED panel processes of cleaning, developing, etching and stripping, and it divides work between Korea and China. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004.

068930.text: Digital Daesung is an education company that runs its business through 3 subsidiaries. Its elementary and middle school division operates reading and essay programs and academy franchises, while its high school division runs online and offline lectures and boarding academies. It applies AI and big data to offer customised learning services. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003.

068940.text: Cellfie Global makes smart cards, including credit, debit and transit cards, and holds manufacturing certifications from VISA, MasterCard and JCB. It supplies domestic banks and card companies, and sells to financial institutions in the Americas through its subsidiary ICK International INC. Founded in 1998, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2010 and adopted its current name in 2022.

069080.text: Webzen develops and services games, including PC titles such as R2 and mobile titles such as R2 ORIGIN, and it runs global publishing and MU IP partnership businesses. It is building its lineup of new titles through in-house development and work with outside studios as it expands in global markets. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003 and has 21 subsidiaries.

069140.text: Nuriplan is an urban construction company that builds pedestrian overpasses and noise barriers, and it also works in construction and plant projects such as bridge bearings, landscape lighting, defence and IT, and air quality. It is developing new technologies such as eco-friendly coating methods and long-span steel parking structures. Founded in 1994, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2010 and has several subsidiaries.

069260.text: TKG Huchems produces fine and basic chemicals, including NT products such as DNT and MNB and NA products such as dilute and concentrated nitric acid and ammonium nitrate. It also sells electronic materials, urea solution and carbon credits, and reports three segments: fine chemicals, electronic materials and investment. It was spun off from another chemical company in 2002, listed on the KOSPI the same year and has 4 consolidated subsidiaries.

069330.text: U.i.display makes flat-panel display products. Its ITO division makes ITO-coated glass for TSP, its DM division handles functional film lamination and display cover glass, and its LCD division covers etching technology and equipment design. Founded in 1990, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003, and its subsidiaries work in LCD glass etching, real estate development and leasing, and solar power and ESS.

069410.text: n Tels is a software and platform company with its own AI-Ready DBMS, a SaaS billing platform and GPUaaS-based AI infrastructure, and it supports enterprise digital transformation through services such as Cloud MSP. In 2026 it acquired a 51% stake in a database migration and construction company, making it a subsidiary. Founded in 2000 to develop and supply software, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007.

069460.text: Daeho AL produces aluminium coils, sheets and circles, with annual rolling capacity of about 70,000 tonnes and circle capacity of 24,000 tonnes. Beyond kitchenware materials, it supplies industrial markets such as electrical and electronics, autos, rechargeable batteries, ESS and building materials, and it also works in railway vehicles. It was set up in 2002 through a spin-off, is listed on the KOSPI and has 6 affiliates.

069510.text: ESTec makes and sells acoustic products, mainly car speakers, TV speakers and other audio components. Its circuit division develops software, electronic circuits and mechanical designs for speakers, amplifiers, sensors and automotive electronic modules. It was founded in 1999 through an employee buyout from another company, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003 and has 6 wholly owned subsidiaries in 5 countries, including Vietnam and China.

069540.text: Lightron Fiber-optic Devices researches, makes and sells optical transceivers, focusing on optical modules for wireless base stations, telecom and datacom, FTTH, broadcasting and cable TV. With data center demand growing, it is expanding into high data rate modules, and it is entering the defence sector through cooperation with defence companies. Founded in 1998 to make optical communication equipment, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004.

069620.text: Daewoong Pharma makes and sells drugs at KGMP-standard plants in two industrial complexes. Its main products include several branded drugs, one of which gained US FDA approval in 2019 and is supplied through a partner. It is investing in new drugs and digital healthcare, and it was set up in 2002 through a spin-off of its parent company's business division.

069640.text: Hansaemk is a fashion company that became a total fashion business after absorbing a children's wear company in 2022. It runs children's and baby wear brands as well as the PGA TOUR brand, and it is dropping loss-making brands to focus on children's wear. Founded in 1995, it listed in 2011 and has 3 consolidated subsidiaries, two in China and one in Japan.

069730.text: DSR Wire makes and sells wire ropes and hard-drawn steel wire in Korea, while its Vietnam operation makes and sells wire ropes and inner cables. In April 2026 it acquired shares in DSR K and made it a consolidated subsidiary. Founded in 1971 to make and sell wire ropes and hard-drawn wire, it listed on the KOSPI in 2003.

069920.text: Exion Group has three main segments: a high-tech business covering plant and civil piping work, a robot automation business installing painting robots under a contract with ABB, and a commerce infrastructure business offering IT solutions and office space leasing. A 2025 merger expanded it into duct and piping work and industrial robot installation. It was spun off from an SK company in 2001 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007.

069960.text: Hyundai Department Store operates 13 department stores, 10 outlets and 2 duty-free shops, and its furniture manufacturing segment makes mattresses and furniture. It was set up in 2002 through a spin-off of a holding company's department store business and added furniture manufacturing through a 2022 stake acquisition. It is focusing on premium spending and experience-based stores and plans new store openings from 2027.

070300.text: QuantumRail develops and supplies embedded software for smart cards, along with platforms and solutions for telecom, finance and security. It supplies 4G LTE NFC-USIM products for SKT and KT, as well as 5G USIM. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2010, adopted its current name in 2026 and added three new consolidated subsidiaries, including Genova Global Inc.

070590.text: Inticube is an AI-based customer communication company providing system integration and services for customer service, including digital contact centers, AI communication, and cloud and messaging solutions. It also owns a subsidiary in pet healthcare. It was set up in 2003 through a spin-off of another company's business division, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004 and adopted its current name in 2026.

070960.text: Mona Yongpyong develops and runs resorts, operating year-round complexes with ski slopes, golf courses, a water park and a tourist cable car, and it sells registered condominiums and memberships. It owns resort sites in two provinces and has several subsidiaries. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSPI in 2016 and adopted its current name in 2024.

071050.text: Korea Investment Holdings is a financial holding company whose main subsidiary is a securities firm, alongside affiliates in asset management, savings banking, capital, real estate trust, venture capital, private equity and startup acceleration. It manages its subsidiaries, sets their business goals, evaluates their performance and provides funding. It was founded in 2003 under the financial holding company act and listed on the KOSPI in July that year through a share swap with a securities firm.

071090.text: Histeel makes steel pipes, producing a range of ERW and SAW pipes, and since 2022 it has supplied large-diameter earthquake-resistant square pipes, which it is using to target overseas markets. A subsidiary diversifies earnings through pipe heat treatment and directly run gas stations. It was set up in 2003 through a spin-off from a steel company, and its subsidiaries include HISTEEL PIPE&TUBE INC in the US.

071200.text: Infinitt Healthcare develops PACS and 3D medical imaging software, supplying about 6,300 medical institutions in 55 countries. In Korea it holds a 75% share among tertiary hospitals and 70% among general hospitals, and it has launched Korea's first integrated medical data platform combined with AI. Founded in 2002, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2010 and has 8 overseas subsidiaries, including in the US.

071280.text: Rorze Systems makes material handling equipment for semiconductors and displays, developing glass cutting systems, mobile robots and EFEM for chipmaking, and display equipment. Its subsidiary RORZE SYSTEMS VINA in Vietnam builds equipment and handles installation. Founded in 1997 to make logistics automation and semiconductor manufacturing equipment, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003.

071320.text: Korea District Heating is a public company specialising in district energy, set up in 1985 under the integrated energy business act. It runs district energy, electricity and renewable energy businesses, supplying heating and cooling from 19 sites to apartment complexes and 2,991 buildings. It listed on the KOSPI in 2010 and has 8 unlisted affiliates.

071670.text: A-Tech Solution makes moulds, including ultra-precision injection, large injection, press and gear moulds, for home appliances, displays, cars and precision parts. Using its mould technology, it also produces precision drive parts and office automation products and offers a one-stop service from idea planning to market launch. It was founded in 2001 after acquiring machinery from an electronics company's precision equipment team, and it listed in 2009.

071840.text: Lotte Himart is an electronics retailer selling home and kitchen appliances and video and IT products through 291 directly operated stores, 11 logistics centers and its online mall. It carries global brands and launched a new private label, PLUX, in 2025 for affordable everyday appliances. It was founded in 1987 for the wholesale and retail sale of home appliances.

071850.text: Castec Korea makes and sells cast turbocharger parts and electronic parts, and also provides casting technology consulting, equipment manufacturing and machining. It has subsidiaries in China, Europe (CASTEC EUROPE S.R.L) and Vietnam (CASTEC VINA CO., LTD.), and an associate in China. Founded in 1998 to produce electronic and auto parts by casting, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2014.

071950.text: Koas makes and sells office furniture and is one of Korea's three major office furniture companies. It supplied eco-friendly furniture as an official sponsor of APEC in 2025, and is expanding into carbon-neutral furniture and AI and IoT-based smart offices. Founded in 1992, it listed on the KOSPI in 2005 and has 4 unlisted subsidiaries.

071970.text: HD Hyundai Marine Engine mainly makes low-speed marine engines, including diesel, LPG dual-fuel and LNG dual-fuel types, and also supplies engine parts such as turbochargers and crankshafts along with after-sales service. It owns a crankshaft subsidiary and liquidated STX HI Malaysia Sdn. Bhd. in January 2026. Founded in 2001, it listed on the KOSPI in 2009 and joined the HD Hyundai group in September 2024.

072020.text: Choong ANG Vaccine Laboratory makes and sells animal vaccines, producing about 80 types for livestock and pets and selling them to farms, dealers, veterinary hospitals and public agencies and through exports. It also sells feed additives and, certified by Affsa Nancy under the OIE, provides rabies antibody testing, disease diagnosis and biological research services. Founded in 1968, it incorporated in 1994 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003.

072130.text: Uangel develops software, supplying core network solutions, IoT solutions and value-added services to fixed and mobile telecom operators in Korea and abroad, and it runs ICT-based early childhood education content. Its eSIM data roaming service, the first in Korea, provides LTE and 5G data in about 150 countries. Founded in 1999, it listed in 2003 and has a subsidiary in Indonesia.

072470.text: Woory Industrial Holdings is a holding company with 9 companies in Korea and abroad, including a KOSDAQ-listed auto parts maker, and it earns income from investments, brand and management advisory fees and rent. Its auto parts business makes HVAC actuators and PTC heaters. Founded in 1989, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2003 and became a holding company in 2015 after spinning off its auto parts business.

072710.text: Nongshim Holdings is a pure holding company set up in 2003 through a spin-off from Nongshim, and it has 6 subsidiaries and 2 second-tier subsidiaries. The group works in holding company investment, manufacturing, engineering and leisure, and its main subsidiary, Nongshim, makes and sells instant noodles, snacks and beverages. The holding company supports accountable and transparent management at its subsidiaries.

072770.text: MemRAY BT was founded in 1998 to develop and supply embedded software and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007. It adopted its current name after shareholder approval in December 2025. It has 7 subsidiaries, working in fashion apparel, waste treatment, battery recycling and green hydrogen, and mine development in Tanzania.

072870.text: Mega Study runs its business through 9 subsidiaries. The parent handles investment, publishing and catering, while subsidiaries provide exam preparation and certification courses for professional jobs and operate a golf course. As owner of its brand, it collects brand royalties and makes venture and growth fund investments to support startups. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004.

072950.text: Vissem Electronics has LED, optical communication, network, defence and solder divisions, making LED signboards and modules, optical closures, high-speed transmission network equipment, cable assemblies for weapons, and solder bars and wires. It owns a subsidiary specialising in solder metal bonding materials. Founded in 1998 to make LED display modules, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2012.

072990.text: HCT provides testing and certification services for electronic devices and other products, along with calibration and repair of measuring instruments. It has 4 subsidiaries, one of which is a GLP-certified non-clinical testing institution. It was set up in 2000 when a chipmaker's quality assurance division was separated, and it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2016.

073010.text: Ksp is a mid-sized maker of marine engine parts. Its engine parts division produces valve spindles and other parts for large and medium engines, and its forging division makes metal forged products such as flanges and ring gears. It does steady business with a domestic shipbuilder and is one of 5 companies worldwide certified by the engine technology firms EVERLLENCE and WINGD. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004.

073110.text: LMS specialises in functional nano-optical components and materials. Its display business makes and sells prism sheets for LCD backlight units, and its optical information business makes IR cut-off filters for smartphone cameras. It has overseas affiliates in China and Hong Kong and acquired a 40% stake in a chemical maker to expand. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007.

073190.text: Duoback makes home and office chairs, designing, producing and selling ergonomic chairs fitted to Korean body types. It acquired exclusive domestic rights to the DUOBACK patent from a German company in 1995 and took full ownership of the patent in 2004. It sells through dealers nationwide, large discount stores, home shopping and online malls, and runs two unmanned showrooms. Founded in 1987, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004.

073240.text: Kumho Tire makes and sells tyres, and was set up in 2003 when the tyre business of another Kumho company was transferred to it. It runs 8 tyre plants in Korea, China, Vietnam and the US, including one in Gwangju and three in China, and sells worldwide through 12 overseas subsidiaries and 13 overseas branches and offices. It operates R&D centers in 5 regions.

073490.text: LIG Accuver's mobile communications division offers wireless network optimisation, big data, telecom test and measurement, small cell and defence products, while its automotive division distributes automotive semiconductors and provides V2X test solutions. It serves customers worldwide through its affiliate Accuver, with bases in 7 regions including the US, Japan, Hong Kong, the UK, Poland, China and India. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005.

073540.text: Frtek develops mobile communication repeaters that amplify base station signals in shadow areas to fill coverage gaps, and it also develops, makes and sells optical communication parts, wired and wireless telecom equipment and broadcast equipment. It has won several technology awards and developed more than 100 repeater and optical communication systems. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007.

073560.text: Woorison F&G focuses on pig farming, running 21 company-owned farms and contract farms, and operates the only LPC in its province, slaughtering, processing and selling cattle and pigs. A 2015 merger laid the base for its branded cut-meat business. It improves breeding pigs through a technical partnership with Hendrix Genetics, keeps HACCP certification across all processes and runs a biogas plant business. Founded in 2001, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2016.

073570.text: Lithium-for-earth was founded in 1998 to develop and make semiconductor test equipment and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004. In 2019 it merged with a company making IP content and mobile products, and in 2023 it adopted its current name. Its consolidated subsidiary has plasma-based equipment and process technology for breaking down semiconductor process by-products.

073640.text: Tera Science produces high-pressure hydraulic pipe fittings and runs solar and wind power businesses, while its subsidiaries develop a virtual asset platform and produce lithium and nickel. It holds intellectual property rights and is investing in eco-friendly energy facilities. It began making hydraulic fittings in 1993, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004 and has 4 subsidiaries.

074430.text: Aminologics makes and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients and amino acid derivatives. Its ingredients business supplies ingredients for stroke, eye disease and dermatitis drugs to domestic drugmakers, while its amino acid business develops, contract-manufactures and sells amino acids such as D-Serine and their derivatives. It is also targeting the peptide drug market and commercialising applied materials. Founded in 1997, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004.

074600.text: Wonik QnC makes quartz and ceramic products used in semiconductor manufacturing, with five segments: quartz, quartz raw materials, ceramics, cleaning and coating, and lamps. It expanded by acquiring a US company's quartz business in 2020 and a Japanese quartz crucible maker in 2022, and it has 18 overseas subsidiaries. It was spun off from Wonik in 2003 and relisted on the KOSDAQ the same year.

074610.text: Enplus is a firefighting company that makes fire engines for fire suppression and rescue and supplies them to government agencies, and it produces and sells the most fire trucks in Korea. It is expanding into heat dissipation materials for rechargeable batteries and lithium battery electrodes, and has developed world-first technologies such as a water pressure control system for fire trucks. Founded in 1980, it listed on the KOSPI in 2003 after a spin-off.

075130.text: Plantynet provides network-based services that block harmful internet content, and it was the first in Korea to commercialise harmful site filtering through ISP networks, now offered through the three major domestic ISPs, MSOs and cable internet providers. A subsidiary runs a digital magazine platform that ranks first in Korea, as well as in-store music and digital signage businesses. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005.

075180.text: Saeron Automotive makes and sells brake friction materials for cars, supplying automakers and parts makers. It is developing Cu-free friction materials in response to US Environmental Protection Agency rules and working on eco-friendly, high-performance products. Founded in 1999, it listed in 2005 and runs a subsidiary in China.

075580.text: Sejin Heavy Industries makes shipbuilding equipment through its shipbuilding and plant segments. Its shipbuilding segment builds deck houses for crew quarters, as well as LPG tanks and hull blocks. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSPI in 2015 and has 6 subsidiaries, including SEJIN VIETNAM CO., Ltd., which also makes deck houses.

075970.text: Dongkuk Refractories & Steel runs refractory, steel and IT businesses. Its refractory segment makes shaped and unshaped refractories and high-performance ceramics, its steel segment makes pipes and steel tubes, and its IT segment offers ERP solutions and IoT and AI services. It was set up in 2004 through a spin-off from another Dongkuk company and is working on eco-friendly refractories, high-strength pipe and cloud and AI-based digital transformation.

076080.text: Welcron Hantec builds water, environment and energy plants and works as a general contractor, carrying out a range of facility and turnkey construction projects. In 2025 it opened a branch in Indonesia to strengthen its base in Southeast Asia, and it is investing in eco-friendly energy technology and R&D. Founded in 1994, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2008 and has a subsidiary in China and an architectural design subsidiary.

076610.text: Haesung Optics makes high-resolution optical lens modules, camera modules and AF/OIS actuators for smartphones, having started with lenses for camcorders, digital cameras and DVD pickups and mobile lens assemblies. It set up units in China in 2002 and Vietnam in 2011, and acquired another company in 2023 to push its OIS business. Founded in 2002, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2013.

077360.text: Duksanhimetal researches, makes and sells solder balls and solder paste. It set up a subsidiary in Myanmar in 2019 to strengthen tin smelting and materials, acquired a stake in another company in 2021 to diversify, and in 2023 set up a new company and bought another stake to enter the high-pressure gas and hydrogen tank market. It was founded in 1999.

077500.text: Uniquest Coporation supplies non-memory semiconductor solutions, providing chips, technical support and training under distribution agreements with overseas non-memory chipmakers. It is working to build a fabless-foundry-packaging-test ecosystem to gain a position in intelligent semiconductors for AI, autonomous driving and IoT. Founded in 1993, it listed on the KOSPI in 2004.

077970.text: STX Engine makes diesel engines and defence electronics and communications equipment. Its three segments cover civilian engines for ships and land power generation, special engines for the K1 tank, K9 self-propelled howitzer and naval vessels, and advanced defence communications equipment. It is developing eco-friendly DF and gas engines, ammonia engines under a national project and hybrid engines. Founded in 1976, it was split from STX in 2004.

078000.text: Telcoware develops, supplies and maintains core network solutions for domestic telecom operators such as SKT, SKB and LGU+, including HLR/UDM, IMS and 5G SA core network solutions. It develops its own underlying technologies, such as a main-memory database and a solution development platform, which help keep its costs competitive. Founded in 2000 to develop telecom software, it listed on the KOSPI in 2004.

078020.text: LS Securities is Korea's first online brokerage, founded in 1999 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007. Its main businesses are investment brokerage, including trading on behalf of clients and credit lending, and investment dealing, including underwriting, PF and proprietary trading in securities and derivatives. It is expanding from retail into wholesale, IB and trading, and raising capital to increase its scale and risk management capacity.

078070.text: Ubiquoss Holdings is a holding company with 8 subsidiaries working in networking, industrial board manufacturing, medical devices and new technology finance. It was founded in 2000 to develop and sell telecom equipment and became a holding company in 2017 through spin-offs. It is diversifying its investment targets and methods and investing early in new growth areas to secure stable income.

078130.text: Kuk-il Paper MFG makes specialty paper, producing industrial functional and specialty papers such as tobacco-related paper and interleaving paper. It owns a subsidiary that researches and develops graphene materials. Founded in 1978, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004 and in March 2024 became part of a business group subject to cross-shareholding restrictions.

078140.text: Daebongls is a biotech company that, through a subsidiary, runs human skin application tests for cosmetics and health supplements. Its pharmaceutical ingredients segment is expanding its pipeline of improved new drugs, and its cosmetic ingredients segment has a portfolio of about 400 materials, including eco-friendly natural ones. It is building a platform business that uses AI-based analysis for beauty tech. Founded in 1986, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005.

078150.text: HB Technology makes and sells equipment such as AOI inspection systems for OLED front-end processes, laser repair equipment and battery exterior inspection systems, and it also makes and processes light guide and diffuser plates for display backlight units. Its main customers include domestic display, electronics and battery makers as well as BOE, CSOT and HKC. Founded in 1997 to make LCD and AMOLED inspection equipment, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004.

078160.text: Medipost has three businesses: a cord blood bank, a stem cell therapy and health supplements, and its cord blood bank holds the top market share. Its subsidiaries include MEDIPOST, Inc. for North American business development, MEDIPOST K.K. for Japan, an immune cell therapy developer and a cell and gene therapy CDMO. Founded in 2000 to store cord blood and develop stem cell therapies, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005.

078340.text: Com2us develops and services mobile games in about 200 countries, with local subsidiaries in the US, China, Japan and elsewhere. Its titles include a global RPG and sports games, among them an MLB title. In 2026 its main subsidiary was absorbed into another company through a merger. Founded in 1998, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007.

078350.text: Hanyang Digitech makes semiconductor memory modules and SSDs, and in 2019 set up volume production of server and PC memory modules in Vietnam. It was created in 2004 through a spin-off of another company's memory module manufacturing division and listed directly on the KOSDAQ. It has 3 subsidiaries, including HANYANG DGT PTE. LTD. and HANYANG DIGITECH VINA COMPANY LIMITED.

078520.text: Able C&C is a beauty company with a portfolio of brands built on traditional earthenware-jar fermentation techniques and naturally derived ingredients. It has entered 56 countries worldwide and is building a global brand hub centred on its US subsidiary. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005 and moved to the KOSPI in 2011.

078590.text: Hyulim A-tech is a tier-1 supplier that develops and makes interior and exterior parts for two Korean carmakers, which account for 67% and 27% of its sales respectively. Its products include carpets and trunk trim for interiors and wheel guards and undercovers for exteriors. Founded in 1993 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005, it counts itself among the 4 major domestic makers in its field.

078600.text: Daejoo Electronic Materials produces electronic materials, including conductive pastes, solar cell electrode materials, polymer and phosphor materials, and anode materials for secondary batteries. It supplies these to industries such as smartphones, PCs, laptops and automotive electronics. Founded in 1981, it took its current name in 2003, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2004 and has 6 subsidiaries, including 4 in China and one in Vietnam.

078860.text: Iokenm is an entertainment company built on managing broadcast personalities, working with about 20 artists across broadcasting, music production and video content. Its subsidiaries handle music distribution and software development. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006, merged with another entertainment company in 2022 and adopted its current name in 2026.

078890.text: KAON Group runs an OTT business, mainly supplying AI devices combined with AI solutions. One subsidiary provides network solutions such as broadband CPE and integrated solutions, while another pursues new businesses including a robot integration platform, XR and networking. Founded in 2001, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005 and took its current name in 2023.

078930.text: GS Holdings is a holding company created in 2004 through a spin-off from LG. Through its subsidiaries it runs refining, petrochemical, LNG, power and district energy businesses, along with retail distribution and hotel operations. A new subsidiary is reviewing data centre construction, and it is also pursuing EV charging, used battery recycling and renewable energy.

079000.text: Watoscorea makes plastic fittings for sanitary ware, starting with toilet tank parts and expanding into basin pop-ups, toilet seats and shower heads. Toilet fittings make up 48.59% of total sales. Founded in 1973 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005, it runs its own factory and an office in Incheon that handles sales and after-sales service.

079160.text: CJ CGV operates multiplex cinemas, having introduced Korea's first multiplex and developed it into a platform combining shopping, dining and entertainment. It runs 519 sites and 3,598 screens in 5 countries. Founded in 1999 as a joint venture between a CJ entertainment company and an Australian partner, it went public in 2004, has 72 unlisted subsidiaries and added an IT services subsidiary in 2024.

079170.text: Hanchang Industry produces zinc dust and zinc phosphate, base materials for heavy-duty anti-corrosion coatings used on ships, containers and steel structures. It also makes lithium bromide for heating and cooling systems and zeolite for oxygen generators, positioning these for the energy efficiency market. Founded in 1985 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005, it is a small or medium-sized enterprise.

079190.text: Kespion develops wireless communication products, including LDS antennas for mobile phones and short-range antennas for NFC, MST and WPC. It also offers outdoor wireless solutions such as routers and vehicle-mounted antennas, and has a defence business. Founded in 1998 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005, it has 2 Vietnamese subsidiaries and a domestic one, and in 2026 acquired and merged another company as a subsidiary.

079370.text: Zeus makes single-wafer and batch wet cleaning equipment for semiconductor wafers, display manufacturing equipment, and industrial robots including 6-axis articulated, SCARA and delta robots. It has 14 subsidiaries, among them J.E.T. in Japan, which listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange in 2023, a plug valve maker and a special steel maker. Founded in 1970, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006.

079430.text: Hyundai Livart Furniture sells household furniture and total interiors, office and built-in furniture, and B2B industrial materials. Through exclusive agreements with several foreign brands, it serves demand from the mid-to-low price range up to high-end. Founded in 1999, it joined the Hyundai Department Store group in 2012, merged with an affiliate in 2017 and has subsidiaries in Vietnam, Canada, China, Malaysia and Indonesia.

079550.text: LIG Defense & Aerospace is a defence company founded in 1998, with roots in a precision industry company set up in 1976 to support national self-reliance in defence. It adopted its current name in 2026 and set up LIG Defense Americas Inc. to enter the US defence market. Its subsidiaries include LNGR LLC, LIG Defense Americas Inc. and LIG Defense U.S. Inc.

079650.text: Seo San runs two divisions: concrete products, which supplies ready-mixed concrete and secondary concrete products, and energy solutions, which runs an electric vehicle charger business. Producing both ready-mix and secondary products reduces its reliance on a single product, and it aims to cut costs and raise the share of higher-value products. Founded in 1974, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005.

079810.text: APS Innovation supplies laser notching equipment, a key tool in secondary battery manufacturing, and display inspection equipment such as Array Testers, Aging Testers and AMI to major customers in Korea and abroad. It has 6 overseas subsidiaries in countries including China, Vietnam, the US, Indonesia and Canada. Founded in 2001 to make TFT LCD inspection equipment, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005.

079900.text: Junjin Construction & Robot makes construction machinery, mainly concrete pump trucks, along with placing booms, stationary pumps and line pumps that move concrete on building sites. Its consolidated subsidiary makes purpose-built vehicles (PBV). Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSPI in 2024.

079940.text: Gabia is a cloud and IT infrastructure company whose portfolio spans cloud, data centres and security across the digital transformation process. Its consolidated subsidiaries include KINX for internet and IDC services, along with companies in network security, software licensing, domains and hosting, and e-commerce solutions. Founded in 1998, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005.
