079950.text: Invenia develops, makes and sells equipment for manufacturing flat panel displays such as TFT-LCD and OLED, centred on dry etchers and expanding into bonding machines and vacuum transfer systems. A subsidiary in China makes and sells parts and provides services for display manufacturing. Founded in 2001, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005.

079960.text: Dongyang E&P makes power supply equipment such as SMPS, chargers, power supplies and adapters for large electronics manufacturers. It focuses on eco-friendly products including EV chargers and ESS, as well as SMPS for LED lighting, and researches power conversion with academic and research institutions. Founded in 1987 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005, it has 9 subsidiaries in countries including China, Vietnam, Romania, India and the US.

079970.text: Tobesoft provides software development platforms for companies, public bodies and financial institutions, centred on its JavaScript and HTML5-based UI/UX development platform. It is expanding into a full-stack AI low-code platform built around its NexaAI engine and pursuing overseas growth. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2010 and has 4 subsidiaries.

079980.text: Huvis is a polyester fibre maker producing staple fibre (SF), filament yarn (FY), industrial materials and chips, and ranks first in the domestic staple fibre market with a share of about 64%. It was formed in 2000 when two companies contributed their polyester businesses to a 50:50 venture, and listed on the KOSPI in 2012. Its subsidiaries include a fibre company in China and an overseas investment platform.

080010.text: e SANGNetworks operates in services, steel and other businesses, with services made up of corporate PG (B2B e-commerce) and exhibitions. Its subsidiaries run exhibition and facility management businesses, and during the period it added a new wholly owned subsidiary. Founded in 2000 for e-commerce, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005.

080160.text: Modetour Network is a travel company selling travel packages and airline tickets to Korean and foreign customers, along with travel arrangement and hotel management on consignment. It has 9 consolidated subsidiaries and overseas units including MODETOUR JAPAN and MODETOUR BEIJING. Founded in 1989 under the Tourism Promotion Act, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005.

080220.text: Jeju Semiconductor is a fabless company that designs memory chips for mobile applications and outsources production to specialist foundries. Its main product, NAND MCP, combines its own LPDRAM with NAND flash from other makers and is supplied to a range of industries. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005.

080420.text: Moda-InnoChips has an electronics division that makes ceramic-based ESD and EMI protection passive components and high-current metal power inductors, and a distribution division that runs department-store-style outlets on city outskirts. The distribution business was added through a 2016 merger. Founded in 2000 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005, it has subsidiaries in Vietnam and in apparel, footwear distribution and real estate.

080470.text: Sungchang Autotech makes auto parts, producing climate control parts such as cabin filters and inverters and electrical components in Korea, and injection-moulded parts such as HVAC units, cowl top covers and wheel guards overseas. Its consolidated subsidiaries are SCA Inc. in the US and one in China. Founded in 1996, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006.

080520.text: ODTech is a non-memory semiconductor company with a vertically integrated structure that uses its chip process base to make sensor modules and LED application products. It is targeting automotive optical sensors, defence sensors, bio-healthcare, the Vietnamese market, and automation of gas detector and dispenser processes. Founded in 1999 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007, it has subsidiaries including ODT VINA, a sales unit in Vietnam.

080530.text: KODI is an OEM/ODM maker of colour cosmetics that originally ran LCD and LED inspection equipment and industrial battery businesses, then entered cosmetics in 2016 by acquiring a colour cosmetics producer. A subsidiary makes and sells cosmetic containers, and an affiliate runs a beauty device business. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2010.

080580.text: OKins Electronics makes sockets for semiconductor testing through its BiTS division and provides chip testing services through its semiconductor division. It developed Korea's first burn-in socket, entering a market led by foreign makers. Founded in 1998, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2014 and has a subsidiary, Okins Electronics (SUZHOU) Co., LTD.

080720.text: Union Korea Pharm makes prescription drugs in GMP-compliant dosage forms, focusing on antibiotics and treatments for musculoskeletal, circulatory and digestive conditions. Founded in 1985 and renamed in 2001, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018 and has 2 unlisted subsidiaries. After a listing eligibility review was triggered in 2024, a decision to delist it was made in 2026.

081000.text: Iljin Diamond makes synthetic diamonds developed jointly with KIST, along with precision materials, tungsten carbide products and diamond grit. It was set up in 2004 as an Iljin Group affiliate and has a subsidiary. In 2026 it established a sales subsidiary in Canada, ILJIN CANADA.

081150.text: Tplex processes and makes stainless steel products, sourcing stainless bars and wire rods from a domestic special steel maker and, since 2021, acting as a distributor for a steelmaker. It holds the top market share in stainless bar machining and has expanded into titanium and nickel alloys for petrochemical and LNG uses. Founded in 1991, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2009.

081180.text: SEC makes electron-beam-based components and inspection equipment, including X-ray systems for the semiconductor and battery industries, and in 2006 developed and commercialised Korea's first X-ray tube, which it produces in-house. Inspection solutions generate more than half of its sales, and it uses AI algorithms to improve automated inspection. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

081580.text: Sungwoo Electronics makes moulds and pressed products across 4 business lines: metal processing (SHIELD CAN, DECO), precision assembly (OIS), injection moulding (battery cases) and others including smart cards, beauty devices and property leasing. It runs its own manufacturing facilities and research centre and has 5 consolidated subsidiaries in Vietnam, Korea and Japan. Founded in 1987, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007.

081660.text: Misto Holdings owns the global FILA trademark and business rights, secured through a 2007 LBO. Its Misto unit holds fashion brands such as FILA and Alife, while Acushnet holds golf brands including Titleist and FootJoy. Founded in 1991 to make and sell textiles, clothing, footwear and golf equipment, it became a holding company through a 2020 spin-off and took its current name in 2025.

082210.text: Optrontec makes optical components, including filters for image sensors, automotive optical lenses and modules, and OIS and folded zoom parts. It is extending optical technology built in mobile into automotive and pursuing optics for defence and drones. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005, merged with another company in 2009, and has its head office in Daejeon with overseas sites in China and Vietnam.

082270.text: GemVax & KAEL operates in environmental pollution control and biotechnology. In pollution control, it developed a domestically made chemical air filter that it supplies to global manufacturers. Founded in 1998 to make coating resin for semiconductors and displays, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005 and has 13 affiliates plus a wholly owned US subsidiary, TELOID Inc.

082740.text: Hanwha Engine is an engine maker focused on large marine engines, with businesses in ship engines, SCR, AM, diesel power generation, marine ESS and system integration for eco-friendly ship power and propulsion. In 2026 it acquired Norway's SEAM AS and 3 other companies to add electric hybrid propulsion and power management capabilities, and set up a unit in China. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSPI in 2011.

082800.text: Vivozon Pharmaceutical makes and sells finished drugs and has about 190 products. Its prescription drugs include circulatory, topical skin, fever and pain relief, and diabetes treatments, and it also sells over-the-counter medicines. Founded in 2002 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005, it is classified as a small and medium-sized venture business and has 1 subsidiary.

082850.text: Wooree Bio makes electronic components such as LED PKG modules, SMT, LED BLU and F-PCB circuit boards, along with health functional foods, and most of its sales come from LED BLU. Through subsidiaries it runs health supplement brands and is working on medical cannabis research and DNA-based health services. Founded in 2000 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005, it has production and sales bases in Korea and abroad.

082920.text: Vitzrocell specialises in lithium primary batteries, producing them along with thermal batteries, while commercialising secondary battery materials and developing CFx batteries for drones. It acquired Vitzrocell USA in 2012 and in 2025 bought 100% of Canada's Innova Power Solutions to expand into the global oil and gas market. It was founded in 1987.

083310.text: LOTVacuum makes, sells and repairs dry vacuum pumps for advanced industries such as semiconductors, displays, solar and secondary batteries, and holds patents on core technologies. It started in 2002 by acquiring a German company's dry pump business and has since developed about 10 models and around 90 products domestically. A major subsidiary makes plasma equipment for semiconductor and display processes.

083420.text: Green Chemical is a fine chemicals maker that uses EO as its main raw material to produce EOA, used as a surfactant, and ETA, for gas purification and CO2 capture, with the only ETA plant in Korea. Its DMC serves as a PC intermediate and battery electrolyte solvent, and its AM goes into UV-curable coatings and optical films. It was spun off in 2003 and listed on the KOSPI in 2005.

083450.text: Global Standard Technology makes semiconductor and display equipment, mainly scrubbers that purify harmful gases from manufacturing processes and chillers that control process temperatures. It has 15 affiliates and overseas units in the US, China, Taiwan and Singapore, adding units in Europe and Japan in 2024. Founded in 2001, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006.

083470.text: EMnI makes OLED materials and gained capabilities across the full OLED materials process by merging with an OLED materials company in 2020. It runs a fabless model that outsources everything except core technologies, and through subsidiaries works on AI-based solid-state battery materials and intelligent robot solutions. Founded in 1999 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2008, it holds deuteration patents and is expanding into India's battery market.

083500.text: FNS Tech makes equipment, parts and materials for semiconductor and display processes. Its equipment division produces display equipment, smart factory automation equipment and winding machines for high-pressure vessels, while its parts and materials division covers TOC oxidisers, UV and halogen lamps, CMP pads and OLED mask cleaning. Founded in 2002, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017.

083550.text: KM makes cleanroom consumables such as wipers, gloves and dust-free suits, supplying major semiconductor and display companies in Korea. It also sells daily goods such as masks and runs life science and industrial safety products, plus a BLU business through a Chinese affiliate that processes LCD optical films for 3M. Founded in 1989, it is a KOSDAQ-listed mid-sized company with factories in China and Vietnam.

083640.text: Incon runs hardware, software and IT service businesses in the ICT sector and develops and makes video security equipment and solutions. Beyond CCTV storage devices and security cameras, it has launched large-scale integrated control solutions, GIS maps and smart policing products. Founded in 2000 to develop information processing software and systems, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005.

083650.text: BHI designs, makes and installs equipment for power plants and steel mills, including boilers, heat recovery steam generators (HRSG), condensers, heat exchangers and deaerators. During the period it set up BHI Japan Co., Ltd to expand overseas. Founded in 1998 to make power generation and steelmaking equipment for Korean and overseas customers, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005.

083660.text: Csa Cosmic makes and sells cosmetics, having launched its cosmetics division in 2015 and merged with another company in 2020 to focus on the business; it now runs 7 brands. Drawing on its CEO's more than 35 years in the industry, it develops trend-driven products and is expanding through e-commerce, social media marketing and offline distribution. Founded in 1989, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006.

083790.text: CG Invites is a biotech company centred on structure-based drug discovery, with businesses in genomics and drug development, AI healthcare solutions and heat patches. It sells an osteoarthritis anti-inflammatory painkiller approved as Korea's 22nd new drug and is running clinical trials of a molecular-targeted cancer drug. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006 and took its current name in 2023.

083930.text: Avaco develops, makes and sells vacuum, dedicated and automation equipment for FPD manufacturing, as well as equipment for making secondary batteries and industrial materials, through 4 business divisions. Its customers include Ultium Cells, BOE and CSOT, along with Korean display, battery and materials makers. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005 and added YESOL Corp. as a subsidiary during the period.

084010.text: Daehan Steel runs a steelmaking business that turns steel scrap into billets and a rolling business that produces rebar, and operates logistics through a subsidiary. Buying a 70% stake in another steelmaker in 2020 made it the third-largest rebar producer. Founded in 1954 and listed in 2005, it is expanding electric arc furnace steelmaking, developing cleaner production technology and adopting smart factories.

084110.text: Huons Global is a pure holding company for a healthcare group of 9 subsidiaries in pharmaceuticals, hyaluronic acid-based fillers and arthritis treatments, botulinum toxin, medical devices and health supplements. It added a subsidiary in 2025 and absorbed another in 2026 to strengthen its drug business. Founded in 1965, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006 and became a holding company through a 2016 spin-off.

084180.text: Soosung Webtoon makes logistics equipment such as industrial trucks and loaders, and runs a webtoon business that provides online content and produces, distributes and sells it. Its logistics unit is developing unmanned autonomous forklifts, while its webtoon platform serves 202 IPs globally. Founded in 1982 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005, it has 13 subsidiaries in semiconductors and webtoons.

084370.text: Eugene Technology develops thin-film deposition equipment for front-end semiconductor processes, with main products BlueJay, Albatross and Harrier. Its subsidiaries include Eugenus Inc. in the US, a maker of industrial gases and front-end materials for chipmaking, and a trading company in China. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006.

084440.text: Ubion is an edtech company whose main business is its learning management platform Coursemos, which holds the top share of Korea's university LMS market. Its other edtech services include a financial and economic education platform, job training, lifelong education and corporate training, serving B2C, B2B and B2G customers. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

084650.text: LabGenomics provides genomic molecular diagnostics, offering prenatal and newborn, cancer gene, infectious disease and chromosomal abnormality testing in Korea. Through US subsidiaries it uses a clinical lab network to expand diagnostic and contract services, having acquired QDx Pathology Services in 2023 and Integrated Molecular Diagnostics in 2024. Founded in 2002, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2014.

084670.text: Dongyang Express runs express bus passenger services, along with three express bus terminals, retail space leasing, freight transport and a maintenance shop. Its subsidiaries work in publishing and education, and in farm management. The original business was founded in 1968 for passenger transport, and the current company was created through a 2005 split to focus on transport and construction.

084680.text: E-world runs a theme park that ranks among Korea's top 3 by visitor numbers, and a jewellery division that makes and sells jewellery, watches and fashion accessories under the LLOYD, OST and GRACE brands through offline and online channels. It was created in 2005 through a spin-off of another company's amusement facilities division and took its current name in 2011.

084690.text: Daesang Holdings is a pure holding company set up through a 2005 spin-off, with 10 subsidiaries and 55 affiliates in Korea and abroad. Its main subsidiary, Daesang, founded in 1956, is a fermentation company with a food business and a materials business in starch sugars, MSG and lysine. It focuses on synergies among subsidiaries, overseas growth, new growth categories and basic materials R&D.

084730.text: Thinkware Systems runs vehicle dashcam, map and home environmental appliance businesses, and since entering the dashcam market in 2010 has exported to 70 countries. Its map division has developed data and solution businesses and commercialised a connected automotive platform and mobile map services to enter the mobility market. Founded in 1997, it is a mid-sized company that listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006.

084850.text: ITM Semiconductor specialises in protection circuits for secondary batteries and, drawing on battery and chip technology, also makes e-cigarettes, battery packs and sensors. Its POC and PMP products, which it developed as world firsts, are used in smartphones, wearables and other small IT devices, and since 2022 it has supplied KT&G with heated tobacco devices and liquid cartridges. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019.

084870.text: TBH Global is a fashion company that runs 4 in-house brands and sells a licensed brand through domestic home shopping channels. It has turned one of its brands into an online-only label and is widening distribution through its TBH SHOP stores and consignment sales on a home shopping channel. Founded in 2000, it listed in 2005 and has a subsidiary.

084990.text: Helixmith is an R&D company with capabilities in drug candidate discovery and clinical development, including experience with US FDA orphan drug, Fast Track and RMAT designations. It also offers drug development platform services, runs B2B health supplement and cosmetics businesses, and is seeking partnerships in Korea and abroad. Founded in 1996, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2005 and has 2 unlisted subsidiaries.

085310.text: NK is a mid-sized company that makes fire extinguishing systems, ballast water treatment systems, offshore plant equipment and high-pressure gas cylinders. Its fire systems serve ships and onshore sites, its gas cylinders go to the semiconductor, medical and defence sectors, and its special equipment is supplied for defence products. It started in 1980, incorporated in 1984, took its current name in 1998 and listed in 2008.

085620.text: Mirae Asset Life Insurance sells life insurance, including survival, death, endowment and group policies, through general agencies, online channels and bancassurance. It has 3 consolidated domestic subsidiaries, made up of a financial services firm and real estate investment trusts in Australia and the US. Founded in 1988 under a different name, it took its current name in 2005 and listed on the KOSPI in 2015.

085660.text: Chabiotech, founded in 2002, is a bio-healthcare company within its group and has 105 subsidiaries. Its businesses include cord blood storage, stem cell research and cell therapy development, anti-aging services, pharmaceuticals, global CDMO and an overseas medical network. Working with an affiliated university, research institute and hospitals, it has built a CGB facility to strengthen its global CGT network.

085670.text: Newflex Technology makes flexible printed circuit boards (FPCB) used in smartphones, wearables, automotive electronics and EV batteries. It has 2 production subsidiaries in Vietnam, Newflex Technology Vina and Vina Newflex, and set up another subsidiary in 2024. Founded in 1992, it became a corporation in 2000 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006.

085810.text: Alticast develops middleware platforms and runs a cryptocurrency payment business. Its 8 consolidated subsidiaries include CIC, which provides quality verification for pay-TV solutions, and a construction company doing mechanical equipment work. Founded in 1999 to develop software solutions for digital broadcasting, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2013.

085910.text: Neotechnicalsystem makes micro bits, ultra-precision tools for PCB machining, and motor shafts for vehicles. It added optical lens polishing machines through a 2021 acquisition, and together with a German company holds about 80% of the global market for automatic optical lens polishers. Founded in 2000 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007, it has a subsidiary that makes insert-type worm shafts.

086040.text: Biotoxtech is a non-clinical CRO that assesses the human safety of drugs, cell and gene therapies and chemicals, including rodent and non-rodent toxicity studies and primate safety and efficacy studies. It runs GLP-certified research and, as the industry shifts toward biologics, is pursuing lab animal facility setup and consulting and drug candidate development. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007 and has a subsidiary.

086060.text: Gene Bio Tech makes natural, eco-friendly feed ingredients and additives using traditional solid-state fermentation, supplying compound feed mills and farms. Founded in 2000 to make functional feed additives from beneficial microbes, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006. In 2011 it acquired 100% of a domestic animal medicine maker, through which it also runs an animal drug business.

086280.text: Hyundai Glovis is an automotive logistics company set up in 2001 to integrate logistics for the Hyundai Motor Group, whose carmakers are its main customers. It handles logistics for finished vehicles, parts and bulk cargo; distribution including CKD parts, used car auctions and exports, and non-ferrous metal trading; and shipping of vehicles on PCTCs and bulk cargo. It listed on the KOSPI in 2005 and has 38 subsidiaries.

086390.text: UniTestInc makes semiconductor test equipment and was the first in Korea to develop and commercialise memory component testers, module testers and burn-in testers. It entered solar power systems in 2009, has diversified from DRAM to storage testers, and through subsidiaries is entering system chip test equipment and developing perovskite solar cells. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006.

086450.text: Dong Kook Pharmaceutical makes and sells medicines and also sells cosmetics and health supplements. It focuses on R&D, developing new products from platform technologies and pursuing overseas markets as it grows into a total healthcare group. Founded in 1968, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007 and has three subsidiaries.

086520.text: Ecopro is the holding company of the Ecopro group. Its battery materials subsidiaries work in cathode materials, precursors, lithium and recycling, while its environmental subsidiary provides total solutions for air quality and water treatment. Founded in 1998, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007.

086670.text: BMT makes industrial precision fittings and valves, used as piping materials for plants, as well as electrical switchboards, distribution panels and intelligent power monitoring systems. It supplies the semiconductor, IT, shipbuilding and offshore plant, nuclear, and oil and gas plant industries, and holds vendor approvals from 23 companies in 12 countries. Founded in 1988, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007 and became a mid-sized company in 2026.

086710.text: Sunjin Beauty Science produces cosmetic ingredients and surfactants using nano, encapsulation and compounding technologies. Founded in 1988 to make surfactants, it shifted to cosmetic materials in 1997 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021. It has 4 subsidiaries, including one in China, and set up a unit in Indonesia in 2024 to strengthen its position in Southeast Asia.

086790.text: Hana Financial Group is a financial holding company set up in 2005 under the Financial Holding Companies Act, with roots in a 1971 investment finance company that became Hana Bank in 1991. It runs banking, investment, credit card, instalment finance, savings bank, life insurance, and trust and asset management businesses through 14 subsidiaries and 34 second-tier subsidiaries, with a global network of 195 sites in 27 regions.

086820.text: Bio Solution develops cell therapies, human stem cell-derived materials and peptides, and human tissue models, with a pipeline that includes joint and burn treatments and cosmetic ingredients. It is commercialising autologous cell therapies, developing allogeneic ones for wider use and pursuing markets such as the US and China. Founded in 2000, it took its current name in 2016 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018 through the technology special listing track.

086890.text: ISU Abxis is the biotech arm of the ISU group, using biotechnology to develop, make and sell therapeutic antibodies and proteins. Its products include treatments for the rare diseases Gaucher disease and Fabry disease, as well as Korea's first antibody therapy. Founded in 2001, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2009.

086900.text: Medy-Tox researches, develops, makes and sells botulinum toxin type A and other biopharmaceuticals, and says it was the world's 4th developer of such toxin products, which are its main sellers. It is developing next-generation liquid, prefilled syringe and recombinant toxins and pursuing overseas markets. Founded in 2000 to make drugs and botulinum toxin treatments, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2009.

086960.text: MDS Tech provides embedded software development, system software and industrial automation solutions, targeting the automotive, machinery and robotics, and electronics markets. It has 12 unlisted subsidiaries and supplies customers across Asia through units in Singapore, Australia, Hong Kong, India and China. Founded in 1998 to provide total embedded system solutions, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006.

086980.text: Showbox is a content media company that distributes films and video, trades content rights, raises investment and produces broadcast programmes, with divisions for film, drama, content distribution and management support. Founded in 1999 for film production, investment and distribution, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006, and in 2015 set up SHOWBOX Inc. in China to serve that market.

087010.text: Peptron focuses on designing and making smart medicines and developing new drugs using its core peptide engineering and long-acting drug technologies. Its SmartDepot technology is a platform for optimising how long a drug stays in the body, and its GMP mass production facility can make clinical and commercial products. Founded in 1997, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2015.

087260.text: Mobile Appliance makes and sells automotive electronics such as video recorders, ADAS, HUD and navigation systems, and is focused on developing combined products such as radar-linked video recorders. It supplies global carmakers including BMW, Audi and Benz, while in Korea it runs B2C and B2B business through a subsidiary. Founded in 2004, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017.

087600.text: Pixelplus is a fabless chip designer specialising in CIS and image processing ICs. Its main products are CIS and related parts for automotive and security cameras, special-purpose CIS and camera SoCs, and it is releasing new products to supply total vehicle camera solutions suited to autonomous driving. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2015.

088130.text: Dongaeltek operates in display inspection equipment, OLED manufacturing equipment and new technology venture financing through its subsidiaries. Its main product, OLED inspection equipment, goes to BOE and Korean display makers, and it was the first in the industry to develop 8.6th-generation deposition equipment, winning orders for mass-production lines. It became a corporation in 1999 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007.

088260.text: E Kocref Cr-reit is a real estate investment company listed on the KOSPI. It invests in property and pays shareholders dividends from the income, rather than running an operating business.

088280.text: Sawnics, founded in 2000, is an RF filter foundry and the only Korean company with technology for making 5G smartphone RF filters smaller and higher-performing. Since 2017 it has co-developed silicon wafer-based TF-SAW filters with a global communications chip company, and it has about 20 fabless communications chip customers in the US and Greater China. It is also working with a Swiss photonics company on advanced packaging.

088290.text: Ewon Comfortech makes automotive seats and interiors, specialising in air suspension seats, spring suspension seats and interior parts for commercial vehicles. It was founded in 1994 to supply seats and interiors to Korean carmakers and an auto parts maker, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2009. Its subsidiary is EWON COMFORTECH USA in the US.

088340.text: Uracle is an AI and mobile platform company whose mobile platform has been used to build mobile environments for more than 1,000 companies. It also builds, runs and maintains UMS systems, and is expanding into AI with its own AI platform, AI coding tools and joint AI research with a university. Founded in 2001, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024 and has two subsidiaries.

088350.text: Hanwha Life Insurance, founded in 1946, is a life insurer that also heads a financial group with subsidiaries in non-life insurance, asset management, securities and savings banking. Its core business covers protection, savings and group insurance. It has entered overseas insurance markets through local units in Vietnam and Indonesia and is expanding by acquiring an Indonesian bank and a US brokerage.

088390.text: Innox is a holding company that sets growth strategy, supports affiliate financing and pursues new businesses including M&A. It has 7 subsidiaries in Korea, China and Vietnam, covering bicycles, investment and raw material production. Founded in 2001, it took its current name in 2005 and in 2017 split into itself and a separate advanced materials company.

088790.text: Jindo, a KOSPI-listed company created through a 2006 spin-off, has sold furs in Korea since 1988, and its fur brand ranks first in the domestic market. It runs three fur clothing brands and two ready-to-wear brands, plans and produces new designs through its in-house design lab, and sells through a range of distribution channels.

088800.text: Ace Technologies makes RF components and base station antennas for wireless communications, integrated antennas for vehicles, and communication antennas for defence. It has completed 5G technology development, uses a Vietnamese unit for cost competitiveness, and is focusing on high-precision navigation devices and 5G/V2X integrated antennas for autonomous driving. It was created through a 2006 spin-off and took its current name in a 2010 merger.

088910.text: Dongwoo Farm To Table produces and sells chicken products as a government-designated livestock integration company, using Farm to Plate and Cold Chain systems. It raises birds through contract farms, giving them stable income while securing quality raw materials, and held a 15.2% share of the domestic chicken slaughter market in 2026. Founded in 1993, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006.

088980.text: Macquarie Korea Infrastructure Fund is an infrastructure fund listed on the KOSPI. It invests in infrastructure assets and pays shareholders dividends from the income, rather than running an operating business.

089010.text: Chemtronics is a mid-sized company that develops and sells wireless charging materials and parts, and operates in semiconductors, electronics, automotive electronics, and distribution and other businesses. In semiconductors it can synthesise ultra-high-purity PGMEA for EUV lithography and has TGV processing technology for glass substrates, and in 2025 it added a wafer processing company. Founded in 1983, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007.

089030.text: Techwing makes semiconductor test equipment for global companies, offering inspection solutions across back-end chip processes; its main products include the Cube Prober for HBM testing, probe stations, and memory and SOC test handlers. It also supplies display inspection equipment such as optical evaluation systems and module visual inspection machines. Founded in 2002, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2011.

089140.text: Nexturn & Rollkorea makes CNC automatic lathes, used in fields such as autos, telecom equipment and medical parts, which can run unmanned 24 hours a day with automatic bar feeders. It also makes and sells excavator and forklift parts and runs a semiconductor equipment business. Founded in 2000 to make and sell CNC automatic lathes, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006.

089150.text: Korea Computer Terminal makes financial terminal systems, supplying integrated branch terminal solutions, passbook printers and card issuing machines, as well as smart ATMs and mini cash dispensers. For the public sector it supplies horse race betting, sports betting and lottery terminals to major institutions, and it exports J-TOTO lottery terminals. It was spun off from another company in 2002 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006.

089230.text: The E&M runs single-person media platforms and also has MCN and entertainment management businesses, and it is upgrading its platforms for mobile trends and expanding its MCN business. It has 7 subsidiaries, including a KOSDAQ-listed company that makes inkjet media and display equipment. Founded in 2002, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006.

089470.text: HDC Hyundai Engineering Plastics is an HDC Group plastics materials company with 3 divisions. Its PO division makes plastic materials from PP and PE for autos, electrical and electronic consumer goods and construction, its PS division makes PS and EPS from SM, and its building materials division supplies sanitary and fire protection piping. Founded in 2000, it listed in 2006.

089590.text: Jejuair is a low-cost carrier (LCC), with air transport making up 95.92% of sales, and it is diversifying revenue as the first LCC to introduce dedicated freighters. Its subsidiaries include a ground handling company, a hotel real estate investment vehicle and a standard workplace for people with disabilities. Founded in 2005, it listed on the KOSPI in 2015.

089600.text: kt nasmedia is a KT Group digital media representative that sells PC and mobile display ads, IPTV digital broadcast ads and digital outdoor ad inventory. It offers a range of ad services through its own mobile ad platform, NAP, and has sold its subsidiaries to focus on ad media sales. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2013.

089790.text: JT makes semiconductor test equipment, focusing on final test tools for back-end processes, and supplies burn-in sorters, test handlers and memory module testers to chipmakers including Micron. It is diversifying by preparing BLU equipment for AI chips for global OSATs, developing a wafer probe station and collaborating on HBM-related equipment technology. Founded in 1998, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006.

089850.text: UbiVelox is an IT convergence company with 16 subsidiaries, running businesses in Secure Element-based smart cards, personal data services, dashcams, maps and home environmental appliances, as well as high-value cards, COS licensing and Korean culture accessories. Its dashcams are supplied exclusively to BMW headquarters and exported to 70 countries. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2010.

089860.text: Lotte Rental runs auto rental, including long- and short-term car rentals and used car sales, and business rentals of office equipment and robots, along with leasing, maintenance and car sharing. It launched the used car brand T Car in 2025 and is expanding overseas. Founded in 2005, it grew through two mergers and joined the Lotte Group in 2015.

089890.text: Koses supplies back-end semiconductor equipment such as solderball attach systems and PKG stack systems, as well as laser application equipment, and can provide total solutions for chip packaging equipment. Building on its laser processing technology, it has expanded into secondary battery manufacturing equipment as a new growth area. Founded in 1994, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006.

089970.text: VM makes and sells dry etching equipment for semiconductor etch processes, with its main products being 300mm silicon and metal film etchers. It has two subsidiaries, APTC AMERICA CORP. in the US and VM(Wuxi) Inc. in China, to provide quick service. Founded in 2002, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018.

089980.text: Sang-a Frontec runs parts, materials and equipment businesses based on its own super engineering plastics technology and processing know-how. It operates a one-stop production system built on fluororesin and high-performance plastics, and is strengthening R&D in new technologies such as e-PTFE membranes. Founded in 1986 to make electronic and electrical parts, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2011.

090080.text: Pyung Hwa Industrial makes auto parts such as anti-vibration parts, air suspensions and hoses, supplying four Korean carmakers and serving overseas markets through subsidiaries in the US, China and India. Its roots trace to a rubber company founded in 1950, and it was created through a 2006 spin-off. It spun off its anti-vibration division in 2008 and merged it back in 2014.

090150.text: iWIN makes and sells car seat heaters, designed for even temperature distribution and overheating protection, and supplies more than 90% of Korea's seat heater volume to major carmakers. It runs sales units in the US, Slovakia and China and a factory in Vietnam. Founded in 1999 to make auto parts, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006.

090350.text: Noroo Paint & Coatings makes and sells paints for buildings, industry and car refinishing, operating in Korea and abroad through affiliates such as NOROO Vina. It has 2 listed and 14 unlisted affiliates, has run the Korean paint industry's first colour research institute since 1987, and works with foreign companies on eco-friendly products. It was spun off from its holding company in 2006.

090360.text: Robostar makes industrial robots across three areas: robots for manufacturing; semiconductor and TR equipment, including wafer and glass transfer robots and EFEM; and smart factory products such as automated guided robots and logistics equipment. Founded in 1999 to make industrial robots, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2011 and has 1 subsidiary.

090370.text: Metalabs has diversified through acquisitions from offline fashion into online fashion and cosmeceuticals, reshaping itself as a healthcare company. Its subsidiaries work in IT solutions, drug and medical device distribution, hospital consulting, real estate development and advertising. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSPI in 2006 and took its current name in 2018.

090410.text: Dukshinepc is a mid-sized company that makes and installs deck plates for buildings, led by an integrated deck plate and several other deck plate lines. Its main subsidiaries work in real estate development and golf course operation. Founded in 1990, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2014.

090430.text: Amorepacific makes and sells cosmetics through luxury and premium brands and health and beauty brands. Sales come 39% from Korea, 13% from duty-free and 48% from overseas, and it is rebalancing globally toward the Americas and EMEA while building core products for each brand. It was created in 2006 through a spin-off, has 31 subsidiaries and acquired a cosmetics company in 2024 to strengthen its global reach.

090460.text: BH makes flexible printed circuit boards (FPCB) for mobile IT devices and display and camera modules, and its automotive division, BH EVS, develops and sells wireless chargers for vehicles. It has 8 subsidiaries, including BHFLEX HK and BH Flex VINA, and several affiliates. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007 and moved to the KOSPI in 2023.

090470.text: JAS Robotics makes and sells equipment for displays, semiconductors, secondary batteries, logistics robots and biotech, with main products including COP/COF/FOG bonders, water-jet cleaning and plating equipment, battery cell assembly equipment and AGV/AMR robots. It started its semiconductor equipment business in 1995 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007. After selling its stake in one company in 2026, it has 3 unlisted subsidiaries.

090710.text: Hyulim Robot makes industrial robots for manufacturing and intelligent service robots, with a range that includes Cartesian, horizontal articulated, desktop and vacuum robots. Founded in 1999 to produce and supply industrial and intelligent robots, it became the first robot company to list on the KOSDAQ in 2006, and it has 5 consolidated subsidiaries.

090850.text: Hyundai Ezwel develops software and runs e-commerce for flexible employee benefit plans, providing companies with consulting, system building and operation, and benefit content. In November 2022 it took control of the top mobile meal voucher operator, entering the meal allowance benefit business. Founded in 2003, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2013.

091120.text: EM-Tech develops and makes electrical and electronic devices and parts, operating a parts business and a products business. The parts business is diversifying around module assemblies for mobile phones, smart watches and TWS devices. Founded in 2001, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007, and its consolidated subsidiaries fell from 6 to 5 after it absorbed one of them in 2026.

091340.text: S & Kpolytec makes high-density polyurethane foam sheets used as shock-absorbing gasket material in mobile phones and OLED panels. It also produces smartphone FPCAs using SMT and makes automotive wiper blades, running the SMT and wiper businesses through a subsidiary. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007 and has completed liquidation of its units in Hong Kong and China.

091440.text: HanWool Materials Science has a telecom division that develops, makes and sells optical transmission equipment and a semiconductor materials division that develops and produces key materials for chip processes, the latter through a subsidiary. In 2026 it set up a new subsidiary and completed the sale of another. Founded in 2000 to make wired communications equipment, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2008.

091580.text: Sangsin Energy Display Precision makes parts for lithium-ion secondary batteries, mainly cylindrical cans used in BBUs and power tools, EV cans for electric vehicles, and parts for large-capacity ESS. Founded in 1992 to develop and sell secondary battery parts, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007 and has 9 consolidated subsidiaries.

091590.text: Nam Hwa Construction is a general contractor handling civil engineering, building, landscaping and electrical contracting work, with building accounting for about 75% of sales and civil, electrical and landscaping work making up the rest. It has 15 affiliates, one of which listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018. Founded in 1959, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2012.

091700.text: Partron makes electronic components through optical-mechanical, sensor and package, and electronics divisions, serving about 100 customers. It is expanding supply of high-resolution smartphone camera modules, entering the ADAS camera market for autonomous driving, and diversifying into ESL, blood glucose meters and communication modules. Founded in 2003, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2006 and has 4 affiliates, including production units in China and Vietnam.

091810.text: Trinity Airways runs scheduled domestic and international passenger flights, adding routes to Europe in 2024 and the Americas in 2025. A wholly owned subsidiary handles ground handling and reservations. It was founded in 2003 with roots in Korea's first low-cost carrier, joined a new business group in 2025 after a change of largest shareholder, and took its current name in 2026.

091970.text: Lskairobot specialises in ESD materials, developing and making raw materials such as organic conductive polymers, ion complex conductive polymers and carbon nanotubes for conductive compounds, conductive plastics and functional ESD protection films. Its 3 overseas manufacturing units in China and Vietnam sell to major IT companies including TCL, and it is expanding into nano-silver transparent electrodes and quantum dot materials. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007.

092040.text: Amicogen uses its own gene evolution technology in specialty pharmaceutical enzymes, Protein A resin, animal cell culture media, NAG, collagen peptides and health supplements. Through a Chinese unit it makes active pharmaceutical ingredients and animal medicines, and in 2023 it set up a joint venture in Vietnam to produce collagen raw material in-house. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2013.

092070.text: DNF makes thin-film materials for forming semiconductor devices, with main products DPT and QPT, High-k, SiO/SiN and ACL materials supplied to major chipmakers. It co-develops next-generation materials with global chipmakers and equipment companies, drawing on its molecular design and synthesis technology. Founded in 2001, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007.

092130.text: e-Credible collects and processes credit information under Korea's credit information law and evaluates creditworthiness for clients. Its main services are electronic credit certification, technology credit ratings, company information lookups and ESG assessments, while its subsidiary runs TAMZ, a payment-based B2B e-marketplace. Founded in 2001, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2008.

092190.text: Seoul Viosys makes LED chips as a compound semiconductor-based optoelectronic device company, with full-spectrum technology from visible to invisible light. It invests about 10% of sales in R&D each year and holds about 7,000 patents, with 6 R&D centres worldwide and subsidiaries in the US, Vietnam and China. Founded in 2002, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020.

092200.text: Dae-il makes gears and shafts, core parts of power transmission systems, for the auto and heavy equipment industries. Its head office and plant are in Ulsan, and it has set up a US subsidiary to make and supply auto parts locally. Founded in 1976, it changed its name in 2006 and listed on the KOSPI in 2007.

092220.text: Kec makes non-memory power semiconductors and IC products, supplying Korean home appliance and automotive companies and expanding exports to China, Japan and the US. It is the only mid-sized company in the field with its own front-end and back-end chip production facilities, and has subsidiaries in Thailand and China. It was created in 2006 when a manufacturing division was split off from its former parent.

092230.text: KPX Holdings is a holding company created in 2006 by splitting off and merging the investment businesses of two KPX chemical companies. Its subsidiaries operate in PPG, auto parts, real estate leasing, and holding and other businesses, with PPG making up more than 85% of total sales. It is strengthening core businesses, pursuing new businesses and M&A, and expanding overseas.

092300.text: Hyunwoo Industrial makes PCBs used in automotive electronics and digital devices such as LCD, LED and OLED products. It supplies major customers in Korea and abroad in the automotive and EV electronics, display, and information and communications sectors. Founded in 1987, it became a corporation in 1996, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007 and has 1 unlisted subsidiary.

092440.text: Kishin makes mould bases for plastic injection moulds, along with precision plates and die sets for press dies, and distributes forged steel for moulds. It was founded in 1988 as a joint venture with a Japanese company and listed on the KOSPI in 2007. Its subsidiaries include KISHIN VIETNAM in Vietnam.

092460.text: Hanla IMS makes measuring instruments, providing one-stop solutions in precision measurement, gas detection, integrated control and eco-friendly systems under several brands for shipbuilding and offshore, onshore plants and green industries. It supports customers through a global after-sales network. Founded in 1989, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007 and has a subsidiary in China.

092600.text: NC's main business is vehicle dashcams, and it also makes and sells multimedia chips for the video security market. It is developing solutions such as AI-based ADAS dashcams and expanding globally with its Vueroid brand. Founded in 1997 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007, it created a new company through a spin-off and merged with another in 2019, taking its current name, and completed a further merger in 2023.

092730.text: Neopharm makes cosmetics under several brands, with 81% of sales in Korea and 19% from exports. Its proprietary MLE formulation technology underpins its products as it widens its business. Founded in 2000, it is listed on the KOSDAQ, and its largest shareholder changed to a cosmetics company in 2016.

092780.text: DYP specialises in pistons, making and selling them through 8 companies in Korea and abroad and supplying global carmakers including BMW and AUDI. To meet demand for eco-friendly vehicles, it took over an enclosure business for hydrogen fuel cell vehicles in 2018 and set up a subsidiary for eco-friendly car parts in 2024. Founded in 1977, it listed on the KOSPI in 2017 and took its current name in 2025.

092790.text: Nexteel makes and sells steel pipes, including OCTG, oil and gas transmission pipelines, and piping and structural pipes, using hot-rolled coil as raw material and exporting worldwide. It has completed investment in 26-inch large-diameter ERW pipe facilities, the largest outside diameter in Asia, and keeps investing in large-diameter pipe facilities for the wind energy industry. It was founded in 1990.

092870.text: Exicon makes semiconductor test equipment and provides chip testing services. Its products include memory test equipment such as DDR4 and DDR5 memory testers, SSD testers and burn-in testers, and non-memory test equipment for CIS, DDI and AP chips. Founded in 2001 to make memory test systems, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2015 and has an affiliate in Japan, Exicon Japan Corporation.

093050.text: LF was created in 2006 when it took over a fashion business split off from an LG trading affiliate. Its fashion business runs brands across many categories, its finance business handles trusts and REITs, and its food business distributes food ingredients. Subsidiaries include a fashion importer, a street casual clothing maker, an online mall, an asset trust company and a food company.

093190.text: Bixolon makes a range of printers produced in Korea and sells them globally through subsidiaries in the US, Germany and Mexico. Drawing on about 20 years of accumulated technology, it is developing linerless printers, RFID printers and products that can print on recycled paper. It was spun off from another company in 2002 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007.

093240.text: Hyungji Elite makes and sells clothing, with school uniforms, B2B and sports merchandising as its main businesses, and its school uniform brand, launched in 1969, was Korea's first. It has set up a new subsidiary for smart clothing and wearables and launched a sports fashion brand. Founded in 2002, it acquired another company's clothing and uniform division and listed on the KOSPI in 2009.

093320.text: KINX provides internet infrastructure services, including IDC, IX, CDN and cloud, and runs 8 data centres in the greater Seoul area, including one completed in 2024. Its main subsidiary is Korea's top Microsoft SPLA partner and provides Grid CDN services after absorbing another company. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2011.

093370.text: Foosung produces refrigerants, secondary battery materials and specialty gases for semiconductors based on fluorine chemistry. The company says it is the only domestic producer of the battery electrolyte LiPF6 and the chip gas C4F6. Founded and listed in 2006, it added a chemical equipment maker through a share swap in 2022; that subsidiary makes titanium reactors and pressure vessels.

093380.text: Pungkang makes nuts, bolts, screws and other parts for vehicle assembly, supplying Korean carmakers and their tier-1 suppliers. Founded in 1974, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007. It has 3 subsidiaries, including units in Mexico and the United States.

093520.text: Makus sells non-memory chips such as FPGA and analog semiconductors through technical sales, distributing products from global chipmakers including AMD, MACOM and RENESAS in Korea. It was created through a spin-off in 2006 and relisted on the KOSDAQ in 2007. Its subsidiaries handle investment and the distribution and maintenance of storage and server systems.

093640.text: Korea Robot Manufacturing has a robot and drone division that makes products for unmanned systems and core drive parts such as BLDC motors and ESCs. Its semiconductor division designs and sells SoC-based AP and multimedia interface chips, along with automotive electronics such as clusters and IVI systems. Founded in 1998 to make multimedia chips, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007.

093920.text: Seowonintech supplies phone keypads, flip covers and other accessories as a first-tier vendor to a Korean electronics maker. It also develops ultra-precision high-speed machining centers and CNC electrical discharge machines for machine tool companies, and says it holds a 90% share of the domestic high-speed machining market. Founded in 1983, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007, runs a unit in Vietnam and made an acquisition in 2024.

094170.text: Dongwoon Anatech is a fabless system semiconductor developer focused on OIS ICs, haptic ICs and BLDC chips, with manufacturing outsourced to two foundry partners. It is preparing digital healthcare products such as a saliva-based glucose measurement system and is developing products that use AI algorithms. Founded in 2006, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2015.

094280.text: Hyosung Itx is a Hyosung group affiliate that provides tailored contact center services to clients in finance, the public sector, retail and manufacturing. It also offers IT solutions and services, display solutions, ITO, IDC and AI services, and has one subsidiary. Founded in 1997, it listed on the KOSPI in 2007.

094360.text: Chips & Media licenses video codec IP to chipmakers for use in smartphones, cars and cameras, and also serves customers building data center GPUs, NPUs and edge AI chips. It completed its own NPU in 2023 and plans to unveil an AI-based full image signal processor in 2026. Founded in 2003, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2015.

094480.text: GalaxiaMoneytree is an electronic payment agent handling mobile phone billing, credit card payments and bank transfers. It also runs an O2O business built around mobile gift vouchers and coupons and its own simple-payment platform. Founded in 1994, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007, joined a Korean business group in 2008, took its current name in 2020 and has 4 subsidiaries.

094800.text: Miraeasset Maps Realty Investment is a real estate investment company listed on the KOSPI. It invests in property and pays shareholders dividends from the income, rather than running an operating business.

094820.text: Iljin Power maintains power plants and works in nuclear power and renewable energy, and also fabricates chemical equipment, builds plants and generates electricity from fuel cells. Its business is split into 6 divisions: power generation, nuclear, new growth, chemical, plant and fuel cells. Founded in 1990, it has two subsidiaries.

094840.text: Suprema HQ makes security products based on biometric technology, developing fingerprint and face recognition terminals for access control and time-and-attendance on an ODM basis for Korean physical security service providers. It also earns income from management consulting, investment and brand fees, and has a real estate investment and development subsidiary. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2008.

094850.text: Very Good Tour is a travel company that sells tour packages and overseas specialty goods. It sells directly to customers to cut distribution costs, selects local partners, develops its own itineraries and monitors trips before, during and after travel. It was spun off from a bicycle company in 2007 and took its current name in 2017, when the travel and bicycle businesses were split.

094860.text: Neorigin runs mobile games aimed at the global market in genres including idle RPG, strategy and role-playing, and its subsidiary handles publishing operations in Korea and abroad. Founded and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007, it changed its name and entered games in 2020 after a change of largest shareholder. It sold its security division in 2023 and absorbed a subsidiary in 2024.

094940.text: Puloon Robotics makes automation equipment based on mechatronics and AI recognition technology, including financial automation machines, station service automation equipment and collaborative robots, with financial automation accounting for about 56% of sales. It supplies entry-level cash dispensers in Korea and ATMs in North America. Founded in 1997, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007.

094970.text: JMT is an electronics manufacturing services company whose main products are FPBAs for mobile phone modules and PBAs for tablet and TV modules, made through its Vietnam unit. It also runs OEM and ODM production of household goods and makes car interior parts, labels and printed products. Founded in 1998, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007.

095190.text: Shinhwapritech is a metal processing and machine parts maker that supplies defense and aerospace parts for the K-2 tank, K-9 self-propelled howitzer and KF-21 fighter, as well as equipment for nuclear and fusion power and core parts for constant-velocity joints. Founded in 2003 to make machine tools, it bought a maker of machine tool parts and defense products in 2005, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007 and took its current name in 2026.

095270.text: Wave Electronics runs a defense business that supports the development and production of military weapons, along with a communications business making wired and wireless telecom equipment. Founded in 1999 to develop power amplifiers for mobile communications equipment, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007 and has 9 subsidiaries.

095340.text: ISC supplies semiconductor test solutions, including test sockets and test probes used with chip and electronic component inspection equipment. The company says it was the first in the world to commercialize silicone rubber sockets and holds a 90% share of the elastomer socket market. Founded in 2001, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007 and has subsidiaries in North America, Vietnam and Hong Kong.

095500.text: Mntech makes display and secondary battery materials, including LCD optical films, QD sheets, EMI filters, cathode additives and lithium hydroxide, and also produces window film and retroreflective film and runs a financial business. It holds 221 intellectual property rights from its research. Founded in 2002, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007 and belongs to a group of 7 affiliates.

095570.text: AJ Networks rents out pallets, IT devices and industrial equipment, leases refrigerated and frozen warehouses and sells fuel at wholesale and retail. It is expanding into renting serving robots and collaborative robots through its nationwide distribution network. Founded in 2000, it took its current name after a merger in 2013 and has 22 consolidated subsidiaries.

095610.text: Tes makes semiconductor manufacturing equipment, focused on front-end process tools such as PECVD and gas-phase etch and cleaning systems. Chip equipment makes up more than 95% of its sales, and it also supplies thin-film encapsulation equipment for displays and MOCVD equipment for UVC LEDs. Founded in 2002, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2008 and has 3 unlisted subsidiaries.

095660.text: Neowiz develops and publishes games for PC, console and mobile platforms, and its catalog includes several long-running titles. It is pursuing new original games, adopting AI technology and building its game IP into franchises. Founded in 2007 through a spin-off, it is listed on the KOSDAQ and has several affiliates in Korea and abroad.

095700.text: Genexine is a biopharmaceutical company built on antibody fusion protein and genetic vaccine technology, developing recombinant protein drugs, DNA vaccines and a bioPROTAC platform. Its pipeline includes the immuno-oncology candidate GX-I7 and GX-H9 for growth hormone deficiency. Founded in 1999 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2009, it gained its bioPROTAC technology through a merger and also brings in technology through licensing and acquisitions.

095720.text: Woongjin Thinkbig provides children's education through membership-based study programs and book sets, along with online and offline learning services and publishing, including edtech services. It is diversifying its business and aims to become an education platform for all ages. It was spun off from Woongjin in 2007 and has several subsidiaries.

095910.text: S-Energy works across the solar power chain, making solar modules, installing solar power systems, generating power and providing operation and maintenance. It is adding BIPV and N-type TOPCon modules and expanding EPC projects and exports. Founded in 2001, it says it is Korea's first solar company, is listed on the KOSDAQ and has two main subsidiaries.

096240.text: Creverse provides education content for preschool, elementary and secondary students through language academies, gifted education centers and coding programs. It operates about 330 directly run and franchised learning centers nationwide, with domestic, overseas and subsidiary segments. Founded in 1998 to run academies, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2008 and has 7 subsidiaries.

096250.text: WISEnut is an AI company with natural language processing and machine learning technology. It supplies AI agents that combine search, big data analysis and LLM-based AI to handle tasks from information search to document writing, and builds industry-specific LLMs, RAG-based agents and the multi-agent platform WISE Agent Sphere. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

096350.text: Daechang Solution makes steel castings for marine solutions, nuclear waste handling, power generation equipment, shipbuilding equipment, general industrial machinery and cryogenic applications. It signed a multi-year supply MOU with GE POWER in 2018 and has won SMR orders as it expands into clean energy. Founded in 1953, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007.

096530.text: Seegene develops, makes and supplies molecular diagnostic reagents, using syndromic quantitative PCR and technologies such as DPO, TOCE and MuDT to develop about 120 reagents. It has local units in Italy, the UAE and the United States and distributors in about 100 countries. Founded in 2000, it is pursuing a technology-sharing program through SGDDS toward its SG OneSystem.

096630.text: S Connect is a precision metal processing company that makes metal parts and foldable hinges for smartphone makers. It has developed metal parts for secondary batteries to target the electric vehicle battery market, and is expanding into clean hydrogen energy through a stake in Recarbon USA and exclusive manufacturing rights. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2007.

096690.text: Aroot has a diversified business spanning printers, distribution, uninterruptible power supplies, semiconductors and waste recycling, with 13 subsidiaries. Its printer business develops and makes mini printers for POS, labels and mobile use, and the company says it holds about 30% of the domestic market and 2 to 3% overseas. Founded in 2002, it is listed on the KOSDAQ.

096760.text: JW Holdings is a holding company with 7 subsidiaries that make and sell drugs, conduct research and development and run a medical device business, earning income from equity in its subsidiaries and brand fees. A drug subsidiary is running a global phase 3 trial of a gout treatment, and a research unit was selected for a national drug development program. It was spun off from its drug subsidiary in 2007.

096770.text: SK Innovation is an energy company with businesses in oil and chemicals, LNG, power and batteries, built into a vertically integrated value chain. After merging with SK E&S in 2024, it says it became the largest private integrated energy company in the Asia-Pacific region. Founded in 2007, it is pursuing electrification, a wider ESS business and an expanded global LNG value chain.

096870.text: LDTInc is a fabless company that develops and sells driver ICs for OLED and LED displays. A 2014 merger added its SSN business, which works on IoT-based smart fire prevention systems, PCB fabless services and a platform linked to AI risk analysis. It was founded in 1997 as a fabless semiconductor company for display driver ICs.

097230.text: HJ Shipbuilding & Construction builds commercial ships such as container ships and tankers, along with naval vessels including large transport ships and high-speed landing craft, a field where the company says it holds a monopoly position. Its construction arm builds passenger and logistics facilities, housing, civil works and overseas infrastructure and plants. Spun off in 2007 and listed on the KOSPI, it has 3 affiliates.

097520.text: Mcnex makes camera modules, mainly for phones and cars, and is expanding into biometric, dashcam, robot, CCTV and 3D camera modules. It is developing high-resolution and zoom technology for phone cameras and more advanced ADAS functions for vehicles. Founded in 2004 with CCM technology, it listed on the KOSPI in 2021 and has 4 overseas subsidiaries in Vietnam, China and India.

097780.text: Eco Volt makes automotive bulbs and LED modules, supplying parts for vehicle lighting to automotive customers. Founded in 2004, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2008 and changed its name and moved its head office in 2023. In 2026 it is restructuring, including a merger and the sale of SF INNOTEK VINA.

097800.text: Winpac provides semiconductor back-end packaging, which mounts chips on a substrate, connects them and protects them, and testing to check chips for defects. The company says that, unlike other Korean back-end firms, it handles both packaging and testing and can take full back-end orders from chipmakers and fabless companies. Founded in 2002, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2013.

097870.text: Hyosung ONB makes and sells organic fertilizers and by-product fertilizers such as compost. It has its head office and a plant in one Korean region and plants in four other locations in Korea. Founded in 1984, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2008 and has two subsidiaries, including HYOSUNG ONB (PVT)LTD in Sri Lanka.

097950.text: CJ CheilJedang makes basic foods such as sugar and flour and processed foods such as instant rice and dumplings, and also runs a bio business including amino acids and logistics, parcel delivery and construction businesses. It was created in 2007 when CJ Corporation's manufacturing arm was spun off, and traces its roots to 1953. During the year it sold its stakes in 14 units in its F&C segment.

098070.text: Hantech designs, builds and installs chemical process equipment such as heat exchangers, pressure vessels and reactors, along with cryogenic and low-temperature storage tanks. Drawing on its supply record with large EPC firms, it is entering green energy and SMR equipment markets with CCUS pressure vessels and hydrogen tanks. It was spun off from a fertilizer company in 1998, joined a business group in 2011 and moved its head office to Ulsan.

098120.text: Micro Contact Solution runs a semiconductor segment that makes IC sockets used as consumables in chip testing and other contact parts for chips and telecom devices. Its appliance segment makes thermal protectors, industrial electronic switches and contact assemblies. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2008 and has a subsidiary that makes chip equipment and parts.

098460.text: Koh Young Technology makes automated inspection and precision measurement equipment, supplying 3D SPI, AOI and semiconductor back-end packaging inspection systems. Its core technologies span mechatronics, optics, vision, software and AI. Founded in 2002, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2008, has 10 subsidiaries in the United States, Europe, China and elsewhere, and set up new units in India and Germany in 2026.

098660.text: STO runs a men's fashion business centred on STCO, which it says was Korea's first shirt-and-tie specialty store brand, along with the casual brand DIEMS and the new womenswear brand UMEORA. It sells through agencies, directly run stores, discount stores and online, with 187 stores in total at a quarter-end in 2026. Founded in 2003, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2009.

099190.text: i-SENS makes medical sensors and meters based on electrochemical and biosensor technology. Blood glucose monitoring accounts for more than 80% of sales and includes continuous glucose monitoring sensors, transmitters, self-testing meters and test strips, while its point-of-care line includes electrolyte, blood gas and glycated hemoglobin analyzers for hospitals. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2013.

099220.text: SDN runs a solar division that supplies solar power systems, modules and inverters as integrated solutions, and an engine and shipbuilding division that sells outboard motors as the Korean distributor for HONDA MOTOR. The company says the engine business has ranked first for the past 3 years. Founded in 1994, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2009 and has 6 subsidiaries.

099320.text: Satrec Initiative develops and produces earth observation satellite systems, including small and medium-sized satellites, payloads and components, satellite control software and image processing software. It has two subsidiaries, one selling satellite imagery and one analyzing it. Founded in 1999 to develop satellite systems and related services, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2008.

099390.text: Brainz Company develops IT infrastructure management software, with 4 product lines covering integrated IT infrastructure management, application performance management, integrated log management and IT service management. It is upgrading these products and developing SaaS, cloud monitoring and AI-based analytics services. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

099410.text: Dongbang Ship Machinery makes and sells shipbuilding equipment. Its pipe spool division makes carbon steel and stainless steel pipes, its painting division coats pipes and steel outfitting, and its environmental equipment division makes sewage treatment units and fresh water generators. Founded in 1994, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2009 and is exploring construction, power plant, plant and renewable energy work.

099430.text: BioPlus develops, makes and sells products based on polymer biomaterials, including hyaluronic acid dermal fillers and anti-adhesion agents, bio cosmetics and biopharmaceuticals. It develops medical devices with its own MDM technology and is expanding abroad through overseas units and a large-scale plant. Founded in 2003, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 and has several unlisted subsidiaries.

099440.text: Smec was founded in 1996 to make telecom equipment, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2009 and added machine tools and industrial robots through a 2011 merger. It has a machine tool subsidiary and a parts-making subsidiary. In 2025 it bought a 34.8% stake in a machine tool maker spun off from a large auto parts company, and it says it expects to become second in its industry.

099520.text: Dg-itx makes video surveillance systems, including NVRs, DVRs and IP cameras, and has entered offshore wind power permitting and EPC work. It holds a 40% stake in Hong Fu Technology, an IoT business in China, and a video search software subsidiary that completed liquidation in June 2026. Founded in 1998, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2009.

099750.text: ezCaretech is a healthcare IT company that develops, installs, operates and maintains hospital information systems for clients ranging from tertiary hospitals to small clinics. It was spun off from a university hospital in Seoul in 2001 and remains its affiliate: the company builds the technology while the hospital supplies medical content and clinical knowledge. It listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019.

100030.text: Inzisoft supplies financial software, including digital branch systems based on optical character recognition and electronic form technology, and maintains these systems. Founded in 2000 to develop its own software, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2010. In 2021 it set up a subsidiary that invests in founders and venture companies through investment partnerships.

100090.text: SK oceanplant builds offshore wind substructures, offshore plants and special-purpose vessels, and also makes thick steel pipes and handles shipbuilding and ship repair and conversion. It works with 24 partner companies to improve its supply chain, says it holds more than 40% of the Taiwan market, and is expanding in Japan and Europe. Founded in 1996, it listed on the KOSPI in 2023.

100120.text: Vieworks is a digital imaging company that develops and makes X-ray detectors for medical imaging and ultra-high-resolution industrial cameras used to inspect semiconductors and displays. It invests about 10% of sales in R&D and holds overseas certifications such as CE and FDA. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2009 and has 13 subsidiaries.

100130.text: Dongkuk Structures & Construction makes towers for onshore and offshore wind turbines and builds wind farms. Its customers include VESTAS, SIEMENS GAMESA, GE, ENERCON, NORDEX and a Korean heavy industry company. Founded in 2001, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2009.

100220.text: Visang Education develops education content for students from kindergarten through high school, with publishing, T-learning and other businesses run with 3 affiliates. It has completed authorized textbooks for the curriculum revised in 2022 and is expanding abroad with edtech platforms, including a Korean language learning service and a hybrid classroom system. Founded in 1997, it listed on the KOSPI in 2008.

100250.text: Chinyang Holdings is a holding company with 7 subsidiaries and 4 second-tier subsidiaries whose businesses include polyurethane foam, PVC artificial leather and auto parts. It was formed in 2008 by combining the investment arms of three affiliated companies. As a holding company it aims to focus on core businesses, pursue new businesses and acquisitions, and expand overseas.

100590.text: Mercury makes in-home terminal equipment for Korean telecom operators and also works on TDXAGW, military satellite communication equipment, small switching systems and IoT devices. It is growing as a home IoT device and FTTH solutions provider. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018 and has two subsidiaries.

100660.text: Seoam Machinery Industry makes core components for machine tools and is diversifying into other machinery fields. Founded in 1978 to make machine tool gears, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2011 and belongs to a group of 17 companies. In 2025 it bought 90% stakes in a Japanese company and its Chinese unit, making them subsidiaries.

100700.text: Sewoon Medical makes and sells consumable medical devices such as medical suction units, catheters and IV sets, and says its main product, medical suction units, holds a high share of the Korean market. It is developing higher-value devices and using its manufacturing unit in Vietnam to keep costs down as it expands abroad. Founded in 1969, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2008 and has a domestic sales subsidiary.

100790.text: Mirae Asset Venture Investment is a venture capital firm that invests in startups and venture companies through venture capital funds and private equity funds. Since its founding it has formed 57 venture funds and 8 private equity funds, and it launched two new funds focused on deep-tech patents and AI in China in the first half of 2026. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019 and has 33 unlisted subsidiaries.

100840.text: SNTEnergy designs and makes air coolers, heat recovery steam generators (HRSG), condensers and SCR systems that reduce nitrogen oxides. It has a strategic long-term procurement contract with a Saudi customer, is localizing in the US market and has acquired original HRSG technology. It was created in 2008 through a spin-off and has local units in Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates.

101000.text: KS Industry makes cranes for ships and offshore plants, deck machinery and LPG and LNG tanks, and also sells and repairs ship equipment. As shipbuilding shifts toward higher-value vessels, it is working to localize offshore plant equipment and build eco-friendly ship technology. Founded in 2004, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2009.

101140.text: Inbiogen distributes kiosks and runs a food and beverage business. Its self-payment kiosks are used by restaurants, public agencies, hospitals and unmanned stores to cut labor costs and offer contactless service, while its F&B business develops menus aimed at younger consumers and products using voice recognition and AI. Founded in 2008, it is listed on the KOSPI.

101160.text: Worldex Industry & Trading makes silicon parts, quartz parts and fine ceramics used in semiconductor etching processes. It bought WCQ, a US silicon ingot and quartz company, in 2009 and sells worldwide through overseas sales units. Founded in 2000 to make chips and electronic parts, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2008.

101170.text: Woorim Power Train Solution makes transmissions for construction equipment, aerospace and defense parts and wind power parts, and has also produced steel mill equipment and industrial gearboxes. It is expanding into precision reducers for robots and aerospace and defense gearboxes, and says it is the only Korean company able to design aviation gearboxes. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2009.

101240.text: CQV makes pearlescent pigments and mica products for industrial, automotive and cosmetics uses, including electrical and electronic applications. It is starting a color aluminum business that combines pearlescent pigments with aluminum paste technology, and is building its global sales network and launching new products. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2011.

101330.text: Mobase makes phone cases, automotive electronic parts such as smart keys, BCMs and wireless chargers, and industrial sewing and embroidery machines, supplying Korean electronics and car makers.
