Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017 and has 4 subsidiaries.

219130.text: Tiger Elec makes printed circuit boards, focusing on high-multilayer, fine-pitch rigid PCBs used in the test stage of back-end semiconductor manufacturing. Founded in 2000, it became a subsidiary of another company in 2011 and took its current name. It listed on the KOSDAQ in 2015 and is classified as a mid-sized company.

219420.text: Linkgenesis develops software, focusing on communication software for semiconductor and display equipment and on automated system verification, with products including XComPro/XGemPro and MAT. It has done AI research since 2016 and is diversifying into converged ICT businesses such as smart factories and IoT. Founded in 2003, it expanded through a 2014 acquisition and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018.

219550.text: DYD, founded in 2000 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2015, is a small company in cosmetics and biotech. It sells its own brand, a skincare brand and a vegan brand online, offline and through overseas distributors. In biotech, it is developing a saliva-based glycated albumin test kit for diabetes that uses semiconductor biosensor technology.

219750.text: BTB Korea has a medical device division that makes and sells anti-ageing beauty devices, including the LEBODY brand and ODM products, and a bio division that supplies reagents, kits and consumables to research institutions through global partnerships. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018 and took its current name after absorbing another company in 2024.

220100.text: FutureChem develops, makes and sells radiopharmaceuticals, including diagnostics for Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease and FC303 and FC705 for diagnosing and treating prostate cancer. Working with affiliates including FutureChem U.S.A, it combines drug development, medical device distribution and global clinical trial management. Founded in 2001, it listed on the KONEX in 2015 and moved to the KOSDAQ in 2016 as a technology growth company.

220180.text: Polaris AI Handy is a software company that supplies groupware and collaboration solutions and, through its cloud division, sells Microsoft 365 and Azure. It is moving to SaaS subscription services and developing AI-based work platforms. Founded in 2009, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2016 and belongs to the Polaris group.

220260.text: Chemtros is a chemical materials maker with an advanced and semiconductor materials division and a converged materials division. Its products include electrolyte additives for secondary batteries, semiconductor process materials, display and OLED materials, APIs, pharmaceutical intermediates and polymer adhesives. Founded in 2006, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2015 and has invested in GMP facilities.

221800.text: ZGOO Holdings is a holding company that owns shares in subsidiaries and takes part in and guides their management. It aims to buy companies that generate steady cash flow at reasonable prices and hold them long term to grow value per share. Founded in 2009 under a different name, it listed on the KONEX in 2015, moved to the KOSDAQ in 2023 and became a holding company through a 2026 split.

221840.text: Hizeaero makes aircraft parts, mainly for Boeing models including the B787, B737, B767 and B777, and offers one-stop production covering machining, sheet metal forming, surface treatment and assembly. Founded in 2001 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2015, it added a carbon composite subsidiary in 2021 to strengthen its composites business.

221980.text: Kdchem makes PVC stabilisers, which prevent resin damage during PVC processing, with liquid organic stabilisers as its main product. The company says it holds more than 50% of the Korean market for them. Founded in 1986, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2015 and added a cosmetic ingredients business in 2025.

222040.text: Cosmax NBT researches, makes and sells functional ingredients for health supplements, offering ODM/OEM manufacturing and brand solutions. It has a plant in Korea and local production units in the US and Australia, and it works with about 300 customers in 32 countries. Founded in 2002, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2015.

222080.text: Sfa Nexel makes electrode process equipment for secondary batteries and deposition and inspection equipment for displays, applying smart factory technology from its parent SFA. It is developing a hybrid coater that uses laser drying and an AI-based quality control system. Founded in 2002, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017 and is a mid-sized company.

222110.text: Pangen Biotech uses GMP facilities and its PanGen CHO-TECH technology to produce and sell an EPO biosimilar and to offer contract manufacturing (CMO) and development technology transfer (CDO). Its pipeline includes a Factor VIII haemophilia A treatment in phase 3 trials and an aflibercept treatment for macular degeneration that has completed non-clinical studies. Founded in 2010 through a split, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2016.

222420.text: Cenotec makes composite materials, including secondary battery additives, ceramic beads, flux, ceramic powders and catalyst supports. The company says it was the first in Korea to mass-produce ceramic beads and is the only Korean firm with both wet and dry grinding capability. Founded in 1999, it set up a battery additive division in 2024 and began mass-producing cathode material additives in the first half of 2025.

222800.text: Simmtech makes printed circuit boards for semiconductors and communication devices, mainly module PCBs for memory expansion and package substrates for chip assembly, used in PCs, servers, smart mobile devices and SSDs. It runs 6 plants and an R&D centre in Korea and has production units in China and Japan. It was established in 2015 through a spin-off from its holding company.

222980.text: Mcnulty Korea makes and processes coffee, with a vertically integrated structure that runs from importing green beans to processing. The company says it is the only one in Korea with integrated production lines for roasted bean coffee, instant coffee and liquid coffee drinks. Founded in 1997 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2015, it split off its pharmaceutical business in 2020 and is diversifying through subsidiaries.

223250.text: DreamCIS is a contract research organisation (CRO) providing clinical trials, post-marketing surveillance, clinical quality management, data management and statistical analysis for drugmakers and biotech ventures. Founded in 2000, it was acquired by a Chinese group in 2015 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020. It uses the group's network to join more multinational trials and is expanding into drug and device development services and non-clinical evaluation.

223310.text: Satoshi Holdings mainly sells health supplements online under its own brand and also runs brands in women's underwear and clothing and in semi-permanent makeup and aesthetics. Founded in 2011 to develop and make electronic components, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2015. It expanded into unmanned aerial vehicles and digital asset finance in 2025 and is entering the drone market.

224060.text: The Codi makes electronic components such as high-frequency coils, transformers and SMD inductors for home appliances and electric vehicles, supplying customers including LG Magna and LS Electric. It runs overseas production units in China and Thailand and has 8 unlisted subsidiaries. Founded in 1999 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2015, it absorbed a branch established in 1973 through a merger in 2024.

224110.text: Atec Mobility makes and sells transport hardware, including in-vehicle payment terminals, ticket machines, bus driver terminals and taxi payment terminals. For transit card terminals and automatic fare collection systems it covers hardware, software development and maintenance and provides integrated ITS-based services. It was formed in 2015 when the transit card business of its former parent was spun off, and it was relisted on the KOSDAQ.

225190.text: LK Samyang develops, makes and sells interchangeable camera lenses for photography and video, handling everything from lens design to sales in-house. It sells in about 70 countries and has broadened its range with XEEN and AF lenses. Founded in 2013, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017 and took its current name in 2024.

225220.text: Genolution runs a gene-based molecular diagnostics business, mainly selling nucleic acid extraction reagents and automated extraction instruments, and an RNAi-based green bio business. In green bio it developed a gene therapy for sacbrood disease in honeybees, which it says is the world's first, and won animal drug approval for it in 2024. Founded in 2006, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020 as a technology growth company.

225430.text: KM Pharmaceutical makes and sells household products in oral care (toothpaste, toothbrushes and mouthwash), beauty care (shampoo, body wash and cosmetics) and other categories, including character-licensed goods, its own brands and OEM/ODM products. It sells through Korean offline and online channels and is adding export markets through overseas online platforms. Founded in 2001, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018.

225530.text: HC BoKwang Industry is a construction materials company based in Daegu and the surrounding region, with aggregate, asphalt concrete and ready-mixed concrete divisions. It produces KS-certified aggregate at a large quarry complex and supplies GR-certified recycled asphalt concrete, and it says it is the only producer of recycled asphalt concrete in Daegu. It was founded in 2004.

225570.text: Nexon Games develops online and mobile game software, running titles including V4, Blue Archive and HIT2 in Korea and overseas. Founded in 2013, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017 through a merger with a special purpose acquisition company and completed a merger with a group affiliate in 2022 that strengthened its FPS game operations. It belongs to the Nexon business group.

225590.text: Fashion Platform makes and sells women's clothing and owns 5 brands, which it sells through offline channels such as department stores, outlets and agency stores. Founded in 2009, it listed on the KOSDAQ through a merger in 2018. It has one consolidated subsidiary.

226320.text: IT'S Hanbul makes and sells cosmetics under several brands. It was founded in 1989, and its current name dates from 2017, when a unit that had listed in 2015 merged with its parent. Its main subsidiary is a KOSDAQ-listed company founded in 2000 that runs functional cosmetics brands.

226330.text: Synteka Bio develops an AI drug discovery platform built on 3D protein structure and genomic big data processing, offering it as a service while also developing its own drug pipeline. Founded in 2009, it became a research institute company in 2014 after receiving ETRI's supercomputing technology for genetic testing as an investment in kind. It listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019.

226340.text: Bonne is a cosmetics ODM company without its own manufacturing facilities: it develops products in-house and supplies them to manufacturers, and it also runs its own brands. Its customers include overseas brand owners in the US, Europe and China, and it focuses on responding quickly to changing trends. Founded in 2009, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018.

226400.text: Osteonic develops, makes and sells orthopaedic implants for joining, replacing and adjusting most bones other than the spine and hip joint. It signed a skull fixation device agreement with the Korean unit of a German company in 2017 and an exclusive Neuro system contract with that company's German headquarters in 2018. Founded in 2012, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018.

226590.text: Mdevice is an SSD company that handles design, manufacturing, assembly and testing, and sales and distribution of SSDs combining memory and system semiconductors, with enterprise, consumer and BGA SSD businesses. It is focusing on data centres and has set up an ICT strategy division to enter next-generation ICT infrastructure and AVP. Founded in 2009, it listed on the KOSPI in 2025.

226950.text: OliX Pharmaceuticals develops drugs for hard-to-treat diseases using its own OASIS RNA interference platform and earns revenue by transferring RNAi technology and drug candidates to pharmaceutical companies. It runs a global R&D network through subsidiaries OliX US, Inc. and OliX AU PTY LTD. Founded in 2010, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018 as a technology growth company.

227610.text: Outin Futures is a cosmetics ODM and own-brand company covering everything from product planning to production, with brands including NEOGEN DERMALOGY and Sur.Medic+. It says its designs have won 7 awards at the world's three major design competitions. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017 and has 4 unlisted subsidiaries.

227840.text: Hyundai Corporation Holdings has two divisions: a brand division covering brand royalties and third-country trade, and a new business division covering livestock product wholesale and packaging and mushroom production. Founded in 2015 and listed on the KOSPI the same year, it has 13 unlisted subsidiaries, including Hyundai Corporation, whose global network it draws on.

227950.text: N2tech makes and sells vacuum chambers and special vacuum valves used in semiconductor processes. It provides related services from its Korean headquarters, while overseas subsidiaries repair products supplied to tier-1 vendors, and it also runs an investment business through a subsidiary. Founded in 1992, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018 through a merger with a special purpose acquisition company.

228340.text: Tongyang Pile makes and sells concrete piles, including PHC piles, a foundation material that raises ground bearing capacity to keep structures stable and is used in housing on soft ground and in large projects. It runs a network of three plants across Korea. Founded in 2013, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2016.

228670.text: Ray makes dental medical devices and software, offering digital diagnostic systems such as dental X-ray, CBCT and 3D facial scanners along with 3D printers and milling machines, and it says it has Korea's only full line-up of digital imaging systems. Founded in 2004 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019, it has sales bases in 13 countries, including the US, Japan and China, and 17 unlisted subsidiaries.

228760.text: Genomictree specialises in molecular diagnostics for cancer, commercialising early-detection products based on biomarker in vitro diagnostic technology. Its main colorectal cancer test won Korean regulatory approval and launched in 2018, and it is rolling out tests for bladder, prostate and lung cancer. Founded in 2000 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019, it has a US subsidiary and is preparing overseas expansion, including a technology transfer in China and US FDA breakthrough device designation.

228850.text: Rayence makes X-ray detectors for medical equipment, with a full line of detectors for medical, dental, veterinary and industrial use and TFT and CMOS detector technology. It was established in 2011 when another company's DR division was split off. Its consolidated subsidiaries include two in Korea, MyVet Imaging and Qpix Solutions in the US, and OSKO MEX in Mexico.

229000.text: Gencurix develops molecular diagnostic tests based on liquid biopsy and biomarker discovery, including a breast cancer prognosis test it says was Asia's first, a digital PCR-based companion diagnostic, and early-detection tests for liver and colorectal cancer under development. Founded in 2011, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020. It has taken a stake in a developer of CTC isolation and analysis equipment to work on products for mass production.

229640.text: LS Eco Energy is a holding company for foreign businesses, set up in 2015 by acquiring stakes in Vietnamese units from an affiliate. Its main subsidiaries are LS-VINA Cable & System and LS Cable & System Vietnam, and the company says LS-VINA holds the largest share of Vietnam's power cable market. It is responding to AI data centre demand and bringing rare earth refining technology in-house.

230240.text: HFR supplies optical transport, fronthaul and DAS equipment in its mobile access division and FTTx, switches and WiFi access points in its broadband access division. It is expanding with the spread of O-RAN and working on AI-RAN technology and an open 6G AI network ecosystem. Founded in 2000 to develop telecom equipment, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018.

232140.text: YC makes and sells automatic test equipment (ATE) that checks DRAM and NAND memory devices at the wafer stage for defects and repairs faulty memory cells. It was founded in 1991, acquired the memory tester business of Japan's Yokogawa Test Solution in 2012 and took its current name in 2024. It has 5 consolidated subsidiaries.

232680.text: Raon Robotics makes robots and automation systems for manufacturing, mainly vacuum robots and EFEMs for moving semiconductor wafers, FPD glass transfer robots, and packaging and inspection automation for pharma and bio. Its independently controlled 4-arm vacuum robot is supplied to major Korean chipmakers, and it is developing a linear vacuum robot while keeping its R&D investment ratio at 10%. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

232830.text: Itcenpns provides security platforms and services, including IT security, fintech security, biometric authentication and e-signature solutions, digital financial services and consulting, and it is developing security solutions based on AI and post-quantum cryptography. Founded in 2011, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023. Its subsidiaries run cloud infrastructure and system and network integration businesses.

234030.text: Synic Solution provides system semiconductor design and foundry services, supplying design solutions to fabless companies as an official foundry sales agent and design solution partner of SK HYNIX SYSTEM IC. It works with several foundry partners and also develops and mass-produces ASICs, sells ASSPs and acts as a sales agent for finished products. Founded in 2005, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

234080.text: JW Lifescience makes and sells prescription intravenous fluids, including 3-chamber nutritional fluids. The company says it leads the basic IV fluid market with a 42.9% share and the nutritional fluid market with 48.5%. Founded in 1994, it listed on the KOSPI in 2016, has an exclusive licensing and export deal with a US company, and says its TPN plant was Asia's first to gain EU-GMP certification.

234100.text: Sewon makes and sells automotive air-conditioning parts and supplies global tier-1 parts makers, with parts for combustion-engine cars, EVs and robotaxis. Its business spans 4 segments: auto air-conditioning parts, synthetic yarn and chemicals, F&C and AI convergence, and software platforms. Founded in 1992, it has three main subsidiaries.

234300.text: STraffic is a transport systems integration company working in roads, including toll collection and Hi-Pass systems, and in railways, including signalling and communications, covering software, hardware, integration and maintenance. It began building and running the transit card system for Seoul's urban railways in 2017 and is expanding overseas, including in the US. Founded in 2013, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017 and has 4 subsidiaries.

234340.text: Hecto Financial is a fintech company providing electronic finance and payment platforms; starting from virtual account relay and firm banking services, it moved into online payments and grew into a full electronic payment company. Founded in 2000 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019, it has 7 unlisted subsidiaries. It launched a cross-border foreign currency settlement service in 2023 and is preparing digital asset-based payment and settlement infrastructure.

234690.text: GC WellBeing, founded in 2004, runs a non-reimbursed prescription drug business built on its placenta injection product, launched in 2005, and is expanding into medical aesthetics. The company says it holds about 80% of Korea's placenta injection market. Drawing on its skills in handling and purifying human-derived materials and in GMP quality control, it is adding ECM, filler and botulinum toxin products.

234920.text: Zaigle runs wellness home appliance, healthcare, restaurant and food distribution businesses. Under its own brand it develops and sells grills, kitchen and home appliances, medical appliances, healthcare products and camping gear, and it says its grill was the world's first infrared heating cooker. Founded in 2008, it has also developed oxygen and high-frequency medical devices under a second brand.

235980.text: MedPacto is a biotech company that uses genome analysis technologies such as next-generation sequencing, array sequencing and bioinformatics to find drug targets and develop new drugs for hard-to-treat cancers and chronic diseases, aiming at personalised therapies. It was set up in 2013 when a drug research institute became independent from another company. It listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019 as a technology growth company.

236200.text: Suprema specialises in biometrics-based access security, with integrated security systems and biometric solutions that supply access control and time-and-attendance systems using face and fingerprint recognition. It is adding AI-based face recognition, cloud services and an AI integrated security platform. It was established in 2015 through a spin-off from its former holding company and runs 7 overseas units, including in the US, Japan and the UK.

236810.text: NBT runs reward-based mobile point platforms, including a B2B offerwall business and several B2C app-tech services. The company says its offerwall network, built through partnerships with major Korean internet platforms, is the largest in Korea, and it is expanding into the US, Thailand and Taiwan. Founded in 2012, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 as a technology growth company.

237690.text: ST Pharm mainly sells active pharmaceutical ingredients for new and generic drugs and runs CDMO businesses for oligonucleotide therapeutics, small-molecule drugs and mRNA. Founded in 2008 under a different name, it took its current name after a 2010 merger and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2016. After joining a business group, it expanded from small-molecule CDMO work into oligonucleotide CDMO.

237750.text: PNC Technologies is a power IT company that develops and makes digital power equipment for distribution networks, including distribution automation terminals, digital protective relays and remote monitoring and control systems, which it supplies to related agencies. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2016. In 2026 it merged with two companies, acquired a 98.4% stake in another and set up a new subsidiary.

237820.text: PlayD is a digital-based full-service advertising agency. It has set up an AI unit, the AX Unit, to build AI into marketing, media and creative work, and uses tools including techHUB for integrated marketing. Founded in 2010 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020, it strengthened its creative capabilities through an acquisition in 2025 and moved its commerce business to a newly established company.

237880.text: CLIO Cosmetics is a cosmetics company built around its colour cosmetics brands, with skincare, haircare and health supplement brands as well. Founded in 1997, it traces its roots to a trading company established in 1993 that it says launched Korea's first colour cosmetics brand. It listed on the KOSDAQ in 2016 and set up a subsidiary in 2020 to expand into inner beauty.

238090.text: Ndfos makes industrial tapes and building and vehicle films, selling the films under its own brand. Its industrial tapes give global manufacturers waterproof, dustproof and shock-resistant materials, and it joins their new product planning early to provide custom adhesive solutions. Founded in 2010, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2016.

238120.text: Aligned Genetics develops and makes advanced instruments and reagents for life science research and diagnostics and sells them worldwide. Built on combined bio, optical, electrical, electronic and software technologies, its main products are automated cell counting systems, tissue clearing and imaging systems, and digital cell imaging systems. Founded in 2008 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2016, it runs sales units in the US, Europe and Japan.

238200.text: Bifido makes and sells probiotic raw powders and health supplements based on bifidobacteria found in the intestines of Korean infants, runs its own brand and offers ODM services. It holds proprietary patented strains with US FDA NDI and GRAS status and is developing recombinant live biotherapeutics on its BiGeX platform. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018.

238490.text: Hims makes equipment and parts for flat panel displays such as OLED, and is developing split metal mask equipment for mobile OLED organic deposition for global panel makers. It also sells mask process equipment such as incoming stick inspectors and mask tensioners to Korean display makers. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017.

239340.text: ESTaid runs a PC and mobile web portal and has expanded into a global interactive content platform and an AI profile app. Founded in 2009, it merged with another company in 2011, completed a merger with a special purpose acquisition company in 2019 and took its current name in 2024 to diversify. It owns an asset management company as a subsidiary.

239610.text: Hlscience is a technology platform company focused on research into new bio-healthcare materials, with a CDMO business for individually approved health supplement ingredients, natural product drug R&D and a microbiome business. It says it was the first in Korea to offer CDMO for such ingredients, and it provides CDO, CRO and CMO as a one-stop service. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2016.

239890.text: P&H Tech is a small company making organic electronic materials, including OLED materials and the catalysts and raw materials used to synthesise them. It develops patented OLED materials, works on joint development and mass production, and supplies red prime, red host and long-life blue host materials. Founded in 2009 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021, it developed a high-refractive CPL material in 2018 and has supplied it in volume since 2021.

240550.text: DongBang Medical makes traditional Korean medicine devices and aesthetic medical devices. The company says it holds the top share of the Korean market for disposable acupuncture needles and cupping cups, and it also makes hyaluronic acid-based dermal fillers, cannulas and needles. Founded in 2014, it exports under its own brands to about 50 countries across Asia, North America, South America and Europe.

240600.text: Yujin Technology makes precision moulds, process machine parts, automation equipment and lead tabs for secondary battery manufacturing, with major Korean battery makers as its main customers. It designs and makes notching dies for EV batteries and says it achieves ultra-precision machining at the ±0.001mm level. Founded in 2010, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

240810.text: Wonik IPS makes and sells core equipment for semiconductor and display manufacturing, mainly deposition and heat treatment tools. Its CVD, ALD and metal deposition systems are used in key DRAM, NAND and logic processes, and it is working to localise low-temperature PECVD. It was established in 2016 when the semiconductor, display and solar cell equipment businesses of its holding company were spun off.

241520.text: DSC Investment is a venture capital firm that forms venture investment funds to invest mainly in early-stage startups and small and medium-sized venture companies, and it manages 17 funds. Founded in 2012, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2016. It owns a startup accelerator that runs 24 venture and individual investment funds.

241560.text: Doosan Bobcat, founded in 2014 and listed in 2016, is a holding company for foreign businesses with 25 subsidiaries, including in North America. It produces compact equipment, portable power and material handling products as well as hydraulic parts for construction machinery. It is developing hydraulic components that combine electrification and smart technology and is diversifying into agriculture and landscaping.

241590.text: Hwaseung Enterprise makes footwear for a brand customer on an ODM basis, a segment that accounts for 99.5% of sales and that runs joint research with that customer. Its other segment handles intermediary trade and logistics in Southeast Asia. Founded in 2015 and listed in 2016, it is a mid-sized company with 24 subsidiaries in countries including Vietnam, Indonesia, China and India.

241690.text: Unitekno makes auto and ESS parts using high-performance engineering plastic injection moulding, including battery cell cases, powertrain plastic parts, motor assemblies and ESS battery cell end plates. Its customers include battery makers, and it holds SQ certification as a second-tier supplier to Korean carmakers. Founded in 2000 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2016, it has 3 subsidiaries in China and Mexico.

241710.text: Cosmecca Korea is a cosmetics ODM/OEM company focused on skincare products for a range of brand customers, and it offers its own global total service called OGM. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2016 and secured a global production base through an acquisition in 2018. Research and development staff make up about 40% of its workforce.

241770.text: Mecaro mainly produces metal heater blocks and says it holds more than 90% of the Korean market, measured by sales to the country's two major chipmakers. Founded in 2000 to localise semiconductor materials, parts and equipment, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017. It has energy and bio subsidiaries, and in 2026 it acquired 100% of another company to gain back-end semiconductor technology and production capacity.

241790.text: Temc CNS makes HCDS and TiCl4 precursors and specialty gases in its chemical materials division, and central chemical supply systems and secondary battery electrolyte supply systems in its equipment division. It develops optimised products with semiconductor device makers and is working to localise materials and grow its share of the supply system market. Founded in 2012 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2016, it has two subsidiaries.

241820.text: PCL develops and makes in vitro diagnostic devices for immunodiagnostics, using its SG Cap technology based on 3D sol-gel reactions to detect multiple viruses, and it is expanding into diagnosis of diseases such as dementia and cancer. It has shown an AI-based POCT device at CES and aims to supply medical devices for the home healthcare market. Founded in 2008, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017.

241840.text: Astory plans and produces content and supplies it to broadcasters, OTT services and overseas markets. Through a subsidiary it runs an actor management business and side businesses that use its intellectual property. Founded in 2004 to produce broadcast programmes, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019.

242040.text: Namu AX specialises in virtualisation and cloud, building VDI-based network separation and smart work systems and cloud-native platforms for companies and public agencies with its own Cocktail Cloud and SPERO solutions. It supports AI environments with Namu AI Agent and offers integrated solutions linking virtualisation, cloud and AI-based automation. Founded in 2001, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018.

243070.text: Huons makes and sells sterile drugs, mainly injections and eye drops, supplying lidocaine local anaesthetics, hyaluronic acid eye drops and vitamin injections to hospitals, clinics and pharmacies. It was established in 2016 through a spin-off from its holding company and has merged with a wholly owned subsidiary. Its subsidiaries run a health supplement OEM/ODM business and an EPO biosimilar production and CMO business.

243840.text: Shin Heung Energy & Electronics makes safety-related parts for lithium-ion secondary batteries used in small devices, EVs and ESS, such as prismatic cap assemblies and cylindrical CIDs. It has 3 sites in Korea and 5 subsidiaries in Malaysia, China, Hungary and the US, and it says it ranks first with its main customers in small cylindrical and mid-to-large prismatic parts. Founded in 1979, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017.

244460.text: Olipass is a biotech company developing RNA therapeutics on its OliPass PNA platform, with core exon skipping technology that removes specific exons to control protein production. It is researching treatments including non-narcotic painkillers and pursuing global markets through technology exports and joint research with partners. Founded in 2006, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019 and has a subsidiary set up to commercialise its technology.

244920.text: A Plus Asset Advisor is an independent insurance agency that works with 34 Korean life and non-life insurers, analysing products from the customer's point of view to offer insurance and financial services. Founded in 2007, it listed on the KOSPI in 2020. Its consolidated subsidiaries work in bio equipment, funeral services, real estate services and loan sales.

245620.text: Eone Diagnomics Genome Center is a genome big data company set up in 2013 as a joint venture between a medical foundation and Diagnomics. It expanded into in vitro diagnostic reagents and equipment through a 2020 merger and built a personalised health supplement platform by acquiring Canadian supplement maker NLN in 2021. Its services include non-invasive prenatal testing, NGS-based liquid biopsy and direct-to-consumer genetic ancestry analysis.

246250.text: SLS Bio works in drug quality control, drug development support and in vitro diagnostics, and as a regulator-designated drug quality testing body it offers about 300 test services. It also provides efficacy evaluation of drug candidates and non-clinical testing, and has developed a rapid allergy diagnostic kit. Founded in 2007 for drug development and quality testing, it moved from the KONEX to the KOSDAQ in 2023.

246690.text: T.S.Investment is a venture capital firm that invests in startups and venture companies, forms and manages venture investment funds under Korea's venture investment law, and invests in companies undergoing restructuring. It raises money from a range of investors to form funds and earns returns by investing in and exiting small and venture companies. Founded in 2008, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2016 and has 5 unlisted subsidiaries.

246710.text: T&R Biofab works in tissue engineering and regenerative medicine and has developed its own 3D bioprinting system based on ECM manufacturing technology. It supplies bio-surgical products such as bio-inks, biodegradable scaffolds, ADM and wound dressings, and is diversifying into freeze-dried ball capsule cosmetics. Founded in 2013 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018, it has 2 subsidiaries.

246720.text: ASTA develops, makes and sells MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry instruments and related consumables, including medical instruments for microbial diagnosis backed by a database of about 5,000 bacterial species and industrial products for uses such as displays. It is building cloud platform businesses for medical and industrial use and pursuing Middle East sales through a joint venture in Saudi Arabia, as well as technology licensing. It was founded in 2006.

246960.text: SCL Science leads the data-based precision medicine business of the SCL group, working in bio logistics, medical DX and clinical trial sample analysis. It makes and sells external and internal haemostatic agents, provides genetic testing services, and is developing an AI-based personalised cancer vaccine platform through a subsidiary. Founded in 2010, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019.

247540.text: Ecopro BM makes and sells cathode materials for secondary batteries, mainly high-nickel NCA and NCM cathode active materials with nickel content of 80% or more, used in EVs, power tools and ESS. It says it can serve all battery types and works with battery-material affiliates to expand its value chain. It was established in 2016 when its parent's secondary battery materials business was split off, and it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019.

247660.text: Nanocms is a small company with core technology in light-control materials designed through nano-based chemical structures. It develops anti-counterfeiting security materials and specialty IT materials, producing taggants such as near-infrared absorbing and reflecting materials and ultraviolet organic fluorescent materials. Founded in 2003, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 and has built SiC processing facilities for next-generation power semiconductors.

248070.text: Solum makes and sells electronic components, with an electronic components division covering power modules and 3-in-1 boards and an ICT division covering ESL and IoT. Its components business relies mainly on integrated TV modules while growing power solutions for servers, vehicle electronics and EV chargers. Founded in 2015, it listed on the KOSPI in 2021 and has 35 overseas subsidiaries in countries including China, Vietnam, Mexico and India.

248170.text: Sempio Foods is a mid-sized food company that makes and sells traditional fermented sauces such as soy sauce, soybean paste and red pepper paste, along with other fermentation-based products and a range of food and beverage brands. Its domestic and overseas sales split roughly 9:1, and its sales are divided about evenly between sauces and other products. It was spun off from its predecessor in 2016 and relisted on the KOSPI the same year.

249420.text: IL Dong Pharmaceutical, founded in 2016, makes and sells drugs such as active vitamins and antibiotics, and also works in drug ingredients, health supplements and special nutrition foods, selling through wholesalers, retailers, clinics and hospitals. It is developing treatments for gastroesophageal reflux, metabolic and respiratory diseases. It is also widening global approvals for a coronavirus treatment and has a P-CAB drug in phase 3 trials.

250000.text: Boratr is a food distributor, founded in 2015, whose subsidiaries import and trade alcoholic beverages and distribute food ingredients. It sources imported processed foods such as pasta, olive oil and tomato sauce, supplying about 720 items from about 90 foreign manufacturers to about 1,900 Korean business customers through B2C and B2B channels. Building on Italian ingredients, it is adding confectionery, Southeast Asian ingredients and dairy products.

250060.text: Mobiis develops control software and electronic equipment for large basic science facilities, supplying precision accelerator control systems, fusion power plant control systems, smart factory solutions and a machine learning platform. It says it is the only Korean company with EPICS-based ultra-precision control technology, and it works on a fourth-generation synchrotron light source and the international fusion experimental reactor project. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017.

250930.text: YeSUN Tech makes functional adhesive materials such as foam pads and bonding tape, mainly for mid-to-large LCD TVs and monitors, and is diversifying into OLED TVs, mobile phones, cars and secondary batteries. It is pursuing global markets through joint development of cutting equipment for OLED panels with a chemical company and development of a battery flame barrier. Founded in 2005, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019.

251120.text: Bio-fd&C is a biotech company built on plant cell platform technology, researching and making plant cell-derived active ingredients for cosmeceuticals, health supplements and drugs, as well as biopharmaceuticals. It uses its SMART-RC² mass culture technology to produce recombinant growth factors and phytopeptides, supplying global customers including a Swiss company. Founded in 2005, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

251270.text: Netmarble develops and publishes mobile games, with a lineup that includes MARVEL Contest of Champions and Jackpot World. It was established in 2011 through a split from a media company and merged with an affiliate in 2014. It has 5 domestic subsidiaries and 3 overseas subsidiaries, including Jam City and Kabam.

251370.text: YMT develops, makes and sells gold and copper plating chemicals used in electronic component manufacturing, which reach products such as smartphones through global PCB makers. It entered the market with its own technology, developed Soft ENIG, and is expanding into chemicals for electronic materials and semiconductor packages. Founded in 1999 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017, it has overseas sales units and 7 subsidiaries.

251630.text: V-one Tech makes inspection equipment based on machine vision and image processing, supplying LCD/OLED indentation inspection equipment to display customers in Korea and abroad. Its main businesses also include secondary battery inspection systems and autonomous mobile robots for smart factories, and it has developed a deep learning platform called With AI. Founded in 2006, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017.

251970.text: Pum-tech Korea makes and sells cosmetic containers, including pumps, jars, tubes, compacts, droppers and sticks, and is extending its range into household goods. Founded in 2001 to make pump-based plastic containers, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019. It entered health supplements in 2021 by buying 60% of a supplement seller and acquired a further 20% in 2025.

252500.text: Sewha P&C researches, makes and distributes hair and body care products and hair dyes, running brands such as moremo and RICHENNA for consumers of different ages. Moremo is sold mainly through a health and beauty store chain, online and overseas channels, while RICHENNA is established in home shopping. The company manages new brands closely from R&D to marketing.

252990.text: Semcns makes ceramic parts for semiconductor testing, producing ceramic STFs for probe cards, which support MEMS pins and carry electrical signals used to judge whether wafers pass or fail. It develops everything from materials to finished products in-house and is exploring new businesses such as advanced packaging and 5G/6G communication modules. Founded in 2016, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

253450.text: Studio Dragon plans and produces drama content and supplies it to broadcasters, media platforms and overseas markets. Its revenue comes from drama sales, broadcast scheduling and other sources such as product placement, DVDs, soundtracks, merchandise and management. It was set up in 2016 when a media company's drama division was split off, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017 and has 9 unlisted subsidiaries.

253590.text: Neosem makes back-end semiconductor test equipment, mainly SSD testers and MBT equipment, and also runs distribution businesses with foreign companies. It develops and supplies test equipment for high-performance products such as DDR5, high-layer NAND and PCIe Gen5 and Gen6 SSDs. Founded in 2002 to make chip test equipment, it went through a merger in 2019.

253840.text: Sugentech researches, makes and sells in vitro diagnostic devices and reagents, with multiplex immunoblot, point-of-care testing (POCT), digital healthcare and health and beauty businesses built on combined bio, nano, IT and AI technologies. It says it is the only Korean company developing and making both the platform and reagents for multiplex immunoblots, and it has more than 120 allergy and autoimmune tests. Founded in 2011, it moved its listing to the KOSDAQ in 2019.

254120.text: Xavis makes X-ray inspection equipment, using X-ray technology, machine vision and factory automation software to inspect secondary batteries, semiconductors, food and industrial parts for internal defects without damaging them. It is also developing new businesses such as explosives detection equipment and a low-dose radiation medical device for treating dementia. Founded in 2002, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019.

254490.text: Mirai Semiconductors distributes semiconductors as a registered agent for a major Korean electronics company, buying 99% of its goods from that company. Its main products are memory chips, system semiconductors and displays, some supplied in foundry form, for industries such as EVs, autonomous driving, IoT, 5G and AI. Founded in 1996 by semiconductor specialists, it says it runs the world's only after-sales centre for that company's memory chips.

255220.text: SG makes and sells asphalt concrete and also works in pavement construction and installing air pollutant reduction equipment. Through its 9 subsidiaries it runs real estate development, environmental plant equipment and paving businesses, and it has specialised in environmental equipment for asphalt plants since acquiring an environmental plant builder in 2019. Founded in 2009, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018.

255440.text: YAS sells equipment for making OLED display panels, with main products including in-line systems for OLED TVs and OLED lighting. It says it is the only company in the world that has mass-produced evaporators for 8th-generation and larger substrates, and it supplies equipment with high material usage efficiency to major manufacturers. Founded in 2002 to make vacuum and semiconductor equipment, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017.

256150.text: Handok Clean Tech is a small company that makes carbon block filters for water purifiers and supplies them to major Korean water purifier makers. Building on this technology it has entered the air filter market, developing car air-conditioning filters under its own brands PURUME and ZERO ON and pursuing overseas markets. Founded in 2003, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019.

256630.text: Point Engineering is a surface treatment company whose aluminium anodising technology underpins its semiconductor equipment parts, Pin Foundry and display equipment parts businesses. Its consolidated subsidiaries repair semiconductor equipment and supply DC power supplies and pulse generators. Founded in 1998, it listed on the KOSDAQ through a merger in 2019.

256840.text: BNC Korea is a bio-healthcare company that researches, makes, sells and distributes medical devices, drugs and cosmetics, including HA-based dermal fillers, botulinum toxin, collagen tissue fillers and derma cosmetics. It has a drug GMP production facility in Sejong as a base for entering the prescription drug market and is researching diabetes and obesity treatments. Founded in 2007, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019.

256940.text: Keeps Biopharma runs pharma and bio, waste battery recycling and OLED businesses, with the pharma side making and selling prescription drugs and developing an oral peptide drug delivery platform and cancer treatments. Founded in 2000 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017, it completed its shift into pharma and bio by absorbing a drugmaker in the first half of 2025. A main subsidiary has taken a stake in another company, now a second-tier subsidiary.

257370.text: People & Technology Ms makes production equipment for high-performance PE wet separators used in lithium-ion batteries, covering design through commissioning for the whole process, from feeding PE powder and paraffin oil to extrusion, forming, stretching and extraction. It says it is the only Korean company able to build full separator lines, and it is developing separator coaters that improve heat resistance and battery safety. Founded in 2001, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018.

257720.text: Silicon 2 is a global K-Beauty distribution platform, selling to consumers in about 175 countries through its own e-commerce site StyleKorean.com and exporting wholesale to global distributors and retailers. It has 16 subsidiaries and recently set up new units in Spain and Portugal to expand in Europe. Founded in 2002, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

258610.text: Caelum runs plant equipment and aircraft parts businesses; its plant equipment division makes geothermal power equipment such as hot-water vaporisers, condensers and piping, and chemical and LNG equipment such as heat exchangers, pressure vessels and towers. Founded in 2009 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017, it merged with a former subsidiary in March 2026 and remained the surviving company. It has one unlisted subsidiary.

258790.text: Softcamp is an information security company specialising in document security, with Document Centric Security and Zero Trust Security solutions as its main products. It sells mainly to major Korean conglomerates and financial holding companies and offers the Security365 cloud security service. Founded in 2016, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017.

258830.text: Sejong Medical makes and assembles medical devices, specialising in laparoscopic surgery instruments such as disposable trocars, specimen retrieval bags and disposable single-port access devices in a range of sizes and models. Founded in 2010, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018. In 2026 one subsidiary was declared bankrupt and another was liquidated and removed from its consolidated group.

259630.text: mPlus is a mid-sized company whose single business is assembly process equipment for pouch-type and prismatic lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles. The company says it is the only one in the world that can build the entire assembly process on a turnkey basis, and it is growing as a battery-maker customer expands its overseas plants. Founded in 2003 to build automation equipment, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017.

259960.text: Krafton develops and publishes games, serving players in more than 200 countries through its flagship global game IP, and runs game and advertising segments. It is diversifying through investments, including in Japan's ADK group, an advertising company, in October 2025 and in an ad-tech company in July 2025. Founded in 2007, it listed on the KOSPI in 2021.

260660.text: Korea Arlico Pharm makes and sells pharmaceuticals, with businesses in domestic drug sales, CMO, exports, medical device manufacturing and sales, and the development and sale of health supplements and cosmetics. Founded in 1992, it moved its production facilities in 2001, remodelled its C-GMP facilities in 2008 and built a KGSP logistics warehouse in 2017. It listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018.

260930.text: CTK is a cosmetics ODM company offering full turnkey services from product planning to logistics and distribution, and it shares global beauty trend and market information through CTKCLIP. Its subsidiaries handle brand strategy and design, produce OTC products in the US and provide 3PL fulfilment and retail services in North America. Founded in 2001, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017 and has 10 unlisted subsidiaries.

260970.text: S&D develops, makes and sells natural functional food ingredients, such as grill concentrates and cheese powders, and natural product-based health supplement ingredients. Its supplement ingredients include seaweed and rice bran extracts used as sleep aids and a chrysanthemum and seaweed extract complex used for respiratory health. Founded in 1998, it listed on the KONEX in 2016 and moved to the KOSDAQ in 2021.

261200.text: Dentis makes dental medical devices, with dental implants as its main product alongside medical lighting, dental 3D printers and bio products. It sells directly in Korea and through dealers and local subsidiaries overseas, and invests more than 6% of sales in R&D each year. Founded in 2005, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020 and set up a new factory in 2024.

261520.text: EGIS develops 3D GIS and digital twin technology, offering spatial data publishing and information services along with software development and systems integration. Its core digital earth technology is being built into a platform that collects and analyses data on cities, infrastructure and the environment in real time. Founded in 2001, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025 as a technology growth company.

261780.text: Aribiolab is a biotech company that uses its own immune-enhancing platform technology to develop vaccines and immunotherapies. Its hepatitis B treatment and prevention vaccine and a shingles vaccine are in clinical stages, and it is adding cancer vaccines, immuno-oncology drugs and animal cancer treatments to its pipeline. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021, and its largest shareholder changed in 2026.

262260.text: APRO makes formation equipment for lithium-ion secondary batteries, drawing on power conversion (SMPS) and inverter technology. Its main products are chargers-dischargers and high-temperature pressure chargers-dischargers, and it develops the full range of equipment for the battery formation process. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020, has 7 subsidiaries and runs overseas units in China, Poland, the United States and Canada.

262840.text: Iquest is a B2B software company whose main products are a subscription ERP service and SAP B1 ERP, an installed ERP system. It is pursuing fintech expansion by applying AI, big data and blockchain and by registering for electronic finance business. Founded in 1996, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 and owns an IT consulting subsidiary.

263020.text: DK&D was founded in 2000 to make synthetic leather and distribute related goods, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018. Its Vietnamese subsidiary DK VINA makes needle-punched nonwoven fabric, a key material for sports shoes, while Shanghai DK&D distributes nonwoven and synthetic leather materials in China. An 80%-owned subsidiary makes sports caps on an OEM/ODM basis at a factory in Bangladesh.

263050.text: Eutilex is a biotech company researching cell and gene therapies such as CAR-T along with antibody treatments. Its pipeline includes EU307, a fourth-generation CAR-T therapy targeting solid tumours, and the antibody treatments EU103 and EU101. Founded in 2015, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018, has 3 subsidiaries and has added an IT division.

263600.text: Derkwoo Electronics makes precision parts for mobile camera modules, such as stiffeners and brackets, and electrical parts for cars. It has auto parts plants in China, Poland and Mexico, a plant completed in 2023 that makes secondary battery and automotive electrical parts, and subsidiaries making MEMS-based sensors and chip equipment parts. Founded in 1992, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017.

263690.text: Drgem develops, makes and sells X-ray imaging systems that hospitals and clinics use to diagnose patients. Its products include digital X-ray systems, analog-to-digital upgrade systems, generators, tubes and imaging software. Founded in 2003, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018 and has the subsidiaries DRGEM America Inc. and Weihai Drgem Medical Equipment Company Limited.

263700.text: Carelabs is a digital healthcare company built around mobile healthcare and beauty-care platforms, combined with digital advertising and CRM software for medical institutions. Its platforms cover hospital search and telemedicine, cosmetic medical information, job listings for medical staff and care workers, and a service for cancer patients. Founded in 2012, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018 and has three subsidiaries.

263720.text: D&C Media was founded in 2012 as a book publisher and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017. It owns a webtoon production studio and an animation planning and production company as subsidiaries. In April 2025 it decided to halt operations at two other subsidiaries, a Korea-Japan content joint venture and a short-form content producer, to improve efficiency and profitability.

263750.text: PearlAbyss was founded in 2010 to develop and sell online games and software, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017. It develops game software and runs game services, distributing its games both through its own publishing and through regional publishers.

263770.text: UST makes and sells stainless steel pipes, supplying piping materials to construction, shipbuilding, offshore plants, petrochemicals, semiconductors and biotech. It runs 3 plants producing piping products, high-purity clean tubes and precision tubes, and serves regional customers through 5 sales offices nationwide. It was spun off from its former parent in 2009 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017.

263800.text: Datasolution is a data company running Data & AI and AI service businesses, and it is also active in the IBCM market. It covers the full data process, including AI/ML modelling, software development and sales, and building data pipelines. It was spun off from its former parent in 2011 and merged with the former Datasolution in 2016.

263810.text: Sangshin Electronics specialises in EMI filters, mainly producing noise filters and coils for washing machines, refrigerators, air conditioners and other appliances, plus some reactors that prevent current fluctuation and improve energy efficiency. It aims to expand into renewable energy and automotive electrical parts and to offer electromagnetic solutions through an EMC certification centre. Founded in 1988, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017.

263860.text: Genians is an information security software company whose products include network access control (NAC), an integrated endpoint security platform and zero-trust (ZTNA) security. It is developing next-generation security technology, including AI-based features and a quantum security gateway, and seeks new technology through partnerships and M&A. Founded in 2005, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017 and is expanding globally, including through a US subsidiary.

263920.text: HuM & C makes glass containers for medical use and, in its cosmetics business, supplies makeup sponges and puffs to cosmetics manufacturers in Korea and abroad on a B2B basis. The company says its own technology gives it more than 30% of the domestic market. Founded in 2002 under a different name, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017 and adopted its current name in 2022.

264450.text: Ubiquoss makes wired communications equipment, including FTTH solutions, L2/L3 Ethernet switches and 5G wired solutions, covering a full line-up of access network gear. The company says its technology ranks first in Korea's telecom carrier subscriber network market. It was created in 2017 through a spin-off of its former parent's network business and is preparing to develop core AI technology and expand in enterprise and overseas markets.

264660.text: C&G Hi Tech makes and sells central chemical supply systems (CCSS), which automatically deliver the chemicals used in semiconductor and display manufacturing. It is preparing new businesses in lining sheets and low-dielectric FCCL materials, and is also pursuing a glass substrate business linked to the growth of the AI industry. Founded in 2002 to make chip manufacturing equipment, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018.

264850.text: Elensys designs, makes and sells core components for home appliances such as robot vacuums, air and clothing purifiers, water purifiers and bidets, as well as for security products such as digital door locks. Founded in 2002, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019 through a merger with a special purpose acquisition company. It has 2 overseas subsidiaries in Vietnam.

264900.text: Crown Confectionery makes and sells biscuits, candy, chocolate, snacks and pies, including long-running brands, and supplies them through sales offices and agencies nationwide. It is working to upgrade existing products, launch new ones and open overseas markets such as China. It was created in 2017 through a spin-off from its holding company and relisted on the KOSPI.

265520.text: Advanced Process Systems makes equipment for semiconductors, OLED, secondary batteries and renewable energy, with products including ELA, LLO, RTP, Sputter and NG Sorter systems. It has long made laser-based OLED manufacturing equipment and is focusing on HBM-related laser equipment as the HPC and AI markets grow. It was created in 2017 through a spin-off from its holding company.

265560.text: Younghwa Tech develops and makes electric vehicle parts, automotive electrical components and power electronics, including junction boxes and EV power electronics modules. It supplies global carmakers, including 5 Korean automakers, and runs production units in China and Mexico and a subsidiary in the United States alongside its Korean headquarters, plant and research centre. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017.

265740.text: NFC makes high-performance cosmetic ingredients and produces finished cosmetics for other brands on an ODM/OEM basis. The company says its MLV stabilisation technology made it the first in Korea to stabilise high-concentration ceramide, and it also has nanoliposome and fermentation technologies. Founded in 2012, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020.

267250.text: HD Hyundai is a holding company formed in 2017 through a spin-off from its shipbuilding affiliate. Through its main subsidiaries it operates in shipbuilding and offshore engineering, oil refining, ship services, electrical equipment and construction machinery. As a holding company it aims for greater transparency, accountable management and faster decision-making while spreading business risk.

267260.text: HD Hyundai Electric, an HD Hyundai group company founded in 2017, makes electrical equipment and energy solutions for every stage of power supply, from generation through transmission and distribution to consumption. Its products include power equipment, rotating machines and distribution equipment, and it acquired a power conversion company in 2022. It has 12 unlisted subsidiaries and runs a global R&D network and a reliability centre in Korea.

267270.text: HD Construction Equipment makes and sells construction machinery and parts, operating with 25 subsidiaries in production and marketing in Korea and abroad. It focuses on core construction machinery components and engines built for emissions and fuel-efficiency rules, and is expanding sales of eco-friendly products. It was created in 2017 through a spin-off of its former parent's construction equipment division and absorbed an affiliate through a merger in 2026.

267290.text: Kyungdong City Gas supplies city gas in Ulsan and a neighbouring city, while its 4 customer service centre subsidiaries provide gas safety management and gas installation work. It was created in 2017 through a spin-off of its former parent's city gas business. It is reviewing new businesses such as pipeline leasing, hydrogen refuelling stations and investment in hydrogen fuel cell power generation.

267320.text: Naintech supplies lamination and stacking equipment for secondary batteries and wet station equipment for OLED, and also runs a lithium-ion battery business for military use. It is diversifying through a stake in a rare-earth recycling company, in-house electrode technology, solution development and entry into new equipment markets. Founded in 2007, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020 and has subsidiaries including NAINTECH MICHIGAN INC.

267790.text: Barrel makes and sells sportswear, with water sports apparel such as rash guards and indoor swimwear, plus athleisure-based yoga, fitness and lifestyle clothing, as its main products. It sells directly in China through a subsidiary and works with local distribution partners in Thailand, Taiwan, Hong Kong and Japan. Founded in 2010, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018.

267850.text: Asiana IDT provides IT services including operations and maintenance, consulting and systems integration, covering IT master plans, system building, digital transformation and IT outsourcing. It traces its roots to a business group's computer department in 1973 and was incorporated in 1991. In 2003 it took over its parent airline's IT business and adopted its current name, and it listed on the KOSPI in 2018.

267980.text: Maeil Dairies makes dairy products across dairy, nutrition and other segments, producing white milk, milk powder, fermented milk, coffee and plant-based drinks. It operates 7 production plants and 9 sales bases in Korea and owns brands spanning milk, infant formula, coffee, soy milk and almond drinks. It was created in 2017 through a spin-off from Maeil Holdings and is one of 15 companies in that group.

268280.text: Miwon Specialty Chemical makes and sells raw materials for UV curing, producing acrylic monomers, oligomers and photoinitiators used in energy curing (UV/EB curing). It supplies them for coatings, inks, adhesives and electronic materials, and has a US subsidiary, Miwon Specialty Chemical USA, Inc. It was spun off from Miwon Holdings in 2017 and listed on the KOSPI the same year.

270520.text: APTN designs and installs geothermal heating and cooling systems that use underground heat, as well as fuel cells that generate electricity and heat from hydrogen in city gas. Founded in 2017, it completed a merger with an energy company in 2020. Its largest shareholder changed in 2025, and it adopted its current name in July of that year.

270660.text: Everybot makes and sells intelligent robots. The company says it launched the world's first dual-spin wet-mop robot vacuum in 2016; it has since built a full line of cleaning robots and added a serving robot in 2023, expanding into AI autonomous-driving service robots. Founded in 2015, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 and in 2025 signed a contract to develop an autonomous air purifier.

270870.text: Newtree develops inner-beauty health functional food ingredients and finished products derived from natural materials using its own biotechnology, running B2C and B2B businesses around 4 core efficacy categories. Founded in 2001 to make, sell and trade food and food additives, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018. Its main subsidiary is a new technology business finance company set up in 2019.

271560.text: Orion makes biscuits, pies and other confectionery at two plants in Korea for sale at home and abroad, and owns brands such as its chocolate pie. It runs production plants overseas in countries including China and Vietnam, and in 2025 entered processed seafood through a joint venture with a fisheries cooperative federation. It was created in 2017 through a spin-off from Orion Holdings to focus on food.

271830.text: Pamtek makes automation equipment, starting from camera module inspection systems and extending to semiconductor process, smart factory and mobility automation equipment. In semiconductors it supplies wafer transfer robots, test handlers and DTFH equipment for AI chip inspection, while in camera modules it serves high-end, mobile and automotive products. Founded in 2005, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 and recently added a subsidiary.

271940.text: Iljin Hysolus makes and sells Type 4 hydrogen tanks for vehicles and exhaust emission reduction devices. The company says it is the exclusive supplier of hydrogen tanks for a Korean carmaker's fuel cell vehicle, and it also supplies MEGC units for hydrogen transport to a customer. Founded in 2012, it adopted its current name in 2021 before listing on the KOSPI, and it files patents in the United States, Germany and China.

271980.text: Jeil Pharmaceutical makes and sells medicines together with its parent holding company and other affiliates, while a subsidiary focuses on new drug development. It is strengthening in-house R&D and pursuing open innovation with outside technologies to diversify its business. It was created in 2017 through a spin-off from its holding company and relisted on the KOSPI.

272110.text: KnJ was founded in 2005 to make CVD-SiC products used in semiconductor manufacturing, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019. It now runs two businesses: core materials and parts for chipmaking processes, and FPCBs for automotive electronics and smart devices. It expanded its electronic components business by bringing several companies into its group through a 2024 equity investment and a 2025 call option.

272210.text: Hanwha Systems has a defence business covering surveillance and reconnaissance, command, control and communications, and combat systems, and an ICT business focused on AI-based digital platforms. Through its subsidiary Hanwha Philly Shipyard Inc. in the United States, it has entered the US naval vessel MRO market. Founded in 2000, it joined the Hanwha group in 2015 and took its current name in 2016.

272290.text: Innox Advanced Materials uses polymer synthesis technology to make materials for semiconductor packaging, OLED and secondary batteries. It is shifting its focus from IT and OLED materials toward semiconductor, battery and mobility materials, and one subsidiary produces high-purity lithium hydroxide. It was created in 2017 through a spin-off and has 5 subsidiaries in Korea, China and Vietnam.

272450.text: Jin Air is an airline with a scheduled air transport licence, offering passenger and cargo services and in-flight duty-free sales. As of the end of June 2026 it leased 32 aircraft, including 19 BOEING 737-800s. Founded in 2008, it runs a preventive safety management system built on SMS and is introducing the A321neo and using AI technology.

272550.text: Samyang Packaging makes PET containers and runs an OEM business for aseptic-filled beverages, producing a range of PET bottles for different filling methods. A Samyang group company, it was spun off from the group's container unit in 2014 and listed on the KOSPI in 2017. In 2022 it split its recycling business off into a subsidiary, and the group has 30 affiliates.

273060.text: Wise birds is an online advertising company whose main businesses are ad agency services based on RTB media, mobile ad planning and software development. Through subsidiaries it also offers digital marketing services and property leasing. It is a partner of two global ad platforms and is building AI-based ad operations and creative capabilities. Founded in 2013, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020.

273640.text: YM Tech makes relays for DC power control. Most of its sales come from makers of EV chargers and ESS, and because its customers are a small number of large companies, sales are seasonal and tend to concentrate in the second half, after customers set production plans early in the year. Founded in 2004, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

274090.text: Kencoa Aerospace was founded in 2013 to design, make and sell aircraft and parts, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020. Its businesses include supplying special aerospace raw materials, producing aircraft structures, machining parts, converting passenger jets to freighters, depot maintenance of military aircraft, making space launch vehicle parts and developing UAM and drones. In 2025 its subsidiary Kencoa Group LLC set up Kencoa Investments LLC.

274400.text: Innosimulation, founded in 2000, builds verification and training infrastructure for Physical AI based on simulation and digital twin technology. Over 26 years it has supplied simulation systems to defence, automotive and other sectors, and its main businesses are synthetic defence training simulators and its Physical AI verification system, INNO ALPS. It works with defence companies on training projects and is moving toward recurring revenue through the INNO ALPS platform.

275630.text: SSR provides information security consulting and security software, including IT infrastructure vulnerability assessment, web server security and source code vulnerability checks, plus penetration testing and other security audits. It is applying AI and other new technology to automate security operations. Founded in 2010, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018 and expanded its security business by absorbing another security software company in 2026.

276040.text: Skonec Entertainment was founded in 2002 as a game content developer and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022 as a technology growth company. It turned to VR content after 2012, and the company says it commercialised the world's first VR FPS game in 2015. It now runs metaverse XR games, XR education and training, and metaverse businesses, and is looking to expand by combining them with AI and blockchain.

276730.text: HanWool & Jeju makes and sells beer, including a wheat ale, through convenience stores, large supermarkets and wholesalers. It learned brewing techniques through a partnership with a US brewery and is pursuing markets such as China, Hong Kong, Japan and the United States. Founded in 2015 as a brewery, it took its current name in 2025 and bought a stake in a frozen rice roll maker it calls the global No. 1.

277070.text: Lindeman Asia Investment is a venture capital firm that provides investment finance to small and venture companies, mainly by forming investment funds and PEFs. It runs 7 investment funds and focuses on companies in the expansion stage rather than early start-ups, supporting their overseas expansion and growth. Founded in 2006, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018 and has 2 unlisted subsidiaries.

277410.text: Insan makes bamboo salt and related food products. The company says it was the first to industrialise bamboo salt, which it has produced with traditional methods for four generations, and that it holds the top position in sales. Its roots go back to a food maker founded in 1987, which it absorbed after being set up in 1992; it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018 through a merger with a special purpose acquisition company.

277810.text: Rainbow Robotics builds collaborative robots, quadruped robots, mobile humanoids and AMRs, drawing on parts, technology, software and control algorithms developed through what it says was Korea's first bipedal walking robot. Founded in 2011, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 as a technology growth company. A large electronics company became its largest shareholder in 2025, but regulators deferred its inclusion in that group, so it keeps its small and venture company status.

277880.text: TSI makes equipment for secondary battery manufacturing, mainly mixing process equipment and systems that blend active materials, conductive agents, binders and solvents. Mixing systems and mixing products account for 84.56% of total sales. Founded in 2011, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020 under a special listing rule for companies without realised profits and has 6 unlisted subsidiaries.

278280.text: Chunbo makes electronic materials such as LCD etchant additives, OLED materials and chip process materials, along with secondary battery electrolytes and electrolyte additives, pharmaceutical intermediates and fine chemicals. The company says its LCD etchant additive ATZ holds the top market share in Korea and worldwide at 95%, and that its chip process materials have the largest share in Korea. Founded in 2007, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019 and has 3 subsidiaries.

278470.text: APR makes cosmetics and home beauty devices, running several cosmetics brands and selling a booster device as its main home beauty product. It keeps planning, R&D, production, sales and after-sales service in-house, and checks product safety and runs clinical evaluations through its own skin science research institute. Founded in 2014, it listed on the KOSPI in 2024.

278650.text: HLB bioStep is a non-clinical CRO that runs non-clinical tests on new drugs and other new substances, offering efficacy, pharmacokinetic and toxicity (safety) evaluations. In May 2024 it acquired a GLP toxicity testing company as a subsidiary, building a one-stop non-clinical service. Founded in 2012, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019.

279570.text: Kbank is Korea's first internet-only bank, founded and granted a banking licence in 2016, and began serving customers in 2017. It offers deposit and savings accounts as well as online credit loans and mortgages, and runs real-name account verification for a crypto exchange and brokerage-linked accounts. Through partnerships in telecoms, investment and digital assets, it is expanding as a digital financial platform.

279600.text: MediaZen has its own speech recognition and speech synthesis technology. The company says it holds the largest share among Korean firms in the global in-car speech recognition market, offering a common platform that supports 21 languages for Korea, North America and Europe. It also runs smart call centre and AI edutech businesses using deep-learning STT and TTS and a generative AI chatbot engine. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019.

280360.text: Lotte Wellfood is a Lotte group food company set up through a split in 2017, with 32 subsidiaries in Korea and abroad. Its main products are long-selling confectionery brands, and it is expanding into bakery, fats and oils, processed meat and HMR. Its overseas subsidiaries include Guylian in Belgium, Rakhat in Kazakhstan and Lotte India, and it exports to about 60 countries.

281740.text: Lake Materials develops and supplies ultra-high-purity organometallic compounds, built on its TMA manufacturing technology, for use in semiconductor, solar, LED and display materials. It runs an integrated process covering design, synthesis and purification and is expanding into new areas such as raw materials for all-solid-state battery electrolytes. Founded in 2010, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020 through a merger.

281820.text: KC Tech makes and sells front-end semiconductor process equipment and consumable materials, with products including CMP and wet cleaning systems. It is working to win demand for new equipment as chip circuits become more highly integrated and displays shift to OLED and next-generation technology. It was created in 2017 through a spin-off of its former parent's chip and display equipment and materials business, and owns KCTech America Inc.

282330.text: BGF Retail runs a nationwide franchise convenience store chain under its own CU brand, launched in 2012, selling food, processed food, tobacco and non-food items. Its main subsidiaries handle logistics and food manufacturing and distribution, and in 2025 it set up BGF RETAIL HAWAII CORP. for overseas business. The current company was created in 2017 through a spin-off, while its convenience store business began in 1990.

282620.text: Kido Industrial makes specialty clothing, mainly high-tech outdoor wear and motorcycle apparel designed to protect the body in extreme conditions. It has in-house technology for handling composite materials and treating special fabrics, and says it meets the strict quality standards of global premium brands. Founded in 1980, it runs 6 overseas production subsidiaries across 4 countries: Vietnam, Bangladesh, Indonesia and Myanmar.

282720.text: Kumyang Green Power is an electrical construction company with 32 years of experience in electrical and instrumentation work for plants, power stations and renewable energy. Its work covers wind, solar and fuel cell power plants, chemical and industrial plants in Korea and abroad, and renewable energy design and routine maintenance services. Founded in 1993, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 and has 8 unlisted subsidiaries.

282880.text: Cowin Robotics specialises in robot automation, with businesses in robot automation, maintenance, and secondary battery materials and engineering. It supplies robots and automation systems to the battery, ESS, automotive and semiconductor industries, including factories of major Korean conglomerates, and is building its position in AMRs. Founded in 1998, it is listed on the KOSDAQ and has 9 subsidiaries.

284620.text: Kainos Medicine was founded in 2007 to research and develop novel drugs, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020 after merging with a special purpose acquisition company. It develops synthetic and biologic drugs for diseases lacking suitable treatments, including brain disorders such as Parkinson's disease and multiple system atrophy, AIDS, and cancer. Its US subsidiary FAScinate pursues global clinical development.
