284740.text: Cuckoo Homesys mainly rents out home appliances such as water purifiers, air purifiers, bidets, mattresses and massage chairs through a nationwide rental distribution network. It operates abroad through units in Malaysia, the United States, Australia and elsewhere, and has 1 listed and 4 unlisted subsidiaries. It was created in 2017 through a spin-off from Cuckoo Holdings and relisted on the KOSPI in 2018.

285130.text: SK Chemicals produces green chemicals and life science products, running 3 plants in Korea and 2 in China. It was created in 2017 through a spin-off from an SK group holding company and strengthened its global CDMO capability by acquiring IDT Biologika of Germany in 2024. It is moving toward chemical recycling to build a circular-economy portfolio centred on green materials, and aims for Net Zero by 2040.

285490.text: Novatech specialises in permanent magnet applications, using rare-earth neodymium magnets to make shielding magnets, automotive electrical parts and other products. Its main customers are a major Korean electronics maker and its suppliers. It has mass-production capacity for motion position sensors used in EV autonomous driving systems and applies its technology to electric power steering and integrated dynamic braking. Founded in 2007, it has subsidiaries in Vietnam and China.

285800.text: Jinyoung makes high-performance plastic sheets from materials such as ASA, ABS, PP and PMMA, including decorative sheets for furniture, interior and exterior parts for home appliances and industrial films, and supplies Korean companies. Using thin-sheet extrusion technology and 8 production lines, it is expanding into vehicle interior materials and flame-retardant films. Founded in 1996, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

286750.text: NanoSilikhan Advanced Materials develops nano materials with its nature-inspired active nano platform, running businesses in anti-counterfeiting security, nucleic acid extraction for biotech and functional displays. In 2015 it commercialised a magnetic-field colour-shifting material for security authentication. It is pursuing silicon anode materials for lithium secondary batteries using its own doping and carbon coating technology. Listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019, it has 1 unlisted subsidiary.

286940.text: Lotte Innovate runs systems management (SM), systems integration (SI) and EV charging businesses; its SM work improves IT efficiency and cuts costs, while its SI work builds information systems and supports physical AI projects. It operates the EVSIS charging platform and serves as an IT partner to Lotte affiliates. Founded in 2017 for systems integration and solutions, it absorbed another IT company in 2019.

287840.text: IntoCell develops drug technology based on drug conjugates, focusing on ADCs. Its research covers its own linker platform, OHPAS linker technology, PMT platform technology and ADC payloads such as Duocarmycin, and it earns revenue by licensing out its linker platform and in-house ADC pipeline. Founded in 2015, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025 as a technology growth company.

288180.text: KP Aero Industries machines and assembles aircraft parts and makes jigs and tooling. Its aviation business covers parts machining, module assembly and tooling, while its defence and space business makes moulds and tooling for guided weapons, processes composites and produces parts for Korea's space launch vehicle, working with partners including a Korean aerospace company. Founded in 1990, it began operating a production plant in Vietnam in 2025.

288330.text: Parataxis Korea was founded in 2015 to make basic pharmaceutical substances and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019. In 2025 it set up a digital asset division through a share issue to Parataxis Holdings and adopted bitcoin as a strategic treasury asset, running it alongside its biotech business. The digital asset division buys, holds and mines bitcoin, while the bio division develops and licenses new drugs for unmet needs such as idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.

288620.text: S-Prism was founded in 2014 to make and sell fuel cell systems and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018. It produces 1kW to 50kW polymer electrolyte membrane fuel cells (PEMFC), with models running on city gas, pure hydrogen and LPG. It says it holds a lead in the building fuel cell market and is adding hydrogen fuel cell power packs as a new business.

288980.text: Moadata provides AI-based system anomaly detection solutions, and its AIOps product has about 300 customers. Through subsidiaries it also runs health data analysis and AI-based pet healthcare businesses, offering digital healthcare services and a pet health app. Founded in 2014, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

289010.text: i-Scream Edu mainly runs a self-directed learning program for preschool, elementary and middle school students, built on digital content and dedicated learning devices, and has extended it to versions for study rooms. It is developing AI-based personalised diagnosis using its large pool of learning data, along with an AI tutor, to offer highly personalised services. It was created in 2013 through a spin-off and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019.

289080.text: SV Investment is a venture capital firm that raises money from pension funds, financial institutions and others to invest in small and venture companies with growth potential, then supports their management to raise value and realise returns. It invests in areas such as bio and healthcare, and ICT and cultural content. Listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018, it has 7 overseas subsidiaries in places including the United States, Singapore and Hong Kong.

289220.text: Giantstep produces VFX for advertising and video as well as real-time content, and is presenting new business models such as virtual production. Founded in 2008, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 and has 5 subsidiaries, including the US unit GIANTSTEP Studios Inc.

289930.text: Wavice makes GaN RF semiconductors. The company says it is Korea's first and only mass producer of GaN RF chips and the only Korean firm to cover the full chip-package-module chain for RF power amplifiers. It won a GaN RF power device process project from a national defence research agency in 2015, says it is a key supplier to major weapons makers, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

290090.text: TWIM develops machine vision inspection and AI inspection systems based on deep-learning algorithms, supplying customised software and hardware for process automation in semiconductors, displays and other fields. Its vision division offers inspection equipment with AI software and smart factory solutions, while its energy division provides power analysis and electricity cost reduction solutions. Founded in 2010, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

290120.text: DH Autolead makes steering wheel parts for vehicles and is classed as a maker of new automotive steering and suspension systems. It was created in 2016 through a spin-off of its former parent's steering wheel business, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018 and took its current name after joining the DH group in 2023. It has built a global production network through overseas units in Mexico, Slovakia, Vietnam and Thailand.

290270.text: Hunesion is an information security company that concentrates on network linkage solutions while also offering a range of other security products. It runs a product sales unit and a solutions division, along with two regional branches. Founded in 2003 to develop and supply system software, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018 and has 2 unlisted subsidiaries.

290520.text: Shindo Eng. Lab makes display equipment, supplying laminators and degassing machines for OLED, foldable and micro LED panel production. The company says it developed the world's first single-sheet degassing machine and curved vacuum laminator. It is expanding into equipment for hydrogen fuel cell MEAs and smart windows. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020 and has 1 unlisted subsidiary.

290550.text: DK Tech develops and produces FPCA modules for smartphones, smartwatches, automotive electronics and BMS, serving the smartphone, wearable, automotive and battery industries. Through its Vietnamese production unit DKT VINA it supplies a display maker's local unit in Vietnam, carmakers and battery companies. Founded in 2012 to make electronic parts for smart devices, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018.

290560.text: Parataxis Ethereum runs two businesses: a digital asset treasury (DAT) business that holds Ethereum as a strategic asset for capital gains and investment income, and a data security business. The data security business holds 16 patents, and the company says it was the first to obtain CC certification for database encryption. Founded in 2005 as a data security firm, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 through a merger.

290650.text: L&C Bio makes and sells human tissue grafts, tissue-based medical devices and cosmeceuticals, and also runs pharmaceutical and CRO businesses for functional cosmetics and health foods. Its main products are based on acellular allogeneic dermis and demineralised bone matrix, and it has localised allogeneic dermal grafts in Korea and is widening their uses. Founded in 2011, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018 and has 4 unlisted subsidiaries.

290660.text: Dynamic solution develops, makes and sells AI and IoT-based rehabilitation devices for stroke and spinal cord injury patients, offering personalised rehab solutions through its smart device series. Its business is organised into 3 segments: BCI, robotics and materials. Founded in 2010, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018, has 9 subsidiaries and sells globally through Neofect USA and a German unit.

290670.text: Daebo Magnetic makes and sells magnetic machinery such as electromagnetic iron removers (EMF) and magnetic separators (MS), and also processes secondary battery materials on consignment. It set up a battery equipment sales unit in China in 2024 and a US subsidiary in 2025 to widen its global sales network. Founded in 1994, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018.

290690.text: Aribio Holdings, founded in 1996, makes electrical lighting and carries out electrical and telecommunications construction work. Its main products are LED indoor lights, fluorescent lights and outdoor lights; it launched a full range of residential LED lighting in 2009 and developed LED outdoor lights and built a second plant in 2018. It entered sports lighting with golf course lighting in 2021 and is exploring night sports and large work-site lighting.

290720.text: Foodnamoo is a food tech company whose main business is selling and producing (OEM) diet and convenient health foods through its own B2C e-commerce platforms. It also has a subsidiary that sells meat and distributes food ingredients, plus overseas units in Vietnam, China and the United States. Founded in 2013, it works in food manufacturing, wholesale, retail and e-commerce, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018.

290740.text: Actro makes actuators for mobile devices and automation equipment, supplying AF, OIS and Folded Zoom Actuators for smartphone camera modules. It has automated the production process for high-end Folded Zoom Actuators and runs two production units in Vietnam that supply its key customers. Founded in 2012, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018.

291230.text: Com2uS N plans and produces experiential content for brand experiences and virtual content using XR technology, and runs the NP XR STAGE studio. It developed emotion-analysis AI in joint research with a Korean science university, launched the MUA mind-care solution and is diversifying its content IP business with short-form dramas. Founded in 2006, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 and took its current name after a merger in 2026.

291650.text: Choolip & Sciences is a biotech company built on an aptamer technology platform, spun off from a Korean university in 2011. Its businesses are drug development based on an aptamer-drug conjugate platform, CRO services for biopharmaceutical analysis, and distribution of healthcare and household goods. It listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020, expanded its CRO business through a 2024 merger and in 2026 acquired 100% of CHOOLIP INC., a US pet supplement distributor.

291810.text: Pintel develops and sells AI video analytics solutions for smart cities and intelligent transport systems, built on high-resolution AI video analysis technology. It supplies the PREVAX platform for multi-NPU environments and is expanding it into an AI platform for smart city operations using agentic AI workflows. Founded in 2015, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022 as a technology growth company.

293480.text: Hana Pharm makes and sells prescription drugs, and says it has long held a leading position in opioid painkillers and anaesthetics used for severe pain. Its range of about 360 insurance-listed drugs covers cardiovascular, pain, digestive, neurology and dermatology treatments. It was founded in 1978, took its current name in 1996 and listed on the KOSPI in 2018.

293490.text: Kakao Games is a game company that develops PC, console and mobile games and publishes them globally, running titles across a range of genres. It owns several game development subsidiaries. Founded in 2013, it took its current name in 2016 after absorbing another game company.

293580.text: NAU IB Capital is a venture capital firm in the new technology finance business, acting as managing partner of investment funds and private equity funds. It earns management and performance fees, equity-method investment gains, advisory fees, interest and dividend income, and gains from valuing and selling investments. Founded in 2007, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018 and has 1 unlisted subsidiary.

293780.text: Aptabio Therapeutics develops new drugs using 3 platform technologies, oxidative stress control, CAF Modulation and Apta-DC, targeting diabetic complications, immuno-oncology and hard-to-treat cancers. It set up a new business division in 2023 to enter health food ODM, pet products and reagent sales, and is seeking partnerships through pipeline licensing and platform technology licences. Founded in 2009, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019.

293940.text: Shinhan Alpha REIT is a real estate investment company listed on the KOSPI. It invests in property and pays shareholders dividends from the income, rather than running an operating business.

294090.text: EOFlow, founded in 2011, develops and makes wearable drug infusion devices and software based on precision electronics. Its wearable systems use high-performance electro-osmotic pumps, and its main product is a smart wearable insulin pump system. It is developing an automated insulin delivery system linked to continuous glucose monitors, and aims to enter global markets through an open integration strategy and FDA approval.

294140.text: Lemon makes functional nano materials using electrospinning technology transferred from its parent company when it was founded in 2012. After a 2025 merger it runs three divisions: nano membranes, making outdoor membranes, mobile VENT parts and heat-dissipation materials; H&B, making sanitary pads and masks; and filters, supplying protective suit and air filter media. It also owns Finetex Technology in the Philippines and a solar power plant.

294570.text: coocon runs a business data brokerage platform. The company says it is the only company in Korea with both data API and payment infrastructure businesses; it collects data from more than 2,500 partner institutions and provides it through APIs. It also offers simple payment and financial VAN services linked to more than 90 financial institutions. Founded in 2006, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

294630.text: SuNAM makes second-generation high-temperature superconducting wire using its own RCE-DR process, and runs businesses across the superconducting value chain, including magnets, cables and buffer wire. Its main markets are power, energy, medical, research and defence applications that need high performance and efficiency. Founded in 2004, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020 as a technology growth company.

294870.text: Ipark Hyundai Development is a general construction company created in 2018 through a spin-off of its former parent's construction, precast concrete structure, and hotel and condo businesses. Its sales come from contracted housing (61.3%), its own projects (23.9%) and civil engineering (7.4%), and it works on private orders, urban redevelopment and private SOC projects under the IPARK brand. Its main subsidiaries include a precast concrete maker, a hotel operator and a REIT.

295310.text: HVM makes advanced metals, with high-cleanliness vacuum melting as its core technology. It produces Ni-based superalloys, Fe-based high-strength alloys, sputtering targets and Ti-based specialty alloys for aerospace, defence, semiconductors and other strategic industries. Founded in 2012, it listed on the KOSDAQ in June 2024.

296640.text: Innoax provides software and services for digital transformation and AX that minimise complex coding when companies build and run IT systems. Founded in 2007, it set up a wholly owned Japanese subsidiary in 2015 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022. It recently acquired 100% of another company, adding it as a consolidated subsidiary.

297090.text: CS Bearing makes pitch and yaw bearings for wind turbines; pitch bearings connect the blades to the rotor, and yaw bearings control the direction of the nacelle. It has specialised in wind bearings since its founding and can produce them for turbines from 2-3MW onshore models to offshore models above 10MW. Founded in 2007, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019 and has a subsidiary in Vietnam.

297570.text: Atlas Link makes Android-based OTT set-top boxes, sold overseas under the FORMULER brand, and PHC piles supplied to major builders through bases in the Seoul metropolitan area. Running both digital media devices and basic construction materials diversifies its portfolio. Founded in 2015, it is listed on the KOSDAQ and adopted its current name in 2026.

297890.text: HB Solution makes display and semiconductor equipment, drawing on its resin coating and inspection technology to produce display equipment, chip measurement and inspection systems, and secondary battery and inkjet equipment. It is investing in R&D for inkjet and semiconductor equipment and aims to expand into batteries, automotive and biotech. Founded in 2001, it runs a global customer service network through overseas units.

298000.text: Hyosung Chemical produces polypropylene (PP), PET and nylon films for industrial, packaging and optical uses, TAC film for displays and other products, with sales centred on specialty products. It was created in 2018 through a spin-off of Hyosung's chemicals business and belongs to the Hyosung business group. It has subsidiaries in Korea and abroad, including in Vietnam and China.

298020.text: Hyosung TNC has a textiles business making spandex, polyester and other fibre materials, and says it holds the top global market share in spandex, which it produces in 6 countries. Its trading business deals in steel and chemicals through about 30 overseas branches, and it says a special gas business acquired in 2025 gives it the world's second-largest production capacity. It was spun off from Hyosung in 2018 and has 27 subsidiaries.

298040.text: Hyosung Heavy Industries makes power equipment such as transformers and circuit breakers and rotating machines such as motors and generators, while its construction business builds housing and handles redevelopment and reconstruction projects. It runs production bases in the United States, India, China and elsewhere and is expanding in ESS, HVDC and green energy. It was split off from the Hyosung group in 2018 and has 24 subsidiaries.

298050.text: HS Hyosung Advanced Materials makes industrial materials such as tire reinforcements, with global tire makers as its main customers. In 2025 it invested in a stake in a subsidiary of a Belgian company, which was renamed HS Hyosung Energy Solution BV in 2026, marking its entry into silicon anode materials. Founded in 2018, it is listed on the KOSPI and has 19 consolidated subsidiaries.

298060.text: Poongjeon Pharmacy runs 3 businesses based on its own stem cell separation technique: stem cell therapy R&D, hair and skin products made with culture media, and drug wholesaling to large hospitals. It is developing treatments for rare and hard-to-treat diseases and researching high-purity stem cells under an agreement with a university and its hospital. Founded in 2014, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020 and expanded by absorbing another pharmaceutical company in 2026.

298380.text: ABL Bio develops biologic drugs based on bispecific antibody technology. Using its Grabody bispecific platform, it researches antibody therapies including immune checkpoint modulators, new cancer targets, treatments for degenerative brain diseases with better blood-brain barrier (BBB) penetration, and ADCs. Its US unit NEOK Bio handles ADC clinical development. Founded in 2016, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018.

298540.text: The Nature Holdings sells casual outdoor and lifestyle apparel under licence agreements with several global brands. Founded in 2004 to import and sell accessories for cameras, small electronics and car electronics, it expanded into clothing and luggage after bringing in a licence in 2013. It strengthened its outdoor fashion business by acquiring a sportswear company in 2022 and taking a stake in another fashion brand in 2024.

298690.text: Air Busan is a low-cost carrier founded in 2007 that flies domestic and international passenger routes, with a focus on developing the Busan region. As of 2026 it operates 21 aircraft, including A320-200, A321-200 and A321-NEO models, on 4 domestic and 23 international routes, selling tickets directly and through agents. The company says it ranks first by passenger share at its main airport, and it uses data-based fare management and fuel-saving flight methods.

298830.text: Suresofttech runs an automated software verification platform, providing test and verification automation solutions to companies in automotive, defence, nuclear power, rail and other fields through licences, maintenance and subscriptions. It is upgrading AI verification and aims to serve as an engineering partner as carmakers move to software-defined vehicles (SDV). Founded in 2002, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 through a merger with a special purpose acquisition company.

299030.text: Hana Technology focuses on secondary battery equipment and offers turnkey solutions covering assembly, formation and pack processes for various battery types. It has completed development of equipment for next-generation all-solid-state batteries and is pursuing new businesses in sulfide-based solid electrolyte materials and eco-friendly display equipment. Founded in 2003 to build precision automation machinery and inspection equipment, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020.

299170.text: WSI wholesales and retails medicines and medical devices, including local hemostatic agents, drawing on its experience in the spinal and joint device market, and since 2024 has worked with a global company to enter the cardiovascular intervention device market. Its subsidiaries make medical robots, produce drugs and analyse clinical trial samples. Founded in 2016, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020 through a merger with a special purpose acquisition company.

299660.text: Cellid was founded in 2006 as a biotech venture developing cancer immunotherapy vaccines and COVID-19 vaccines, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019 as a technology growth company. It is developing 6 cancer immunotherapy vaccines based on its CeliVax technology and an adenovirus-vector COVID-19 vaccine, and uses its own GMP facility for biopharmaceutical CMO and CDMO work. It added an e-commerce division by absorbing another company in 2024.

300080.text: Flitto is an AI language data company that sells data for AI model research and development and offers translation services and AI-based interpretation and translation solutions. Its customers include global big tech companies and public institutions, and its platform supports 42 languages across 173 countries. Founded in 2012, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019, has a Japanese subsidiary in a similar business and is building robotics and AI datasets.

300120.text: LaonPeople provides AI-based vision solutions, including AI machine vision, AI smart vision and camera module inspection, and is focusing on generative AI. It has diversified by launching the AI platform EZ-PLANET, the generative AI service HI FENN and the video analytics solution Odin AI. Founded in 2010, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019.

300720.text: Hanil Cement makes and sells cement, ready-mixed mortar and ready-mixed concrete, operating plants in several regions of Korea. Ready-mixed mortar is a blend of cement and sand, while ready-mixed concrete is unhardened concrete made of cement, aggregate and admixtures. It was created in 2018 through a spin-off from Hanil Holdings and owns a construction subsidiary.

301300.text: VAIV is an AI and big data company. Its AI solutions include VAIV Agent, VAIV Search and VAIV KMS, while its AI services, including a trend analysis service and the global beauty intelligence service WHOTAG, bring in subscription revenue. It combines its own Korean-language model, VAIV GeM, with high-reliability data assets to work as an AX partner. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020.

302430.text: Innometry makes X-ray non-destructive inspection equipment, mainly used to find internal defects in EV secondary batteries and mobile devices, and supplies systems for prismatic, cylindrical and pouch batteries. It has subsidiaries in China, Hong Kong, Hungary and the United States for global sales and customer support. Founded in 2008, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018.

302440.text: SK Bioscience was created in 2018 through a spin-off of an SK group company's vaccine division, and entered the CDMO market by acquiring IDT Biologika of Germany in 2024. Its portfolio includes a cell-culture flu vaccine, a shingles vaccine and a chickenpox vaccine. It is running a phase 3 pneumococcal vaccine trial with Sanofi and securing mRNA vaccine technology with CEPI, and aims to become a global top 10 vaccine company.

302550.text: Remed develops, makes and sells devices that use strong magnetic fields to depolarise nerve cells, running TMS brain rehabilitation, PMS chronic pain treatment and CSMS and EBD aesthetic businesses. After gaining US FDA approval in 2021, it is launching a depression treatment device globally and pursuing clinical research in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease. Founded in 2003, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019 and has 3 subsidiaries.

303030.text: Zinitix designs system semiconductors, with touch controller ICs as its core product alongside AF Driver ICs, Haptic ICs, Fintech MST ICs and AMOLED DC-DC ICs. It supplies ICs to global manufacturers including Huawei and Xiaomi and is expanding into the module business. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019 through a reverse merger.

303360.text: Protia makes in-vitro diagnostic devices, using its core immunodiagnostic technology to develop kits for allergies, animal health, food intolerance, autoimmune disease and antibiotic susceptibility. The company says it holds more than 60% of Korea's allergy diagnostics market; it sells in about 80 countries and has 4 NET new-technology certifications. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KONEX in 2018 and moved to the KOSDAQ in 2023.

303530.text: Innodep is an AI video recognition company that provides IOD and IDL solutions based on object recognition technology to the public sector. Through a subsidiary it runs unmanned traffic enforcement and smart intersection businesses. It is pursuing private and overseas markets with advanced AI and investing in AI, digital twin and cloud technology for smart city platforms. Founded in 2008, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

303810.text: DongKook Life Science makes and sells contrast media, including X-ray, MRI and iodised oil agents, and works with 35 partners in 25 countries. Through its MEMD division it imports and distributes CT, MRI, mammography and ultrasound imaging equipment in cooperation with global companies. Founded in 2017 to make contrast media and distribute medical and diagnostic equipment, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

304100.text: Saltlux is an AI company offering a generative AI platform built on its own large language model, big data and data platforms, maintenance and outsourced operations, and ontology-based knowledge graph services. It says it leads the domain-specific AI agent market with its knowledge graph technology, and it is diversifying through cloud solutions and more private-sector work. Founded in 1981, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020 and has 6 subsidiaries.

304360.text: S.Biomedics is a stem cell biotech that develops cell therapies for various diseases, using technology to standardise embryonic stem cell differentiation and to build 3D cell aggregates. Its subsidiary, set up in 2016, makes and sells anti-aging aesthetic and cosmetic products. Founded in 2003, it later shifted to developing and supplying stem cell therapies and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 as a technology growth company.

304840.text: PeopleBio develops and makes blood tests for diseases caused by misfolded proteins. Its main product is a blood test for early detection of Alzheimer's disease that measures oligomerised beta-amyloid using its own SI-MDS technology. Building on its MDS patents, it is extending its diagnostic pipeline to Parkinson's disease, diabetes and colorectal cancer. Founded in 2002, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020 as a technology growth company.

305090.text: Micro Digital supplies bio healthcare solutions, offering single-use cell culture systems and bags in its bioprocess segment and fully automated immunoassay systems in its biomedical segment. It sells to pharmaceutical companies and others through 60 partners in 30 countries, and is developing precision diagnostic systems and a bio content business. Founded in 2002, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019 and has set up a unit in India.

306040.text: SJ Group runs fashion brands, selling several licensed brands mainly through premium retail channels and widening its portfolio with others such as LCDC and ECCO Golf Apparel. In 2025 it signed a global licence for one brand's bags and an exclusive import deal for another brand, ADP. Founded in 2008, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019 and has 4 subsidiaries.

306200.text: SeAH Steel produces and sells steel pipes used for piping, oil wells, structures and other purposes. It was created in 2018 through a spin-off of its holding company's pipe manufacturing and sales business, and belongs to the SeAH business group. Its subsidiaries include a steel wholesaler and retailer and a structural steel pipe maker.

306620.text: GIS makes and sells cutting equipment for semiconductors, displays and MLCCs. After a 2026 merger it widened its business to semiconductor back-end processing, MLCC cutting equipment, display inspection equipment and defence automation, and it now runs 6 business divisions covering equipment, FA, drones, electronics, automation and new businesses. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020.

307180.text: IL produces vehicle lamps, LED lighting and other products using silicone lenses for LEDs, which it says were the world's first, and is widening their use in automotive electronics. Since 2024 it has acquired companies to vertically integrate PCB design for car lamps, silicone lenses and injection-moulded plastic lamp covers. Founded in 2008 to develop high-efficiency LED lighting, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019 through a SPAC merger.

307280.text: Wonbiogen makes medical materials, mainly polyurethane foam dressings and hydrocolloid dressings, which it supplies on an ODM basis to Korean drugmakers and through distributors to hospital and pharmacy markets. It also runs a dermocosmetics business and is expanding into anti-adhesion agents and biosensor patches. Founded in 2006, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 through a reverse merger with a special purpose acquisition company.

307750.text: Kukjeon makes and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients and materials. Its pharmaceutical division synthesises, imports and distributes APIs, while its materials division develops and sells materials for OLED, next-generation displays and AI chip packaging. Its subsidiaries work on finished drug technology, nanoparticle cancer drugs and AI-based automation. Founded in 1995, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020.

307870.text: B2En is a data company offering consulting and solutions across the full process, from data strategy and big data system design and building to finding value with AI/ML analytics. Founded in 2004, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 through a merger with a special purpose acquisition company. In the first half of 2026 it sold all its shares in two subsidiaries, removing them from consolidation.

307930.text: Company K Partners is a venture capital firm set up in 2006 to invest in promising small and venture companies and raise their value. It focuses on start-up investment, forming venture funds and investing in venture companies, and ran 21 funds in 2026 covering fields such as ICT, biotech, AI and semiconductor materials, parts and equipment. It listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019.

307950.text: Hyundai Autoever provides IT services covering the full process from IT consulting to system building, operations and maintenance, split into SI and ITO. It also runs a vehicle software business, including vehicle software platforms and navigation software, which is growing in importance as the industry moves to SDV. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSPI in 2019 and has 11 unlisted subsidiaries.

308080.text: ViGenCell is a biotech venture that grew into an immune cell therapy developer through an industry-academic research model with a Korean university. It researches new drugs and develops and manufactures immune cell therapies, with a pipeline that includes VT-EBV-N for NK/T-cell lymphoma, VC-302 for glioblastoma and VC-420 for liver cancer, including iPSC-derived NK cell therapies. Founded in 2013, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 as a technology growth company.

308100.text: Hyungji Global makes and sells golf apparel and golf goods such as caddie bags, Boston bags, caps, socks and shoes. It was spun off from its parent fashion group in 2016 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019. It holds global trademark rights to a golf brand obtained by acquiring France's PMJC, bought a 51.1% stake in an affiliate in 2025, and is expanding distribution and licensing in Taiwan and Greater China.

308170.text: CTR Mobility makes drivetrain and suspension parts for cars, including rotor shafts, inner races, ball screws, propeller shafts, axles and control arms. It supplies a domestic carmaker group, other parts makers and overseas carmakers from plants in Ulsan, where it is headquartered, Daegu and another domestic site, plus a subsidiary's plant. It listed on the KOSPI in 2019.

308430.text: Cellbion develops radiopharmaceuticals, led by Lu-177-pocuvotide, a PSMA-targeted prostate cancer treatment in domestic clinical trials. It also runs a GMP-certified generic prescription drug business and focuses on theranostics and new cancer drugs. Founded in 2010, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

309710.text: It-chem is an organic materials company that uses synthesis technology to research, make and sell fine chemicals for pharmaceuticals and display electronic materials. It is developing next-generation OLED materials, while a subsidiary develops key secondary battery materials and an affiliate makes battery parts for energy storage systems. It was founded in 2005.

309930.text: Joyworks designs interior products and sells them under its own furniture brands through about 30 online shopping malls and offline showrooms. In 2024 it added a subsidiary in aircraft simulators and VR solutions, and in 2025 it acquired the domestic offline retail business of a global brand. Founded in 2010, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020.

309960.text: LB Investment is a venture capital firm that provides funding and management services mainly to early-stage small and venture companies and recovers its investments through mergers, acquisitions and listings. Its operating revenue comes from management fees, performance fees, gains on proprietary financial assets and equity-method income. It was founded in 1996 and adopted its current name in 2008.

310200.text: Aniplus, founded in 2009, is an animation media company that listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020 by merging with a special purpose acquisition company. It bought a merchandise company and an animation streaming service in 2022 and the industry's second-largest player in 2023, which it says made it Korea's largest youth animation business. It completed a merger absorbing that company in the first half of 2026.

310210.text: Voronoi is a drug development venture founded in 2015 in Incheon that develops precision kinase-targeted therapies for a range of diseases. It runs its own medicinal chemistry and AI research labs and conducts early clinical trials itself to test its candidates in humans. It licensed a lung cancer drug to Nasdaq-listed ORIC in 2020 and signed an agreement with Anvia Therapeutics in 2025.

310870.text: DYC, founded in 2000, machines automotive powertrain parts, supplying drivetrain components such as shafts, flanges, pinions, differential cases, yokes and ring gears to carmakers worldwide. It started with rear axle shafts and completed a merger with a special purpose acquisition company in 2021. In 2025 it acquired another company and made it a subsidiary.

311320.text: GO Element has a semiconductor division that supplies chip parts such as sputtering targets and canisters along with equipment solutions, and an appliance division that supplies heating elements and cooler parts. Founded in 2005, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 and acquired a stake in another company in 2024 to diversify its chip business. It is expanding overseas sales through agents in Japan, Taiwan and China and investing in ALD research.

311390.text: Neo Cremar makes microbiome-based functional food ingredients, including functional sugars and peptides, and says it has the world's first technology for producing organic galacto-oligosaccharides. Through a main subsidiary it also runs a materials business, including monofilaments and functional air filters, and a healthcare business in household and hygiene products. It was founded in 2007 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019.

311690.text: CJ Bioscience runs drug development, microbial genome analysis solutions and a health and wellness business built on its AI-based microbiome analysis platform, Ez-Mx. It pursues drug R&D and wellness as two tracks with a focus on profitability. Founded in 2009, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019 and has one unlisted subsidiary.

312610.text: A.F.W is a metal processing company that uses friction welding and die casting to make electrical components for eco-friendly vehicles. Its products include BCCMs for electric vehicles made with FSW, die-cast end plates and other metal parts such as axle shafts, and in 2026 it began supplying BCCMs and end plates through two customers. It was founded in 1998 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019.

313760.text: Carry develops, makes and sells power conversion devices, including induction heating inverters, ship water treatment equipment, direct-flow water purifier controllers and telecom battery packs. Founded in 2003, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019. It spun off its renewable energy unit as a subsidiary in 2024, which became an affiliate in 2025 after a third-party share issue reduced its stake.

314130.text: Genome is a drug development company founded in 2015 that listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020 as a technology growth company. It acquired control of a US microbiome CDMO in 2021 and develops microbiome therapies through its US subsidiary, along with ADC and immuno-oncology candidates from its drug discovery platform. It also sells microbiome-based cosmetics and health supplements.

314140.text: RPbio makes pharmaceuticals and health supplements in various forms for other companies on an OEM and ODM basis, building on soft capsule formulation technology. Its business traces back to a 1983 joint venture with US-based RP Scherer, and it began operating a health supplement plant in 2019. It was spun off in 2016, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022 and says it works with about 200 client companies.

314930.text: Biodyne develops, makes and sells liquid-based cytology equipment and cancer diagnostic kits, with a focus on cervical cancer diagnosis. It holds patents in Korea, Japan and the US for its in-house blowing technology and exports to 13 countries. It listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 and has granted a partner an exclusive license for a slide preparation device based on that technology, with the two pursuing global sales.

315640.text: Deepnoid is an artificial intelligence company founded in 2008 that listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 as a technology growth company. Its medical AI business offers diagnostic and reading support tools, such as brain aneurysm detection and lung disease diagnosis aids. Its industrial AI business provides deep-learning vision inspection and automated X-ray screening for hazardous items for aviation and corporate security.

316140.text: Woori Financial Group is a financial holding company established in 2019, tracing its roots to a bank founded in 1899. Its main subsidiary is Woori Bank, and its other units cover life insurance, credit cards, capital, securities, trusts, asset management and a savings bank.

317120.text: Ranix develops system semiconductors and solutions for wireless communication, security and authentication, with businesses in autonomous vehicles, automotive MCUs and smart life. It says it is the only company in the world that has both system semiconductors and solutions. Founded in 2003 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019, it is working to develop domestically made automotive MCUs and next-generation security technology.

317240.text: TS Trillion makes and sells functional cosmetics, mainly shampoos that relieve hair-loss symptoms and other hair care products, through a range of channels in Korea and abroad. It develops its own formulations based on natural ingredients and is working to diversify products and expand overseas. Founded in 2007, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020 and has 4 subsidiaries.

317330.text: Duksan Techopia makes intermediates for OLED light-emitting materials, deposition materials for semiconductors and additives for secondary batteries. It is preparing a polyimide monomer synthesis business and researching materials for 3D NAND with more stacked layers and finer chip processes. Founded in 2006, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019 and has 3 affiliates.

317400.text: Xi S&D is a construction and real estate services company affiliated with a construction company; it was founded in 2000 and listed on the KOSPI in 2019. It operates three segments: building work for advanced factories, data centers, clean rooms and chemical plants; housing development; and home solutions covering smart homes, after-sales service and property leasing. It is responding to data center demand from AI growth and expanding into eco-friendly plants.

317450.text: Myungin Pharm, founded in 1985 and incorporated in 1988, makes and sells prescription drugs specialised in central nervous system and psychiatric treatment, including drugs for stroke, Parkinson's disease, schizophrenia and depression. It also sells over-the-counter medicines such as a gum treatment and a laxative. It listed on the KOSPI in 2025.

317530.text: Episode is a content and media company founded in 2014 that listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019 as a technology growth company. It runs content, commerce and IP and management businesses, producing content to build original IP and running media commerce. It recently acquired three companies, bringing content planning and production, celebrity IP, brand operation and distribution under one roof.

317690.text: QuantaMatrix develops, makes and sells in vitro diagnostic devices and reagents for major general hospitals and testing labs in Korea and abroad. Its microbial diagnostics include dRAST, a rapid antimicrobial susceptibility test for sepsis patients, and QDST, a rapid anti-tuberculosis drug susceptibility test. Founded in 2010, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020 as a technology growth company and has one subsidiary.

317770.text: Xperix provides digital identity verification solutions, developing, making and selling fingerprint enrollment and authentication devices and passport readers. Its business consists of Biometric Solutions and eDocument Solutions, and it has strengthened its AI data capabilities by acquiring a stake in a company that is now a subsidiary. Founded in 2017, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019.

317830.text: SP Systems builds robotic automation manufacturing systems and develops and sells smart factory software, along with making industrial machinery and parts. Founded in 1988, it recently set up a joint venture in China, Jiangsu YuedaSP Intelligent System, and made it a subsidiary.

317850.text: Daemo Engineering makes excavator attachments such as hydraulic breakers, quick couplers and crushers, along with special boom arms and parts, and sells them worldwide. About 80% of its sales come from exports, and it has 4 overseas subsidiaries, including DAEMO EUROPE, DAEMO AMERICA and a unit in China. It was founded in 1989 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019.

317870.text: Envioneer develops, makes and sells components and materials using advanced wet-laid nonwoven technology. Its main products are positively charged high-performance nanofilters for water purification and ceramic paper that prevents thermal runaway in EVs and energy storage systems, and a membrane subsidiary makes gas separation membranes. Founded in 2001, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019 as a technology growth company.

318000.text: KBG researches, makes and sells silicone materials, including silane monomers, silicone polymers and silicone resins, for construction, electrical and electronics, mobility and other industries. It entered the silica aerogel insulation market by acquiring a company in July 2024. Founded in 2001, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019.

318010.text: Pharmsville develops, makes and sells health supplements and health-oriented foods through B2C e-commerce and other distribution platforms. It runs a subsidiary set up with a university technology holding company and a research institute company set up with a regional technology holding company. It was founded in 2000 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019.

318020.text: Point Mobile develops and makes barcode- and RFID-based industrial mobile computers, POS terminals and tablet PCs, with exports making up more than 85% of sales. All its products are Google AER certified, and it is expanding into RFID, specialised tablets and MC PTT devices for disaster networks. Founded in 2006, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020 and has unlisted subsidiaries.

318060.text: Graphy makes 3D printing materials and orthodontic solutions, using its own oligomer development and synthesis to create custom materials. It says it was the first in the world to commercialise shape-memory clear aligners that recover their shape in the mouth; they are 3D printed and sold with equipment, software and materials as an integrated solution. Founded in 2017, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

318160.text: Cell Bio Human Tech develops and makes eco-friendly fibre materials for sheet masks using cellulose molecular control technology, and also makes and sells hydrocolloid patches. It has a nonwoven fabric production unit in Vietnam and 4 affiliates, including cosmetics wholesale and beauty materials subsidiaries. Founded in 2015 to make fibres for cosmetics, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

318410.text: Best Bristle researches, makes and sells engineering plastic lines, rods, tubes and hoses, and supplies PBT monofilament for dental care, beauty care and industrial brushes. It also sells its own brands of toothbrushes and other household healthcare products and fashion goods through home shopping and online channels. Founded in 2008, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020.

319400.text: Hyundai Movex provides total logistics automation solutions to a range of industries and also designs, makes and installs platform screen doors and offers IT services. It is upgrading its solutions with AGVs and other robots and AI, supported by an R&D centre. Founded in 2011, it merged with a special purpose acquisition company in 2021 and added a subsidiary in 2024 through a stake acquisition.

319660.text: PSK makes front-end semiconductor manufacturing equipment such as Dry Strip and Dry Cleaning systems, and says it holds about 39% of the global Dry Strip equipment market. It was created in 2019 through a spin-off from its holding company and listed on the KOSDAQ the same year. It runs 5 overseas subsidiaries, including in the US, Taiwan and China, and 9 branches.

320000.text: HanWool Semiconductor makes machine vision inspection equipment, mainly inspection systems for the appearance, measurement and packaging of chip-type passive components, display bonder lines and copper foil film for secondary batteries. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020 through a merger with a special purpose acquisition company. Its subsidiaries include a craft beer maker and a maker of K-pop light sticks and lighting effects.

321260.text: Pro2000 makes OLED and LCD inspection equipment and probe cards for semiconductor testing, based on a film-type probe block patent it says is a world first. It acquired a signal generator business for OLEDoS and is entering the CIS and SoC markets while developing MEMS probe cards. Founded in 2006, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

321370.text: Sensorview develops high-speed RF connection products, including mmWave cables, connectors and antennas, for the defence, aviation and space industries as well as commercial telecoms and semiconductor testing. It is developing special connectors for vehicle electronics for autonomous and connected cars and working with a global telecom chip company to commercialise automotive products. Founded in 2015, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

321550.text: TiumBio researches and develops treatments for rare and intractable diseases, covering both small-molecule and biologic drugs. It was founded in 2016 by core researchers who had developed an FDA- and EMA-approved haemophilia treatment at a chemical company. It earns revenue by taking candidates from discovery through early clinical trials and then licensing them to global drugmakers.

321820.text: Artist focuses on entertainment management, content production and distribution, and advertising and marketing services, and is also developing commerce products and brands based on celebrity IP. It was founded in 2010 as an ad-tech platform business, added content production and distribution in 2024, and absorbed an entertainment company in 2025 to diversify.

322000.text: HD Hyundai Energy Solutions is a solar energy company in the HD Hyundai Group, founded in 2016 and listed on the KOSPI in 2019. It aims to be a total energy solution provider, covering everything from high-efficiency monocrystalline cells and modules to inverters, energy storage systems and system installation. It has a subsidiary, HD HYUNDAI ENERGY SOLUTIONS AMERICA.

322180.text: LS THiRA-UTECH provides total smart factory solutions, drawing on experience building unmanned automated factories for high-tech industries such as secondary batteries and semiconductors. Its subsidiaries make autonomous logistics robots with control solutions, and Cartesian robots and core factory automation parts. Founded in 2006 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019, it is expanding into power and automation through its largest shareholder, LS Electric.

322310.text: Auros Technology makes metrology and inspection equipment for front-end semiconductor processes. Its main product, overlay metrology equipment, precisely measures the alignment between stacked circuit patterns in lithography, and it says it was the first in Korea to develop it domestically, in 2011. Founded in 2009, it took its current name after a 2010 merger, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 and has 2 unlisted subsidiaries.

322510.text: JLK develops medical imaging analysis AI solutions, including MEDIHUB STROKE for stroke and Cancer Solution for precision cancer analysis. It has obtained 79 regulatory approvals in Korea and abroad and is expanding into the US and Japan through core technology development and global patent filings. Founded in 2014, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019.

322780.text: Copus Korea licenses dramas, entertainment shows and other content from Korean producers and broadcasters and supplies it to major Japanese broadcasters and streaming services. It strengthened its production capability by acquiring a production company in 2022 and has 4 subsidiaries, including a local unit in Japan. Founded in 2005, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020 through a merger with a special purpose acquisition company.

323280.text: Taesung develops, makes and sells automation equipment used in manufacturing PCBs, glass substrates and composite copper foil. Building on PCB process automation, it is expanding into equipment for glass substrates and secondary battery materials. Founded in 2006, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022 through a merger with a special purpose acquisition company and has 2 unlisted subsidiaries.

323350.text: Dawon Nexview applies advanced laser process technology to develop and make automation equipment for semiconductor testing and packaging. Based on its core LSMB technology, it sells pLSMB systems for ultra-precise bonding of probe card needles and sLSMB systems for micro solder ball bumping on chip packaging substrates. Founded in 2009 to make laser equipment, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024 as a technology growth company.

323410.text: KakaoBank is an internet-only bank founded in 2016 that received its banking licence in 2017. It offers deposits and savings, including group accounts and a 26-week savings product, loans such as emergency, credit and mortgage loans, and currency exchange and overseas remittance. It also runs a financial platform business and has launched AI-based services.

323990.text: Vaxcell-Bio Therapeutics develops cancer immunotherapies, with a pipeline that includes its NK cell-based Vax-NK platform, next-generation Vax-CAR immunotherapies and small-molecule targeted cancer drugs. It was founded in 2010, listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020 and completed a new headquarters and plant in 2025 as it builds commercial capabilities.

326030.text: SK Biopharmaceuticals develops new drugs for the central nervous system, especially epilepsy, and has launched its own epilepsy drug and a sleep disorder drug after US FDA approval. It sells directly in the US and has licensing deals covering Europe, China, Japan, Korea and other regions. It was spun off from the life science unit of SK in 2011 and listed on the KOSPI in 2020.

327260.text: RF Materials develops and makes compound semiconductor packages, including telecom packages for RF and optical communications, packages for laser modules and military packages used in infrared sensors. These packages must combine hermetic sealing, heat dissipation, low thermal expansion, electrical connection, heat resistance and durability. Founded in 2007, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2019.

328130.text: Lunit is a deep-learning medical AI company that provides reading support solutions for cancer screening images and solutions that predict response to immuno-oncology treatment. Its 2024 acquisition of Lunit International Ltd. laid the groundwork for an integrated platform covering the full breast cancer screening cycle, and it is expanding through partnerships and joint research with global companies. Founded in 2013, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

328380.text: Saltware is an AI and cloud company whose core business is cloud managed services for a broad client base spanning public institutions, universities, finance, manufacturing and startups. It has strategic partnerships with AWS, Red Hat and SailPoint, and it says it is the only KOSDAQ-listed AWS MSP in Korea. Founded in 2003, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

329180.text: HD Hyundai Heavy Industries builds ships, offshore plants and engines and machinery; shipbuilding, including merchant ships, LNG carriers and naval vessels, makes up 78% of sales. Its offshore plant business, 7% of sales, takes part in offshore wind and SMR projects. It was spun off in 2019, listed on the KOSPI in 2021, absorbed a group affiliate in 2025 to expand capacity and has 4 subsidiaries.

330350.text: Withus Pharmaceutical makes and sells prescription drugs for cardiovascular, musculoskeletal, digestive and central nervous system conditions, as well as antibiotics, targeting an ageing population and chronic diseases. It is strongest in cardiovascular drugs and has dedicated production lines for first- to third-generation cephalosporin antibiotics. Founded in 2004 under a different name, it adopted its current name in 2007 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020.

330590.text: Lotte Reit is a real estate investment company listed on the KOSPI. It invests in property and pays shareholders dividends from the income, rather than running an operating business.

330730.text: Stonebridge Ventures is a venture capital firm that makes equity investments in technology-rich but capital-short venture companies, providing funding and management services and recovering its money through mergers, acquisitions and listings. It manages 18 funds and is expanding strategic investment in the AI technology and applications value chain. It was spun off in 2017 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

330860.text: Nepes Ark provides back-end test solutions for system semiconductors such as power chips, display driver chips, SoCs and RF chips, covering wafer and package testing along with equipment rental. It was spun off from its parent's semiconductor test unit in 2019 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020. It is hiring key engineers and developing test programs to keep pace with denser and smaller chips.

331380.text: Focus Ai provides an AI physical security platform built on AI vision technology, offering AI cameras, NVRs, UVMS, video analytics and integrated control as a single stack; it says it is the only such company in Korea. Founded in 2012, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 through a SPAC merger and took its current name in 2025. In 2026 it bought a 42.50% stake in a Busan digital asset exchange.

331520.text: Valofe publishes and republishes PC online and mobile games, and runs local companies and game studios in Korea, China, Japan, Hong Kong, the Philippines and Taiwan. Founded in 2007 for software development and services, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022 through a merger with a special purpose acquisition company.

331740.text: Autocrypt, founded in 2019, provides automotive cybersecurity software that protects vehicles from hacking, developing products for in-vehicle systems and external communications. In V2X communication security, which covers wireless traffic and power communication networks, it supplies 6 product lines that apply its specialised cryptography to vehicle encryption and communication security.

331920.text: Celemics is an NGS-based genetic analysis technology company that uses next-generation cloning technology to make and sell Target Capture Kits and BTSeq solutions. It supplies diagnostic and drug development materials to hospitals, drugmakers and research institutes, and focuses on low-cost, high-volume molecular cloning by combining bio, nano and information technology. Founded in 2010, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020.

332290.text: Nousbo researches, makes and sells fertilisers and organic farming materials, with businesses in domestic agriculture, golf course landscaping and exports of agricultural foods and materials. It supplies dedicated fertilisers and pesticides to about 350 golf courses in Korea and exports organic green tea to 10 countries, including the US and European markets. Founded in 2007, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022 through a SPAC merger.

332370.text: IDP develops, makes and sells desktop card printers, peripheral equipment and consumables. Its card printers are specialised machines for issuing cards such as ID cards, driver's licences, financial cards and student cards. Founded in 2005, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020 and has one subsidiary.

332570.text: Pentastone Electronics is a wireless communication parts company with three businesses: RF FEM, automation equipment and servers. It supplies PAMs for mobile communications, smart factory solutions, and AI and HPC servers and data center infrastructure, and is expanding into higher-value 6G and automotive products and server ODM. Founded in 2006, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020.

333050.text: Innotena provides cloud, AI, big data and other solutions to corporate clients across manufacturing, finance, services and the public sector. It is expanding its digital transformation business and building global partnerships. Founded in 2007, it merged with a special purpose acquisition company in 2022 and took its current name in 2026.

333430.text: IL Seung makes and sells shipbuilding equipment across four segments: environmental equipment, shipbuilding LNG, pipe spools and materials. Its environmental equipment unit makes sewage treatment units and fresh water generators for ships, while the LNG and pipe spool units make key equipment. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 through a merger and has one subsidiary.

333620.text: Nsys makes machine vision inspection equipment for every stage of secondary battery production, from electrode, assembly and formation to module and pack processes, along with cell and module manufacturing equipment and defence mixing equipment, all built to order. It has overseas subsidiaries in Hungary and the US and a subsidiary for cylindrical cell assembly equipment. Founded in 2006, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

334890.text: IGIS Value Plus REIT is a real estate investment company listed on the KOSPI. It invests in property and pays shareholders dividends from the income, rather than running an operating business.

334970.text: Prestige Biologics is a CDMO that offers integrated process development, analytical testing and production of advanced biopharmaceuticals for drugmakers in Korea and abroad. It has 154,000L of mainly single-use production capacity and uses a modular strategy built on standard 2,000L bioreactors. Founded in 2015, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 and has 7 affiliates.

335810.text: Precision Biosensor is an in vitro diagnostics company that makes and sells immunodiagnostic and clinical chemistry products using time-resolved fluorescence technology. It was founded in 2009 under a different name, developed advanced optical analysis instruments and made another company a subsidiary in 2015. Its time-resolved fluorescence immunoassay platform is designed for urgent testing, and it seeks synergies with digital healthcare platforms.

335870.text: Wing's Foot distributes footwear through department stores, fashion outlets and e-commerce. It holds exclusive Korean licences for Italian and US brands, sells its own private-label brands and buys products from global brands to supply directly. Founded in 2007, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022 through a SPAC merger.

336060.text: Wavus provides integrated spatial information solutions, building and running public administration systems such as a national land information system, and offers several software products. It acquired a GIS business unit in 2023 and is investing in GeoAI research, including Geo-LLM and Vision AI. Founded in 2004, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

336260.text: Doosan Fuel Cell supplies fuel cell equipment for power generation and provides long-term maintenance services, and says it has the largest cumulative market share in Korea. Alongside PAFC it has SOFC technology, began mass production in 2025 and is working with a partner to diversify its technology and expand overseas. It was spun off in 2019 and added eco-friendly commercial vehicles in 2024 through a stake acquisition.

336370.text: Solus Advanced Materials was created in 2019 through a spin-off of its former parent's OLED, copper foil and bio units. Its businesses are battery foil, OLED and advanced materials, and it supplies battery foil to EV makers and battery cell makers in Europe, Asia and North America. It says it is Europe's only battery foil maker, with production in Hungary, and it is building a plant in Canada it says is North America's first.

336570.text: Won Tech researches, makes and sells energy-based medical devices, mainly aesthetic lasers, RF and HIFU devices, under names such as Picocare, Oligio and Tightan. It sells through distributors in Korea and abroad and exports to Asia, Europe, the Middle East and South America. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022 through a merger.

336680.text: Top Run Total Solution makes automotive electronics such as vehicle display backlight units, IVI and HUD systems, as well as IT parts including OLED and TV components. It runs production plants close to customers in China, Vietnam and elsewhere and uses fully automated in-line processes to secure quality. It listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024 and has two domestic subsidiaries.

337930.text: Xexymix is an R&D-based direct-to-consumer company whose main brand offers functional athleisure clothing and accessories for yoga, pilates, running, golf and other activities, making up about 95% of consolidated sales. It has subsidiaries in Japan, China and Taiwan, plus a digital advertising agency subsidiary that holds official agency rights for about 40 media outlets. Founded in 2017, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020.

338100.text: NH Prime REIT is a real estate investment company listed on the KOSPI. It invests in property and pays shareholders dividends from the income, rather than running an operating business.

338220.text: VUNO is a deep-learning medical AI company that analyses medical images and biosignals to provide solutions from diagnosis to prognosis prediction. It says its VUNO Med-BoneAge was Korea's first AI medical device, and it serves hospitals, device makers and consumers with a focus on subscription services. Founded in 2014, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 and is expanding in Japan, Europe, China and the US.

338840.text: Y-Biologics holds fully human antibody and nanobody libraries based on its Ymax-ABL platform, and its main business models are licensing antibody drugs and CRO services. It is developing 7 in-house pipeline candidates across modalities such as bispecific antibodies, ADCs and CAR-T/NK. Founded in 2007 for antibody drug research, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 as a technology growth company.

339770.text: Kyochon Food & Beverage, founded in 1999, runs a chicken franchise and supplies its domestic franchisees with raw materials such as chicken, sauces and frying oil. Abroad, it operates directly run stores in the US and China and has entered Malaysia, Indonesia and the Middle East through master franchises. It is also pursuing sauce manufacturing, craft beer, new restaurant brands and eco-friendly pulp mold packaging.

339950.text: Ibkimyoung is an education company offering university transfer exam preparation, beauty education for licences and admissions, and other programs such as credit-bank distance learning and national technical certification courses. Its transfer business includes an AI platform, its beauty business runs 25 branches, and its other programs include AI, big data and semiconductor job training. Founded in 2005, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020 and absorbed a transfer education company in 2026.

340360.text: Davolink develops, makes and sells telecom equipment such as APs, APCs and gateways, supplying home devices and enterprise and public-sector devices to Korean network carriers and specialised telecom operators. It was set up in 2019 as a special purpose acquisition company and listed on the KOSDAQ after completing a merger in 2021. It has one unlisted subsidiary.

340440.text: Serim B&G makes and sells plastic food packaging containers using vacuum-forming technology, as well as eco-friendly biodegradable films, including agricultural mulching films. It has launched products for online commerce and the growing delivery market and set up a robotics unit that supplies AI autonomous driving solutions. Founded in 2003, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 through a SPAC merger.

340450.text: GC Genome analyses clinical genomes, using personal genomic big data for early screening, prediction and personalised treatment of disease. Its testing services span four areas: obstetric, cancer, rare genetic disease and health screening, and it supplies genomic services to about 1,000 hospitals and clinics, including all 47 of Korea's tertiary general hospitals. Founded in 2013, it listed on the KOSDAQ in June 2025 as a technology growth company.

340570.text: T&L applies high-performance materials technology to medical products, making and selling wound dressings such as hydrocolloid and polyurethane foam dressings, microneedle patches and orthopaedic immobilisers. Wound dressings are its main business, and it also uses polymer technology to make microneedle and cosmetic products. Founded in 1998, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020 and has 4 unlisted subsidiaries.

340810.text: Secern Ai is an artificial intelligence company focused on vision AI, working on AI algorithm research, training data construction, AI solution development and dedicated hardware design. It has subsidiaries in robotics, system integration and fintech. Founded in 2010, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 as a technology growth company.

340930.text: Sungwon Ener Tech makes equipment for eco-friendly energy manufacturing, including notching, stacking and tab welding machines, key assembly tools for secondary batteries used in electric vehicles and energy storage systems. It also builds automated module and pack line equipment for battery modules and packs. Founded in 2012, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 and has 3 unlisted subsidiaries.

342870.text: OA sells small and mid-sized home appliances under its own brands and has expanded into health foods as it grows into a broad consumer goods company. Founded in 2014 under a different name, it adopted its current name in 2018 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025 through a merger with a special purpose acquisition company. It recently acquired a 60% stake in a newly established company, making it a subsidiary.

344820.text: KCC Glass operates glass, interiors and distribution, and concrete pile businesses. It was created in 2020 by a spin-off of the glass and interior units of KCC, and the same year absorbed another company, adding automotive safety glass and concrete piles. It merged with another company in 2022 to secure global raw material sourcing, and in 2024 began commercial production of architectural glass at its Indonesian unit.

344860.text: Innogene specialises in hair loss and skin regeneration, providing home care products, scalp care devices, health foods and medicines to hospitals and clinics in Korea and exporting to about 20 countries. Its hair loss symptom relief products come with IIT and DEDS systems, and it runs a skincare brand and is entering the anti-ageing inner beauty market. Founded in 2005, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 through a fast-track listing.

347000.text: Senko makes more than 80 types of electrochemical and optical infrared gas sensors and fine dust sensors, plus IoT-based indoor air quality monitors and atmospheric measuring equipment; it says it is Korea's only gas safety solution company of its kind. It has begun supplying gas detectors to a major chipmaker and is expanding into China and the US. Founded in 2004, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020.

347700.text: Sphere centres on a supply chain for special alloys for the space industry and also runs special minerals, digital AI healthcare, health supplement and smart medical device businesses. It set up a Singapore subsidiary, Sphere Nickel Cobalt Pte. Ltd., and in 2025 signed a deal to buy a 10% stake in Indonesia's ENC Project to secure raw materials. Founded in 2012, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 as a technology growth company.

347740.text: P&K Skin Research Center performs human application tests and in-vitro tests to verify the safety and efficacy of cosmetics, health supplements and beauty devices. It was founded in 2010 under an agreement with a medical school research institute, and it says it was the first such company in Korea founded by two doctors. It signed a technical cooperation MOU with BASF and is expanding its global network.

347770.text: PIMS designs, makes and sells metal masks used in OLED display deposition and encapsulation, covering common layer and RGB deposition and CVD encapsulation, and it says it holds the largest market share. It also offers a one-stop service that includes mask frames and CVD coating, backed by 32 patents and 3 utility models. It was founded in 2016.

347850.text: D&D Pharmatech researches and develops peptide-based drugs such as GLP-1 therapies, with a pipeline that includes oral obesity treatments and drugs for MASH, Parkinson's disease and Alzheimer's disease. It runs global clinical development through a US subsidiary and uses PEGylation technology and its ORALINK platform to discover and improve GLP-1 peptide drugs. Founded in 2014, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024 as a technology growth company.

347860.text: Alchera provides AI image recognition solutions in three areas: facial recognition, abnormal situation detection and AI training data production. Its facial recognition AI comes in on-premises and cloud versions for payment systems, mobile banking, immigration and public security, while its detection AI recognises spreading smoke to monitor wildfires from a distance. Founded in 2016, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020.

347890.text: MX On is a digital transformation company providing smart HMI, SCADA, devices and smart factory solutions, supplying integrated platforms to industries such as semiconductors and secondary batteries. It is preparing to launch a next-generation soft PLC, MuLiN, and has partnered with a global robotics company as it works toward becoming an AI autonomous manufacturing platform. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020.

348030.text: Mobirix develops and supplies mobile games, mainly casual and mid-core RPG titles; it has released more than 300 games worldwide and currently operates about 200. Its revenue comes from in-app purchases of in-game items and advertising through ad platforms. Founded in 2007, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

348080.text: Quratis is a biopharmaceutical R&D and manufacturing company with a platform that can handle every stage of development, from finding vaccine candidates to commercialisation. It is developing QTP101, a tuberculosis vaccine, QTP105, a schistosomiasis vaccine, and QTP104, an mRNA COVID-19 vaccine, and offers CMO and CDMO services from its own cGMP plant. Founded in 2016, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 as a technology growth company.

348150.text: KoBioLabs develops treatments and health supplements based on the human microbiome, building a pipeline for immune, metabolic and brain diseases on its own drug discovery platform. Its subsidiary is a health supplement company set up in 2022 as a joint investment with another company. Founded in 2014, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020.

348210.text: Nextin makes wafer inspection equipment for front-end semiconductor processes and says its combined tools, based on 2D imaging technology it describes as unique in the world, match KLA equipment in performance. It says it is the only Korean small or mid-sized company with a research centre in Israel. Founded in 2010 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020, it is commercialising KROKY to meet HBM demand.

348340.text: Neuromeka is a robotics company that develops its own robot control software and hardware; robots make up 55.5% of sales and automation solutions 44.1%. It is bringing core parts and AI technology in-house as it grows as a physical AI-based robot automation company. Founded in 2013, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022 as a technology growth company.

348350.text: Withtech has ultra-precise technology for measuring contaminants in semiconductor and display clean rooms and supplies AMC monitoring systems to major Korean chipmakers. It holds 79 patents in measurement and analysis, monitoring and contamination control, and is pursuing new businesses such as a mobile lab for analysing radioactive waste from nuclear plant decommissioning. It was founded in 2003.

348370.text: Enchem makes electrolytes for secondary batteries used in electric vehicles, energy storage systems and mobile devices, supplying global battery makers. It has built supply systems in Korea, China, the US and Europe and is diversifying and integrating vertically into areas such as waste NMP recycling and CNT conductive materials. Founded in 2012, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

348950.text: JR Global Reit is a real estate investment company listed on the KOSPI. It invests in property and pays shareholders dividends from the income, rather than running an operating business.

350520.text: Igis Residence Reit is a real estate investment company listed on the KOSPI. It invests in property and pays shareholders dividends from the income, rather than running an operating business.

351320.text: Nexa Dynamics develops and makes FPD bonding and inspection systems for display panel production, including TAB bonders, PCB bonders and AOI inspection systems, replacing imported equipment with domestic products. It also runs logistics automation and cosmetics distribution businesses. Founded in 2004, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 through a merger with a special purpose acquisition company.

351330.text: Isaac Engineering supplies smart factory solutions, including industrial automation, digital factory solutions and industrial IoT platforms, along with related electronic parts. Its customers span manufacturing industries such as semiconductors, steel, heavy industry, pharmaceuticals, bio and secondary batteries. Founded in 2006, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 and has 4 unlisted subsidiaries.

351870.text: Chai Communication is an independent digital advertising agency providing integrated marketing services such as digital brand campaigns, performance marketing and content production, and is expanding into TV advertising and online and offline campaigns. In 2025 it acquired a subsidiary that handles marketing for medical institutions and sells medical devices and cosmetics. Founded in 2004, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

352090.text: Stormtec develops and makes key parts for home water purifiers, such as fittings, valves, safety faucets and tubing assemblies, and supplies major Korean water purifier makers. Through a subsidiary it also makes printed circuit boards for electronic and telecom equipment. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.
