352480.text: C&C International is a colour cosmetics maker that works only on an ODM basis, producing lip, base and eye makeup products. It started with eye pencils and began developing lipsticks and lip tints in 2013, and it says it has become Korea's strongest maker of lip products. Founded in 1997, it became a corporation in 2013 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

352700.text: Cntus uses high-performance MB filter technology, vertically integrated from materials to finished products, to run air and water solutions and a workwear brand. It operates 5 production centres in Korea and one in Vietnam, with 5 subsidiaries and further second-tier subsidiaries. Founded in 2003, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 and took its current name in 2022.

352770.text: Celestra is a genome-based bio-health company with four core businesses: genome-based healthcare, a liquid biopsy platform, cancer diagnosis and monitoring, and multi-omics-based early diagnosis. Through its own bio big data centre it developed standard genome data for Koreans that was registered as a national standard. Founded in 2011, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020, and its subsidiaries include CLINOMICS USA.

352820.text: HYBE is an entertainment company that runs 17 independent labels in Korea, Japan, the US and elsewhere, developing global artists through its domestic labels and overseas units. It operates in three areas, music, platform and tech-based future growth, with revenue from albums and digital music, concerts, merchandise and licensing, and content. Founded in 2005, it listed on the KOSPI in 2020.

352910.text: Obigo is a mobility AX platform company focused on AI content, AI car care and physical AI solutions, supplying IVI platforms and an AI content platform to global carmakers. It is applying its browser engine technology beyond mobility to AI transformation in power, robotics and smart factories. Founded in 2003, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

352940.text: Enbio makes and sells fungicides, insecticides, herbicides and fertilisers, including an eco-friendly sulphur-based crop protection product and a broad-spectrum insecticide. It sells through agricultural cooperatives and through regional wholesalers and retailers served by its 10 branches in Korea. Founded in 1997 to make pesticides, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020.

353190.text: Hurum makes and distributes health supplements and probiotic products and also distributes ingredients for cafes; its main products include a premium probiotic and a plant-based energy product. Its main subsidiaries develop and make medical devices and sell health foods online. Founded in 2005, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 through a merger with a special purpose acquisition company.

353200.text: Daeduck Electronics makes PCBs, mainly semiconductor package substrates and MLBs, including FCBGA and FCCSP substrates for memory and non-memory chips and MLBs for AI servers and networking, and supplies major Korean chipmakers. It has developed high-speed, high-capacity and ultra-thin board technology for AI servers, data centers and autonomous driving. It was created in 2020 through a spin-off and set up a Canadian unit in 2026.

353590.text: AUTO is a mobility platform company that started in 2012 as an in-house venture of a carmaker group and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022. Its integrated platform links the automotive before-market and aftermarket through its A2B, e-commerce and SPACE ZONE platforms. A2B supplies new-car options and vehicle care goods for car brands, while its e-commerce business runs O2O and carmaker partnership commerce models.

353810.text: Easy Bio makes compound feed and feed additives and develops and makes antibiotic alternatives based on biotechnology such as fermentation and enzyme engineering. It was created in 2020 through a spin-off from its holding company and relisted on the KOSDAQ in June that year. It has 11 subsidiaries and recently expanded by acquiring stakes in BioMartrix, Inc and NUTRIBINS, PBC.

354200.text: NGeneBio supplies NGS-based precision diagnostic panels and genomic analysis software, and also distributes medicines and health supplements to large pharmacies near hospitals. It took on drug distribution directly after a 2026 merger, and its subsidiaries include TOPLAB in the US. Founded in 2015, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020 as a technology growth company.

354320.text: Almac is an aluminium extrusion company focused on extruded aluminium parts for electric vehicles. It says it is the only tier-one supplier to GM Korea and another carmaker with its own production chain covering aluminium casting, extrusion, machining, assembly and surface treatment. Founded in 2001 under a different name, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023, has 3 subsidiaries and became a mid-sized company in April 2026.

355150.text: Kostecsys makes materials and components for semiconductor packaging, including packages for RF communications, aerospace, optical communications and lasers, thermal solutions for power semiconductors and a high-heat-dissipation metal-ceramic package platform. It has developed its KCMC material platform based on a molybdenum and copper composite structure and is adding products such as block bonding parts. It listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

355390.text: CrowdWorks runs AI, data and academy businesses, building high-quality data, developing custom AI agents with its agentic AI solution Alpy and offering model evaluation. Its subsidiaries include CWJ, a Japanese unit, and an academy business. Founded in 2017 for AI data and solutions, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

355690.text: Atum makes planar transformers, using its core technology to produce small, high-efficiency and high-output transformers for portable chargers, TVs, electric vehicle parts and other uses. Its subsidiaries include a production base in Vietnam, an electronic parts distributor handling MLCCs and a maker of ship and industrial machinery parts. Founded in 2015, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 as a technology growth company.

356680.text: Axgate makes and sells network security products such as VPN, firewall and UTM systems, supplying its AXGATE Series appliances running its own software. It also provides 24-hour security monitoring services. Founded in 2010, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 through a merger.

356860.text: TLB makes PCBs for memory modules and SSDs, and its major customers are global chipmakers. It entered PCBs for back-end chip test equipment in 2020 and obtained AS9100 and ISO27001 certification in 2025 to broaden the industries it serves. Founded in 2011, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020 and runs a local plant through its Vietnamese unit.

356890.text: CyberOne is an information security company offering security monitoring, security consulting, smart systems, security solutions and cloud services. It is government-designated as a specialised security monitoring company and information protection service provider. Founded in 2005, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 and added a security solution developer as a subsidiary in 2023.

357120.text: Koramco Life Infra Reit is a real estate investment company listed on the KOSPI. It invests in property and pays shareholders dividends from the income, rather than running an operating business.

357230.text: H.PIO develops, makes and sells health supplements, and brought production in-house by acquiring a supplement manufacturer in 2019. It expanded into a junior life business through acquisitions in 2021 and 2023, and entered beauty in August 2025 by acquiring a dermocosmetic brand company. Founded in 2012, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

357250.text: Miraeasset Maps REIT 1 is a real estate investment company listed on the KOSPI. It invests in property and pays shareholders dividends from the income, rather than running an operating business.

357430.text: Mastern Premier Reit 1 is a real estate investment company listed on the KOSPI. It invests in property and pays shareholders dividends from the income, rather than running an operating business.

357550.text: Sukgyung AT makes and sells functional nanomaterials for biohealthcare, electrical and electronics, and coatings, as well as low-dielectric materials for 5G and 6G substrates. It runs 3 production sites in Korea, including one at its head office, and serves overseas markets through its Japanese unit, SG JAPAN. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020 through a technology-based special listing.

357580.text: Amosense makes materials and components in three segments, materials, modules, and devices and platforms, producing wireless charging shielding sheets, SOFC ceramic substrates, wireless charging modules, automotive modules and IoT devices. Using its ceramic mixing and sintering skills, it is developing SOFC electrolyte substrates and Si3N4 substrates for EVs and expanding into automotive and robotics uses. Founded in 2008, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

357780.text: Soulbrain makes chemical materials for semiconductor and display processes and secondary battery materials, supplying major Korean manufacturers. It was created in 2020 by a spin-off from Soulbrain Holdings and listed on the KOSDAQ the same year. It recently raised its stake in another company to make it a subsidiary and set up a new company.

357880.text: SKAI worldwide researches graph database technology and develops products, supplying AX solutions based on database and ontology technology. It is developing an AI agent, sells graph DB software and provides hardware infrastructure maintenance. Founded in 2013 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021, it named AI advertising, AI solutions and AI e-commerce as new growth engines in 2025.

358570.text: GI Innovation develops new drugs based on fusion proteins, with a pipeline that includes the immuno-oncology candidates GI-101 and GI-102, the allergy treatment GI-301 and the metabolic immuno-oncology candidate GI-108. Its GI-SMART platform enables early discovery of dual fusion proteins, and it has made large licensing deals with a Chinese company and a Korean company. Founded in 2017, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

359090.text: C&R Research is a contract research organisation that runs clinical trials for regulatory approval and other purposes for drugmakers and biotech ventures, offering full-scope services including consulting, monitoring and statistical analysis; it says it was Korea's first CRO. Its units include a sample analysis lab and a clinical imaging platform, and it uses its own IT solution for CDISC-standard data management. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

360070.text: Top Material supplies secondary battery materials, parts and equipment, providing system engineering and electrode material manufacturing along with custom consulting and turnkey projects for global companies. It set up a US subsidiary, built a new cathode material plant in Korea and moved its electrode plant equipment to the new site. Founded in 2012, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

360350.text: Coxem makes and sells scanning electron microscopes for nanoscale analysis, along with compact tabletop SEMs and sample preparation equipment, and is preparing to commercialise an SEM combined with ion milling. It sells directly and through dealers in Korea, and exports to 41 countries through 20 overseas agents. Founded in 2007, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

361390.text: Genohco develops and makes communication products for aerospace and defence, including avionics for the KF-21 and the LAH light armed helicopter and payloads, buses and ground station products for low-orbit satellites, as domestic alternatives. It is now a subsidiary of a Korean aerospace company. Founded in 2004, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

361570.text: RBW is a K-pop content company with music and copyright, management, concert and broadcast production and idol merchandise businesses. Founded in 2010 for broadcast and music production and entertainment management, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021. It has 4 consolidated subsidiaries, one of which moved from affiliate to subsidiary following a spin-off.

361610.text: SK ie technology makes lithium-ion battery separators (LiBS), a key battery material that keeps the cathode and anode apart while letting lithium ions pass, improving battery safety. It was spun off from SK Innovation in 2019 and listed on the KOSPI in 2021. It has a Polish subsidiary and is selling its Chinese subsidiary to streamline production.

361670.text: Samyoung S&C makes environmental, energy efficiency and health sensors and applications, handling everything from material synthesis and MEMS chip processing to mass production of its HumiChip chip-type temperature and humidity sensor. It is expanding into automotive pressure sensors and combined sensor modules, and supplies dew point meters for EV battery dry rooms. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

362320.text: Chungdam Global is an e-commerce company that distributes beauty and life products globally as a one-stop solution and runs an S2C business centred on live commerce. It has built TDMS, a platform that uses big-data-based AI algorithms to connect brands with influencers, and owns a filler and botulinum toxin distributor and maker. Founded in 2017, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

362990.text: Dreaminsight is an online advertising agency that handles everything from ad planning and production to placement on online platforms and follow-up management. In 2024 it set up a D2C commerce subsidiary and an entertainment management and YouTube content subsidiary, and in 2025 it established a Singapore unit to expand overseas. Founded in 2012, it listed on the KOSDAQ in January 2024.

363250.text: Genesystem makes point-of-care molecular diagnostic platforms based on rapid PCR technology, with products including diagnostic systems, biochips, test kits and reagents. It supplies its compact, lightweight equipment together with diagnostic kits to customers in Europe, Asia and other overseas markets. Founded in 2010, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 as a technology growth company and recently invested in a wind power company that became a subsidiary.

363260.text: Mobidays provides performance marketing and media rep services, offering full-stack ad and data technology solutions. It has 5 subsidiaries and acquired a K-pop content company in 2023. Founded in 2014 for online advertising, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022 through a merger with a special purpose acquisition company.

363280.text: TY Holdings is a pure holding company created in 2020 through a spin-off from a construction company, managing and investing in its subsidiaries. Its main subsidiaries include the broadcaster SBS and a construction company, and its businesses span broadcasting, leisure through a golf course, construction, logistics and other areas.

364950.text: AI Korea supplies central electrolyte supply systems (CESS), process piping and fire protection equipment for secondary battery production lines. Its main customers are Korea's three major battery makers, and it is expanding overseas, mainly in North America, based on early mass production experience and custom equipment design. Founded in 2014, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025 through a SPAC merger.

365270.text: curacle is a biotech venture developing treatments that normalise endothelial dysfunction to address the root cause of various intractable diseases. It is building a pipeline of first-in-class or best-in-class drug candidates based on its chemical drug platform and its biologics platform. Founded in 2016, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 under the technology growth company track.

365330.text: SY Steel Tech makes and sells deck plates that replace plywood formwork, and also provides construction work and floor sound insulation materials. It holds a number of patents and design rights. Founded in 2015, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 and recently added an energy company as a subsidiary.

365340.text: SungEel HiTech recycles lithium secondary batteries from electric vehicles, phones, laptops, energy storage systems and power tools, extracting valuable metals to produce cathode base materials such as cobalt sulphate, nickel sulphate and lithium carbonate. It was spun off from its parent's battery recycling unit in 2017 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022. It has 10 unlisted subsidiaries.

365550.text: ESR Kendall Square REIT is a real estate investment company listed on the KOSPI. It invests in property and pays shareholders dividends from the income, rather than running an operating business.

365590.text: HiDeep is a fabless semiconductor company that provides complete solutions for mobile device UX/UI, covering chips, algorithms, sensors and styluses. It targets global markets for smartphones, smartwatches, tablets, laptops and pen technology applications. Founded in 2010, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022 through a merger with a special purpose acquisition company.

365660.text: Lemon Healthcare develops medical information software built on LDB, its real-time two-way platform for relaying personal medical data. The platform supports smart hospital services, private health insurance claims and the distribution and use of medical data, and has separate modules for smart hospitals (LDB-H), a medical data ecosystem (LDB-E) and customised health data (LDB-D). Founded in 2017, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2026.

365900.text: VC develops, makes and sells golf rangefinders, launch monitors and golf simulators, and runs its global business through overseas sales subsidiaries and a domestic subsidiary. It also operates indoor golf practice ranges and develops golf-related software. Founded in 2005 to make semiconductors and components, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

366030.text: Nine is a plus-size women's clothing company that sells its own brands of plus-size apparel, innerwear, accessories and fitness wear directly to consumers through online shopping malls. It has overseas subsidiaries in China, Japan and Taiwan and is preparing to launch a Danish children's brand. Founded in 2006, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

367000.text: Plateer is an enterprise B2B company providing vertical AI and digital transformation solutions. Drawing on 20 years of designing and running business systems in areas such as e-commerce and marketing, it runs four businesses including Enterprise AX, AI CX and Intelligent DX, and is expanding into finance, the public sector and defence. Founded in 2005, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

368600.text: ICH makes eco-friendly patterned advanced and circuit materials, handling everything from adhesive materials and raw material development to finished products. Its businesses span basic, composite and advanced materials, and it has subsidiaries in Vietnam and India. Founded in 2012, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022, and in 2023 it acquired another company's polyurethane business to integrate vertically.

368770.text: Fiberpro specialises in fibre-optic sensors and precision optics, supplying high-performance optical sensor solutions for optical communications, sensing, navigation, defence, energy and infrastructure monitoring. It has set up a US subsidiary, FIBERPRO AMERICA, INC., to expand its global business. Founded in 1997, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022 through a merger with a special purpose acquisition company.

368970.text: OSP makes pet food, mainly dry food on an ODM basis, and holds USDA-NOP and Korean organic certifications for its organic pet food. Through a subsidiary it produces a range of feeds and treats and has built distribution channels in Korea and overseas. Founded in 2004 as a paper packaging maker, it moved into pet food in 2011 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

369370.text: Blitzway Entertainment is a content company whose main businesses are artist management, including K-POP artists, drama production, and the development and production of figures. It is expanding into Japan and North America through its subsidiaries BLITZWAY JAPAN CO., LTD. and BLITZWAY USA, INC. Founded in 2010, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 after merging with a special purpose acquisition company.

370090.text: Furonteer makes automation equipment related to camera modules. Its equipment division develops and sells assembly and inspection equipment for automotive cameras, while its parts division, created through a 2018 merger, offers industrial PCs, LED light sources for inspection and automation components. Founded in 2009, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022 as a technology growth company.

371950.text: Poongwon Precision makes display components using thin metal sheet processing technology, and its main product today is open metal masks used in AMOLED production. It says it has supplied about 180 companies over 29 years and has developed high-resolution FMM in Korea using INVAR thin metal and etching technology. Founded in 1996, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

372170.text: Yunsung F&C makes mixing equipment and systems that blend raw materials for secondary batteries, concentrating its sales on batteries as demand grows from EVs, ESS and smartphones. The company says that in 2012 it co-developed with a battery maker the world's first and largest-capacity PD MIXER 1300L and 2300L, bringing its main mixer into mass production. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

372320.text: Curocell develops CAR-T therapies, which genetically modify human immune cells to strengthen their ability to kill cancer cells, and handles research, clinical trials, production and commercialisation. Its OVIS CAR-T technology is designed to combine the advantages of CAR-T therapy and immune checkpoint inhibitors. It plans to produce and sell in Korea and license its technology abroad; founded in 2016, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 as a technology growth company.

372800.text: Iteyes is an IT company specialising in IT compliance and regulatory response for the financial sector, founded in 2012 to enter the fintech market. It has expanded from financial IT compliance and AI and big data services into cloud-based digital platforms for the public sector, healthcare and agri-life sciences. Its newer businesses include the vertical AI engine GENAI, medical MyData and a remote AI medical consultation platform.

372910.text: Hancom Lifecare makes self-contained breathing apparatus, gas masks for general and military use and special-purpose protective clothing, and carries out defence projects. It supplies safety equipment for firefighters, the military and police to government and to chemical and heavy industry sites. The company says it holds more than 90% of the firefighting breathing apparatus market; founded in 1971 and incorporated in 1996, it listed on the KOSPI in 2021.

373110.text: Xcell Therapeutics specialises in cell and gene therapy, and its main product line is third-generation chemically defined culture media for mesenchymal stem cells, dermal papilla cells and exosomes. It is extending its pipeline to media for NK cells, T cells and iPSCs. Founded in 2015, it supplies products in Korea and abroad from its own GMP facility and is repositioning itself as a CGT total solution provider.

373160.text: Day1 plans, develops and distributes learning content for adults, with its business divided by customer type into B2C, B2B, B2G2C and global operations. In January 2026 it acquired a 70% stake in another company, making it a subsidiary, and it now has 6 unlisted subsidiaries. Founded in 2017 to develop education content, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

373170.text: Micube Solution is a software company that integrates manufacturing-floor information and makes it intelligent, offering smart factory solutions and a digital transformation platform. It computerises and automates operations in industries such as electrical and electronics, semiconductors and secondary batteries, providing everything from consulting to system building and operating services. Founded in 2005, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

373200.text: Xplus makes and sells accessories for mobile IT devices, with mobile accessories that use intellectual property as its signature products. Founded in 2005 under a different name, it merged with a special purpose acquisition company in 2022 and adopted its current name in 2024. It is expanding its business by acquiring a stake in a cosmetics company, which it has made a subsidiary.

373220.text: LG Energy Solution is a secondary battery company spun off from LG Chem in 2020. It researches, develops, makes and sells batteries for EVs, ESS, IT devices, power tools and LEVs, operating as a single energy solution segment. It has 25 subsidiaries in Korea and abroad and production, sales and R&D bases in major locations including the United States, Poland and China.

375500.text: DL E&C is a general construction company and DL Group affiliate, created in 2021 when DL Inc. spun off its construction business. Housing makes up 55.6% of its business, plants 31.0% and civil engineering 13.3%, covering apartment brands, refining, gas and petrochemical EPC projects, and roads, bridges and railways. It has 15 subsidiaries, including 9 overseas units.

376180.text: picogram develops and sells water purifiers and filters and produces filter assemblies, and the company says it was the first in Korea to commercialise a one-touch connecting filter. It moved into cosmetics manufacturing in 2023 to expand sales in Southeast Asia and began mass-producing a food waste processor in 2024. Founded in 2002, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 and set up US operations in 2026 to target North America.

376270.text: HEM Pharma uses PMAS, its gut microbiome simulation technology, to run microbiome-based personalised healthcare, an LBP discovery platform and a cosmetics business. In 2025 it acquired Logme, making it a subsidiary, and set up a Japanese unit, HEM Pharma Japan. Founded in 2016 for research and development in physics, chemistry and biology, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

376290.text: Cu Tech makes FPCA driver boards, including PCA and RFPCA, used in smartphone displays, touchscreens and camera modules. It has consolidated subsidiaries in China and Vietnam and completed a small-scale merger with another company in July 2025. Founded in 2004 to make and sell electronic parts for mobile phones, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

376300.text: Dear U runs DearU bubble, a paid messenger-based platform launched in 2020 on which artists and fans exchange private one-to-one messages. The company says it has the most artist IP among fandom platforms, with K-POP and C-POP artists on the service. Founded in 2017 for a mobile karaoke service, it merged with another company in 2019 to apply messenger technology to entertainment.

376900.text: Rokit Healthcare is a regenerative medicine company whose AI-based, patient-specific organ regeneration platform covers skin, cartilage and kidney regeneration, with the skin regeneration platform already commercialised. The platform combines AI-based automatic modelling of the affected area with 3D bioprinting. Founded in 2012, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025 as a technology growth company and has 3 unlisted subsidiaries.

376930.text: Noul is a healthcare solutions company combining medical AI, biotechnology and on-device AI. Its main product, miLab, is an AI diagnostic lab solution that the company says is a global first, enabling malaria diagnosis, peripheral blood smear tests and cervical cell analysis where diagnostic infrastructure is limited. Founded in 2015, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022 and has registered products in several regions based on EU CE certification.

376980.text: Wanted Lab is an AI-based HR technology company. Its recruitment AI engine, trained on matching data, predicts document screening results, searches for candidates and makes automatic recommendations, and its AX platform offers comprehensive HR solutions. It has set up a Japanese subsidiary and works with government and educational institutions; founded in 2015, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

377030.text: Bitmax runs AR, VR and XR platform businesses, holds crypto assets such as bitcoin as a strategy, and builds and operates MES, PLM and MIS systems for large electronics manufacturers. It created its SI division by absorbing another company in 2025, and its subsidiaries include a performance and event planning company and GameClub Inc, a game services company set up in 2025. Founded in 2010, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

377190.text: D&D Platform REIT is a real estate investment company listed on the KOSPI. It invests in property and pays shareholders dividends from the income, rather than running an operating business.

377220.text: From Bio makes health functional foods and general foods, covering the whole process from sourcing ingredients to product development, manufacturing and distribution, and holds individually approved functional ingredients. It is developing cell culture and cryopreservation products and conducting stem cell research, and is pushing into cosmetics through a separate entity. Founded in 2006, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

377300.text: KakaoPay was set up in 2017 when Kakao contributed its fintech business in kind, and it listed on the KOSPI in 2021. It offers payment services, financial services such as loan comparison, investment and insurance, and platform services including advertising, card recommendations and telecom brokerage. The company says it launched Korea's first simple payment service in 2014, and its subsidiaries include securities and non-life insurance units.

377330.text: Egtronics develops and produces power conversion equipment, including converters, inverters and on-board chargers for electric and hydrogen vehicles, rectifiers for telecoms and power converters for defence. It supplies carmakers and telecom and defence companies in Korea and abroad, and is expanding into EV chargers and renewable energy. Founded in 2008, it invested in other companies and widened its global business base in 2023.

377450.text: Refine specialises in real estate title investigation, applying it to lending and guarantee products such as rental deposit loans, mortgage loans and deposit return guarantees. The company says it was the first in Korea to create an RPA-based real estate finance business model. It works under agreements with 8 title insurers in Korea and abroad; founded in 2002, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

377460.text: Q Aid sells home appliances online and offline, provides transport and installation logistics, and handles after-sales service on behalf of brands such as Apple and Electrolux. Founded in 2015, it merged with an electronics service company in 2019 and adopted its current name in 2026. It aims to become a home appliance specialist and has started its own-brand business with AIDON and Quming products.

377480.text: Maum.ai is an artificial intelligence company with 3 subsidiaries. Its Agent AI business builds AI platforms that automate customer consultation and other work, while its Physical AI business develops and supplies intelligent systems such as autonomous vehicles and robots. The company says it has completed VLA technology using four foundation models; founded in 2014, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

377740.text: BioNote makes diagnostic kits and equipment for animal diseases, supplying diagnostic reagents made with recombinant antigen and antibody technology. It focuses on immunochemistry, point-of-care molecular, biochemistry and hematology diagnostics, and is expanding into semi-finished products and raw materials for human in vitro diagnostics. The company says it has Korea's only BL-3 research facility, and it distributes in about 80 countries; it was founded in 2003.

378340.text: Philenergy makes secondary battery equipment, including stacking machines, laser notching machines and winders for 46XX batteries, based on its own laser processing and precision control technology. It has supplied laser notching equipment for mass production since 2015 and is strengthening its all-solid-state battery process technology. It was spun off from another company in 2020 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

378800.text: Shaperon is a biotech company developing new drugs based on inflammasome regulation. The company says it has the world's first GPCR19-targeted inflammasome inhibitor, along with a nanobody antibody platform, and it earns revenue mainly from upfront and milestone payments on technology licensing. It also runs an AI drug design platform, AIDEN, and is moving into anti-ageing cosmetics; founded in 2008, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

378850.text: Hwaseung R&A makes and sells rubber parts for cars as its single business, with sealing products and fluid products as its main lines. It was created in 2021 when Hwaseung Corporation spun off its auto parts business, and it runs two plants in Korea, one of them in Sejong. Its main customers are carmakers including Korean automakers, GM and Volkswagen.

380540.text: OptiCore develops, produces and sells optical transceivers, optical multiplexers and related components for telecom access networks, based on optical communication laser and systems technology. It is expanding into making and selling screen doors and factory automation equipment, and it has set up a new subsidiary. Founded in 2016, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022 through a merger with a special purpose acquisition company.

380550.text: Neurophet develops AI solutions for brain diseases, using deep learning-based brain image analysis for the diagnosis, treatment planning and therapeutic devices for neurodegenerative conditions such as Alzheimer's disease. Its main products include Neurophet AQUA, MRI-based software that supports diagnosis of degenerative brain disease, and Neurophet SCALE PET, software for quantitative analysis of PET images. Founded in 2016, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

381620.text: Zenix Robotics develops and supplies automated material handling systems (AMHS) for industries such as semiconductors, displays, secondary batteries and cars, with stockers and AGV/AMR as its main products. The company says it was the first in Korea to produce laser-guided AGVs domestically, and it has developed SLAM-based AMRs. Founded in 2010, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

381970.text: KG Mobility Platform runs a used-car business that buys vehicles directly and sells them itself, and the company says it is Korea's largest direct-operated used-car platform. It serves customers through 48 branches nationwide and an online home-delivery car buying service, with used-car operations split into OMO retail and auctions. It also rents out new and used cars short and long term; founded in 2017, it listed on the KOSPI in 2021.

382150.text: Oncocross is an AI-based drug development platform company. The company says it was the first in Korea to use AI to analyse changes in gene expression data and match diseases with the best-fitting treatments, through its RAPTOR AI platform, which it provides to drug makers. It has built a value chain from multi-omics data generation to AI drug development; founded in 2015, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

382480.text: G.I.Tech makes slot dies and slit nozzles and provides repair services for them. Its 2025 merger with another company combined ultra-precision parts with machine vision solutions, and it offers customised inspection solutions through RAVID AI. Building on its slot die technology, it is developing electrode coating equipment for hydrogen vehicles and pursuing overseas markets; founded in 2012, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

382800.text: GnBS eco develops and supplies eco-friendly process equipment that treats harmful gases and dust from semiconductor, solar, display and power plant operations, including scrubbers, powder traps, plasma white plume removal units and De-NoX & E.P systems. It supplies large chipmakers in Korea and abroad and is discussing overseas orders with foreign partners. Founded in 2005, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

382840.text: Onejoon provides heat treatment solutions for producing advanced materials, building and delivering kilns (RHK, PK) used to make cathode and anode materials for secondary batteries. It also offers EPC turnkey solutions covering the entire materials production process. Founded in 2008, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 and has set up affiliates in Germany, China, the United States, Poland and Canada.

382900.text: Bumhan Fuel Cell makes fuel cell modules for submarines and fuel cells for buildings, and runs hydrogen refuelling stations. The company says its submarine fuel cell was the second in the world to be commercialised, and it is the exclusive supplier to a navy submarine programme. Spun off from its parent in 2019, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022 and is developing marine, hydrogen bus, SOFC and SOEC fuel cells.

383220.text: F&F makes and sells apparel under the licensed brands MLB and DISCOVERY and its own brand DUVETICA, among others. It sells through department stores, duty-free shops, street stores and online channels in Korea, and has 7 subsidiaries, including FNF HONGKONG LIMITED. It was created in 2021 when its holding company spun off the fashion business, and it listed on the KOSPI the same year.

383310.text: Ecopro HN makes chemical filters that remove harmful gases in semiconductor and display production, and provides greenhouse gas reduction, fine dust reduction and industrial water treatment solutions. Covering everything from environmental materials to plant engineering, it is diversifying into advanced materials fields such as semiconductor processes and battery materials. It was created in 2021 when Ecopro spun off its environmental business, and it has 2 unlisted subsidiaries.

383800.text: LX Holdings is a pure holding company founded in 2021 with 6 domestic subsidiaries, including LX International. Its main income comes from subsidiary dividends, fees for use of the LX brand and rent, after it bought an office building in Seoul in 2025. Its subsidiaries work in commodity trading, building plastics manufacturing, and system semiconductor design and manufacturing.

383930.text: DT & Cro is a contract research organisation founded in 2017 that provides non-clinical and clinical trial services for drugs, medical devices and health functional foods. Its services cover the full drug development cycle, from efficacy, PK and GLP toxicity studies to bioequivalence studies and phase 1 to 4 clinical trials. It is building AI-based prediction models and a hybrid evaluation system and expanding into alternatives to animal testing.

384470.text: Coreline Soft develops and sells AVIEW, AI-based 3D medical image analysis software that supports diagnosis from CT scans. Its main products, AVIEW LCS, AVIEW COPD and AVIEW CAC, support diagnosis of lung cancer, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and coronary artery calcification. Founded in 2012, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 as a technology growth company, and it set up a European unit in 2020 and a US unit in 2021.

386380.text: Sky Labs develops, makes and sells wearable medical devices and a data platform that continuously measure and analyse the vital signs of chronic disease patients outside hospitals. Its main product is CART BP pro, a ring-type cuffless blood pressure monitor that measures blood pressure with a PPG sensor and sends the data to the cloud for doctors to use in treatment and patient care. It was founded in 2015.

387570.text: Finemedix makes devices for gastrointestinal endoscopic procedures, developing its own knives, injectors and snares for ESD and EMR procedures as well as tissue sampling devices for endoscopic ultrasound (EUS-FNA/FNB). It holds CE and FDA certifications to expand exports and works with global companies, including through an ODM contract with a Japanese firm. Founded in 2009, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024 as a technology growth company.

387690.text: Remedi develops and sells medical X-ray imaging devices and industrial non-destructive testing equipment based on low-dose, compact X-ray technology. It is pursuing public procurement markets aligned with WHO tuberculosis elimination policy, linking its devices with AI imaging solutions and expanding into space and aerospace markets. Founded in 2012 to develop radiation generators and make medical devices, it added an Indian medical device distributor as a subsidiary in 2024.

388050.text: G2Power makes and installs switchgear based on CMD technology, solar power systems and ESS, and runs a solar EPC business. In 2023 it set up a solar power special purpose company that began commercial operation in 2024, extending its business into renewable energy operation and management. Founded in 2010 to develop and make heavy electrical equipment, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

388210.text: CMTX makes precision parts for front-end semiconductor processes, producing consumable parts based on silicon, sapphire and ceramic materials for etching and deposition. It holds a 58.57% stake in one subsidiary and a 70% stake in another, Core Materials Advanced Tech CORP. Founded in 2013, it adopted its current name in 2024.

388610.text: GFC Life Science develops and produces bio materials for cosmetics, centred on skin microbiome and exosome technology, and also runs a clinical business. Its materials division has a library of about 2,000 microbial strains, test methods for skin-resident bacteria and patented exosome isolation and purification technology, which it uses to produce active compounds. Founded in 2002, it listed on the KONEX in 2022 and moved to the KOSDAQ in 2025.

388720.text: Yuil Robotics develops and produces industrial robots, including Cartesian, collaborative and articulated robots, and automation systems that combine them with smart devices. It provides total manufacturing automation solutions for injection moulding and other industries. Founded in 2011, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022 and set up a US subsidiary, YUIL AMERICA, INC, in the first quarter of 2026.

388790.text: LiComm makes and sells optical communication components such as optical amplifiers and fibre lasers, and supplies global companies. The company says it was the first in Korea to produce optical amplifiers domestically and developed the world's first ultra-compact optical amplifiers, such as the SFP+ EDFA, which it says have been well received by data centres. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 after merging with a special purpose acquisition company.

388870.text: Pharos iBio develops new drugs for rare and intractable diseases, especially cancer. Its core technology is Chemiverse, an AI-based drug discovery platform that it uses to shorten development time and cut costs, and it has built a pipeline running from early drug candidates to clinical stages. Founded in 2016, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 as a technology growth company.

389020.text: Zaram Technology is a fabless company that designs system semiconductors, producing telecom chips such as XGSPON chips and supplying Korea's three telecom operators and overseas service providers. In 2023 it signed a design contract for XGSPON custom chips with a global telecom equipment maker, and in 2025 a design and supply contract for next-generation XGSPON. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 as a technology growth company.

389030.text: Geninus is a biotech company developing genome analysis technology and solutions, spun off in 2018 from a Korean hospital's genome research institute. It runs three businesses: platforms for drug makers, analysis solutions for researchers, and testing and diagnostic products. It supports drug development from multi-omics-based target discovery to AI-based digital pathology and works with drug makers on precision biomarkers and immuno-oncology vaccines; it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021.

389140.text: 4by4 is a content AI solutions company that provides noise removal, super-resolution and other video quality technologies to broadcasters, OTT services and production companies, based on its in-house AI video enhancement solution AI PIXELL. In 2023 it acquired an esports content company, entering the gaming culture content business, and in 2026 it liquidated 4BY4 Solutions Inc. Founded in 2017, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

389260.text: Dae Myoung Energy is a renewable energy company that handles every stage of solar and wind projects itself, from development, design, procurement and construction to operation and management. It provides O&M services for completed power complexes as well as VPP services, taking part in the power generation forecasting system and running virtual power plants. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022 and has 16 unlisted subsidiaries.

389470.text: Inventage Lab is a drug delivery system (DDS) platform company developing long-acting injectables (LAI) based on its IVL-DrugFluidic platform. In 2025 it acquired a KOSDAQ-listed company, securing GMP manufacturing for injectables and genetic medicines. It is expanding joint research and technology licensing on its platform while also running drug manufacturing and CDMO businesses; it was founded in 2015.

389500.text: SBB Tech makes and sells bearings and reducers, supplying the semiconductor and display equipment industries. The company says it began producing carbide ball and ceramic ball bearings domestically after 1993 and developed precision reducers for robots using purely Korean technology, commercialising them under its own brand. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022 as a technology growth company.

389650.text: Next Biomedical develops medical devices and treatment materials using polymers and drug delivery systems, and holds US FDA and European CE certifications. It has a quality cooperation agreement with Medtronic and has secured global distribution through contracts with companies including CMI in Japan and Terumo in Europe. Founded in 2014 for medical device research and development, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024 as a technology growth company.

389680.text: Udmtek provides industrial AI solutions based on machine language processing (MLP), which interprets the control logic of automation systems in an explainable AI (X-AI) way to deliver an integrated digital manufacturing platform. The company says it was the first to develop this technology in Korea and abroad. Its main industries are cars, secondary batteries and electrical and electronics; founded in 2007, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024 through a SPAC merger.

391710.text: Kornic Automation runs control software, smart factory, robotic logistics and IT infrastructure businesses. It supplies factory automation software based on EasyCluster and integrated hardware and software automation for logistics, inspection and manufacturing. Using its precision control and system integration skills, it is expanding into semiconductor equipment makers, pharmaceuticals and biotech, and battery materials; founded in 2003, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

393210.text: Tomato System is an IT solutions company whose own products include a university ERP system and UI/UX development platforms, among them the HTML5-based eXBuilder6. It says it counts about 100 universities as customers, and it is expanding into the public sector and businesses. Founded in 2000, it moved its listing from the KONEX to the KOSDAQ in 2023.

393890.text: W-scope Chungju Plant makes secondary battery separators, one of the four core battery materials, producing wet separators for EVs and CCS among other products. The company says its 5.5m-wide lines are the largest in the world, giving it higher output than competitors, and it is expanding into Hungary. Founded in 2016 as a wholly owned subsidiary of W-SCOPE Corporation, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

393970.text: Daejin Advanced Materials makes materials for battery production, with anti-static trays, PET release films and anti-static coating solutions using CNT modification and dispersion technology as its main products. It also supplies plastic parts for car interiors to customers in Korea and abroad and is pursuing its CNT business as a new growth driver. Founded in 2019, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

394280.text: Openedges Technology designs system semiconductor IP for AI edge devices, offering high-performance total memory system IP solutions and AI platform IP solutions that combine them with NPUs. It strengthened its R&D by acquiring TSS of Canada in 2019 and set up a Japanese subsidiary, OTJ, in 2024 to enter the Japanese market. Founded in 2017, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

394420.text: RecensMedical is a medical device company whose platform combines cryogenic and thermoelectric technology for rapid, precise cooling, used for precision cooling therapy and transdermal drug delivery. Its devices control cooling anaesthesia and inflammation suppression within the temperature range tissue can survive, with cooling speeds of 100°C per second and control within ±1°C. Founded in 2016, it has commercialised devices in dermatology and ophthalmology and is expanding into beauty devices.

394800.text: 3billion has commercialised genetic testing for rare disease diagnosis based on AI genome interpretation technology, offering both full-service and SaaS options. Founded in 2016 to use AI in rare disease diagnosis and drug development, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024 as a technology growth company. In 2025 it set up a wholly owned US subsidiary, 3billion US, Inc., and is setting up a lab there and preparing for CLIA certification.

395400.text: SK Reit is a real estate investment company listed on the KOSPI. It invests in property and pays shareholders dividends from the income, rather than running an operating business.

396270.text: Nextchip designs system semiconductors for image processing and recognition in intelligent vehicle cameras, supplying ISP, AHD and SoC-based products to global customers. It has grown alongside the spread of ADAS and autonomous driving and is extending its business into robots and drones. Founded in 2019, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022 as a technology growth company.

396300.text: HT Robotics specialises in aluminium die-casting and precision machining, mainly producing ESS parts, advanced IT device parts and auto parts. It runs an integrated process from design and mould making to die-casting, CNC machining and assembly, and supplies parts that improve the structural stability of battery modules for EVs, hydrogen vehicles and ESS. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

396470.text: Wot makes environmental control systems for semiconductor and display processes, including ultra-precise temperature and humidity controllers (THC), fan filter units (FFU) and temperature control units (TCU). Its THC units are fitted to track equipment in semiconductor and HBM processes, supplying air with controlled particles, temperature, humidity and trace gases. It is a registered first-tier supplier to two major Korean chipmakers; founded in 2004, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

396690.text: Mirae Asset Global REIT is a real estate investment company listed on the KOSPI. It invests in property and pays shareholders dividends from the income, rather than running an operating business.

397030.text: AprilBio is a research-focused company founded in 2013 as a faculty start-up, earning revenue by developing drug candidates and licensing them out. It develops candidates using an antibody library for making human antibodies and its SAFA platform, which extends the half-life of protein drugs. It follows a RIPCO model of licensing non-clinical and early clinical assets globally and plans to move to a FIPCO model over time.

397810.text: ADforus is a digital advertising platform company that runs SSP and DSP businesses and provides a range of digital advertising services through its own platforms. It gained Google MCM status in 2023, was selected for GCPP in 2025 and applies AI to optimise advertising. Founded in 2014, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025 and owns two subsidiaries.

398120.text: SG Healthcare makes and sells medical diagnostic imaging equipment, including digital X-ray, FPD C-arm, CT, MRI and ultrasound devices used by hospitals and other medical institutions in Korea and abroad to examine people and pets. Through a subsidiary set up in 2021 it develops AI software for medical devices. Founded in 2009, it listed on the KOSDAQ in December 2024.

399720.text: Gaonchips designs system semiconductors and is an official design solution partner of a major foundry as well as an Arm AADP partner. Bridging fabless companies and foundries, it offers one-stop support for customers' custom ASICs from design to mass production. It is developing AI chips, including generative AI chips for edge devices, and strengthening production support through advanced packaging; it was founded in 2012.

400760.text: NH All-One REIT is a real estate investment company listed on the KOSPI. It invests in property and pays shareholders dividends from the income, rather than running an operating business.

402030.text: Konan Technology is an AI company founded in 1999 whose core technologies are text AI and vision AI, and it runs five business divisions. It positions itself as an agentic AI partner, applying technology proven in industrial settings to change how its customers work. It focuses on research and development through its AI research institute to respond to generative, agentic and physical AI.

402340.text: SK Square is a holding company spun off from SK Telecom in 2021, with a semiconductor-centred portfolio built around subsidiaries including SK hynix. Its main subsidiary SK hynix is a global company that mainly produces memory chips. It is organised into four business segments and aims to strengthen competitiveness and shareholder value through fast decision-making and specialised focus.

402490.text: Green Resource makes protective coating materials and applies coatings to parts used in semiconductor and display process equipment, improving the corrosion and plasma resistance of dry etching equipment parts. Its main product, an ultra-high-density SD coating, applies rare earth materials using physical vapour deposition (PVD), with coating layers tailored to each part. Founded in 2011, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 as a technology growth company and has one subsidiary.

403490.text: WooDeumGee Farm is a smart farm-based agricultural company that grows, produces and distributes tomatoes under its own brand from an 11.1ha smart farm glasshouse in Korea. Working with a subsidiary, it has vertically integrated smart farm construction, and it transfers its semi-closed glasshouse technology and provides cultivation training to partner farms. Founded in 2011, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 and is pursuing smart farm consulting and overseas expansion.

403550.text: Socar runs a short-term car-sharing service and a monthly car subscription service, and also operates a parking-sharing platform and an electric bike-sharing service. It has 5 consolidated subsidiaries and in 2026 set up a new company dedicated to autonomous driving. Founded in 2011, it listed on the KOSPI in 2022.

403850.text: The Pinkfong is a content media company built on character IP, developing characters and turning them into content such as videos and music. It is expanding its business model into character licensing and merchandise. Founded in 2010, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025 and has 9 unlisted subsidiaries.

403870.text: HPSP makes and sells front-end semiconductor equipment based on high-pressure hydrogen annealing technology, supplying its GENI-SYS equipment to global chipmakers. The company says it is the world's only maker of high-pressure hydrogen annealing equipment, and it is focused on widening its technology gap. Founded in 2017, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022 and was reclassified from a small to a mid-sized company in 2026.

404990.text: Shinhan Seobu T&D REIT is a real estate investment company listed on the KOSPI. It invests in property and pays shareholders dividends from the income, rather than running an operating business.

405000.text: Plasmapp develops, makes and sells medical devices centred on bio-plasma technology, with products including sterilisers, surface activators and root canal treatment devices based on its core plasma technology. It is growing in global markets with low-temperature sterilisation solutions and is pushing further into healthcare with biological tissue stimulation treatments. It was founded in 2015 as a start-up from a KAIST physics laboratory and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

405100.text: Quality Reliability Technology evaluates the reliability of semiconductors and electronic components, analyses failure mechanisms, and develops and sells reliability testing equipment, providing objective data as a third-party verification body. It combines services, analysis and equipment development to help customers reduce quality risks as chips are used in more fields. It was set up in 2014 through a spin-off of another company's semiconductor testing division and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

405920.text: Nara Cellar imports and wholesales alcoholic beverages, bringing in wine from major producing countries such as the United States, France, Chile and Italy. Its portfolio covers 273 brands and about 1,782 SKUs, including a Chilean wine label and US wines, sold through both on-trade and off-trade channels. Founded in 1990, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

406820.text: Beautyskin is a cosmetics OEM/ODM maker and brand distributor that covers the full cosmetics value chain and runs its own private brands alongside its manufacturing business. It is diversifying target markets such as Thailand, the United States and Europe and developing functional cosmetics and dermocosmetics. Founded in 2011, it absorbed another company in 2021 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

407400.text: Ggumbi makes and sells products for babies and young children, including play mats, children's living room furniture and skincare, under several brands. Its main subsidiaries run an online shopping mall and a KONEX-listed baby products distributor, and it has set up two new companies to expand its business. It was founded in 2014 to make, wholesale and retail baby products.

408470.text: Hanpass provides digital remittance solutions, mobile wallets and prepaid card services. After obtaining a small-sum overseas remittance licence, it began services to countries such as Nepal and the Philippines and has since expanded to about 200 countries worldwide, with multilingual support. It is also adding everyday services such as mobility and commerce; founded in 2017, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2026.

408900.text: Studio Mir plans and produces animation, handling everything from pre-production to post-production in house, and has a subsidiary focused on 3D animation. Its main clients are global OTT platforms and North American cable channels, and it is pursuing joint IP development with other industries such as games and webtoons. It was founded in 2010.

408920.text: Messe eSang organises exhibitions, planning and running trade shows and related events across various industries, often in cooperation with government agencies and industry associations. Founded in 2008 for the exhibition business, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 after merging with a special purpose acquisition company.

411080.text: Sands Lab is a cyber threat intelligence (CTI) company that uses its own AI and big data analysis to provide security threat response and predictive intelligence, with the CTX platform and MDX, MNX and MAX solutions. It is focusing on natural-language cyber threat information services using generative AI, including CTX for GPT and a security-specific LLM called SANDY. Founded in 2004, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

412350.text: Laserssel develops and makes back-end packaging equipment for semiconductors, displays and secondary batteries using its area laser technology, which uses a surface light source. Its strengths are packaging equipment for chips and PCB substrates. It supplies major foundry, mobile device and EV battery companies and has demo centres in the United States, Taiwan, Japan and China; it was founded in 2015.

412540.text: Jeil M&S makes and sells mixing equipment and systems for the electrode process in secondary battery production, and also produces equipment for food, pharmaceuticals and defence. The company says it is the only Korean firm with the technology and delivery record for ultra-high-viscosity mixing, and the only one in Korea to develop and deliver mixing equipment for defence. Founded in 1986, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

413390.text: MOT makes production automation equipment for secondary batteries, mainly supplying tab welding, jelly roll insertion and can-cap welding equipment for battery assembly. Its founder and key staff are former core engineers of a major battery maker, and it runs a subsidiary in Hungary and a branch in the United States. Founded in 2019 to make automation equipment for batteries and auto parts, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

413630.text: CP System develops its own cable chains, flexible tubes and other products using extrusion and injection moulding technology, and supplies them to industries such as semiconductors, displays and cars. It is concentrating on ultra-low-dust cable chains and robot-related systems, and is working with large companies and global chemical firms. Founded in 1993 and incorporated in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024 after merging with a special purpose acquisition company.

413640.text: Bi Matrix is a business intelligence (BI) solutions company that has expanded from BI tools for fast data-driven decisions into big data processing and AI analysis and forecasting. Its products include the agentic AI platform TRINITY, the generative AI-based G-MATRIX, the integrated BI platform AUD and the SCM solution M4PLAN. Founded in 2005, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

415380.text: Studio Samick is an online home furnishing retailer that has its products made by manufacturing partners and sells them under several brands through about 30 online platforms. It has built a just-in-time production and delivery system to cut delivery times and runs its own customer service team. Founded in 2017, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

415640.text: KB Balhae Infrastructure Fund is an infrastructure fund listed on the KOSPI. It invests in infrastructure assets and pays shareholders dividends from the income, rather than running an operating business.

416180.text: Shinsung ST makes secondary battery parts for EVs and ESS, mainly bus bars and module cases, and produces smartphone parts and e-cigarette cases through its Vietnamese subsidiary. In 2025 it set up a US subsidiary and completed a line for liquid-cooled thermal management parts for ESS. Founded in 2004, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 and runs a mould centre to keep technology in house.

417010.text: NanoTIM develops, makes and sells thermal management materials used in core EV components. Gap fillers account for 68.55% of its sales, gap pads 12.17% and thermal runaway prevention pads 11.66%. It supplies heat-dissipation materials to two Korean carmakers and is expanding its customer base to overseas carmakers and battery makers; founded in 2016, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

417030.text: Nearthlab provides intelligent drone platforms capable of autonomous missions for the defence and enterprise markets. In the enterprise segment it inspects wind turbines and has a track record in blade inspection, demonstrating autonomous flight in extreme environments. In defence it is developing counter-drone and swarm strike solutions and working with global defence organisations; it was founded in 2015.

417180.text: Finger Story runs a webtoon platform for male readers specialising in martial arts and action, which it says was the first of its kind in Korea, and a romance and BL platform for female readers. A subsidiary sells low-irritation cosmetics made with plant ingredients through its own online store and pharmacies. Founded in 2018, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022 through a merger with a special purpose acquisition company.

417200.text: LS Materials makes and sells medium and large ultracapacitors (UC) used in renewable energy, AGVs in smart factories and electric vehicles. Through a subsidiary it makes aluminium parts and landscape materials and provides turnkey solutions for public facilities. It was created in 2021 when an LS affiliate spun off its ultracapacitor business, and it has 3 subsidiaries.

417310.text: Koramco The One Reit is a real estate investment company listed on the KOSPI. It invests in property and pays shareholders dividends from the income, rather than running an operating business.

417500.text: Ji-tech makes materials for semiconductors and displays, with businesses including semiconductor precursors, photomask cases for flat panel displays, OLED organic material purification and CO2 capture. As new businesses it is pursuing battery electrolyte canisters, starting up an OLED organic material synthesis facility and working with partners in recycling. Founded in 2014, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

417790.text: Truen makes digital video surveillance systems and IoT solutions. The company says it was the first in the industry to release H.264 IP cameras in the early days of IP cameras, and it applied the ONVIF international standard early and helped set TTA security certification. It is widening its megapixel camera range and runs smart home cameras and cloud subscription services under its own brand; founded in 2005, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

417840.text: Justem makes environmental control systems for semiconductor manufacturing, with semiconductor equipment accounting for 98% of its sales, and focuses on N₂ purge systems. Its main product, the N₂ LPM, is compatible with almost all equipment worldwide, and the company says it holds about 85% market share among top-tier global IDM customers. Founded in 2016, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

417860.text: Obzen is a full-stack AI data platform company based on AI and data science, offering end-to-end solutions from data collection, integration and analysis to business execution. Its businesses are a customer data and experience management platform and a data analytics platform. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023, acquired a data engineering company in 2025 and completed a merger with it in 2026.

417970.text: Model Solution supports the whole process from design and prototype making to injection moulding, assembly and mass production for industries such as cars, aerospace, IT and telecoms, and medical devices. After expanding its contract manufacturing business it renamed that division TSB, and sales from IMB and TSB are growing as a share of the total. Founded in 1993 and incorporated in 2005, it belongs to a Korean business group.

418250.text: SecuLetter makes security software, using its MARS platform, built on its own reverse engineering technology, to detect and analyse unknown malware at the assembly level. Its main businesses are email security, data transfer between separated networks, web services, document centralisation and cloud security, along with AI and vulnerability research. Founded in 2015, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 as a technology growth company.

418420.text: Raontech is a fabless system semiconductor company that designs and makes microdisplays and SoC chips used in AR/VR/MR (XR) smart glasses, automotive HUDs and optical communication equipment. The company says it is the first in Korea, and one of few worldwide, to have all three microdisplay technologies: LCoS, OLEDoS and LEDoS. Founded in 2009, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 as a technology growth company.

418470.text: kt millie seojae runs an unlimited e-book subscription service that the company says was Korea's first, serving individuals, businesses and public institutions. It is adding reading content such as audiobooks and chat books, and in 2025 introduced web novels and webtoons, AI-based recommendations and conversational reading services. Founded in 2016, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 and then became a subsidiary of a KT affiliate, working within the KT media value chain.

418550.text: JEIO makes carbon nanotube conductive additives for secondary batteries and provides plant engineering. The company says it has researched carbon nanotubes for battery conductive additives for 24 years and was the first in Korea to mass-produce them, supplying battery makers. Its plant engineering business has provided EPC services for 33 years in fields including batteries, electronic materials, bio and petrochemicals; founded in 1994, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

418620.text: E8 develops AI digital twin technology, collecting and analysing data from industrial, urban and facility environments, recreating them digitally and offering monitoring, forecasting and decision-support services. Its products include the digital twin platform NDX Pro, the data intelligence platform NAXiS, the operating system NAX Ops and the simulation solution NFLOW Ai. Founded in 2012, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024 as a technology growth company.

419050.text: Samkee Energy Solutions makes battery parts for electric vehicles, mainly aluminium structural parts and electrical components for ESS and EVs. It is pursuing battery sensing cables based on FF-PCB technology as a new growth driver and is working to expand its product line-up. It was created in 2020 when Samkee spun off its EV battery business, and it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

419080.text: Enjet provides EHD inkjet printing and coating solutions, which form functional patterns such as ultra-fine electrode wiring for advanced industries including displays, semiconductors and PCBs. In 2026 it acquired another company's recycling business, so it now has two segments: EHD solutions and recycling. Founded in 2009, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022 as a technology growth company.

419120.text: Sandoll provides subscription font services through its cloud-based font platform and makes custom fonts for businesses. It was created in 2018 when its predecessor spun off its font business, and it says the predecessor, founded in 1984, was Korea's first font company. It listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022 and acquired another font company in 2024.

419530.text: Samg Entertainment is an animation and family entertainment company, and it says it is Korea's largest 3D animation producer. It plans and produces content, licenses characters, sells merchandise, handles global distribution and runs stores, as well as its own channels on YouTube, OTT and IPTV. Founded in 2000, it launched a new brand in 2025 and is expanding from China and Japan into Russia, Taiwan, Europe and North America.

419540.text: Bistos makes medical devices for fetuses and newborns, including fetal monitors, fetal heart detectors, jaundice treatment devices, incubators and warmers. It is expanding into home devices such as breast pumps and thermometers and general devices such as patient monitors. More than 90% of its sales are exports to over 120 countries; founded in 2001, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

420570.text: J2kbio makes and sells cosmetic ingredients centred on natural and bio materials, and provides clinical services testing functional cosmetics, health functional foods and beauty devices on people. It owns 3 unlisted companies and in 2024 expanded its efficacy-testing clinical services through a subsidiary. Founded in 2017, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

420770.text: GigaVis makes and sells automated optical inspection and automated optical repair equipment for semiconductor substrates. It supplies high-resolution inspection and repair platforms to top-tier global FC-BGA substrate makers, where it says it holds a high market share. Founded in 2004, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 and is expanding into new areas based on its ultra-fine pattern inspection and repair capabilities.

424760.text: Bellock provides network, operations and management solutions and information security services, mainly building and operating next-generation firewalls, integrated security monitoring systems and vulnerability checks. It has its own solutions, is expanding into converged security such as an AI-based anti-drone solution, and is developing export models with overseas partners. Founded in 2009, it completed a merger with a special purpose acquisition company in 2023.

424870.text: ImmuneOncia Therapeutics develops antibody-based immuno-oncology drugs, with monoclonal antibodies against PD-L1, CD47 and LAG-3 as its core assets. It earns revenue by developing drug candidates and licensing them out at early clinical stages, and aims to commercialise its anti-PD-L1 antibody in Korea. Founded in 2016, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025 as a technology growth company.

424960.text: Smart Radar System develops 4D imaging radar, with core technologies in non-uniform array antenna design, real-time radar signal processing and AI-based object recognition. In mobility it develops radar for autonomous driving, special ADAS vehicles and drones, and outside mobility it develops radar for healthcare, security and smart cities. Founded in 2017, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 as a technology growth company.

424980.text: Micro2nano makes MEMS-based probe cards for semiconductor testing and provides foundry services, with its main products split into probe cards for NAND and DRAM. Probe cards touch the wafer directly to carry electrical signals and identify defects. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 as a technology growth company.

425040.text: TEMC makes specialty gases for semiconductor processes and, through three subsidiaries, also works in semiconductor equipment, battery equipment and industrial gases. It has brought in house the full range of process technologies, including gas synthesis, water electrolysis, rare gas extraction and separation, and specialty gas purification, mixing and filling, and has a technology partnership with a major chipmaker. Founded in 2015, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

425420.text: TFE provides semiconductor test solutions for the process that checks each device's performance and interaction with surrounding parts after assembly. The company says it is the only Korean firm supplying test resources such as test boards, test sockets and COK for final tests, reliability tests, SLT and set-simulation tests. Founded in 2003, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2022.

429270.text: Sigetronics is an integrated device manufacturer (IDM) of silicon-based optical and discrete devices such as ESD, power and sensor devices, covering development, production and sales. It is also developing gallium nitride (GaN) power semiconductors and RF devices. Its products are used in LEDs, wearable healthcare devices and military supplies in Korea and abroad; founded in 2008, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 as a technology growth company.

430690.text: Hanssak develops and supplies application software, with main products including solutions for data transfer between separated networks, password management, secure electronic fax and smart billing. It has set up a cloud development and AI research centre and released new products aimed at converged security. Founded in 1992 and incorporated in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

431190.text: K3I provides XR solutions for creating AR, VR, MR and interactive content, and the company says it developed Korea's first augmented reality engine and authoring tools. Using physics engine-based XR technology developed in house, it develops and supplies XR services for education and training, tourism and culture, healthcare, manufacturing and entertainment. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024 as a technology growth company and has 3 subsidiaries.

432320.text: KB Star Reit is a real estate investment company listed on the KOSPI. It invests in property and pays shareholders dividends from the income, rather than running an operating business.

432430.text: YLAB is a studio-based webtoon producer that handles the whole production process, including story, in house, supplying major webtoon platforms and providing drama and film works to broadcasters and OTT services. Its Japanese subsidiary attracted outside investment in 2024, and it added a K-POP artist IP business as a subsidiary. Founded in 2010, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

432470.text: KNS makes automation equipment for secondary batteries, specialising in CID assembly equipment for cylindrical batteries and BMA automation equipment, and has won orders across the whole process for 46mm-diameter cylindrical batteries. Its core strategy is unmanned production, and it is developing AI-based smart factory solutions and intelligent robots based on physical AI. Founded in 2006, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

432720.text: Qualitas Semiconductor designs ultra-high-speed interconnect semiconductors, providing interface IP licensing and design services with products such as MIPI, PCIe and UCIe IP. It applies its FinFET design and verification technology to next-generation GAAFET processes. Founded in 2017, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 and set up a US subsidiary in 2026.

432980.text: MFC develops and mass-produces active pharmaceutical ingredients (API), key starting materials (KSM) and PI using organic synthesis and large-scale production technology. It has registered 37 APIs for cardiovascular disease and chronic bronchitis with Korea's drug regulator and produces and sells them. It is developing new crystal forms and salts for improved drugs; founded in 2008, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

434480.text: Monitorapp is a B2B cybersecurity vendor offering deployment options from on-premises appliances to its cloud-based platform AIONCLOUD, and the company says it launched Korea's first edge computing-based SSE. All its products and services connect to AILabs, its AI-based CTI platform, to update threat intelligence and improve detection accuracy. Founded in 2005, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 and rounded out an integrated security portfolio through an acquisition.

435570.text: Ercohs Agricultural is a food tech company specialising in food for babies and young children, producing about 160 kinds of baby food, nutritional porridge and health functional foods under its main brand. It is expanding through an alternative food brand and a plant-based bakery brand. It sells through about 20 online channels and exports to countries including China, Taiwan, Vietnam and the United States; founded in 2014, it listed on the KOSDAQ in February 2025.

437730.text: Samhyun makes motors, controllers and reducers, producing smart actuators and smart power units. It supplies electrical parts to a major Korean carmaker group and, in defence, develops and delivers products such as electric horizontal stabilisers with a Korean business group. Founded in 1988, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024 as a technology growth company, has set up units in India and China and acquired an autonomous robot company as a subsidiary.

438700.text: Virnect is a technology company developing XR solutions based on computer vision-driven AR technology, and it has commercialised remote collaboration, AR and digital twin solutions built on its XR engine to improve efficiency and safety in industry.
