Its main subsidiary cuts and processes heavy steel plates, supplying custom products to the shipbuilding, construction, heavy equipment and plant industries. Founded in 2016, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

439090.text: Manyo Factory is a skincare cosmetics brand company using naturally derived ingredients, with vegan cosmetics, fragrance-focused products and colour cosmetics under its main brand. It exports mainly basic skincare products to 65 countries and develops clean beauty products under a no-additive principle and vegan recipes, working with OEM/ODM partners. Founded in 2012, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

439260.text: Daehan Shipbuilding designs and builds medium and large-medium ships, including crude oil tankers, product tankers, container ships and shuttle tankers. To respond to environmental rules and decarbonisation, it is developing technologies such as air lubrication and shaft generator systems, and it is pursuing strategic ship types such as VLGCs and VLACs. Founded in 1987, it took its current name in 2004 and listed on the KOSPI in 2025.

439580.text: Bluemtec focuses on pharmaceutical distribution and also earns revenue from e-commerce, website and app development, and advertising agency services. It recently acquired a controlling stake in VLOC, adding it as a consolidated subsidiary. Founded in 2015 under a different name, it listed on the KOSDAQ in December 2023 under the special listing track for companies not yet profitable.

439960.text: Cosmo Robotics makes and sells ergonomic wearable robots, including lower-limb exoskeleton gait rehabilitation robots, walking assistance robots and muscle strength assistance robots. It develops and manufactures medical rehabilitation robots and industrial suits in Korea, and holds patents in the United States, Europe, Japan and China. Founded in 2016, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2026 as a technology growth company and has 8 unlisted subsidiaries.

440110.text: Fadu is a fabless system semiconductor company focused on data centres, and its core product is SSD controllers for data centres, targeting the controller market for enterprise SSDs. It concentrates on data centres, which are growing as demand for data rises from cloud, AI, 5G and autonomous driving. Founded in 2015, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 as a technology growth company.

440290.text: HB Investment is a venture capital firm, set up in 1999 as a venture investment company, that provides investment financing to small and venture companies. It supplies capital and management services to early-stage firms with strong technology but weak finances, and recovers its money through mergers and acquisitions or listings. It listed on the KOSDAQ in January 2024 and manages 19 venture investment funds.

440320.text: Openknowl's main business is an AI-based HR and edtech platform, alongside job-matching services and education in careers, admissions, start-ups and AI/AX. It also owns a subsidiary that makes digital signage and industrial displays. Founded in 2012 to develop and supply software and provide education services, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 as a technology growth company.

441270.text: Fine M-Tec makes and supplies precision mechanical parts for advanced IT devices and the energy sector, and has overseas subsidiaries. It is diversifying into precision parts for foldable display modules and large energy storage systems, and has completed new process set-up and equipment investment to prepare mass production for new projects. It was created in 2022 through a spin-off from its former parent.

443060.text: HD Hyundai Marine Solution is part of the HD Hyundai group and provides integrated services across a ship's life cycle after delivery. Its four business lines are aftermarket (AM) solutions, bunkering, eco-friendly solutions, and digital solutions for smart ships and autonomous navigation. It was set up in 2016 by taking over the group's after-sales service operations in shipbuilding, engines and electrical systems, and listed on the KOSPI in 2024.

443250.text: RevuCorporation is an influencer marketing company that connects advertisers with influencers through its own matching platform, which also offers influencer services and help with overseas expansion. It says it runs automated campaigns using a large member pool and big-data algorithms. Founded in 2014, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 and in 2024 bought a 54% stake in a short-form content company.

443670.text: SPSoft provides IT solutions built on cloud infrastructure, including Microsoft software licence supply, subscription SaaS services, VDI and DaaS, grid CDN and copyright protection solutions. The company says it holds a 76% share of Korea's SPLA market, and it is adding new services such as Copilot. Founded in 2013, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

444530.text: Simplatform develops and supplies application software for industrial AX. Its NUBISON AX platform combines IoT-based data collection with industrial AI and covers data collection and linking, storage, AI modelling and analysis, and deployment and operations, offered as integrated cloud and on-premises solutions. Founded in 2011, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

445090.text: Asicland, founded in 2016, provides system semiconductor design solutions, mainly to fabless companies, turning circuit designs into physical designs and handling SoC design and verification. It says it is TSMC's only official VCA partner in Korea, and it is also an Arm ADP partner. Its work covers AI chips, mobile, networking and automotive electronics.

445180.text: Purit recovers and refines waste organic solvents, and on that base produces ultra-high-purity chemicals for semiconductors as well as display and industrial chemicals, while also supplying raw materials. It was founded in 2010 for the solvent recovery and refining business and has since become an affiliate of another company's group. It is working on new products and more customers through research and development.

445680.text: Curiox Biosystems makes automated equipment and consumables for cell analysis. The company says it was the world's first to develop and commercialise C-FREE, a technology that automates cell analysis without a centrifuge, using natural gravity to limit cell damage and keep viability and reproducibility high. Founded in 2018, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023 as a technology growth company and has 3 subsidiaries, including one in Singapore.

446070.text: UNID btplus makes and sells MDF and MDF-based processed products such as flooring and LPM, and also handles wood products including particle board, plywood, sawn timber and logs. It was created in 2022 through a spin-off and relisted on the KOSPI in November that year. It belongs to the OCI business group, which has 24 affiliates, 7 of them listed.

446540.text: Megatouch makes precision pins: charge-discharge test pins for the formation process of secondary batteries, and pins for wafer tests and final tests in non-memory chip back-end processes. It also provides high-speed signal integrity test solutions for next-generation chips such as GPUs, NPUs and HBM. Founded in 2010, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

446840.text: Gitsn develops, makes and sells systems based on radio-frequency (RF) analysis that detect wireless eavesdropping, wireless backdoor hacking and illegal filming devices. It develops its own software, hardware, network and monitoring systems, handles everything from R&D to manufacturing, and is working on AI-based wireless security. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025 through a merger with a special purpose acquisition company.

448280.text: Ecoeye is a greenhouse gas reduction company that sells emission credits issued from its reduction investments and offers environmental consulting and global ETS credit trading. In the regulated carbon market it converts UNFCCC-certified credits into KOC/i-KOC for sale, and in the voluntary market it issues and sells carbon credits through Verra and Gold Standard. Founded in 2005, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

448710.text: COTS Technology designs and makes core modules for defence weapon systems, including single-board computers, military displays and weapon-system computers. It has expanded into civilian products such as electronic interlocking for rail signalling and controllers for high-voltage direct current transmission, and its growth is tied to weapon exports such as the K2 tank, including to Poland. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

448730.text: SamsungFN REIT is a real estate investment company listed on the KOSPI. It invests in property and pays shareholders dividends from the income, rather than running an operating business.

448900.text: Pim Korea uses metal injection moulding (MIM) to make small, precise and complex metal parts, with turbocharger and transmission parts, dental implants and wearable smart-device parts as its main businesses. In 2021 it acquired a mould maker with 27 years of history, gaining mould technology and equipment. Founded in 2001, it moved its listing from the KONEX to the KOSDAQ in 2025.

450080.text: Ecopro Materials makes and sells precursors for ternary cathode materials used in secondary batteries, through raw material refining (RMP) and precursor (CPM) processes. It completed its nickel supply chain by acquiring the PT Green Eco Nickel smelter, and is developing HVM and LMR precursors for mid- to low-priced EVs while planning plants in North America and Europe. Founded in 2017, it listed on the KOSPI in 2023.

450330.text: HASS, founded in 2008 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024, makes dental restorative materials and sells its own Amber and Rosetta products worldwide. The company says it was the first in Korea to develop and mass-produce dental prosthetic materials using lithium silicate glass-ceramics. It is expanding into digital dentistry through new businesses such as AMDC and Amber DryMill.

450520.text: Inswave develops and supplies application software, including WebSquare5, a web-standard UI/UX development platform, and WebTop, a finance solution supplied to many financial institutions. It is developing AX solutions that combine LLMs with AI, such as WebSquare AI and an in-house LLM. Founded in 2002, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

450950.text: Asterasys makes and sells aesthetic skin devices that use high-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) and non-invasive radiofrequency (RF), in Korea and abroad, with products including Liftera, CoolSoniq and Coolfase. It also has an unlisted affiliate that distributes beauty devices. Founded in 2015 to make medical devices, it listed on the KOSDAQ in January 2025.

451220.text: IMT, founded in 2000 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023, makes semiconductor process equipment based on its laser and CO2 dry cleaning and laser heat treatment technologies, including CO2 dry cleaning equipment for HBM. It also sells chip chemical analysis equipment and materials and parts for advanced industries. Its subsidiaries make MLC for probe cards and, through IMT VINA, coils for smartphone camera AF and OIS.

451250.text: Bbia is a cosmetics company with 5 brands, focused on colour cosmetics, whose products are made by outside OEM/ODM manufacturers. It is rebranding, positioning itself as an eco-friendly beauty company and expanding overseas through global platforms and foreign partners. Founded in 2004, it took its current name in 2022 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024 through a SPAC merger.

451760.text: Contec provides downstream space industry solutions, including ground station antennas and modems, ground systems, GSaaS network solutions and AI deep-learning satellite image analysis. It says it covers both the upstream and downstream parts of the space industry in a full vertical chain. Founded in 2015 to provide downstream space solutions, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

451800.text: Hanwha REIT is a real estate investment company listed on the KOSPI. It invests in property and pays shareholders dividends from the income, rather than running an operating business.

452160.text: JNB makes semiconductor equipment and vacuum systems. Its equipment division makes stacker systems and provides vacuum pump utilities with noise suppression and vibration protection, while its precision machining division supplies vacuum pump parts and makes setting kits for on-tool pumps. Founded in 2005, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

452190.text: HBL designs and makes high-precision industrial laser equipment and process automation systems built around its laser control technology. Its main products are laser equipment for making secondary batteries, cars, and semiconductor and electronic parts, and its customers include battery makers, carmakers and parts manufacturers in Korea and abroad. Founded in 1997, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

452200.text: Mintech develops inspection and diagnostic solutions for secondary batteries used in EVs and energy storage systems. It has commercialised a third-generation technology using electrochemical impedance spectroscopy that it says diagnoses battery condition accurately in a short time and at low cost, and it takes part in a battery alliance's performance and safety evaluations. Founded in 2015, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024 as a technology growth company.

452260.text: Hanwha Galleria runs 5 department stores, including a luxury store in Seoul, and focuses on differentiated merchandise and premium brands. It also has food and beverage businesses, including 9 franchise restaurants, premium wine imports and an ice cream brand, and has secured that restaurant franchise's rights in Japan. It was created in 2023 through a spin-off from a Hanwha group company and has subsidiaries.

452280.text: Hansun Engineering makes instrumentation fittings, valves and plumbing products under its own S-LOK brand for the petrochemical, shipbuilding and offshore, defence, aerospace, semiconductor and hydrogen fuel cell industries. It is diversifying into hydrogen, semiconductors and ESS, and turned its research unit into a corporate research institute in 2026. Founded in 2012 by acquiring another fitting and valve maker's production assets, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

452300.text: Capstone Partners is a venture capital firm that makes equity investments in small and venture companies with strong technology but weak finances, providing capital and management services and recovering its money through mergers and acquisitions or listings. It ranked 31st by VC fund assets under management at the end of the first half of 2026. Founded in 2008, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

452400.text: Inics makes secondary battery parts for electric vehicles, including cell pads and fire-resistant materials that improve the efficiency and life of pouch batteries, and supplies major carmakers. It is building a fire-resistance test lab, developing thermal runaway prevention technology and setting up production bases in major markets such as North America. Founded in 1984, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024 and has 4 unlisted subsidiaries.

452430.text: Sapien Semiconductors designs display driver ICs (DDIC) optimised for Micro-LED and Mini-LED displays and supplies them to global display panel, LED and IT device makers. It holds core patents based on a multi-bit MIP structure and PWM driving, and develops products jointly with large global customers. Founded in 2017, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

452450.text: Pie provides AI-based manufacturing intelligence, combining deep-learning vision and physical AI for high-precision inspection in processes such as high-end PCBs, automotive parts, secondary batteries and semiconductors. Its smart factory solutions collect and analyse inspection, process and equipment data for defect detection, process support, monitoring and prediction. Founded in 2018, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

453340.text: Hyundai Green Food runs institutional catering, distribution of manufactured goods and fresh food, food ingredient wholesale and retail, and restaurant and retail businesses, with catering operations in China, Mexico and the US. It is developing new menus for its health food brand and producing HMR and care food at a smart food centre. It was created in 2023 through a spin-off, listed on the KOSPI, and has 8 subsidiaries.

453450.text: Gridwiz is a distributed energy platform company working in power demand management, EV charging modems and chargers, and building and operating ESS and solar power facilities. It is expanding its EV charging communications business globally on international standards, along with a BESS business through its Australian unit and a VPP platform. Founded in 2013, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

453860.text: ASTech specialises in UV filter ingredients and also runs active pharmaceutical ingredient and beauty care businesses. It has mass-produced UviMax DHHB since 2019, supplying global chemical companies and many cosmetics OEMs in Korea and abroad, and in 2008 signed a production technology transfer and supply deal for Clopidogrel Bisulfate with a drug maker. Founded in 2005, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2023.

454910.text: Doosan Robotics, a Doosan Group company founded in 2015 and listed on the KOSPI in 2023, specialises in collaborative robots such as robot arms, and through subsidiaries offers EOL solutions and customised automation systems (CMI). In 2025 it acquired US automation and robot solutions company ONExia and merged it with its North American unit to target that market.

455180.text: Kga develops and makes electrode process equipment for secondary battery production, including coaters, presses and slitters, and also runs an air-conditioning business covering duct automation equipment and duct engineering. It is classed as a small and venture company and has one unlisted subsidiary. Founded in 2017, it listed on the KOSDAQ in June 2025.

455900.text: Angel Robotics makes and sells wearable robots, including angel MEDI, angel GEAR for industrial safety, angel SUIT for hospitals and homes, and angel KIT core robot parts, and carries out defence wearable robot R&D contracts. It is expanding into Southeast Asia and preparing for US FDA approval. Founded in 2017, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

456010.text: ICTK designs security system semiconductors and says it was the world's first to commercialise a security chip based on anti-cloning technology. It develops and supplies Security SoCs that combine its VIA PUF security IP with post-quantum cryptography, and provides end-to-end security to mobile carriers and global big tech companies. Founded in 2017, it listed on the KOSDAQ as a technology growth company.

456040.text: OCI runs basic chemical and carbon chemical businesses: the first makes polysilicon for semiconductors, hydrogen peroxide and TDI, and the second makes carbon black, pitch and BTX. It was created in 2023 through a spin-off from OCI Holdings and relisted on the KOSPI in May that year. It has 6 subsidiaries, 2 in Korea and 4 overseas.

456070.text: ENCell is an advanced biopharmaceutical company that offers contract development and manufacturing (CDMO) for advanced biologics and develops next-generation cell and gene therapies for rare and intractable muscle diseases. It draws on GMP optimisation technology for multiple cell and gene therapy products, and says its GMP facility is the only one in Korea able to produce both cells and viruses. Founded in 2018, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024 as a technology growth company.

456160.text: G2gbio is a drug delivery system (DDS) platform company built on InnoLAMP, its microsphere technology for long-acting drugs that can carry a wide range of medicines. Its main pipeline includes GB-7001, GB-5001 and GB-6002, and it has technology commercialisation deals with global drugmakers while expanding CDO/CDMO work. Founded in 2017 to develop long-acting drugs, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025 as a technology growth company.

457190.text: Isu Specialty Chemical produces and sells fine chemicals such as TDM, NOM/NDM, IPA and special solvents, and makes lithium sulfide (Li2S), a raw material for solid electrolytes in all-solid-state batteries. It was created in 2023 when an Isu group company spun off these businesses, and in 2024 it absorbed another affiliate's fine chemicals division. It has a plant in Ulsan, a unit in Japan and an office in China.

457370.text: Hanchem researches, develops and produces new organic compound materials, focused on OLED materials along with materials for semiconductors, catalysts and pharmaceuticals, and runs a CRO/CDMO business for large companies in Korea and abroad. It holds core synthesis technologies such as Pd-catalysed and ultra-low-temperature reactions, backed by a large body of synthesis data. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

457550.text: Woojin Ntec provides maintenance for instrumentation and control systems at nuclear and thermal power plants, including equipment diagnosis and performance upgrades, and also makes and supplies domestically developed systems. It is preparing to enter the nuclear plant decommissioning market. Founded in 2013 for this maintenance business, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

457600.text: VECT is a digital signage company offering tailored visual solutions that combine projectors, LED displays, electronic whiteboards and software. It is adding AI voice recognition and OCR handwriting recognition to its whiteboards and expanding into media art content and the metaverse. Founded in 2006, it began as a distributor and official importer of other companies' projectors and products, and acquired another company in 2022.

458350.text: ESteem is a fashion content company whose main business is planning and producing content, from fashion shows, brand promotions, exhibitions and campaigns to content for broadcast, online video and social media. Founded in 2004, it says it was Korea's first specialist model management agency, and it has since expanded from fashion into beauty and art. It listed on the KOSDAQ in 2026.

458650.text: Sungwoo mainly makes cylindrical secondary battery parts and automotive electrical parts, supplying cylindrical battery parts for wireless earphones and EVs to global battery makers. It has finished developing parts for 46mm-diameter cylindrical batteries and is developing parts for other battery form factors. Founded in 1992, it first made electron gun parts for CRT TVs and diversified after LCD TVs appeared.

458870.text: Seers is an IoMT platform company that uses biosignal analysis AI and wearable devices to provide mobiCARE, an ECG service, and thynC, an inpatient monitoring system, to institutions in Korea and abroad. mobiCARE, a subscription arrhythmia screening service, launched in 2020 and thynC in 2024. Founded in 2009, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

459100.text: WITS supplies wireless charging modules and chargers for smartphones and wearables as a first-tier supplier to a major electronics maker. It is diversifying into mobility and displays, having acquired an automotive electronics module business in 2024 and, in 2025, entered display modules and begun mass-producing slow EV chargers. It was founded in 2019 by acquiring another company's wireless charging division and patents, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

459510.text: Nau Robotics develops and makes industrial robot automation systems, including cartesian, articulated, SCARA and AMR robots, for the automotive, semiconductor, secondary battery, medical device and logistics industries. In 2026 it absorbed another robot maker to build out its line-up, and it is expanding abroad with a North American branch and a new unit in Mexico. Founded in 2016, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

459550.text: ALT, founded in 2017 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025, develops and makes smart devices. It targets niche markets such as kids' and senior phones with Korea's three mobile carriers, and supplies Android and AI set-top boxes to broadband operators. It has also finished developing an AI senior care robot and is expanding overseas, including Japan, under its own MIVE brand.

460470.text: IVIM Technology is a biotech company founded on intravital microscope technology developed in 2017, and it says it was the world's first to commercialise an all-in-one intravital microscope that images cells and biologic drugs at the same time. It sells equipment, provides CRO services and develops AI-based medical devices, imaging cell interactions in living bodies for disease and drug candidate analysis. It listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

460850.text: Dongkuk Coated Metal makes cold-rolled galvanised steel and colour-coated steel sheets under its Luxteel and Appsteel brands. It was created in 2023 through a spin-off from a Dongkuk group holding company, with roots in the Dongkuk Steel group founded in 1954. After acquiring another steelmaker in 2025, it says it became the world's largest colour-coated steel company, and it has overseas sites including Aju Steel USA and Aju Poland.

460860.text: Dongkuk Steel Mill makes steel bars, sections and heavy plates. It was created in 2023 when a Dongkuk group holding company spun off its hot-rolled steel business. The company says it has made iron since the 1960s, ran Korea's first private 50-ton blast furnace and in 1971 became the first in Korea to make heavy plate, and it started an electric arc furnace aimed at lower carbon in 2010.

460870.text: SMCG makes and sells cosmetics packaging based on glass containers, running an ODM business that develops and proposes products to fit customers' needs. It draws on glass-container production experience dating back to 1989 and has built automated production lines to meet large-scale demand from the cosmetics industry. Founded in 1998, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

460930.text: Hyundai Hyms supplies shipbuilding materials such as ship blocks, piping, outfitting steel and painting, under long-term partnerships with large Korean shipbuilders including HD Hyundai group yards. It says it has Korea's largest production site, and it is diversifying into independent tanks for eco-friendly ships and port cranes. It was set up in 2008 with the ship block and piping operations of a Hyundai group shipbuilder, and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

460940.text: P&S Robotics makes rehabilitation robots and has built in-house robotics technology across humanoid and service robots and manipulators. Its main product, the Walkbot gait rehabilitation robot, controls joints such as the hip to provide walking training, and in 2025 it entered upper-limb rehabilitation with the Healerbot shoulder training robot. Founded in 2003, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

461030.text: IMBdx uses liquid biopsy technology to offer personalised precision medicine and early cancer detection across the course of the disease. Its main businesses are precision profiling of advanced cancer, early detection of recurrence after surgery and early cancer screening, with products that combine liquid biopsy and NGS. Founded in 2018 for medical and pharmaceutical R&D, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024 as a technology growth company.

461300.text: i-Scream Media is an edtech company that develops and supplies elementary school textbooks and runs a digital teaching platform, a teacher training platform, an online store for teaching aids and a school-home communication app. The company says it ranked first by market share in 2022, its first year in the authorised textbook market. It was spun off in 2002 from another company's content division and says it was Korea's first edtech company.

462310.text: New Kids On specialises in children's clothing and cosmetics, running several kids' fashion brands and launching skincare and fragrance brands through subsidiaries. It is working to grow through global character IP collaborations, online brand stores and its own online mall. Founded in 2013, it absorbed two companies in 2022 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

462350.text: Innospace works in the upstream space industry, developing and building launch vehicles (science rockets) and rocket engines, and providing satellite launch services and testing and evaluation services. It has overseas subsidiaries in Brazil, Europe and the UAE. Founded in 2017 to make aircraft parts, it listed on the KOSDAQ in July 2024 as a technology growth company.

462510.text: Lameditech develops, makes and sells laser-based aesthetic and medical devices, drawing on its own miniature high-power laser technology and platform. Its products span several laser device series, and in 2026 it is launching a device that combines laser blood sampling with glucose measurement and an all-in-one home beauty device. Founded in 2012, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

462520.text: Chosun Refractories makes refractories, essential materials for heavy industries such as steel, cement, glass and chemicals, and says it is Korea's largest integrated refractory maker. Supplying refractories since 1947, it offers shaped and unshaped refractories, sliding nozzles and continuous casting nozzles (CCN). It was created in 2023 through a spin-off from its holding company and has subsidiaries, including one in China.

462860.text: Dozn is a digital finance solutions company. Its products include digital banking solutions such as firm banking and virtual accounts for companies with large payment volumes, FX solutions such as cross-border fund management and unmanned currency exchange kiosks, and data solutions including apartment ERP and messaging services. Founded in 2017, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

462870.text: Shift UP is a global game developer whose main titles are a game serviced in about 150 countries and a console game. It is diversifying its portfolio by developing and acquiring IP and expanding businesses built on its existing IP. Founded in 2013, it listed on the KOSPI in 2024 and acquired 100% of Japanese game developer Unbound Inc., making it a subsidiary.

462980.text: Aiji net is an insurtech company using AI and MyData, running a consumer insurance service platform and developing and supplying software for businesses. It obtained a full MyData licence in 2021 and offers personalised services that combine people's insurance and health information. Founded in 2014, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025 as a technology growth company and has an insurance agency and brokerage subsidiary.

463020.text: Newen Ai develops and supplies big data and AI-based application software, offering its Quetta_Enterprise, Quetta_Service and Quetta_Data services. It targets industries that need accurate AI-driven forecasting and works on AI analysis of unstructured data such as images and voice. It holds 30 technology patents, has 217 staff with 135 in R&D, and was founded in 2004 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

463480.text: Motivelink makes transformers and EMC coil solutions for automotive electronics, with core products for ICCU, OBC and LDC units that support electric motor drive, power supply to electrical loads and high-voltage battery charging. It is mass-producing OBC, LDC and inverter parts and expanding into hydrogen fuel cell vehicles. Founded in 1977, it moved from home appliance parts to car parts and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

464080.text: Sos Lab develops and makes lidar sensors, which use lasers to measure distance and shape, and supplies products and solutions to the automotive, robotics and smart infrastructure industries. It is co-developing lidar modules for autonomous driving with global companies and supplies obstacle detection solutions to chip plants in Korea. Founded in 2016, it listed in 2024 as a technology growth company.

464280.text: Tdspharm is a drug delivery system (DDS) company whose main business is developing and making transdermal cataplasms and plasters, produced for drugmakers on an OEM and ODM basis. It builds on its own TDDS technologies for skin penetration, adhesive polymers and drug release, and is developing patches with systemic effects. Founded in 2002, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

464490.text: QuadMedicine is a drug delivery company built on a microneedle platform, using needles a few hundred micrometres long to deliver active ingredients, with separable, coated and particle-attached manufacturing methods. It is developing next-generation delivery by changing the form and route of approved drugs, and pursues CDMO work with drugmakers and ODM of cosmetic ingredients. Founded in 2016, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

464500.text: Iron Device is a fabless chip company that designs and sells mixed-signal SoC semiconductors, supplying high-efficiency speaker amplifiers and motor drivers for smartphones, cars and home appliances. Built on power-electronics-based mixed-signal technology, it is expanding its smart power amplifier business and working to commercialise power ICs for compound semiconductors. Founded in 2008, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

464580.text: dotmill is an immersive media entertainment technology company that produces content and supplies solutions using projection mapping, XR and holograms for business and government clients, and also runs immersive media theme parks. It handles planning, construction and operation with its own staff. Founded in 2015, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024 under a special listing track for companies that are not yet profitable.

465480.text: Inspien provides EAI implementation and operation, SAP security solutions and EDI SaaS services to corporate clients in manufacturing, finance, services and the public sector. Its new projects include automated migration from SAP PO to IS, integrated security management and cloud-based SaaS EAI. Founded in 2009 as an SAP consulting and security software firm, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024 and merged with another company in 2026.

465770.text: STX Green Logis is a shipping and logistics company focused on bulk carriers, running liner, tramp and large-vessel services and carrying bulk raw materials on Panamax-size and larger ships. It also buys and sells vessels to earn profit and manage risk. It was created in 2023 through a spin-off of STX's shipping and logistics business and relisted on the Korea Exchange the same year.

466100.text: Clobot provides robot solutions and services, developing CHAMELEON, a general-purpose autonomous driving solution, and CROMS, a fleet management and control solution for mixed robot fleets, which it supplies to robot makers. It also offers robot-based services in public spaces, daily life, logistics and manufacturing, and is expanding abroad through Clobot America Inc. Founded in 2015, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024 as a technology growth company.

466410.text: Synapsoft supplies AI, AX and DX solutions to businesses and to the public and education sectors, including OCR, document analysis and assistant tools for digital documents. It says its document viewer is used by 49 of the top 100 large business groups and that it supplies more than 9,000 companies and institutions. Founded in 2000 under an earlier name, it is listed on the KOSDAQ and is a small and venture company.

466690.text: Kiwoom Hero No.1 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

468530.text: Proteina is a biotech company whose SPID platform directly observes and quantifies protein-protein interactions at the single-molecule level, producing reliable data quickly from very small samples. Using SPID, it develops biomarkers, discovers drug candidates and is commercialising precision analysis equipment across the drug development cycle. Founded in 2015, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

468760.text: Eugene Special Purpose Acquisition 10 is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

469480.text: IBKS No.24 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

469610.text: Innotech makes combined reliability and environmental test equipment, used in developing and delivering electronics to analyse changes and defects in parts and finished products under different conditions. It develops and delivers customised test equipment for displays, semiconductors and secondary batteries, and provides maintenance. Founded in 2013, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

469750.text: Ivisionworks develops and makes inspection equipment and software for secondary battery manufacturing, covering the electrode, assembly and pack processes, and supplies battery makers, with two large Korean battery makers as major customers. It began full-scale deliveries of electrode and assembly inspection systems in 2018 and has also supplied pilot lines of overseas battery makers. Founded in 2015, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

469900.text: Hana 31 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

471820.text: Cellromax Science makes and sells health foods, cosmetics and over-the-counter medicines distributed to pharmacies in Korea, and sells health functional foods through pharmacies and online platforms. It develops products with natural ingredients sourced through global partnerships, and in 2026 it set up local units in China and Vietnam to expand overseas. Founded in 2014, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

472230.text: SK Securities No.11 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

472850.text: Pond Group is a retail-sector company created in 2023 through a spin-off from another company, and it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024. It has eight subsidiaries, including Muskat Beauty Inc. In 2024 it acquired a cosmetics distributor and a brand company.

473000.text: SK Securities No.12 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

473050.text: Yuanta 15 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

473950.text: SK Securities No.13 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

473980.text: Knowmerce is an entertainment technology company that provides integrated solutions built on artist IP. Besides direct activities such as album sales and concert promotion, it acquires rights by contract, including rights to produce content and merchandise and to use IP on fandom platforms. Founded in 2019, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024 under a special track for companies not yet profitable, and its subsidiaries include Knowmerce Japan.

474170.text: Lumir works in Earth observation satellites, covering SAR satellite systems, satellite imagery and information services, satellite electronics, and solenoids for ship engines that use space technology. The company says it was the first private firm to launch and operate a secondary payload satellite on the third launch of Korea's space rocket, and it has won a C-Band SAR system contract for a next-generation mid-sized satellite. Founded in 2009, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

474490.text: Yuanta 16 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

474610.text: RF Systems is a defence company that develops radar, antenna and environmental control systems based on dip brazing, a special metal-joining technology, and on weapon system design know-how, supplying several defence companies. It localised seeker antennas using dip brazing and has expanded into system-level work covering R&D, production, assembly, test and evaluation, and quality inspection. Founded in 2000, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

474650.text: Lincsolution makes 3D printers and provides 3D printing services, having developed and commercialised its own SLA, FDM and MBJ printers. Alongside printer sales, it produces printed parts at a large factory for industries including mobility, aerospace, defence, consumer goods and medical, and robotics and semiconductors. Founded in 2015, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025 and has a subsidiary.

474660.text: Shinhan 12th Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

474930.text: Shinhan 13th Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

475040.text: StradVision develops SVNet, AI vision software for advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) and autonomous driving, and supplies it to global carmakers and Tier-1 suppliers. It was founded in 2014 to develop deep-learning-based autonomous driving software, has drawn investment from investors including a Korean carmaker, and has 4 unlisted subsidiaries. It listed on the KOSDAQ in June 2026 as a technology growth company.

475150.text: SK eternix is a renewable energy company with a portfolio spanning solar, wind, fuel cells and ESS, and it has completed the purchase of 220MW of solar assets while pursuing more acquisitions. It was created in 2024 through a spin-off from an SK group company and listed on the KOSPI in March that year. Its subsidiaries include a solar power company and a company that jointly provides power-saving services.

475230.text: NRB is an off-site construction (OSC) company founded in 2019 by modular construction specialists from another firm. It offers relocatable and permanent modular products based on precast concrete (PC) and steel, focusing on education and housing. For schools it mainly runs a rotating rental business for movable modular units, and for housing it makes and sells PC modular dormitories and military residences.

475240.text: Hana 32 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

475250.text: Hana 33 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

475400.text: CMES Robotics is an AI robotics company offering intelligent robot solutions and inspection solutions based on 3D vision, AI and industrial robot control technology. Its intelligent robot solutions cover logistics and manufacturing, and its main customers are large companies in Korea and abroad. Founded in 2014, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024 as a technology growth company.

475430.text: Kistron mainly makes wire for electronic components, producing copper-clad steel wire and aluminium and other metal wire products. It also runs solar power facilities, selling electricity to a power utility along with RECs, and leases property in Seoul and Busan. Founded in 1992, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

475460.text: MeatBox Global runs a direct trading platform for meat and livestock products, using IT to simplify a complex distribution market, reduce information gaps and make prices more transparent. Its subsidiaries provide loans secured by meat products and import sales, and operate a HACCP processing plant. Founded in 2014 to distribute and sell livestock products, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

475560.text: The BORN Korea runs four businesses: restaurant franchising, distribution, hotels and regional development. It operates 25 restaurant brands it developed itself, in Korea and abroad, and has 8 unlisted subsidiaries. Founded in 1994, it made restaurants its main business in 2004 and listed on the KOSPI in November 2024.

475580.text: ALUX makes drones and robots, running a combined business that spans educational drones and robots, content, platforms and services, and designs key components in-house. It entered the defence market in 2025 by acquiring a defence drone company, and in 2026 diversified by setting up a subsidiary and buying a stake in another company. Founded in 2015, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

475660.text: S-chem makes fine chemical materials for displays and for biotech and pharmaceuticals. In displays it synthesises finished OLED materials and intermediates and recycles materials, while in healthcare it supplies protein purification reagents for in-vitro diagnostics (IVD) and life science research, drug intermediates made in non-GMP facilities and vitamins for animals. Founded in 2014, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

475830.text: Orum Therapeutics develops degrader-antibody conjugates (DAC), which combine ADC and targeted protein degradation (TPD) technology, and says its next-generation TPD² approach offers better efficacy and safety than existing treatments. It has a US subsidiary, Orum Therapeutics USA, Inc. Founded in 2016 for drug research and development, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025 under the technology growth company track.

475960.text: Tomocube, founded in 2015 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024 as a technology growth company, builds imaging systems based on 3D optical measurement. Its core holotomography (HT) technology uses light scattering and interference to reconstruct the 3D refractive index inside a sample, capturing internal structure without labels. It has supplied cell imaging instruments such as HT-X1 to about 200 institutions in 50 countries, including MIT.

476040.text: Organoid Sciences builds on its organoid technology with two main businesses: ATORM, organoid-based regenerative therapies for damaged tissue, and ODISEI, an organoid-based evaluation solution for new materials that makes drug development more efficient. It acquired a stake in NIPPON ORGANOID LLC to enter the Japanese market. Founded in 2018, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

476060.text: Onconic Therapeutics researches and develops small-molecule drugs for acid-related digestive diseases and cancer, areas with large unmet medical needs. Its portfolio includes a P-CAB drug approved as Korea's 37th domestically developed new drug and Nesuparib, a next-generation targeted cancer drug. Founded in 2020, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024 as a technology growth company.

476080.text: M eighty-three is a VFX company whose core business is visual effects for films, dramas and OTT content, creating virtual images with digital compositing, 3D animation and special effects. It has 9 unlisted subsidiaries, including one providing AI computing and IT infrastructure solutions and another producing advertising, brand and new-media video content. Founded in 2020, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2024.

476830.text: Rznomics develops gene therapies using its RNA replacement enzyme platform and self-circularising RNA platform, with commercialisation through technology licensing as its business model. It works on RNA editing, specifically targeting the RNA of target genes to discover treatments for cancer, genetic diseases and degenerative diseases. Founded in 2017 for gene therapy R&D, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025 as a technology growth company.

477340.text: Hmcib No.7 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

477380.text: Mirae Asset Vision Special Purpose Acquisition 4 is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

477470.text: Mirae Asset Vision Special Purpose Acquisition 5 is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

477760.text: DB Finance No.12 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

477850.text: MakinaRocks is a physical AI company built on an enterprise AI operating system, applying AI in manufacturing and defence settings where factory equipment, industrial robots and drones interact with the physical world. Its core product, Runway, manages the full AI cycle from development to deployment, operation and monitoring, and supports cloud, on-premises, edge and closed-network environments. Founded in 2017, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2026.

478110.text: Ebest Special Purpose Acquisition No6 is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

478340.text: Nara Space Technology, founded in 2015, develops, builds and operates small satellites and provides data analysis services across the satellite value chain. The company says it was the first outside North America and Europe to develop a 16U-class Earth observation small satellite with its own system technology, and its deep-learning super-resolution technology gives centimetre-level images. It reached NASA TRL 9 with the successful launch of Observer-1A in 2023.

478390.text: KB No.29 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

478440.text: Mirae Asset Vision Special Purpose Acquisition 6 is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

478560.text: Black Yak I&C makes industrial safety products and fire protection equipment: its safety division develops and makes personal protective equipment such as safety shoes and clothing, and its fire division designs, builds, installs and maintains gas fire-extinguishing systems. It is developing recycled eco safety shoes and ICT-enabled smart PPE and has invested in a video analytics company. Founded in 2013, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

479880.text: Korea No.15 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

479960.text: Winners Elec makes wiring devices such as switches and sockets, along with multi-sockets, smart wiring devices and smart distribution boxes, and has recently entered the EV charger market. It holds 103 intellectual property rights, including 56 patents, and focuses on product safety and design. Founded in 2004, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

480370.text: CK Solution designs and builds dry room, clean room and dehumidification room systems used in secondary batteries, biotech, semiconductors and other advanced industries, and for the Far East District of the US Army Corps of Engineers (FED). It is expanding globally through overseas units and branches in Poland, Hungary, Malaysia and the US. Founded in 2004 for mechanical installation work and manufacturing, it listed on the KOSPI in 2025.

481070.text: Au Brandz is a fashion and lifestyle company. In 2010 it brought a brand into Korea through a partnership with the UK's ZENNAR LTD, acquired its trademark and business rights in 2013, rebranded it as a weatherwear label in 2020 and bought a stake in ZENNAR LIMITED in 2024 to reorganise its global business. It was created in 2022 through a spin-off of another company's brand division and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

481850.text: Shinhan Global Active REIT is a real estate investment company listed on the KOSPI. It invests in property and pays shareholders dividends from the income, rather than running an operating business.

481890.text: NH Special Purpose Acquisition 31 is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

482520.text: Kyobo 16 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

482630.text: Samyang NC Chem makes fine chemical materials for semiconductors, producing materials used in lithography and cleaning processes and supplying photoresists for NAND, DRAM and foundry production. Its lithography materials portfolio covers KrF, ArF and EUV, and it is raising the share of higher-value products, including EUV materials. Founded in 2008, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

482680.text: Mirae Asset Vision Special Purpose Acquisition 7 is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

482690.text: Daishin Balance No.19 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

483350.text: Dealicious runs a wholesale marketing platform for wholesalers and a retail business solution for retailers, both built on its online market service. The wholesale platform consists of online advertising and subscription advertising, while the retail solution offers purchasing-agent services and a subscription service. Founded on 24 January 2011, it listed on the KOSDAQ on 12 August 2026.

483650.text: d'Alba Global specialises in vegan cosmetics and health functional foods. Its d'Alba brand sells low-irritation products built around white truffle, and its Veganery brand offers premium vegan inner-beauty products based on plant collagen. It launched d'Alba Signature in 2024, and was founded in 2016 and listed on the KOSPI in 2025.

484120.text: Dowooinsys mainly makes UTG for foldable smartphones, supplying it as a first-tier supplier to a large display maker for a global foldable phone series and to other global manufacturers. It has finished developing large-area UTG for laptops due in 2027 and is diversifying into glass substrates for cars and semiconductors. Founded in 2010 to develop, make and sell UTG, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

484130.text: Hana Thirty-four Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

484590.text: Samyang Comtech makes protection systems for weapons, including K2 tank armour, protection kits for small vehicles and ballistic parts for aircraft, and says it is Korea's only protection specialist able to handle everything from materials development to testing. It gained KOLAS accreditation for ballistics in 2013 and is moving into semiconductors and aerospace with high-purity ceramics. Founded in 1962 and designated a defence contractor in 1973, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

484810.text: TXR Robotics provides robot and logistics automation solutions. Its logistics division offers turnkey systems with intelligent equipment such as wheel sorters and flap sorters, supplying Korean logistics companies and exporting to Europe, South America and the US, while its robot division offers AMR and manipulator-based automation and is pursuing fire-fighting and cleaning robots. Founded in 2017, it absorbed a subsidiary in 2024 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

484870.text: MNC Solution develops drive stabilisation and precision control technology for the defence industry and has been a designated defence contractor since 1974. Its R&D covers electric drive units, space and aerospace, and laser precision drive units. It was created in 2020 through a split from its former parent, took its current name in 2023 after a spin-off involving the hydraulics business, and listed on the KOSPI in 2024.

486630.text: KB No.30 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

486990.text: Nota is an AI model optimisation company whose core platform, NetsPresso, helps large AI models run efficiently and links model analysis through to deployment in a single workflow. It works with global chip and technology companies such as Arm, Samsung, NVIDIA and AWS to widen use of its optimisation toolchain. Founded in 2015, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025 and set up a unit in the UAE in 2026.

487360.text: Shinhan 14th Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

487400.text: KNS Space and Defence mainly designs, makes and sells maritime and military satellite communication antennas and provides integrated antenna solutions for satellite communication infrastructure. Drawing on about 25 years of experience, it supplies commercial VSAT and TVRO products and has moved into military antennas, starting with a navy maritime satellite communication programme. It is also developing ESA flat-panel antennas to enter low-earth-orbit satellite communications.

487570.text: HS Hyosung is a holding company under Korea's fair trade law, created in 2024 through a spin-off from Hyosung. It controls 4 subsidiaries, and HS Hyosung USA, Inc. is a major consolidated subsidiary. Its main business is managing and investing in its subsidiaries' shares, and it also runs a freight forwarding business directly.

487580.text: Poled develops and sells baby products, including car seats, ventilated and heated seats for strollers and bouncers, baby appliances such as bottle sterilisers and formula makers, and baby skincare and cleansing products. It was set up in 2019 as a spin-off from a carmaker and has 3 subsidiaries. It listed on the KOSDAQ in May 2026.

487720.text: Kiwoom No.10 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

487830.text: Shinhan 15th Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

488060.text: Eugene Special Purpose Acquisition 11 is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

488280.text: S2W provides AI data intelligence solutions, using knowledge-graph technology to cross-analyse big data across multiple domains, and supplies international public institutions and large companies. It recently set up a Japanese subsidiary to build sales and distribution in Japan. Founded in 2018, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025 as a technology growth company.

488900.text: Vitzro Nextech was created in 2016 through a split of the aerospace, fusion energy, accelerator and plasma businesses of a Vitzro group company. It supplies engine components for Korea's space launch vehicle, builds devices for the KSTAR and ITER fusion reactors, and designs and makes accelerator parts. It is pursuing reusable launch vehicle technology, lunar exploration engines, upgraded tungsten plasma-facing components, klystron localisation and nuclear plant decommissioning.

489210.text: Kyobo 17 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

489460.text: Biobijou is an aesthetics company that researches, makes and sells hyaluronic acid-based skin boosters and fillers under three brands. It also does OEM contract manufacturing, is the exclusive distributor of an ECM skin reviser product and sells cosmeceutical cosmetics. Founded in 2018, it completed a production plant in 2020 and set up a research centre in 2021.

489480.text: Kiwoom No.11 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

489500.text: LK Chem develops, makes and sells chemical materials for semiconductor thin-film deposition, including precursors and ligands, and holds high-k and low-k materials and perovskite photovoltaic materials. It says it holds Korea's only process patent for making PCP, and its new R&D includes localising HfCl4 and developing perovskite materials for tandem top cells. Founded in 2007, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025.

489730.text: DB Finance No.13 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

489790.text: Hanwha Vision runs security and industrial equipment businesses: the security division provides global video security solutions built on optical design and image processing technology, and the industrial equipment division makes SMT equipment, semiconductor equipment and machine tools. It was created in 2024 through a spin-off from a Hanwha group company, and in 2025 it merged with the former Hanwha Vision to run the security business directly as an operating holding company.

490470.text: SemiFive provides semiconductor design services and was founded in 2019 with the aim of making system chips cheaper and faster to develop. It offers turnkey design engineering for custom chips, covering everything from specification and layout design to production management and back-end processing. It turns skilled engineers' design work into digital assets and uses automation algorithms to deliver chips quickly and economically.

491000.text: LivsMed makes laparoscopic instruments for minimally invasive surgery, focusing on handheld multi-joint laparoscopic instruments based on its own multi-joint technology. It has commercialised ArtiSential and ArtiSeal and is developing ArtiStapler, LivsCam and the STARK surgical robot, aiming to offer a full minimally invasive surgery solution. Founded in 2011, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025 as a technology growth company.

492220.text: KB No.31 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

493280.text: IMBiologics develops antibody drugs for autoimmune diseases and immuno-oncology based on its IM-OpDECon antibody modality technology, and can handle the full drug development cycle in-house. It has licensed its main pipeline candidates, IMB-101 and IMB-102, in the US, and has received external certifications such as NET. Founded in 2020, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2026 as a technology growth company.

493330.text: GFI makes and sells fire extinguishers and does fire protection installation work. The company says it was the world's first to microencapsulate the FK-5-1-12 extinguishing agent, sold in various products under the AEGIS name, and that the unpowered automatic detection system has a malfunction rate of almost 0% and installs without extra wiring or piping. Founded in 2014, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2026 through a merger with a special purpose acquisition company.

493790.text: Yuanta 17 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

494120.text: Curiosis develops and sells bio research equipment, lab automation products and medical devices, with main products including the Celloger live-cell imaging system, the Cellpuri cell concentration and blood component separation system and the MSP digital pathology system. It completed a plant expansion in 2026 to increase production capacity. Founded in 2015, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025 as a technology growth company.

496070.text: Shinhan 16th Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

498390.text: Hanwha Plus No 5 Special Purpose Acquisition is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) listed on the KOSDAQ. It was set up to merge with an unlisted company and has no operating business of its own until a merger is completed.

499790.text: GS P&L is a holding company created in 2024 through a spin-off from a GS group retailer, with two subsidiaries and one second-tier subsidiary. Its main subsidiary is a hotel company with 40 years of experience running five-star hotels, operating a premium luxury five-star hotel, 6 business hotels, a tower and a mall.

900070.text: Global SM Tech is a pure holding company set up in 2008 in the Cayman Islands, wholly owning 4 subsidiaries with production units in China and elsewhere. Its subsidiaries make fastening parts such as screws, shafts and springs for global companies. It entered the European auto parts market in 2015 by acquiring Spain's Industrias Gol S.A.U., and in 2025 its Vietnam unit took another local unit as a subsidiary.

900100.text: Phionx has apparel and cannabis businesses: its apparel division distributes men's and women's clothing at wholesale in the US, and its cannabis division sells at retail and wholesale through its own brand, holding licences for the whole process from cultivation to sale. Founded in 1978, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2010 and adopted its current name in 2026.

900110.text: Deep Commerce is a holding company set up in Hong Kong in 2009 that runs fashion brand and commerce businesses through its Chinese subsidiaries. It operates its own brands, including ZAPPY, handling the planning, design, production, distribution and sale of shoes, clothing and fashion accessories. It is expanding its market share mainly in China's second- and third-tier cities and working to build an AI-based fashion and commerce ecosystem.

900120.text: CXI Healthcare Technology Group was set up in 2009 as a holding company in the Cayman Islands and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2010. Through its subsidiaries it makes and sells health foods in China, including health functional foods based on herbal medicine ingredients under its own brand, and also runs raw material distribution and cosmetics businesses.

900140.text: LVMC Holdings is an offshore holding company set up in the Cayman Islands in 2009 to list its Laos-based operating subsidiary on the KOSPI. Centred on Laos, Vietnam and Myanmar, it sells completely built cars, assembles and sells SKD/CKD vehicles, and sells auto parts and after-sales service. The company says exclusive distribution rights for two car brands and two further dealerships make it the only full-line supplier in Laos.

900250.text: China Crystal New Material Holdings is a non-financial holding company set up in the Cayman Islands in 2012 for an overseas listing. Its main business is producing and selling synthetic mica flakes and pearlescent pigments for industries including automotive paint, cosmetics and power. In 2025 it acquired 100% of GeneVision AI Technology Holdings Ltd. through a contribution in kind.

900260.text: Rothwell International is a holding company set up in Hong Kong in 2014. Its two subsidiaries research, develop and make CAN-based vehicle electronic systems and make and sell home information and communication terminals, with products including CAN gateways, CAN display modules and dual-system GPS driving recorders. Based on its IoV platform technology, it is developing connected car and autonomous driving solutions.

900270.text: Heng Sheng Holding Group designs, develops, produces and sells its own toys, mainly branded plush toys, electric toys and animation toys, and is also entering the mask business. The holding company was set up in Hong Kong in 1995, its main toy subsidiary was founded in China in 1992, and it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2016. Its subsidiaries include HS BEAUTY.

900290.text: Great Rich Technologies is a non-financial holding company set up in Hong Kong in 2012 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2016. Through its operating subsidiary it develops, makes and sells packaging films and optical protective films, including PE amorphous protective films and 3D display optical films. It has 4 business areas, including precision coated adhesive and protective materials, functional coatings and polymer thin films.

900300.text: Organic Tea Cosmetics Holdings is a non-financial holding company set up in Hong Kong in 2012 that operates through subsidiaries, with footwear and cosmetics sales as its core businesses, mainly in China and Indonesia. It set up an Indonesian subsidiary in 2024 to expand abroad, and in 2025 set up Organic Gaohang Tea Co.,Ltd. to earn returns from equity investments.

900310.text: Coloray International Investment is a holding company set up in Hong Kong in 2013, and its operating subsidiary was founded in 2008. It researches, develops, makes and sells pearlescent pigments for cosmetics and industrial use, and makes and sells mica powder and synthetic mica. It listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017 and has four subsidiaries.

900340.text: Wing Yip Food Holdings Group is a meat processor that dries, smokes, cures and cooks pork and poultry to make traditional foods such as salami, bacon and cured meat, as well as convenience sausages and frozen foods. The holding company was set up in Hong Kong in 2015 for an overseas listing, and its main operating subsidiary was founded in 2010. It also has subsidiaries set up in 2020 and 2025.

950130.text: Access Bio is an in-vitro diagnostics company set up in the US in 2002 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2013. Its main diagnostics business develops, makes and sells rapid diagnostic tests (RDT) for infectious diseases such as malaria, COVID-19 and flu, along with molecular diagnostics and biosensor products. It has 6 subsidiaries and recently expanded into medical aesthetics by acquiring a stake in one of them.

950140.text: Englewood Lab is a US-based cosmetics ODM/OEM company that makes skincare, functional cosmetics and colour cosmetics. It offers a one-stop service that includes consulting on FDA regulatory compliance and quality control. Founded in 2015, it merged with a related company in 2017 and has a subsidiary for entering Korea and other Asian markets.

950160.text: Kolon TissueGene is a foreign-incorporated company whose main business is developing cell and gene therapies based on its TG-C platform, including a phase 3 FDA clinical trial for knee osteoarthritis, and it has also gained clinical trial approval for other diseases. It also runs health and beauty and liquor and beverage businesses. Founded in 1999, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2017 and operates with several affiliates in Korea and abroad.

950170.text: JTC sells duty-free goods to foreign tourists visiting Japan, with a network of 23 stores on major tourist routes and in major tourist regions. It started in 1993 as an electrical goods seller in Japan, became a corporation in 1994 and began retailing to foreign travellers, taking its current name in 2015. It listed on the KOSDAQ in 2018 and has a consolidated subsidiary.

950190.text: Ghost Studio is a mobile game software company set up in Hong Kong in 2016 that runs more than 25 slot games and 10 solitaire games across various platforms, and publishes webtoons and web novels through subsidiaries. It has 9 subsidiaries, including development units in China, and expanded by acquiring companies in 2023 and 2024. It listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020.

950200.text: Psomagen is a genome analysis company set up in the US in 2004 and listed on the KOSDAQ in 2020. Its core businesses are Sanger-based CES and next-generation sequencing (NGS) services, provided to national institutions such as the NIH, universities and global drugmakers. It recently sold part of its stake in KEAN Health Corp., which is no longer a consolidated subsidiary.

950210.text: Prestige BioPharma is a biopharmaceutical company set up in Singapore in 2015 and listed on the KOSPI in 2021. It focuses on research and development of new antibody drugs and biosimilars, and has gained European marketing approval for one of its biosimilars. It is developing other major pipeline candidates and next-generation antibody drugs, and is adopting AI-based digital technology and strategic partnerships.

950220.text: NeoImmuneTech develops T cell-based immunotherapies, with NT-I7, a long-acting IL-7 T cell amplifier, as its core pipeline, alongside next-generation immuno-oncology candidates built on a Heterodimer Fc platform. It holds exclusive North American licence and distribution rights for a rare disease treatment, which it sells across the US. Set up in the US in 2014, it listed on the KOSDAQ in 2021 under the technology growth company track.

950250.text: Teraview Holdings PLC is a holding company set up in 2024, which made TeraView Limited its subsidiary through a share exchange that year. TeraView Limited, founded in 2001, uses terahertz-frequency non-destructive inspection and measurement technology in equipment for the semiconductor, automotive and secondary battery industries. The company listed on the KOSDAQ in 2025 as a technology growth company.

950260.text: Ingenia Therapeutics develops antibody drug candidates through its own research, aiming to take them through early clinical trials and then license them out to global drugmakers and other partners. Its two core technologies are the LCIDEC platform and TIE body. Target diseases include retinal eye diseases, glaucoma, chronic kidney disease, cardiovascular diseases such as heart attack, arterial diseases such as atherosclerosis, and brain diseases such as stroke and dementia.
